entries.a: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تَسْـَٔلُوا۟ عَنْ أَشْيَآءَ إِن تُبْدَ لَكُمْ تَسُؤْكُمْ وَإِن تَسْـَٔلُوا۟ عَنْهَا حِينَ يُنَزَّلُ ٱلْقُرْءَانُ تُبْدَ لَكُمْ عَفَا ٱللَّهُ عَنْهَا ۗ وَٱللَّهُ غَفُورٌ حَلِيمٌۭ
entries.t: O you who believe! Do not ask about things that would trouble you if disclosed to you. But if you were to ask about them while the Quran is being revealed, they will become obvious to you. God forgives that. God is Forgiving and Clement.
entries.na: يايها الذين امنوا لا تسلوا عن اشيا ان تبد لكم تسوكم وان تسلوا عنها حين ينزل القران تبد لكم عفا الله عنها والله غفور حليم
entries.nt: o you who believe do not ask about things that would trouble you if disclosed to you but if you were to ask about them while the quran is being revealed they will become obvious to you god forgives that god is forgiving and clement

entries.a: قَدْ سَأَلَهَا قَوْمٌۭ مِّن قَبْلِكُمْ ثُمَّ أَصْبَحُوا۟ بِهَا كَٰفِرِينَ
entries.t: A people before you asked about them, but then came to reject them.
entries.na: قد سالها قوم من قبلكم ثم اصبحوا بها كفرين
entries.nt: a people before you asked about them but then came to reject them

entries.a: مَا جَعَلَ ٱللَّهُ مِنۢ بَحِيرَةٍۢ وَلَا سَآئِبَةٍۢ وَلَا وَصِيلَةٍۢ وَلَا حَامٍۢ ۙ وَلَٰكِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ يَفْتَرُونَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ٱلْكَذِبَ ۖ وَأَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْقِلُونَ
entries.t: God did not institute the superstitions of Bahirah, Saibah, Wasilah, or of Hami; but those who disbelieve fabricate lies about God-most of them do not understand.
entries.na: ما جعل الله من بحيره ولا سايبه ولا وصيله ولا حام ولكن الذين كفروا يفترون علي الله الكذب واكثرهم لا يعقلون
entries.nt: god did not institute the superstitions of bahirah saibah wasilah or of hami but those who disbelieve fabricate lies about god most of them do not understand

entries.a: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ تَعَالَوْا۟ إِلَىٰ مَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ وَإِلَى ٱلرَّسُولِ قَالُوا۟ حَسْبُنَا مَا وَجَدْنَا عَلَيْهِ ءَابَآءَنَآ ۚ أَوَلَوْ كَانَ ءَابَآؤُهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ شَيْـًۭٔا وَلَا يَهْتَدُونَ
entries.t: And when it is said to them, "Come to what God has revealed, and to the Messenger," they say, "Sufficient for us is what we found our forefathers upon." Even if their forefathers knew nothing, and were not guided?
entries.na: واذا قيل لهم تعالوا الي ما انزل الله والي الرسول قالوا حسبنا ما وجدنا عليه ابانا اولو كان اباوهم لا يعلمون شيا ولا يهتدون
entries.nt: and when it is said to them come to what god has revealed and to the messenger they say sufficient for us is what we found our forefathers upon even if their forefathers knew nothing and were not guided

entries.a: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ عَلَيْكُمْ أَنفُسَكُمْ ۖ لَا يَضُرُّكُم مَّن ضَلَّ إِذَا ٱهْتَدَيْتُمْ ۚ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ مَرْجِعُكُمْ جَمِيعًۭا فَيُنَبِّئُكُم بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
entries.t: O you who believe! You are responsible for your own souls. He who has strayed cannot harm you if you are guided. To God is you return, all of you, and He will inform you of what you used to do.
entries.na: يايها الذين امنوا عليكم انفسكم لا يضركم من ضل اذا اهتديتم الي الله مرجعكم جميعا فينبيكم بما كنتم تعملون
entries.nt: o you who believe you are responsible for your own souls he who has strayed cannot harm you if you are guided to god is you return all of you and he will inform you of what you used to do

entries.a: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ شَهَٰدَةُ بَيْنِكُمْ إِذَا حَضَرَ أَحَدَكُمُ ٱلْمَوْتُ حِينَ ٱلْوَصِيَّةِ ٱثْنَانِ ذَوَا عَدْلٍۢ مِّنكُمْ أَوْ ءَاخَرَانِ مِنْ غَيْرِكُمْ إِنْ أَنتُمْ ضَرَبْتُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَأَصَٰبَتْكُم مُّصِيبَةُ ٱلْمَوْتِ ۚ تَحْبِسُونَهُمَا مِنۢ بَعْدِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةِ فَيُقْسِمَانِ بِٱللَّهِ إِنِ ٱرْتَبْتُمْ لَا نَشْتَرِى بِهِۦ ثَمَنًۭا وَلَوْ كَانَ ذَا قُرْبَىٰ ۙ وَلَا نَكْتُمُ شَهَٰدَةَ ٱللَّهِ إِنَّآ إِذًۭا لَّمِنَ ٱلْءَاثِمِينَ
entries.t: O you who believe! When death approaches one of you, let two reliable persons from among you act as witnesses to the making of a bequest, or two persons from another people if you are travelling in the land and the event of death approaches you. Engage them after the prayer. If you have doubts, let them swear by God: "We will not sell our testimony for any price, even if he was a near relative, and we will not conceal God's testimony, for then we would be sinners."
entries.na: يايها الذين امنوا شهده بينكم اذا حضر احدكم الموت حين الوصيه اثنان ذوا عدل منكم او اخران من غيركم ان انتم ضربتم في الارض فاصبتكم مصيبه الموت تحبسونهما من بعد الصلوه فيقسمان بالله ان ارتبتم لا نشتري به ثمنا ولو كان ذا قربي ولا نكتم شهده الله انا اذا لمن الاثمين
entries.nt: o you who believe when death approaches one of you let two reliable persons from among you act as witnesses to the making of a bequest or two persons from another people if you are travelling in the land and the event of death approaches you engage them after the prayer if you have doubts let them swear by god we will not sell our testimony for any price even if he was a near relative and we will not conceal god s testimony for then we would be sinners

entries.a: فَإِنْ عُثِرَ عَلَىٰٓ أَنَّهُمَا ٱسْتَحَقَّآ إِثْمًۭا فَـَٔاخَرَانِ يَقُومَانِ مَقَامَهُمَا مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱسْتَحَقَّ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْأَوْلَيَٰنِ فَيُقْسِمَانِ بِٱللَّهِ لَشَهَٰدَتُنَآ أَحَقُّ مِن شَهَٰدَتِهِمَا وَمَا ٱعْتَدَيْنَآ إِنَّآ إِذًۭا لَّمِنَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
entries.t: If it is discovered that they are guilty of perjury: let two others take their place, two from among those responsible for the claim, and have them swear by God, "Our testimony is more truthful than their testimony, and we will not be biased, for then we would be wrongdoers."
entries.na: فان عثر علي انهما استحقا اثما فاخران يقومان مقامهما من الذين استحق عليهم الاولين فيقسمان بالله لشهدتنا احق من شهدتهما وما اعتدينا انا اذا لمن الظلمين
entries.nt: if it is discovered that they are guilty of perjury let two others take their place two from among those responsible for the claim and have them swear by god our testimony is more truthful than their testimony and we will not be biased for then we would be wrongdoers

entries.a: ذَٰلِكَ أَدْنَىٰٓ أَن يَأْتُوا۟ بِٱلشَّهَٰدَةِ عَلَىٰ وَجْهِهَآ أَوْ يَخَافُوٓا۟ أَن تُرَدَّ أَيْمَٰنٌۢ بَعْدَ أَيْمَٰنِهِمْ ۗ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱسْمَعُوا۟ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ لَا يَهْدِى ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلْفَٰسِقِينَ
entries.t: That makes it more likely that they will give true testimony, fearing that their oaths might be contradicted by subsequent oaths. So fear God, and listen. God does not guide the disobedient people.
entries.na: ذلك ادني ان ياتوا بالشهده علي وجهها او يخافوا ان ترد ايمن بعد ايمنهم واتقوا الله واسمعوا والله لا يهدي القوم الفسقين
entries.nt: that makes it more likely that they will give true testimony fearing that their oaths might be contradicted by subsequent oaths so fear god and listen god does not guide the disobedient people

entries.a: ۞ يَوْمَ يَجْمَعُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلرُّسُلَ فَيَقُولُ مَاذَآ أُجِبْتُمْ ۖ قَالُوا۟ لَا عِلْمَ لَنَآ ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ عَلَّٰمُ ٱلْغُيُوبِ
entries.t: On the Day when God will gather the messengers, then say, "What response were you given?" They will say, "We have no knowledge; it is you who are the Knower of the unseen."
entries.na: يوم يجمع الله الرسل فيقول ماذا اجبتم قالوا لا علم لنا انك انت علم الغيوب
entries.nt: on the day when god will gather the messengers then say what response were you given they will say we have no knowledge it is you who are the knower of the unseen

entries.a: إِذْ قَالَ ٱللَّهُ يَٰعِيسَى ٱبْنَ مَرْيَمَ ٱذْكُرْ نِعْمَتِى عَلَيْكَ وَعَلَىٰ وَٰلِدَتِكَ إِذْ أَيَّدتُّكَ بِرُوحِ ٱلْقُدُسِ تُكَلِّمُ ٱلنَّاسَ فِى ٱلْمَهْدِ وَكَهْلًۭا ۖ وَإِذْ عَلَّمْتُكَ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ وَٱلْحِكْمَةَ وَٱلتَّوْرَىٰةَ وَٱلْإِنجِيلَ ۖ وَإِذْ تَخْلُقُ مِنَ ٱلطِّينِ كَهَيْـَٔةِ ٱلطَّيْرِ بِإِذْنِى فَتَنفُخُ فِيهَا فَتَكُونُ طَيْرًۢا بِإِذْنِى ۖ وَتُبْرِئُ ٱلْأَكْمَهَ وَٱلْأَبْرَصَ بِإِذْنِى ۖ وَإِذْ تُخْرِجُ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ بِإِذْنِى ۖ وَإِذْ كَفَفْتُ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ عَنكَ إِذْ جِئْتَهُم بِٱلْبَيِّنَٰتِ فَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ إِنْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحْرٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
entries.t: When God will say, "O Jesus son of Mary, recall My favor upon you and upon your mother, how I supported you with the Holy Spirit. You spoke to the people from the crib, and in maturity. How I taught you the Scripture and wisdom, and the Torah and the Gospel. And recall that you molded from clay the shape of a bird, by My leave, and then you breathed into it, and it became a bird, by My leave. And you healed the blind and the leprous, by My leave; and you revived the dead, by My leave. And recall that I restrained the Children of Israel from you when you brought them the clear miracles. But those who disbelieved among them said, `This is nothing but obvious sorcery.'"
entries.na: اذ قال الله يعيسي ابن مريم اذكر نعمتي عليك وعلي ولدتك اذ ايدتك بروح القدس تكلم الناس في المهد وكهلا واذ علمتك الكتب والحكمه والتوريه والانجيل واذ تخلق من الطين كهيه الطير باذني فتنفخ فيها فتكون طيرا باذني وتبري الاكمه والابرص باذني واذ تخرج الموتي باذني واذ كففت بني اسريل عنك اذ جيتهم بالبينت فقال الذين كفروا منهم ان هذا الا سحر مبين
entries.nt: when god will say o jesus son of mary recall my favor upon you and upon your mother how i supported you with the holy spirit you spoke to the people from the crib and in maturity how i taught you the scripture and wisdom and the torah and the gospel and recall that you molded from clay the shape of a bird by my leave and then you breathed into it and it became a bird by my leave and you healed the blind and the leprous by my leave and you revived the dead by my leave and recall that i restrained the children of israel from you when you brought them the clear miracles but those who disbelieved among them said this is nothing but obvious sorcery

entries.a: وَإِذْ أَوْحَيْتُ إِلَى ٱلْحَوَارِيِّۦنَ أَنْ ءَامِنُوا۟ بِى وَبِرَسُولِى قَالُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا وَٱشْهَدْ بِأَنَّنَا مُسْلِمُونَ
entries.t: "And when I inspired the disciples: `Believe in Me and in My Messenger.' They said, `We have believed, so bear witness that We have submitted.'"
entries.na: واذ اوحيت الي الحوارين ان امنوا بي وبرسولي قالوا امنا واشهد باننا مسلمون
entries.nt: and when i inspired the disciples believe in me and in my messenger they said we have believed so bear witness that we have submitted

entries.a: إِذْ قَالَ ٱلْحَوَارِيُّونَ يَٰعِيسَى ٱبْنَ مَرْيَمَ هَلْ يَسْتَطِيعُ رَبُّكَ أَن يُنَزِّلَ عَلَيْنَا مَآئِدَةًۭ مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ ۖ قَالَ ٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
entries.t: "And when the disciples said, 'O Jesus son of Mary, is your Lord able to bring down for us a feast from heaven?' He said, 'Fear God, if you are believers.'"
entries.na: اذ قال الحواريون يعيسي ابن مريم هل يستطيع ربك ان ينزل علينا مايده من السما قال اتقوا الله ان كنتم مومنين
entries.nt: and when the disciples said o jesus son of mary is your lord able to bring down for us a feast from heaven he said fear god if you are believers

entries.a: قَالُوا۟ نُرِيدُ أَن نَّأْكُلَ مِنْهَا وَتَطْمَئِنَّ قُلُوبُنَا وَنَعْلَمَ أَن قَدْ صَدَقْتَنَا وَنَكُونَ عَلَيْهَا مِنَ ٱلشَّٰهِدِينَ
entries.t: They said, "We wish to eat from it, so that our hearts may be reassured, and know that you have told us the truth, and be among those who witness it."
entries.na: قالوا نريد ان ناكل منها وتطمين قلوبنا ونعلم ان قد صدقتنا ونكون عليها من الشهدين
entries.nt: they said we wish to eat from it so that our hearts may be reassured and know that you have told us the truth and be among those who witness it

entries.a: قَالَ عِيسَى ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ ٱللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَآ أَنزِلْ عَلَيْنَا مَآئِدَةًۭ مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ تَكُونُ لَنَا عِيدًۭا لِّأَوَّلِنَا وَءَاخِرِنَا وَءَايَةًۭ مِّنكَ ۖ وَٱرْزُقْنَا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ ٱلرَّٰزِقِينَ
entries.t: Jesus son of Mary said, "O God, our Lord, send down for us a table from heaven, to be a festival for us, for the first of us, and the last of us, and a sign from You; and provide for us; You are the Best of providers."
entries.na: قال عيسي ابن مريم اللهم ربنا انزل علينا مايده من السما تكون لنا عيدا لاولنا واخرنا وايه منك وارزقنا وانت خير الرزقين
entries.nt: jesus son of mary said o god our lord send down for us a table from heaven to be a festival for us for the first of us and the last of us and a sign from you and provide for us you are the best of providers

entries.a: قَالَ ٱللَّهُ إِنِّى مُنَزِّلُهَا عَلَيْكُمْ ۖ فَمَن يَكْفُرْ بَعْدُ مِنكُمْ فَإِنِّىٓ أُعَذِّبُهُۥ عَذَابًۭا لَّآ أُعَذِّبُهُۥٓ أَحَدًۭا مِّنَ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
entries.t: God said, "I will send it down to you. But whoever among you disbelieves thereafter, I will punish him with a punishment the like of which I never punish any other being."
entries.na: قال الله اني منزلها عليكم فمن يكفر بعد منكم فاني اعذبه عذابا لا اعذبه احدا من العلمين
entries.nt: god said i will send it down to you but whoever among you disbelieves thereafter i will punish him with a punishment the like of which i never punish any other being

entries.a: وَإِذْ قَالَ ٱللَّهُ يَٰعِيسَى ٱبْنَ مَرْيَمَ ءَأَنتَ قُلْتَ لِلنَّاسِ ٱتَّخِذُونِى وَأُمِّىَ إِلَٰهَيْنِ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ قَالَ سُبْحَٰنَكَ مَا يَكُونُ لِىٓ أَنْ أَقُولَ مَا لَيْسَ لِى بِحَقٍّ ۚ إِن كُنتُ قُلْتُهُۥ فَقَدْ عَلِمْتَهُۥ ۚ تَعْلَمُ مَا فِى نَفْسِى وَلَآ أَعْلَمُ مَا فِى نَفْسِكَ ۚ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ عَلَّٰمُ ٱلْغُيُوبِ
entries.t: And God will say, "O Jesus son of Mary, did you say to the people, `Take me and my mother as gods rather than God?'" He will say, "Glory be to You! It is not for me to say what I have no right to. Had I said it, You would have known it. You know what is in my soul, and I do not know what is in your soul. You are the Knower of the hidden.
entries.na: واذ قال الله يعيسي ابن مريم انت قلت للناس اتخذوني وامي الهين من دون الله قال سبحنك ما يكون لي ان اقول ما ليس لي بحق ان كنت قلته فقد علمته تعلم ما في نفسي ولا اعلم ما في نفسك انك انت علم الغيوب
entries.nt: and god will say o jesus son of mary did you say to the people take me and my mother as gods rather than god he will say glory be to you it is not for me to say what i have no right to had i said it you would have known it you know what is in my soul and i do not know what is in your soul you are the knower of the hidden

entries.a: مَا قُلْتُ لَهُمْ إِلَّا مَآ أَمَرْتَنِى بِهِۦٓ أَنِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ رَبِّى وَرَبَّكُمْ ۚ وَكُنتُ عَلَيْهِمْ شَهِيدًۭا مَّا دُمْتُ فِيهِمْ ۖ فَلَمَّا تَوَفَّيْتَنِى كُنتَ أَنتَ ٱلرَّقِيبَ عَلَيْهِمْ ۚ وَأَنتَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ شَهِيدٌ
entries.t: I only told them what You commanded me: that you shall worship God, my Lord and your Lord. And I was a witness over them while I was among them; but when You took me to Yourself, you became the Watcher over them-You are Witness over everything.
entries.na: ما قلت لهم الا ما امرتني به ان اعبدوا الله ربي وربكم وكنت عليهم شهيدا ما دمت فيهم فلما توفيتني كنت انت الرقيب عليهم وانت علي كل شي شهيد
entries.nt: i only told them what you commanded me that you shall worship god my lord and your lord and i was a witness over them while i was among them but when you took me to yourself you became the watcher over them you are witness over everything

entries.a: إِن تُعَذِّبْهُمْ فَإِنَّهُمْ عِبَادُكَ ۖ وَإِن تَغْفِرْ لَهُمْ فَإِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
entries.t: If You punish them, they are Your servants; but if You forgive them, You are the Mighty and Wise."
entries.na: ان تعذبهم فانهم عبادك وان تغفر لهم فانك انت العزيز الحكيم
entries.nt: if you punish them they are your servants but if you forgive them you are the mighty and wise

entries.a: قَالَ ٱللَّهُ هَٰذَا يَوْمُ يَنفَعُ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ صِدْقُهُمْ ۚ لَهُمْ جَنَّٰتٌۭ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدًۭا ۚ رَّضِىَ ٱللَّهُ عَنْهُمْ وَرَضُوا۟ عَنْهُ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ
entries.t: God will say, "This is a Day when the truthful will benefit from their truthfulness." They will have Gardens beneath which rivers flow, wherein they will remain forever. God is pleased with them, and they are pleased with Him. That is the great attainment.
entries.na: قال الله هذا يوم ينفع الصدقين صدقهم لهم جنت تجري من تحتها الانهر خلدين فيها ابدا رضي الله عنهم ورضوا عنه ذلك الفوز العظيم
entries.nt: god will say this is a day when the truthful will benefit from their truthfulness they will have gardens beneath which rivers flow wherein they will remain forever god is pleased with them and they are pleased with him that is the great attainment

entries.a: لِلَّهِ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا فِيهِنَّ ۚ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ قَدِيرٌۢ
entries.t: To God belongs the sovereignty of the heavens and the earth and what lies in them, and He has power over everything.
entries.na: لله ملك السموت والارض وما فيهن وهو علي كل شي قدير
entries.nt: to god belongs the sovereignty of the heavens and the earth and what lies in them and he has power over everything

entries.a: ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَجَعَلَ ٱلظُّلُمَٰتِ وَٱلنُّورَ ۖ ثُمَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِرَبِّهِمْ يَعْدِلُونَ
entries.t: Praise be to God, Who created the heavens and the earth, and made the darkness and the light. Yet those who disbelieve ascribe equals to their Lord.
entries.na: الحمد لله الذي خلق السموت والارض وجعل الظلمت والنور ثم الذين كفروا بربهم يعدلون
entries.nt: praise be to god who created the heavens and the earth and made the darkness and the light yet those who disbelieve ascribe equals to their lord

entries.a: هُوَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَكُم مِّن طِينٍۢ ثُمَّ قَضَىٰٓ أَجَلًۭا ۖ وَأَجَلٌۭ مُّسَمًّى عِندَهُۥ ۖ ثُمَّ أَنتُمْ تَمْتَرُونَ
entries.t: It is He who created you from clay, then decided a term-a term determined by him. Yet you doubt.
entries.na: هو الذي خلقكم من طين ثم قضي اجلا واجل مسمي عنده ثم انتم تمترون
entries.nt: it is he who created you from clay then decided a term a term determined by him yet you doubt

entries.a: وَهُوَ ٱللَّهُ فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَفِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ يَعْلَمُ سِرَّكُمْ وَجَهْرَكُمْ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا تَكْسِبُونَ
entries.t: He is God in the heavens and the earth. He knows what you keep secret and what you make public; and He knows what you earn.
entries.na: وهو الله في السموت وفي الارض يعلم سركم وجهركم ويعلم ما تكسبون
entries.nt: he is god in the heavens and the earth he knows what you keep secret and what you make public and he knows what you earn

entries.a: وَمَا تَأْتِيهِم مِّنْ ءَايَةٍۢ مِّنْ ءَايَٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ عَنْهَا مُعْرِضِينَ
entries.t: Not one of their Lord's signs comes to them, but they turn away from it.
entries.na: وما تاتيهم من ايه من ايت ربهم الا كانوا عنها معرضين
entries.nt: not one of their lord s signs comes to them but they turn away from it

entries.a: فَقَدْ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِٱلْحَقِّ لَمَّا جَآءَهُمْ ۖ فَسَوْفَ يَأْتِيهِمْ أَنۢبَٰٓؤُا۟ مَا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
entries.t: They denied the truth when it has come to them; but soon will reach them the news of what they used to ridicule.
entries.na: فقد كذبوا بالحق لما جاهم فسوف ياتيهم انبوا ما كانوا به يستهزون
entries.nt: they denied the truth when it has come to them but soon will reach them the news of what they used to ridicule

entries.a: أَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّن قَرْنٍۢ مَّكَّنَّٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مَا لَمْ نُمَكِّن لَّكُمْ وَأَرْسَلْنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ عَلَيْهِم مِّدْرَارًۭا وَجَعَلْنَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرَ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهِمْ فَأَهْلَكْنَٰهُم بِذُنُوبِهِمْ وَأَنشَأْنَا مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ قَرْنًا ءَاخَرِينَ
entries.t: Have they not considered how many generations We destroyed before them? We had established them on earth more firmly than We established you, and We sent the clouds pouring down abundant rain on them, and We made rivers flow beneath them. But We destroyed them for their sins, and established other civilizations after them.
entries.na: الم يروا كم اهلكنا من قبلهم من قرن مكنهم في الارض ما لم نمكن لكم وارسلنا السما عليهم مدرارا وجعلنا الانهر تجري من تحتهم فاهلكنهم بذنوبهم وانشانا من بعدهم قرنا اخرين
entries.nt: have they not considered how many generations we destroyed before them we had established them on earth more firmly than we established you and we sent the clouds pouring down abundant rain on them and we made rivers flow beneath them but we destroyed them for their sins and established other civilizations after them

entries.a: وَلَوْ نَزَّلْنَا عَلَيْكَ كِتَٰبًۭا فِى قِرْطَاسٍۢ فَلَمَسُوهُ بِأَيْدِيهِمْ لَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ إِنْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحْرٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
entries.t: Had We sent down upon you a book on paper, and they had touched it with their hands, those who disbelieve would have said, "This is nothing but plain magic."
entries.na: ولو نزلنا عليك كتبا في قرطاس فلمسوه بايديهم لقال الذين كفروا ان هذا الا سحر مبين
entries.nt: had we sent down upon you a book on paper and they had touched it with their hands those who disbelieve would have said this is nothing but plain magic

entries.a: وَقَالُوا۟ لَوْلَآ أُنزِلَ عَلَيْهِ مَلَكٌۭ ۖ وَلَوْ أَنزَلْنَا مَلَكًۭا لَّقُضِىَ ٱلْأَمْرُ ثُمَّ لَا يُنظَرُونَ
entries.t: And they say, "Why was an angel not sent down to him." Had We sent down an angel, the matter would have been settled, and they would not have been reprieved.
entries.na: وقالوا لولا انزل عليه ملك ولو انزلنا ملكا لقضي الامر ثم لا ينظرون
entries.nt: and they say why was an angel not sent down to him had we sent down an angel the matter would have been settled and they would not have been reprieved

entries.a: وَلَوْ جَعَلْنَٰهُ مَلَكًۭا لَّجَعَلْنَٰهُ رَجُلًۭا وَلَلَبَسْنَا عَلَيْهِم مَّا يَلْبِسُونَ
entries.t: Had We made him an angel, We would have made him a man, and confused them when they are already confused.
entries.na: ولو جعلنه ملكا لجعلنه رجلا وللبسنا عليهم ما يلبسون
entries.nt: had we made him an angel we would have made him a man and confused them when they are already confused

entries.a: وَلَقَدِ ٱسْتُهْزِئَ بِرُسُلٍۢ مِّن قَبْلِكَ فَحَاقَ بِٱلَّذِينَ سَخِرُوا۟ مِنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
entries.t: Messengers before you were ridiculed, but those who mocked them became besieged by what they ridiculed.
entries.na: ولقد استهزي برسل من قبلك فحاق بالذين سخروا منهم ما كانوا به يستهزون
entries.nt: messengers before you were ridiculed but those who mocked them became besieged by what they ridiculed

entries.a: قُلْ سِيرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ثُمَّ ٱنظُرُوا۟ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
entries.t: Say, "Travel the earth and observe the final fate of the deniers."
entries.na: قل سيروا في الارض ثم انظروا كيف كان عقبه المكذبين
entries.nt: say travel the earth and observe the final fate of the deniers

entries.a: قُل لِّمَن مَّا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ قُل لِّلَّهِ ۚ كَتَبَ عَلَىٰ نَفْسِهِ ٱلرَّحْمَةَ ۚ لَيَجْمَعَنَّكُمْ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ لَا رَيْبَ فِيهِ ۚ ٱلَّذِينَ خَسِرُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ فَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
entries.t: Say, "To whom belongs what is in the heavens and the earth?" Say, "To God." He has inscribed for Himself mercy. He will gather you to the Day of Resurrection, in which there is no doubt. Those who lost their souls do not believe.
entries.na: قل لمن ما في السموت والارض قل لله كتب علي نفسه الرحمه ليجمعنكم الي يوم القيمه لا ريب فيه الذين خسروا انفسهم فهم لا يومنون
entries.nt: say to whom belongs what is in the heavens and the earth say to god he has inscribed for himself mercy he will gather you to the day of resurrection in which there is no doubt those who lost their souls do not believe

entries.a: ۞ وَلَهُۥ مَا سَكَنَ فِى ٱلَّيْلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
entries.t: To Him belongs whatever rests in the night and the day. He is the Hearing, the Knowing.
entries.na: وله ما سكن في اليل والنهار وهو السميع العليم
entries.nt: to him belongs whatever rests in the night and the day he is the hearing the knowing

entries.a: قُلْ أَغَيْرَ ٱللَّهِ أَتَّخِذُ وَلِيًّۭا فَاطِرِ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَهُوَ يُطْعِمُ وَلَا يُطْعَمُ ۗ قُلْ إِنِّىٓ أُمِرْتُ أَنْ أَكُونَ أَوَّلَ مَنْ أَسْلَمَ ۖ وَلَا تَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ
entries.t: Say, "Shall I take for myself a protector other than God, Originator of the heavens and the earth, and He feeds and is not fed?" Say, "I am instructed to be the first of those who submit." And do not be among the idolaters.
entries.na: قل اغير الله اتخذ وليا فاطر السموت والارض وهو يطعم ولا يطعم قل اني امرت ان اكون اول من اسلم ولا تكونن من المشركين
entries.nt: say shall i take for myself a protector other than god originator of the heavens and the earth and he feeds and is not fed say i am instructed to be the first of those who submit and do not be among the idolaters

entries.a: قُلْ إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ إِنْ عَصَيْتُ رَبِّى عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍۢ
entries.t: Say, "I fear, should I defy my Lord, the punishment of a tremendous Day."
entries.na: قل اني اخاف ان عصيت ربي عذاب يوم عظيم
entries.nt: say i fear should i defy my lord the punishment of a tremendous day

entries.a: مَّن يُصْرَفْ عَنْهُ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ فَقَدْ رَحِمَهُۥ ۚ وَذَٰلِكَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْمُبِينُ
entries.t: Whoever is spared on that Day-He had mercy on him. That is the clear victory.
entries.na: من يصرف عنه يوميذ فقد رحمه وذلك الفوز المبين
entries.nt: whoever is spared on that day he had mercy on him that is the clear victory

entries.a: وَإِن يَمْسَسْكَ ٱللَّهُ بِضُرٍّۢ فَلَا كَاشِفَ لَهُۥٓ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ وَإِن يَمْسَسْكَ بِخَيْرٍۢ فَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ قَدِيرٌۭ
entries.t: If God touches you with adversity, none can remove it except He. And if He touches you with good-He is Capable of everything.
entries.na: وان يمسسك الله بضر فلا كاشف له الا هو وان يمسسك بخير فهو علي كل شي قدير
entries.nt: if god touches you with adversity none can remove it except he and if he touches you with good he is capable of everything

entries.a: وَهُوَ ٱلْقَاهِرُ فَوْقَ عِبَادِهِۦ ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْحَكِيمُ ٱلْخَبِيرُ
entries.t: He is the Supreme over His servants. He is the Wise, the Expert.
entries.na: وهو القاهر فوق عباده وهو الحكيم الخبير
entries.nt: he is the supreme over his servants he is the wise the expert

entries.a: قُلْ أَىُّ شَىْءٍ أَكْبَرُ شَهَٰدَةًۭ ۖ قُلِ ٱللَّهُ ۖ شَهِيدٌۢ بَيْنِى وَبَيْنَكُمْ ۚ وَأُوحِىَ إِلَىَّ هَٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانُ لِأُنذِرَكُم بِهِۦ وَمَنۢ بَلَغَ ۚ أَئِنَّكُمْ لَتَشْهَدُونَ أَنَّ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ ءَالِهَةً أُخْرَىٰ ۚ قُل لَّآ أَشْهَدُ ۚ قُلْ إِنَّمَا هُوَ إِلَٰهٌۭ وَٰحِدٌۭ وَإِنَّنِى بَرِىٓءٌۭ مِّمَّا تُشْرِكُونَ
entries.t: Say, "What thing is more solemn in testimony?" Say, "God is Witness between you and me. This Quran was revealed to me, that I may warn you with it, and whomever it may reach. Do you indeed testify that there are other gods with God?" Say, "I myself do not testify." Say, "He is but One God, and I am innocent of your idolatry."
entries.na: قل اي شي اكبر شهده قل الله شهيد بيني وبينكم واوحي الي هذا القران لانذركم به ومن بلغ اينكم لتشهدون ان مع الله الهه اخري قل لا اشهد قل انما هو اله وحد وانني بري مما تشركون
entries.nt: say what thing is more solemn in testimony say god is witness between you and me this quran was revealed to me that i may warn you with it and whomever it may reach do you indeed testify that there are other gods with god say i myself do not testify say he is but one god and i am innocent of your idolatry

entries.a: ٱلَّذِينَ ءَاتَيْنَٰهُمُ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ يَعْرِفُونَهُۥ كَمَا يَعْرِفُونَ أَبْنَآءَهُمُ ۘ ٱلَّذِينَ خَسِرُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ فَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
entries.t: Those to whom We have given the Book recognize it as they recognize their own children; but those who have lost their souls do not believe.
entries.na: الذين اتينهم الكتب يعرفونه كما يعرفون ابناهم الذين خسروا انفسهم فهم لا يومنون
entries.nt: those to whom we have given the book recognize it as they recognize their own children but those who have lost their souls do not believe

entries.a: وَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّنِ ٱفْتَرَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًا أَوْ كَذَّبَ بِـَٔايَٰتِهِۦٓ ۗ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يُفْلِحُ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ
entries.t: Who does greater wrong than someone who fabricates lies against God, or denies His revelations? The wrongdoers will not succeed.
entries.na: ومن اظلم ممن افتري علي الله كذبا او كذب بايته انه لا يفلح الظلمون
entries.nt: who does greater wrong than someone who fabricates lies against god or denies his revelations the wrongdoers will not succeed

entries.a: وَيَوْمَ نَحْشُرُهُمْ جَمِيعًۭا ثُمَّ نَقُولُ لِلَّذِينَ أَشْرَكُوٓا۟ أَيْنَ شُرَكَآؤُكُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ كُنتُمْ تَزْعُمُونَ
entries.t: On the Day when We gather them all together, then say to the idolaters, "Where are your idols, those you used to claim?"
entries.na: ويوم نحشرهم جميعا ثم نقول للذين اشركوا اين شركاوكم الذين كنتم تزعمون
entries.nt: on the day when we gather them all together then say to the idolaters where are your idols those you used to claim

entries.a: ثُمَّ لَمْ تَكُن فِتْنَتُهُمْ إِلَّآ أَن قَالُوا۟ وَٱللَّهِ رَبِّنَا مَا كُنَّا مُشْرِكِينَ
entries.t: Then their only argument will be to say, "By God, our Lord, we were not idolaters."
entries.na: ثم لم تكن فتنتهم الا ان قالوا والله ربنا ما كنا مشركين
entries.nt: then their only argument will be to say by god our lord we were not idolaters

entries.a: ٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ كَذَبُوا۟ عَلَىٰٓ أَنفُسِهِمْ ۚ وَضَلَّ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَفْتَرُونَ
entries.t: Look how they lied to themselves. And what they invented deserted them.
entries.na: انظر كيف كذبوا علي انفسهم وضل عنهم ما كانوا يفترون
entries.nt: look how they lied to themselves and what they invented deserted them

entries.a: وَمِنْهُم مَّن يَسْتَمِعُ إِلَيْكَ ۖ وَجَعَلْنَا عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمْ أَكِنَّةً أَن يَفْقَهُوهُ وَفِىٓ ءَاذَانِهِمْ وَقْرًۭا ۚ وَإِن يَرَوْا۟ كُلَّ ءَايَةٍۢ لَّا يُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِهَا ۚ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءُوكَ يُجَٰدِلُونَكَ يَقُولُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ إِنْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّآ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
entries.t: Among them are those who listen to you; but We place covers over their hearts, to prevent them from understanding it, and heaviness in their ears. Even if they see every sign, they will not believe in it. Until, when they come to you, to argue with you, those who disbelieve will say, "These are nothing but myths of the ancients."
entries.na: ومنهم من يستمع اليك وجعلنا علي قلوبهم اكنه ان يفقهوه وفي اذانهم وقرا وان يروا كل ايه لا يومنوا بها حتي اذا جاوك يجدلونك يقول الذين كفروا ان هذا الا اسطير الاولين
entries.nt: among them are those who listen to you but we place covers over their hearts to prevent them from understanding it and heaviness in their ears even if they see every sign they will not believe in it until when they come to you to argue with you those who disbelieve will say these are nothing but myths of the ancients

entries.a: وَهُمْ يَنْهَوْنَ عَنْهُ وَيَنْـَٔوْنَ عَنْهُ ۖ وَإِن يُهْلِكُونَ إِلَّآ أَنفُسَهُمْ وَمَا يَشْعُرُونَ
entries.t: They keep others from it, and avoid it themselves; but they ruin only their own souls, and they do not realize.
entries.na: وهم ينهون عنه وينون عنه وان يهلكون الا انفسهم وما يشعرون
entries.nt: they keep others from it and avoid it themselves but they ruin only their own souls and they do not realize

entries.a: وَلَوْ تَرَىٰٓ إِذْ وُقِفُوا۟ عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ فَقَالُوا۟ يَٰلَيْتَنَا نُرَدُّ وَلَا نُكَذِّبَ بِـَٔايَٰتِ رَبِّنَا وَنَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
entries.t: If only you could see, when they are made to stand before the Fire; they will say, "If only we could be sent back, and not reject the revelations of our Lord, and be among the faithful."
entries.na: ولو تري اذ وقفوا علي النار فقالوا يليتنا نرد ولا نكذب بايت ربنا ونكون من المومنين
entries.nt: if only you could see when they are made to stand before the fire they will say if only we could be sent back and not reject the revelations of our lord and be among the faithful

entries.a: بَلْ بَدَا لَهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يُخْفُونَ مِن قَبْلُ ۖ وَلَوْ رُدُّوا۟ لَعَادُوا۟ لِمَا نُهُوا۟ عَنْهُ وَإِنَّهُمْ لَكَٰذِبُونَ
entries.t: What they used to conceal before will become clear to them. And even if they were sent back, they would revert to what they were forbidden. They are liars.
entries.na: بل بدا لهم ما كانوا يخفون من قبل ولو ردوا لعادوا لما نهوا عنه وانهم لكذبون
entries.nt: what they used to conceal before will become clear to them and even if they were sent back they would revert to what they were forbidden they are liars

entries.a: وَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنْ هِىَ إِلَّا حَيَاتُنَا ٱلدُّنْيَا وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَبْعُوثِينَ
entries.t: And they say, "There is nothing but our life in this world, and we will not be resurrected."
entries.na: وقالوا ان هي الا حياتنا الدنيا وما نحن بمبعوثين
entries.nt: and they say there is nothing but our life in this world and we will not be resurrected

entries.a: وَلَوْ تَرَىٰٓ إِذْ وُقِفُوا۟ عَلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ ۚ قَالَ أَلَيْسَ هَٰذَا بِٱلْحَقِّ ۚ قَالُوا۟ بَلَىٰ وَرَبِّنَا ۚ قَالَ فَذُوقُوا۟ ٱلْعَذَابَ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَكْفُرُونَ
entries.t: If only you could see, when they are stationed before their Lord. He will say, "Is this not real?" They will say, "Yes indeed, by our Lord." He will say, "Then taste the torment for having disbelieved."
entries.na: ولو تري اذ وقفوا علي ربهم قال اليس هذا بالحق قالوا بلي وربنا قال فذوقوا العذاب بما كنتم تكفرون
entries.nt: if only you could see when they are stationed before their lord he will say is this not real they will say yes indeed by our lord he will say then taste the torment for having disbelieved

entries.a: قَدْ خَسِرَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِلِقَآءِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءَتْهُمُ ٱلسَّاعَةُ بَغْتَةًۭ قَالُوا۟ يَٰحَسْرَتَنَا عَلَىٰ مَا فَرَّطْنَا فِيهَا وَهُمْ يَحْمِلُونَ أَوْزَارَهُمْ عَلَىٰ ظُهُورِهِمْ ۚ أَلَا سَآءَ مَا يَزِرُونَ
entries.t: Losers are those who deny the encounter with God. Then, when the Hour comes upon them suddenly, they will say, "Alas for us, how we have neglected it." And they will carry their burdens on their backs-evil is what they carry.
entries.na: قد خسر الذين كذبوا بلقا الله حتي اذا جاتهم الساعه بغته قالوا يحسرتنا علي ما فرطنا فيها وهم يحملون اوزارهم علي ظهورهم الا سا ما يزرون
entries.nt: losers are those who deny the encounter with god then when the hour comes upon them suddenly they will say alas for us how we have neglected it and they will carry their burdens on their backs evil is what they carry

entries.a: وَمَا ٱلْحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنْيَآ إِلَّا لَعِبٌۭ وَلَهْوٌۭ ۖ وَلَلدَّارُ ٱلْءَاخِرَةُ خَيْرٌۭ لِّلَّذِينَ يَتَّقُونَ ۗ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ
entries.t: The life of this world is nothing but game and distraction, but the Home of the Hereafter is better for those who are righteous. Do you not understand?
entries.na: وما الحيوه الدنيا الا لعب ولهو وللدار الاخره خير للذين يتقون افلا تعقلون
entries.nt: the life of this world is nothing but game and distraction but the home of the hereafter is better for those who are righteous do you not understand

entries.a: قَدْ نَعْلَمُ إِنَّهُۥ لَيَحْزُنُكَ ٱلَّذِى يَقُولُونَ ۖ فَإِنَّهُمْ لَا يُكَذِّبُونَكَ وَلَٰكِنَّ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ بِـَٔايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ يَجْحَدُونَ
entries.t: We know that what they say grieves you. It is not you they reject, but it is God's revelations that the wicked deny.
entries.na: قد نعلم انه ليحزنك الذي يقولون فانهم لا يكذبونك ولكن الظلمين بايت الله يجحدون
entries.nt: we know that what they say grieves you it is not you they reject but it is god s revelations that the wicked deny

entries.a: وَلَقَدْ كُذِّبَتْ رُسُلٌۭ مِّن قَبْلِكَ فَصَبَرُوا۟ عَلَىٰ مَا كُذِّبُوا۟ وَأُوذُوا۟ حَتَّىٰٓ أَتَىٰهُمْ نَصْرُنَا ۚ وَلَا مُبَدِّلَ لِكَلِمَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ وَلَقَدْ جَآءَكَ مِن نَّبَإِى۟ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
entries.t: Other messengers before you were rejected, but they endured rejection and persecution until Our help came to them. There can be no change to God's words. News of the Messengers has already reached you.
entries.na: ولقد كذبت رسل من قبلك فصبروا علي ما كذبوا واوذوا حتي اتيهم نصرنا ولا مبدل لكلمت الله ولقد جاك من نباي المرسلين
entries.nt: other messengers before you were rejected but they endured rejection and persecution until our help came to them there can be no change to god s words news of the messengers has already reached you

entries.a: وَإِن كَانَ كَبُرَ عَلَيْكَ إِعْرَاضُهُمْ فَإِنِ ٱسْتَطَعْتَ أَن تَبْتَغِىَ نَفَقًۭا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ أَوْ سُلَّمًۭا فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَتَأْتِيَهُم بِـَٔايَةٍۢ ۚ وَلَوْ شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ لَجَمَعَهُمْ عَلَى ٱلْهُدَىٰ ۚ فَلَا تَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْجَٰهِلِينَ
entries.t: If you find their rejection hard to bear, then if you can, seek a tunnel into the earth, or a stairway into the heaven, and bring them a sign. Had God willed, He could have gathered them to guidance. So do not be of the ignorant.
entries.na: وان كان كبر عليك اعراضهم فان استطعت ان تبتغي نفقا في الارض او سلما في السما فتاتيهم بايه ولو شا الله لجمعهم علي الهدي فلا تكونن من الجهلين
entries.nt: if you find their rejection hard to bear then if you can seek a tunnel into the earth or a stairway into the heaven and bring them a sign had god willed he could have gathered them to guidance so do not be of the ignorant

entries.a: ۞ إِنَّمَا يَسْتَجِيبُ ٱلَّذِينَ يَسْمَعُونَ ۘ وَٱلْمَوْتَىٰ يَبْعَثُهُمُ ٱللَّهُ ثُمَّ إِلَيْهِ يُرْجَعُونَ
entries.t: Only those who listen will respond. As for the dead, God will resurrect them; then to Him they will be returned.
entries.na: انما يستجيب الذين يسمعون والموتي يبعثهم الله ثم اليه يرجعون
entries.nt: only those who listen will respond as for the dead god will resurrect them then to him they will be returned

entries.a: وَقَالُوا۟ لَوْلَا نُزِّلَ عَلَيْهِ ءَايَةٌۭ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦ ۚ قُلْ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ قَادِرٌ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يُنَزِّلَ ءَايَةًۭ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
entries.t: And they say, "If only a sign could come down to him from his Lord." Say, "God is Able to send down a sign, but most of them do not know."
entries.na: وقالوا لولا نزل عليه ايه من ربه قل ان الله قادر علي ان ينزل ايه ولكن اكثرهم لا يعلمون
entries.nt: and they say if only a sign could come down to him from his lord say god is able to send down a sign but most of them do not know

entries.a: وَمَا مِن دَآبَّةٍۢ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَا طَٰٓئِرٍۢ يَطِيرُ بِجَنَاحَيْهِ إِلَّآ أُمَمٌ أَمْثَالُكُم ۚ مَّا فَرَّطْنَا فِى ٱلْكِتَٰبِ مِن شَىْءٍۢ ۚ ثُمَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ يُحْشَرُونَ
entries.t: There is no animal on land, nor a bird flying with its wings, but are communities like you. We neglected nothing in the Scripture. Then to their Lord they will be gathered.
entries.na: وما من دابه في الارض ولا طير يطير بجناحيه الا امم امثالكم ما فرطنا في الكتب من شي ثم الي ربهم يحشرون
entries.nt: there is no animal on land nor a bird flying with its wings but are communities like you we neglected nothing in the scripture then to their lord they will be gathered

entries.a: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا صُمٌّۭ وَبُكْمٌۭ فِى ٱلظُّلُمَٰتِ ۗ مَن يَشَإِ ٱللَّهُ يُضْلِلْهُ وَمَن يَشَأْ يَجْعَلْهُ عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍۢ مُّسْتَقِيمٍۢ
entries.t: Those who reject Our revelations are deaf and dumb, in total darkness. Whomever God wills, He leaves astray; and whomever He wills, He sets on a straight path.
entries.na: والذين كذبوا بايتنا صم وبكم في الظلمت من يشا الله يضلله ومن يشا يجعله علي صرط مستقيم
entries.nt: those who reject our revelations are deaf and dumb in total darkness whomever god wills he leaves astray and whomever he wills he sets on a straight path

entries.a: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتَكُمْ إِنْ أَتَىٰكُمْ عَذَابُ ٱللَّهِ أَوْ أَتَتْكُمُ ٱلسَّاعَةُ أَغَيْرَ ٱللَّهِ تَدْعُونَ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ
entries.t: Say, "Have you considered? if God's punishment came upon you, or the Hour overtook you, would you call upon any other than God, if you are sincere?"
entries.na: قل اريتكم ان اتيكم عذاب الله او اتتكم الساعه اغير الله تدعون ان كنتم صدقين
entries.nt: say have you considered if god s punishment came upon you or the hour overtook you would you call upon any other than god if you are sincere

entries.a: بَلْ إِيَّاهُ تَدْعُونَ فَيَكْشِفُ مَا تَدْعُونَ إِلَيْهِ إِن شَآءَ وَتَنسَوْنَ مَا تُشْرِكُونَ
entries.t: In fact, it is Him you will call upon; and if He wills, he will remove what you called Him for, and you will forget what you idolized.
entries.na: بل اياه تدعون فيكشف ما تدعون اليه ان شا وتنسون ما تشركون
entries.nt: in fact it is him you will call upon and if he wills he will remove what you called him for and you will forget what you idolized

entries.a: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَىٰٓ أُمَمٍۢ مِّن قَبْلِكَ فَأَخَذْنَٰهُم بِٱلْبَأْسَآءِ وَٱلضَّرَّآءِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَضَرَّعُونَ
entries.t: We sent messengers to communities before you, and We afflicted them with suffering and hardship, that they may humble themselves.
entries.na: ولقد ارسلنا الي امم من قبلك فاخذنهم بالباسا والضرا لعلهم يتضرعون
entries.nt: we sent messengers to communities before you and we afflicted them with suffering and hardship that they may humble themselves

entries.a: فَلَوْلَآ إِذْ جَآءَهُم بَأْسُنَا تَضَرَّعُوا۟ وَلَٰكِن قَسَتْ قُلُوبُهُمْ وَزَيَّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
entries.t: If only, when Our calamity came upon them, they humbled themselves. But their hearts hardened, and Satan made their deeds appear good to them.
entries.na: فلولا اذ جاهم باسنا تضرعوا ولكن قست قلوبهم وزين لهم الشيطن ما كانوا يعملون
entries.nt: if only when our calamity came upon them they humbled themselves but their hearts hardened and satan made their deeds appear good to them

entries.a: فَلَمَّا نَسُوا۟ مَا ذُكِّرُوا۟ بِهِۦ فَتَحْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ أَبْوَٰبَ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا فَرِحُوا۟ بِمَآ أُوتُوٓا۟ أَخَذْنَٰهُم بَغْتَةًۭ فَإِذَا هُم مُّبْلِسُونَ
entries.t: Then, when they disregarded what they were reminded of, We opened for them the gates of all things. Until, when they delighted in what they were given, We seized them suddenly; and at once, they were in despair.
entries.na: فلما نسوا ما ذكروا به فتحنا عليهم ابوب كل شي حتي اذا فرحوا بما اوتوا اخذنهم بغته فاذا هم مبلسون
entries.nt: then when they disregarded what they were reminded of we opened for them the gates of all things until when they delighted in what they were given we seized them suddenly and at once they were in despair

entries.a: فَقُطِعَ دَابِرُ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ ۚ وَٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
entries.t: Thus the last remnant of the people who did wrong was cut off. And praise be to God, Lord of the Worlds.
entries.na: فقطع دابر القوم الذين ظلموا والحمد لله رب العلمين
entries.nt: thus the last remnant of the people who did wrong was cut off and praise be to god lord of the worlds

entries.a: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَخَذَ ٱللَّهُ سَمْعَكُمْ وَأَبْصَٰرَكُمْ وَخَتَمَ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِكُم مَّنْ إِلَٰهٌ غَيْرُ ٱللَّهِ يَأْتِيكُم بِهِ ۗ ٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ نُصَرِّفُ ٱلْءَايَٰتِ ثُمَّ هُمْ يَصْدِفُونَ
entries.t: Say, "Have you considered? If God took away your hearing and your sight, and set a seal on your hearts, what god other than God would restore them to you?" Note how We explain the revelations in various ways, yet they still turn away.
entries.na: قل اريتم ان اخذ الله سمعكم وابصركم وختم علي قلوبكم من اله غير الله ياتيكم به انظر كيف نصرف الايت ثم هم يصدفون
entries.nt: say have you considered if god took away your hearing and your sight and set a seal on your hearts what god other than god would restore them to you note how we explain the revelations in various ways yet they still turn away

entries.a: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتَكُمْ إِنْ أَتَىٰكُمْ عَذَابُ ٱللَّهِ بَغْتَةً أَوْ جَهْرَةً هَلْ يُهْلَكُ إِلَّا ٱلْقَوْمُ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ
entries.t: Say, "Have you considered? if God's punishment descended on you suddenly or gradually, would any be destroyed except the wrongdoing people?"
entries.na: قل اريتكم ان اتيكم عذاب الله بغته او جهره هل يهلك الا القوم الظلمون
entries.nt: say have you considered if god s punishment descended on you suddenly or gradually would any be destroyed except the wrongdoing people

entries.a: وَمَا نُرْسِلُ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ إِلَّا مُبَشِّرِينَ وَمُنذِرِينَ ۖ فَمَنْ ءَامَنَ وَأَصْلَحَ فَلَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ
entries.t: We sent the messengers only as bearers of good news and as warners. Those who believe and reform have nothing to fear, nor shall they grieve.
entries.na: وما نرسل المرسلين الا مبشرين ومنذرين فمن امن واصلح فلا خوف عليهم ولا هم يحزنون
entries.nt: we sent the messengers only as bearers of good news and as warners those who believe and reform have nothing to fear nor shall they grieve

entries.a: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا يَمَسُّهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْسُقُونَ
entries.t: But as for those who reject Our revelations, torment will afflict them because of their defiance.
entries.na: والذين كذبوا بايتنا يمسهم العذاب بما كانوا يفسقون
entries.nt: but as for those who reject our revelations torment will afflict them because of their defiance

entries.a: قُل لَّآ أَقُولُ لَكُمْ عِندِى خَزَآئِنُ ٱللَّهِ وَلَآ أَعْلَمُ ٱلْغَيْبَ وَلَآ أَقُولُ لَكُمْ إِنِّى مَلَكٌ ۖ إِنْ أَتَّبِعُ إِلَّا مَا يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَىَّ ۚ قُلْ هَلْ يَسْتَوِى ٱلْأَعْمَىٰ وَٱلْبَصِيرُ ۚ أَفَلَا تَتَفَكَّرُونَ
entries.t: Say, "I do not say to you that I possess the treasuries of God, nor do I know the future, nor do I say to you that I am an angel. I only follow what is inspired to me." Say, "Are the blind and the seeing alike? Do you not think?"
entries.na: قل لا اقول لكم عندي خزاين الله ولا اعلم الغيب ولا اقول لكم اني ملك ان اتبع الا ما يوحي الي قل هل يستوي الاعمي والبصير افلا تتفكرون
entries.nt: say i do not say to you that i possess the treasuries of god nor do i know the future nor do i say to you that i am an angel i only follow what is inspired to me say are the blind and the seeing alike do you not think

entries.a: وَأَنذِرْ بِهِ ٱلَّذِينَ يَخَافُونَ أَن يُحْشَرُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ ۙ لَيْسَ لَهُم مِّن دُونِهِۦ وَلِىٌّۭ وَلَا شَفِيعٌۭ لَّعَلَّهُمْ يَتَّقُونَ
entries.t: And warn with it those who fear to be gathered before their Lord-they have no protector or intercessor apart from him-perhaps they will grow in piety.
entries.na: وانذر به الذين يخافون ان يحشروا الي ربهم ليس لهم من دونه ولي ولا شفيع لعلهم يتقون
entries.nt: and warn with it those who fear to be gathered before their lord they have no protector or intercessor apart from him perhaps they will grow in piety

entries.a: وَلَا تَطْرُدِ ٱلَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ رَبَّهُم بِٱلْغَدَوٰةِ وَٱلْعَشِىِّ يُرِيدُونَ وَجْهَهُۥ ۖ مَا عَلَيْكَ مِنْ حِسَابِهِم مِّن شَىْءٍۢ وَمَا مِنْ حِسَابِكَ عَلَيْهِم مِّن شَىْءٍۢ فَتَطْرُدَهُمْ فَتَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
entries.t: And do not drive away those who call upon their Lord, morning and evening, seeking His attention. You are not accountable for them in any way, nor are they accountable for you in any way. If you drive them away, you would be one of the unjust.
entries.na: ولا تطرد الذين يدعون ربهم بالغدوه والعشي يريدون وجهه ما عليك من حسابهم من شي وما من حسابك عليهم من شي فتطردهم فتكون من الظلمين
entries.nt: and do not drive away those who call upon their lord morning and evening seeking his attention you are not accountable for them in any way nor are they accountable for you in any way if you drive them away you would be one of the unjust

entries.a: وَكَذَٰلِكَ فَتَنَّا بَعْضَهُم بِبَعْضٍۢ لِّيَقُولُوٓا۟ أَهَٰٓؤُلَآءِ مَنَّ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِم مِّنۢ بَيْنِنَآ ۗ أَلَيْسَ ٱللَّهُ بِأَعْلَمَ بِٱلشَّٰكِرِينَ
entries.t: Thus We try some of them by means of others, that they may say, "Are these the ones whom God has favored from among us?" Is God not aware of the appreciative?
entries.na: وكذلك فتنا بعضهم ببعض ليقولوا اهولا من الله عليهم من بيننا اليس الله باعلم بالشكرين
entries.nt: thus we try some of them by means of others that they may say are these the ones whom god has favored from among us is god not aware of the appreciative

entries.a: وَإِذَا جَآءَكَ ٱلَّذِينَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا فَقُلْ سَلَٰمٌ عَلَيْكُمْ ۖ كَتَبَ رَبُّكُمْ عَلَىٰ نَفْسِهِ ٱلرَّحْمَةَ ۖ أَنَّهُۥ مَنْ عَمِلَ مِنكُمْ سُوٓءًۢا بِجَهَٰلَةٍۢ ثُمَّ تَابَ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ وَأَصْلَحَ فَأَنَّهُۥ غَفُورٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۭ
entries.t: When those who believe in Our revelations come to you, say, "Peace be upon you, your Lord has prescribed mercy for Himself. Whoever among you does wrong out of ignorance, and then repents afterwards and reforms-He is Forgiving and Merciful."
entries.na: واذا جاك الذين يومنون بايتنا فقل سلم عليكم كتب ربكم علي نفسه الرحمه انه من عمل منكم سوا بجهله ثم تاب من بعده واصلح فانه غفور رحيم
entries.nt: when those who believe in our revelations come to you say peace be upon you your lord has prescribed mercy for himself whoever among you does wrong out of ignorance and then repents afterwards and reforms he is forgiving and merciful

entries.a: وَكَذَٰلِكَ نُفَصِّلُ ٱلْءَايَٰتِ وَلِتَسْتَبِينَ سَبِيلُ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
entries.t: Thus We explain the revelations, and expose the path of the unrighteous.
entries.na: وكذلك نفصل الايت ولتستبين سبيل المجرمين
entries.nt: thus we explain the revelations and expose the path of the unrighteous

entries.a: قُلْ إِنِّى نُهِيتُ أَنْ أَعْبُدَ ٱلَّذِينَ تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ قُل لَّآ أَتَّبِعُ أَهْوَآءَكُمْ ۙ قَدْ ضَلَلْتُ إِذًۭا وَمَآ أَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلْمُهْتَدِينَ
entries.t: Say, "I am forbidden from worshiping those you pray to besides God." Say, "I will not follow your desires; else I would be lost and not be of those guided."
entries.na: قل اني نهيت ان اعبد الذين تدعون من دون الله قل لا اتبع اهواكم قد ضللت اذا وما انا من المهتدين
entries.nt: say i am forbidden from worshiping those you pray to besides god say i will not follow your desires else i would be lost and not be of those guided

entries.a: قُلْ إِنِّى عَلَىٰ بَيِّنَةٍۢ مِّن رَّبِّى وَكَذَّبْتُم بِهِۦ ۚ مَا عِندِى مَا تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ بِهِۦٓ ۚ إِنِ ٱلْحُكْمُ إِلَّا لِلَّهِ ۖ يَقُصُّ ٱلْحَقَّ ۖ وَهُوَ خَيْرُ ٱلْفَٰصِلِينَ
entries.t: Say, "I stand on clear evidence from my Lord, and you have rejected Him. I do not possess what you seek me to hasten; the decision belongs solely to God. He states the truth, and He is the Best of Judges."
entries.na: قل اني علي بينه من ربي وكذبتم به ما عندي ما تستعجلون به ان الحكم الا لله يقص الحق وهو خير الفصلين
entries.nt: say i stand on clear evidence from my lord and you have rejected him i do not possess what you seek me to hasten the decision belongs solely to god he states the truth and he is the best of judges

entries.a: قُل لَّوْ أَنَّ عِندِى مَا تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ بِهِۦ لَقُضِىَ ٱلْأَمْرُ بَيْنِى وَبَيْنَكُمْ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
entries.t: Say, "If I possessed what you seek me to hasten, the matter between you and me would have been settled. God is well aware of the unjust."
entries.na: قل لو ان عندي ما تستعجلون به لقضي الامر بيني وبينكم والله اعلم بالظلمين
entries.nt: say if i possessed what you seek me to hasten the matter between you and me would have been settled god is well aware of the unjust

entries.a: ۞ وَعِندَهُۥ مَفَاتِحُ ٱلْغَيْبِ لَا يَعْلَمُهَآ إِلَّا هُوَ ۚ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا فِى ٱلْبَرِّ وَٱلْبَحْرِ ۚ وَمَا تَسْقُطُ مِن وَرَقَةٍ إِلَّا يَعْلَمُهَا وَلَا حَبَّةٍۢ فِى ظُلُمَٰتِ ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَا رَطْبٍۢ وَلَا يَابِسٍ إِلَّا فِى كِتَٰبٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
entries.t: With Him are the keys of the unseen; none knows them except He. And He knows everything on land and in the sea. Not a leaf falls but He knows it; and there is not a single grain in the darkness of earth, nor is there anything wet or dry, but is in a clear record.
entries.na: وعنده مفاتح الغيب لا يعلمها الا هو ويعلم ما في البر والبحر وما تسقط من ورقه الا يعلمها ولا حبه في ظلمت الارض ولا رطب ولا يابس الا في كتب مبين
entries.nt: with him are the keys of the unseen none knows them except he and he knows everything on land and in the sea not a leaf falls but he knows it and there is not a single grain in the darkness of earth nor is there anything wet or dry but is in a clear record

entries.a: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى يَتَوَفَّىٰكُم بِٱلَّيْلِ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا جَرَحْتُم بِٱلنَّهَارِ ثُمَّ يَبْعَثُكُمْ فِيهِ لِيُقْضَىٰٓ أَجَلٌۭ مُّسَمًّۭى ۖ ثُمَّ إِلَيْهِ مَرْجِعُكُمْ ثُمَّ يُنَبِّئُكُم بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
entries.t: It is He Who takes you by night, and He knows what you earn by day. Then He raises you up in it, until a fixed term is fulfilled. Then to Him is your return, then He will inform you of what you used to do.
entries.na: وهو الذي يتوفيكم باليل ويعلم ما جرحتم بالنهار ثم يبعثكم فيه ليقضي اجل مسمي ثم اليه مرجعكم ثم ينبيكم بما كنتم تعملون
entries.nt: it is he who takes you by night and he knows what you earn by day then he raises you up in it until a fixed term is fulfilled then to him is your return then he will inform you of what you used to do

entries.a: وَهُوَ ٱلْقَاهِرُ فَوْقَ عِبَادِهِۦ ۖ وَيُرْسِلُ عَلَيْكُمْ حَفَظَةً حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءَ أَحَدَكُمُ ٱلْمَوْتُ تَوَفَّتْهُ رُسُلُنَا وَهُمْ لَا يُفَرِّطُونَ
entries.t: He is the Conqueror over His servants, and He sends guardians over you, until, when death overtakes one of you, Our envoys take him away, and they never fail.
entries.na: وهو القاهر فوق عباده ويرسل عليكم حفظه حتي اذا جا احدكم الموت توفته رسلنا وهم لا يفرطون
entries.nt: he is the conqueror over his servants and he sends guardians over you until when death overtakes one of you our envoys take him away and they never fail

entries.a: ثُمَّ رُدُّوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ مَوْلَىٰهُمُ ٱلْحَقِّ ۚ أَلَا لَهُ ٱلْحُكْمُ وَهُوَ أَسْرَعُ ٱلْحَٰسِبِينَ
entries.t: Then they are brought back to God, their True Master. Unquestionably, His is the judgment, and He is the Swiftest of reckoners.
entries.na: ثم ردوا الي الله موليهم الحق الا له الحكم وهو اسرع الحسبين
entries.nt: then they are brought back to god their true master unquestionably his is the judgment and he is the swiftest of reckoners

entries.a: قُلْ مَن يُنَجِّيكُم مِّن ظُلُمَٰتِ ٱلْبَرِّ وَٱلْبَحْرِ تَدْعُونَهُۥ تَضَرُّعًۭا وَخُفْيَةًۭ لَّئِنْ أَنجَىٰنَا مِنْ هَٰذِهِۦ لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلشَّٰكِرِينَ
entries.t: Say, "Who delivers you from the darkness of land and sea?" You call upon Him humbly and inwardly: "If He delivers us from this, We will surely be among the thankful."
entries.na: قل من ينجيكم من ظلمت البر والبحر تدعونه تضرعا وخفيه لين انجينا من هذه لنكونن من الشكرين
entries.nt: say who delivers you from the darkness of land and sea you call upon him humbly and inwardly if he delivers us from this we will surely be among the thankful

entries.a: قُلِ ٱللَّهُ يُنَجِّيكُم مِّنْهَا وَمِن كُلِّ كَرْبٍۢ ثُمَّ أَنتُمْ تُشْرِكُونَ
entries.t: Say, "It is God who delivers you from it, and from every disaster. Yet then you associate others with Him."
entries.na: قل الله ينجيكم منها ومن كل كرب ثم انتم تشركون
entries.nt: say it is god who delivers you from it and from every disaster yet then you associate others with him

entries.a: قُلْ هُوَ ٱلْقَادِرُ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يَبْعَثَ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابًۭا مِّن فَوْقِكُمْ أَوْ مِن تَحْتِ أَرْجُلِكُمْ أَوْ يَلْبِسَكُمْ شِيَعًۭا وَيُذِيقَ بَعْضَكُم بَأْسَ بَعْضٍ ۗ ٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ نُصَرِّفُ ٱلْءَايَٰتِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَفْقَهُونَ
entries.t: Say, "He is Able to send upon you an affliction, from above you, or from under your feet. Or He can divide you into factions, and make you taste the violence of one another. Note how We explain the revelations, so that they may understand."
entries.na: قل هو القادر علي ان يبعث عليكم عذابا من فوقكم او من تحت ارجلكم او يلبسكم شيعا ويذيق بعضكم باس بعض انظر كيف نصرف الايت لعلهم يفقهون
entries.nt: say he is able to send upon you an affliction from above you or from under your feet or he can divide you into factions and make you taste the violence of one another note how we explain the revelations so that they may understand

entries.a: وَكَذَّبَ بِهِۦ قَوْمُكَ وَهُوَ ٱلْحَقُّ ۚ قُل لَّسْتُ عَلَيْكُم بِوَكِيلٍۢ
entries.t: But your people rejected it, though it is the truth. Say, "I am not responsible for you."
entries.na: وكذب به قومك وهو الحق قل لست عليكم بوكيل
entries.nt: but your people rejected it though it is the truth say i am not responsible for you

entries.a: لِّكُلِّ نَبَإٍۢ مُّسْتَقَرٌّۭ ۚ وَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ
entries.t: For every happening is a finality, and you will surely know.
entries.na: لكل نبا مستقر وسوف تعلمون
entries.nt: for every happening is a finality and you will surely know

entries.a: وَإِذَا رَأَيْتَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَخُوضُونَ فِىٓ ءَايَٰتِنَا فَأَعْرِضْ عَنْهُمْ حَتَّىٰ يَخُوضُوا۟ فِى حَدِيثٍ غَيْرِهِۦ ۚ وَإِمَّا يُنسِيَنَّكَ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ فَلَا تَقْعُدْ بَعْدَ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ مَعَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
entries.t: When you encounter those who gossip about Our revelations, turn away from them, until they engage in another topic. But should Satan make you forget, do not sit after the recollection with the wicked people.
entries.na: واذا رايت الذين يخوضون في ايتنا فاعرض عنهم حتي يخوضوا في حديث غيره واما ينسينك الشيطن فلا تقعد بعد الذكري مع القوم الظلمين
entries.nt: when you encounter those who gossip about our revelations turn away from them until they engage in another topic but should satan make you forget do not sit after the recollection with the wicked people

entries.a: وَمَا عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ يَتَّقُونَ مِنْ حِسَابِهِم مِّن شَىْءٍۢ وَلَٰكِن ذِكْرَىٰ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَّقُونَ
entries.t: The righteous are in no way accountable for them; it is only a reminder, that they may be careful.
entries.na: وما علي الذين يتقون من حسابهم من شي ولكن ذكري لعلهم يتقون
entries.nt: the righteous are in no way accountable for them it is only a reminder that they may be careful

entries.a: وَذَرِ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ دِينَهُمْ لَعِبًۭا وَلَهْوًۭا وَغَرَّتْهُمُ ٱلْحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنْيَا ۚ وَذَكِّرْ بِهِۦٓ أَن تُبْسَلَ نَفْسٌۢ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ لَيْسَ لَهَا مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَلِىٌّۭ وَلَا شَفِيعٌۭ وَإِن تَعْدِلْ كُلَّ عَدْلٍۢ لَّا يُؤْخَذْ مِنْهَآ ۗ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُبْسِلُوا۟ بِمَا كَسَبُوا۟ ۖ لَهُمْ شَرَابٌۭ مِّنْ حَمِيمٍۢ وَعَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌۢ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَكْفُرُونَ
entries.t: So leave alone those who take their religion for play and pastime, and whom the worldly life has deceived. But remind with it, lest a soul becomes damned on account of what it has earned. It has no helper or intercessor besides God. Even if it offers every equivalent, none will be accepted from it. These are the ones who are delivered to perdition by their actions. They will have a drink of scalding water, and a painful punishment, because they used to disbelieve.
entries.na: وذر الذين اتخذوا دينهم لعبا ولهوا وغرتهم الحيوه الدنيا وذكر به ان تبسل نفس بما كسبت ليس لها من دون الله ولي ولا شفيع وان تعدل كل عدل لا يوخذ منها اوليك الذين ابسلوا بما كسبوا لهم شراب من حميم وعذاب اليم بما كانوا يكفرون
entries.nt: so leave alone those who take their religion for play and pastime and whom the worldly life has deceived but remind with it lest a soul becomes damned on account of what it has earned it has no helper or intercessor besides god even if it offers every equivalent none will be accepted from it these are the ones who are delivered to perdition by their actions they will have a drink of scalding water and a painful punishment because they used to disbelieve

entries.a: قُلْ أَنَدْعُوا۟ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا يَنفَعُنَا وَلَا يَضُرُّنَا وَنُرَدُّ عَلَىٰٓ أَعْقَابِنَا بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَىٰنَا ٱللَّهُ كَٱلَّذِى ٱسْتَهْوَتْهُ ٱلشَّيَٰطِينُ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ حَيْرَانَ لَهُۥٓ أَصْحَٰبٌۭ يَدْعُونَهُۥٓ إِلَى ٱلْهُدَى ٱئْتِنَا ۗ قُلْ إِنَّ هُدَى ٱللَّهِ هُوَ ٱلْهُدَىٰ ۖ وَأُمِرْنَا لِنُسْلِمَ لِرَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
entries.t: Say, "Shall we invoke besides God something that can neither benefit us nor harm us, and turn back on our heels after God has guided us; like someone seduced by the devils and confused on earth, who has friends calling him to guidance: 'Come to us'?" Say, "The guidance of God is the guidance, and we are commanded to surrender to the Lord of the Universe."
entries.na: قل اندعوا من دون الله ما لا ينفعنا ولا يضرنا ونرد علي اعقابنا بعد اذ هدينا الله كالذي استهوته الشيطين في الارض حيران له اصحب يدعونه الي الهدي ايتنا قل ان هدي الله هو الهدي وامرنا لنسلم لرب العلمين
entries.nt: say shall we invoke besides god something that can neither benefit us nor harm us and turn back on our heels after god has guided us like someone seduced by the devils and confused on earth who has friends calling him to guidance come to us say the guidance of god is the guidance and we are commanded to surrender to the lord of the universe

entries.a: وَأَنْ أَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَٱتَّقُوهُ ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ إِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُونَ
entries.t: "And to perform the prayers, and to revere Him; it is to Him that you will be gathered."
entries.na: وان اقيموا الصلوه واتقوه وهو الذي اليه تحشرون
entries.nt: and to perform the prayers and to revere him it is to him that you will be gathered

entries.a: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۖ وَيَوْمَ يَقُولُ كُن فَيَكُونُ ۚ قَوْلُهُ ٱلْحَقُّ ۚ وَلَهُ ٱلْمُلْكُ يَوْمَ يُنفَخُ فِى ٱلصُّورِ ۚ عَٰلِمُ ٱلْغَيْبِ وَٱلشَّهَٰدَةِ ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْحَكِيمُ ٱلْخَبِيرُ
entries.t: It is He who created the heavens and the earth in truth. On the Day when He says: "Be," it will be. His saying is the truth, and His is the sovereignty on the Day when the trumpet is blown. The Knower of secrets and declarations. He is the Wise, the Expert.
entries.na: وهو الذي خلق السموت والارض بالحق ويوم يقول كن فيكون قوله الحق وله الملك يوم ينفخ في الصور علم الغيب والشهده وهو الحكيم الخبير
entries.nt: it is he who created the heavens and the earth in truth on the day when he says be it will be his saying is the truth and his is the sovereignty on the day when the trumpet is blown the knower of secrets and declarations he is the wise the expert

entries.a: ۞ وَإِذْ قَالَ إِبْرَٰهِيمُ لِأَبِيهِ ءَازَرَ أَتَتَّخِذُ أَصْنَامًا ءَالِهَةً ۖ إِنِّىٓ أَرَىٰكَ وَقَوْمَكَ فِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
entries.t: Abraham said to his father Azar, "Do you take idols for gods? I see that you and your people are in evident error."
entries.na: واذ قال ابرهيم لابيه ازر اتتخذ اصناما الهه اني اريك وقومك في ضلل مبين
entries.nt: abraham said to his father azar do you take idols for gods i see that you and your people are in evident error

entries.a: وَكَذَٰلِكَ نُرِىٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ مَلَكُوتَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَلِيَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُوقِنِينَ
entries.t: Thus We showed Abraham the empire of the heavens and the earth, that he might be one of those with certainty.
entries.na: وكذلك نري ابرهيم ملكوت السموت والارض وليكون من الموقنين
entries.nt: thus we showed abraham the empire of the heavens and the earth that he might be one of those with certainty

entries.a: فَلَمَّا جَنَّ عَلَيْهِ ٱلَّيْلُ رَءَا كَوْكَبًۭا ۖ قَالَ هَٰذَا رَبِّى ۖ فَلَمَّآ أَفَلَ قَالَ لَآ أُحِبُّ ٱلْءَافِلِينَ
entries.t: When the night fell over him, he saw a planet. He said, "This is my lord." But when it set, he said, "I do not love those that set."
entries.na: فلما جن عليه اليل را كوكبا قال هذا ربي فلما افل قال لا احب الافلين
entries.nt: when the night fell over him he saw a planet he said this is my lord but when it set he said i do not love those that set

entries.a: فَلَمَّا رَءَا ٱلْقَمَرَ بَازِغًۭا قَالَ هَٰذَا رَبِّى ۖ فَلَمَّآ أَفَلَ قَالَ لَئِن لَّمْ يَهْدِنِى رَبِّى لَأَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ
entries.t: Then, when he saw the moon rising, he said, "This is my lord." But when it set, he said, "If my Lord does not guide me, I will be one of the erring people."
entries.na: فلما را القمر بازغا قال هذا ربي فلما افل قال لين لم يهدني ربي لاكونن من القوم الضالين
entries.nt: then when he saw the moon rising he said this is my lord but when it set he said if my lord does not guide me i will be one of the erring people

entries.a: فَلَمَّا رَءَا ٱلشَّمْسَ بَازِغَةًۭ قَالَ هَٰذَا رَبِّى هَٰذَآ أَكْبَرُ ۖ فَلَمَّآ أَفَلَتْ قَالَ يَٰقَوْمِ إِنِّى بَرِىٓءٌۭ مِّمَّا تُشْرِكُونَ
entries.t: Then, when he saw the sun rising, he said, "This is my lord, this is bigger." But when it set, he said, "O my people, I am innocent of your idolatry.
entries.na: فلما را الشمس بازغه قال هذا ربي هذا اكبر فلما افلت قال يقوم اني بري مما تشركون
entries.nt: then when he saw the sun rising he said this is my lord this is bigger but when it set he said o my people i am innocent of your idolatry

entries.a: إِنِّى وَجَّهْتُ وَجْهِىَ لِلَّذِى فَطَرَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ حَنِيفًۭا ۖ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ
entries.t: I have directed my attention towards Him Who created the heavens and the earth-a monotheist-and I am not of the idolaters."
entries.na: اني وجهت وجهي للذي فطر السموت والارض حنيفا وما انا من المشركين
entries.nt: i have directed my attention towards him who created the heavens and the earth a monotheist and i am not of the idolaters

entries.a: وَحَآجَّهُۥ قَوْمُهُۥ ۚ قَالَ أَتُحَٰٓجُّوٓنِّى فِى ٱللَّهِ وَقَدْ هَدَىٰنِ ۚ وَلَآ أَخَافُ مَا تُشْرِكُونَ بِهِۦٓ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ رَبِّى شَيْـًۭٔا ۗ وَسِعَ رَبِّى كُلَّ شَىْءٍ عِلْمًا ۗ أَفَلَا تَتَذَكَّرُونَ
entries.t: And his people argued with him. He said, "Do you argue with me about God, when He has guided me? I do not fear what you associate with Him, unless my Lord wills it. My Lord comprehends all things in knowledge. Will you not reconsider?
entries.na: وحاجه قومه قال اتحجوني في الله وقد هدين ولا اخاف ما تشركون به الا ان يشا ربي شيا وسع ربي كل شي علما افلا تتذكرون
entries.nt: and his people argued with him he said do you argue with me about god when he has guided me i do not fear what you associate with him unless my lord wills it my lord comprehends all things in knowledge will you not reconsider

entries.a: وَكَيْفَ أَخَافُ مَآ أَشْرَكْتُمْ وَلَا تَخَافُونَ أَنَّكُمْ أَشْرَكْتُم بِٱللَّهِ مَا لَمْ يُنَزِّلْ بِهِۦ عَلَيْكُمْ سُلْطَٰنًۭا ۚ فَأَىُّ ٱلْفَرِيقَيْنِ أَحَقُّ بِٱلْأَمْنِ ۖ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
entries.t: And why should I fear those you associate with Him, and you do not fear associating others with God for which He sent down to you no authority? Which side is more entitled to security, if you are aware?"
entries.na: وكيف اخاف ما اشركتم ولا تخافون انكم اشركتم بالله ما لم ينزل به عليكم سلطنا فاي الفريقين احق بالامن ان كنتم تعلمون
entries.nt: and why should i fear those you associate with him and you do not fear associating others with god for which he sent down to you no authority which side is more entitled to security if you are aware

entries.a: ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَلَمْ يَلْبِسُوٓا۟ إِيمَٰنَهُم بِظُلْمٍ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمُ ٱلْأَمْنُ وَهُم مُّهْتَدُونَ
entries.t: Those who believe, and do not obscure their faith with wrongdoing-those will have security, and they are guided.
entries.na: الذين امنوا ولم يلبسوا ايمنهم بظلم اوليك لهم الامن وهم مهتدون
entries.nt: those who believe and do not obscure their faith with wrongdoing those will have security and they are guided

entries.a: وَتِلْكَ حُجَّتُنَآ ءَاتَيْنَٰهَآ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ عَلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦ ۚ نَرْفَعُ دَرَجَٰتٍۢ مَّن نَّشَآءُ ۗ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ حَكِيمٌ عَلِيمٌۭ
entries.t: That was Our argument which We gave to Abraham against his people. We elevate by degrees whomever We will. Your Lord is Wise and Informed.
entries.na: وتلك حجتنا اتينها ابرهيم علي قومه نرفع درجت من نشا ان ربك حكيم عليم
entries.nt: that was our argument which we gave to abraham against his people we elevate by degrees whomever we will your lord is wise and informed

entries.a: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُۥٓ إِسْحَٰقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ ۚ كُلًّا هَدَيْنَا ۚ وَنُوحًا هَدَيْنَا مِن قَبْلُ ۖ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِهِۦ دَاوُۥدَ وَسُلَيْمَٰنَ وَأَيُّوبَ وَيُوسُفَ وَمُوسَىٰ وَهَٰرُونَ ۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
entries.t: And We gave him Isaac and Jacob-each of them We guided. And We guided Noah previously; and from his descendants David, and Solomon, and Job, and Joseph, and Moses, and Aaron. Thus We reward the righteous.
entries.na: ووهبنا له اسحق ويعقوب كلا هدينا ونوحا هدينا من قبل ومن ذريته داود وسليمن وايوب ويوسف وموسي وهرون وكذلك نجزي المحسنين
entries.nt: and we gave him isaac and jacob each of them we guided and we guided noah previously and from his descendants david and solomon and job and joseph and moses and aaron thus we reward the righteous

entries.a: وَزَكَرِيَّا وَيَحْيَىٰ وَعِيسَىٰ وَإِلْيَاسَ ۖ كُلٌّۭ مِّنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
entries.t: And Zechariah, and John, and Jesus, and Elias-every one of them was of the upright.
entries.na: وزكريا ويحيي وعيسي والياس كل من الصلحين
entries.nt: and zechariah and john and jesus and elias every one of them was of the upright

entries.a: وَإِسْمَٰعِيلَ وَٱلْيَسَعَ وَيُونُسَ وَلُوطًۭا ۚ وَكُلًّۭا فَضَّلْنَا عَلَى ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
entries.t: And Ishmael, and Elijah, and Jonah, and Lot-We favored each one of them over all other people.
entries.na: واسمعيل واليسع ويونس ولوطا وكلا فضلنا علي العلمين
entries.nt: and ishmael and elijah and jonah and lot we favored each one of them over all other people

entries.a: وَمِنْ ءَابَآئِهِمْ وَذُرِّيَّٰتِهِمْ وَإِخْوَٰنِهِمْ ۖ وَٱجْتَبَيْنَٰهُمْ وَهَدَيْنَٰهُمْ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍۢ مُّسْتَقِيمٍۢ
entries.t: And of their ancestors, and their descendants, and their siblings-We chose them, and guided them to a straight path.
entries.na: ومن ابايهم وذريتهم واخونهم واجتبينهم وهدينهم الي صرط مستقيم
entries.nt: and of their ancestors and their descendants and their siblings we chose them and guided them to a straight path

entries.a: ذَٰلِكَ هُدَى ٱللَّهِ يَهْدِى بِهِۦ مَن يَشَآءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِۦ ۚ وَلَوْ أَشْرَكُوا۟ لَحَبِطَ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
entries.t: Such is God's guidance. He guides with it whomever He wills of His servants. Had they associated, their deeds would have gone in vain.
entries.na: ذلك هدي الله يهدي به من يشا من عباده ولو اشركوا لحبط عنهم ما كانوا يعملون
entries.nt: such is god s guidance he guides with it whomever he wills of his servants had they associated their deeds would have gone in vain

entries.a: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَاتَيْنَٰهُمُ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ وَٱلْحُكْمَ وَٱلنُّبُوَّةَ ۚ فَإِن يَكْفُرْ بِهَا هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ فَقَدْ وَكَّلْنَا بِهَا قَوْمًۭا لَّيْسُوا۟ بِهَا بِكَٰفِرِينَ
entries.t: Those are they to whom We gave the Book, and wisdom, and prophethood. If these reject them, We have entrusted them to others who do not reject them.
entries.na: اوليك الذين اتينهم الكتب والحكم والنبوه فان يكفر بها هولا فقد وكلنا بها قوما ليسوا بها بكفرين
entries.nt: those are they to whom we gave the book and wisdom and prophethood if these reject them we have entrusted them to others who do not reject them

entries.a: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ هَدَى ٱللَّهُ ۖ فَبِهُدَىٰهُمُ ٱقْتَدِهْ ۗ قُل لَّآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ أَجْرًا ۖ إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرَىٰ لِلْعَٰلَمِينَ
entries.t: Those are they whom God has guided, so follow their guidance. Say, "I ask of you no compensation for it; it is just a reminder for all mankind."
entries.na: اوليك الذين هدي الله فبهديهم اقتده قل لا اسلكم عليه اجرا ان هو الا ذكري للعلمين
entries.nt: those are they whom god has guided so follow their guidance say i ask of you no compensation for it it is just a reminder for all mankind

entries.a: وَمَا قَدَرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ حَقَّ قَدْرِهِۦٓ إِذْ قَالُوا۟ مَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ بَشَرٍۢ مِّن شَىْءٍۢ ۗ قُلْ مَنْ أَنزَلَ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ ٱلَّذِى جَآءَ بِهِۦ مُوسَىٰ نُورًۭا وَهُدًۭى لِّلنَّاسِ ۖ تَجْعَلُونَهُۥ قَرَاطِيسَ تُبْدُونَهَا وَتُخْفُونَ كَثِيرًۭا ۖ وَعُلِّمْتُم مَّا لَمْ تَعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنتُمْ وَلَآ ءَابَآؤُكُمْ ۖ قُلِ ٱللَّهُ ۖ ثُمَّ ذَرْهُمْ فِى خَوْضِهِمْ يَلْعَبُونَ
entries.t: They do not value God as He should be valued, when they say, "God did not reveal anything to any human being." Say, "Who revealed the Scripture which Moses brought-a light and guidance for humanity?" You put it on scrolls, displaying them, yet concealing much. And you were taught what you did not know-neither you, nor your ancestors. Say, "God;" then leave them toying away in their speculation.
entries.na: وما قدروا الله حق قدره اذ قالوا ما انزل الله علي بشر من شي قل من انزل الكتب الذي جا به موسي نورا وهدي للناس تجعلونه قراطيس تبدونها وتخفون كثيرا وعلمتم ما لم تعلموا انتم ولا اباوكم قل الله ثم ذرهم في خوضهم يلعبون
entries.nt: they do not value god as he should be valued when they say god did not reveal anything to any human being say who revealed the scripture which moses brought a light and guidance for humanity you put it on scrolls displaying them yet concealing much and you were taught what you did not know neither you nor your ancestors say god then leave them toying away in their speculation

entries.a: وَهَٰذَا كِتَٰبٌ أَنزَلْنَٰهُ مُبَارَكٌۭ مُّصَدِّقُ ٱلَّذِى بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ وَلِتُنذِرَ أُمَّ ٱلْقُرَىٰ وَمَنْ حَوْلَهَا ۚ وَٱلَّذِينَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْءَاخِرَةِ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِۦ ۖ وَهُمْ عَلَىٰ صَلَاتِهِمْ يُحَافِظُونَ
entries.t: This too is a Scripture that We revealed-blessed-verifying what preceded it, that you may warn the Mother of Cities and all around it. Those who believe in the Hereafter believe in it, and are dedicated to their prayers.
entries.na: وهذا كتب انزلنه مبارك مصدق الذي بين يديه ولتنذر ام القري ومن حولها والذين يومنون بالاخره يومنون به وهم علي صلاتهم يحافظون
entries.nt: this too is a scripture that we revealed blessed verifying what preceded it that you may warn the mother of cities and all around it those who believe in the hereafter believe in it and are dedicated to their prayers

entries.a: وَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّنِ ٱفْتَرَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًا أَوْ قَالَ أُوحِىَ إِلَىَّ وَلَمْ يُوحَ إِلَيْهِ شَىْءٌۭ وَمَن قَالَ سَأُنزِلُ مِثْلَ مَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ ۗ وَلَوْ تَرَىٰٓ إِذِ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ فِى غَمَرَٰتِ ٱلْمَوْتِ وَٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ بَاسِطُوٓا۟ أَيْدِيهِمْ أَخْرِجُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَكُمُ ۖ ٱلْيَوْمَ تُجْزَوْنَ عَذَابَ ٱلْهُونِ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَقُولُونَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ غَيْرَ ٱلْحَقِّ وَكُنتُمْ عَنْ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ تَسْتَكْبِرُونَ
entries.t: Who does greater wrong than someone who invents falsehood against God, or says, "It was revealed to me," when nothing was revealed to him, or says, "I will reveal the like of what God revealed"? If only you could see the wrongdoers in the floods of death, as the angels with arms outstretched: "Give up your souls. Today you are being repaid with the torment of shame for having said about God other than the truth, and for being too proud to accept His revelations."
entries.na: ومن اظلم ممن افتري علي الله كذبا او قال اوحي الي ولم يوح اليه شي ومن قال سانزل مثل ما انزل الله ولو تري اذ الظلمون في غمرت الموت والمليكه باسطوا ايديهم اخرجوا انفسكم اليوم تجزون عذاب الهون بما كنتم تقولون علي الله غير الحق وكنتم عن ايته تستكبرون
entries.nt: who does greater wrong than someone who invents falsehood against god or says it was revealed to me when nothing was revealed to him or says i will reveal the like of what god revealed if only you could see the wrongdoers in the floods of death as the angels with arms outstretched give up your souls today you are being repaid with the torment of shame for having said about god other than the truth and for being too proud to accept his revelations

entries.a: وَلَقَدْ جِئْتُمُونَا فُرَٰدَىٰ كَمَا خَلَقْنَٰكُمْ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍۢ وَتَرَكْتُم مَّا خَوَّلْنَٰكُمْ وَرَآءَ ظُهُورِكُمْ ۖ وَمَا نَرَىٰ مَعَكُمْ شُفَعَآءَكُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ زَعَمْتُمْ أَنَّهُمْ فِيكُمْ شُرَكَٰٓؤُا۟ ۚ لَقَد تَّقَطَّعَ بَيْنَكُمْ وَضَلَّ عَنكُم مَّا كُنتُمْ تَزْعُمُونَ
entries.t: "You have come to Us individually, just as We created you the first time, leaving behind you everything We gave you. We do not see with you your intercessors-those you claimed were your partners. The link between you is cut, and what you had asserted has failed you."
entries.na: ولقد جيتمونا فردي كما خلقنكم اول مره وتركتم ما خولنكم ورا ظهوركم وما نري معكم شفعاكم الذين زعمتم انهم فيكم شركوا لقد تقطع بينكم وضل عنكم ما كنتم تزعمون
entries.nt: you have come to us individually just as we created you the first time leaving behind you everything we gave you we do not see with you your intercessors those you claimed were your partners the link between you is cut and what you had asserted has failed you

entries.a: ۞ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ فَالِقُ ٱلْحَبِّ وَٱلنَّوَىٰ ۖ يُخْرِجُ ٱلْحَىَّ مِنَ ٱلْمَيِّتِ وَمُخْرِجُ ٱلْمَيِّتِ مِنَ ٱلْحَىِّ ۚ ذَٰلِكُمُ ٱللَّهُ ۖ فَأَنَّىٰ تُؤْفَكُونَ
entries.t: It is God Who splits the grain and the seed. He brings the living from the dead, and He brings the dead from the living. Such is God. So how could you deviate?
entries.na: ان الله فالق الحب والنوي يخرج الحي من الميت ومخرج الميت من الحي ذلكم الله فاني توفكون
entries.nt: it is god who splits the grain and the seed he brings the living from the dead and he brings the dead from the living such is god so how could you deviate

entries.a: فَالِقُ ٱلْإِصْبَاحِ وَجَعَلَ ٱلَّيْلَ سَكَنًۭا وَٱلشَّمْسَ وَٱلْقَمَرَ حُسْبَانًۭا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ تَقْدِيرُ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْعَلِيمِ
entries.t: It is He Who breaks the dawn. And He made the night for rest, and the sun and the moon for calculation. Such is the disposition of the Almighty, the All-Knowing.
entries.na: فالق الاصباح وجعل اليل سكنا والشمس والقمر حسبانا ذلك تقدير العزيز العليم
entries.nt: it is he who breaks the dawn and he made the night for rest and the sun and the moon for calculation such is the disposition of the almighty the all knowing

entries.a: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلنُّجُومَ لِتَهْتَدُوا۟ بِهَا فِى ظُلُمَٰتِ ٱلْبَرِّ وَٱلْبَحْرِ ۗ قَدْ فَصَّلْنَا ٱلْءَايَٰتِ لِقَوْمٍۢ يَعْلَمُونَ
entries.t: And it is He Who created the stars for you, that you may be guided by them in the darkness of land and sea. We thus explain the revelations for people who know.
entries.na: وهو الذي جعل لكم النجوم لتهتدوا بها في ظلمت البر والبحر قد فصلنا الايت لقوم يعلمون
entries.nt: and it is he who created the stars for you that you may be guided by them in the darkness of land and sea we thus explain the revelations for people who know

entries.a: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنشَأَكُم مِّن نَّفْسٍۢ وَٰحِدَةٍۢ فَمُسْتَقَرٌّۭ وَمُسْتَوْدَعٌۭ ۗ قَدْ فَصَّلْنَا ٱلْءَايَٰتِ لِقَوْمٍۢ يَفْقَهُونَ
entries.t: And it is He who produced you from a single person, then a repository, then a depository. We have detailed the revelations for people who understand.
entries.na: وهو الذي انشاكم من نفس وحده فمستقر ومستودع قد فصلنا الايت لقوم يفقهون
entries.nt: and it is he who produced you from a single person then a repository then a depository we have detailed the revelations for people who understand

entries.a: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۭ فَأَخْرَجْنَا بِهِۦ نَبَاتَ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ فَأَخْرَجْنَا مِنْهُ خَضِرًۭا نُّخْرِجُ مِنْهُ حَبًّۭا مُّتَرَاكِبًۭا وَمِنَ ٱلنَّخْلِ مِن طَلْعِهَا قِنْوَانٌۭ دَانِيَةٌۭ وَجَنَّٰتٍۢ مِّنْ أَعْنَابٍۢ وَٱلزَّيْتُونَ وَٱلرُّمَّانَ مُشْتَبِهًۭا وَغَيْرَ مُتَشَٰبِهٍ ۗ ٱنظُرُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ ثَمَرِهِۦٓ إِذَآ أَثْمَرَ وَيَنْعِهِۦٓ ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكُمْ لَءَايَٰتٍۢ لِّقَوْمٍۢ يُؤْمِنُونَ
entries.t: And it is He who sends down water from the sky. With it We produce vegetation of all kinds, from which We bring greenery, from which We produce grains in clusters. And palm-trees with hanging clusters, and vineyards, and olives, and pomegranates-similar and dissimilar. Watch their fruits as they grow and ripen. Surely in this are signs for people who believe.
entries.na: وهو الذي انزل من السما ما فاخرجنا به نبات كل شي فاخرجنا منه خضرا نخرج منه حبا متراكبا ومن النخل من طلعها قنوان دانيه وجنت من اعناب والزيتون والرمان مشتبها وغير متشبه انظروا الي ثمره اذا اثمر وينعه ان في ذلكم لايت لقوم يومنون
entries.nt: and it is he who sends down water from the sky with it we produce vegetation of all kinds from which we bring greenery from which we produce grains in clusters and palm trees with hanging clusters and vineyards and olives and pomegranates similar and dissimilar watch their fruits as they grow and ripen surely in this are signs for people who believe

entries.a: وَجَعَلُوا۟ لِلَّهِ شُرَكَآءَ ٱلْجِنَّ وَخَلَقَهُمْ ۖ وَخَرَقُوا۟ لَهُۥ بَنِينَ وَبَنَٰتٍۭ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍۢ ۚ سُبْحَٰنَهُۥ وَتَعَٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
entries.t: Yet they attributed to God partners-the sprites-although He created them. And they invented for Him sons and daughters, without any knowledge. Glory be to Him. He is exalted, beyond what they describe.
entries.na: وجعلوا لله شركا الجن وخلقهم وخرقوا له بنين وبنت بغير علم سبحنه وتعلي عما يصفون
entries.nt: yet they attributed to god partners the sprites although he created them and they invented for him sons and daughters without any knowledge glory be to him he is exalted beyond what they describe

entries.a: بَدِيعُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ أَنَّىٰ يَكُونُ لَهُۥ وَلَدٌۭ وَلَمْ تَكُن لَّهُۥ صَٰحِبَةٌۭ ۖ وَخَلَقَ كُلَّ شَىْءٍۢ ۖ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌۭ
entries.t: Originator of the heavens and the earth-how can He have a son when He never had a companion? He created all things, and He has knowledge of all things.
entries.na: بديع السموت والارض اني يكون له ولد ولم تكن له صحبه وخلق كل شي وهو بكل شي عليم
entries.nt: originator of the heavens and the earth how can he have a son when he never had a companion he created all things and he has knowledge of all things

entries.a: ذَٰلِكُمُ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّكُمْ ۖ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ خَٰلِقُ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ فَٱعْبُدُوهُ ۚ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ وَكِيلٌۭ
