entries.a: أَلَآ إِنَّ لِلَّهِ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ قَدْ يَعْلَمُ مَآ أَنتُمْ عَلَيْهِ وَيَوْمَ يُرْجَعُونَ إِلَيْهِ فَيُنَبِّئُهُم بِمَا عَمِلُوا۟ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌۢ
entries.t: Surely, to God belongs everything in the heavens and the earth. He knows what you are about. And on the Day they are returned to Him, He will inform them of what they did. God has full knowledge of all things.
entries.na: الا ان لله ما في السموت والارض قد يعلم ما انتم عليه ويوم يرجعون اليه فينبيهم بما عملوا والله بكل شي عليم
entries.nt: surely to god belongs everything in the heavens and the earth he knows what you are about and on the day they are returned to him he will inform them of what they did god has full knowledge of all things

entries.a: تَبَارَكَ ٱلَّذِى نَزَّلَ ٱلْفُرْقَانَ عَلَىٰ عَبْدِهِۦ لِيَكُونَ لِلْعَٰلَمِينَ نَذِيرًا
entries.t: Blessed is He who sent down the Criterion upon His servant, to be a warning to humanity.
entries.na: تبارك الذي نزل الفرقان علي عبده ليكون للعلمين نذيرا
entries.nt: blessed is he who sent down the criterion upon his servant to be a warning to humanity

entries.a: ٱلَّذِى لَهُۥ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَمْ يَتَّخِذْ وَلَدًۭا وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُۥ شَرِيكٌۭ فِى ٱلْمُلْكِ وَخَلَقَ كُلَّ شَىْءٍۢ فَقَدَّرَهُۥ تَقْدِيرًۭا
entries.t: He to whom belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth, who took to Himself no son, who never had a partner in His kingship; who created everything and determined its measure.
entries.na: الذي له ملك السموت والارض ولم يتخذ ولدا ولم يكن له شريك في الملك وخلق كل شي فقدره تقديرا
entries.nt: he to whom belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth who took to himself no son who never had a partner in his kingship who created everything and determined its measure

entries.a: وَٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ ءَالِهَةًۭ لَّا يَخْلُقُونَ شَيْـًۭٔا وَهُمْ يُخْلَقُونَ وَلَا يَمْلِكُونَ لِأَنفُسِهِمْ ضَرًّۭا وَلَا نَفْعًۭا وَلَا يَمْلِكُونَ مَوْتًۭا وَلَا حَيَوٰةًۭ وَلَا نُشُورًۭا
entries.t: And yet, instead of Him, they produce for themselves gods that create nothing, but are themselves created; that have no power to harm or benefit themselves; and no power over life, death, or resurrection.
entries.na: واتخذوا من دونه الهه لا يخلقون شيا وهم يخلقون ولا يملكون لانفسهم ضرا ولا نفعا ولا يملكون موتا ولا حيوه ولا نشورا
entries.nt: and yet instead of him they produce for themselves gods that create nothing but are themselves created that have no power to harm or benefit themselves and no power over life death or resurrection

entries.a: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ إِنْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّآ إِفْكٌ ٱفْتَرَىٰهُ وَأَعَانَهُۥ عَلَيْهِ قَوْمٌ ءَاخَرُونَ ۖ فَقَدْ جَآءُو ظُلْمًۭا وَزُورًۭا
entries.t: Those who disbelieve say, "This is nothing but a lie that he made up, and others have helped him at it." They have committed an injustice and a perjury.
entries.na: وقال الذين كفروا ان هذا الا افك افتريه واعانه عليه قوم اخرون فقد جاو ظلما وزورا
entries.nt: those who disbelieve say this is nothing but a lie that he made up and others have helped him at it they have committed an injustice and a perjury

entries.a: وَقَالُوٓا۟ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ ٱكْتَتَبَهَا فَهِىَ تُمْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ بُكْرَةًۭ وَأَصِيلًۭا
entries.t: And they say, "Tales of the ancients; he wrote them down; they are dictated to him morning and evening."
entries.na: وقالوا اسطير الاولين اكتتبها فهي تملي عليه بكره واصيلا
entries.nt: and they say tales of the ancients he wrote them down they are dictated to him morning and evening

entries.a: قُلْ أَنزَلَهُ ٱلَّذِى يَعْلَمُ ٱلسِّرَّ فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ غَفُورًۭا رَّحِيمًۭا
entries.t: Say, "It was revealed by He who knows the Secret in the heavens and the earth. He is always Forgiving and Merciful."
entries.na: قل انزله الذي يعلم السر في السموت والارض انه كان غفورا رحيما
entries.nt: say it was revealed by he who knows the secret in the heavens and the earth he is always forgiving and merciful

entries.a: وَقَالُوا۟ مَالِ هَٰذَا ٱلرَّسُولِ يَأْكُلُ ٱلطَّعَامَ وَيَمْشِى فِى ٱلْأَسْوَاقِ ۙ لَوْلَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْهِ مَلَكٌۭ فَيَكُونَ مَعَهُۥ نَذِيرًا
entries.t: And they say, "What sort of messenger is this, who eats food, and walks in the marketplaces? If only an angel was sent down with him, to be alongside him a warner."
entries.na: وقالوا مال هذا الرسول ياكل الطعام ويمشي في الاسواق لولا انزل اليه ملك فيكون معه نذيرا
entries.nt: and they say what sort of messenger is this who eats food and walks in the marketplaces if only an angel was sent down with him to be alongside him a warner

entries.a: أَوْ يُلْقَىٰٓ إِلَيْهِ كَنزٌ أَوْ تَكُونُ لَهُۥ جَنَّةٌۭ يَأْكُلُ مِنْهَا ۚ وَقَالَ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ إِن تَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا رَجُلًۭا مَّسْحُورًا
entries.t: Or, "If only a treasure was dropped on him." Or, "If only he had a garden from which he eats." The evildoers also say, "You are following but a man under spell."
entries.na: او يلقي اليه كنز او تكون له جنه ياكل منها وقال الظلمون ان تتبعون الا رجلا مسحورا
entries.nt: or if only a treasure was dropped on him or if only he had a garden from which he eats the evildoers also say you are following but a man under spell

entries.a: ٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ ضَرَبُوا۟ لَكَ ٱلْأَمْثَٰلَ فَضَلُّوا۟ فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ سَبِيلًۭا
entries.t: Look how they invent examples for you. They have gone astray, and cannot find a way.
entries.na: انظر كيف ضربوا لك الامثل فضلوا فلا يستطيعون سبيلا
entries.nt: look how they invent examples for you they have gone astray and cannot find a way

entries.a: تَبَارَكَ ٱلَّذِىٓ إِن شَآءَ جَعَلَ لَكَ خَيْرًۭا مِّن ذَٰلِكَ جَنَّٰتٍۢ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ وَيَجْعَل لَّكَ قُصُورًۢا
entries.t: Blessed is He who, if He wills, can provide you with better than that-gardens beneath which rivers flow-and He will give you palaces.
entries.na: تبارك الذي ان شا جعل لك خيرا من ذلك جنت تجري من تحتها الانهر ويجعل لك قصورا
entries.nt: blessed is he who if he wills can provide you with better than that gardens beneath which rivers flow and he will give you palaces

entries.a: بَلْ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِٱلسَّاعَةِ ۖ وَأَعْتَدْنَا لِمَن كَذَّبَ بِٱلسَّاعَةِ سَعِيرًا
entries.t: In fact, they have denied the Hour, and We have prepared for those who deny the Hour a Blaze.
entries.na: بل كذبوا بالساعه واعتدنا لمن كذب بالساعه سعيرا
entries.nt: in fact they have denied the hour and we have prepared for those who deny the hour a blaze

entries.a: إِذَا رَأَتْهُم مِّن مَّكَانٍۭ بَعِيدٍۢ سَمِعُوا۟ لَهَا تَغَيُّظًۭا وَزَفِيرًۭا
entries.t: When it sees them from a distant place, they will hear it raging and roaring.
entries.na: اذا راتهم من مكان بعيد سمعوا لها تغيظا وزفيرا
entries.nt: when it sees them from a distant place they will hear it raging and roaring

entries.a: وَإِذَآ أُلْقُوا۟ مِنْهَا مَكَانًۭا ضَيِّقًۭا مُّقَرَّنِينَ دَعَوْا۟ هُنَالِكَ ثُبُورًۭا
entries.t: And when they are thrown into it, into a tight place, shackled, they will plead there for death.
entries.na: واذا القوا منها مكانا ضيقا مقرنين دعوا هنالك ثبورا
entries.nt: and when they are thrown into it into a tight place shackled they will plead there for death

entries.a: لَّا تَدْعُوا۟ ٱلْيَوْمَ ثُبُورًۭا وَٰحِدًۭا وَٱدْعُوا۟ ثُبُورًۭا كَثِيرًۭا
entries.t: "Do not plead for one death today, but plead for a great many deaths."
entries.na: لا تدعوا اليوم ثبورا وحدا وادعوا ثبورا كثيرا
entries.nt: do not plead for one death today but plead for a great many deaths

entries.a: قُلْ أَذَٰلِكَ خَيْرٌ أَمْ جَنَّةُ ٱلْخُلْدِ ٱلَّتِى وُعِدَ ٱلْمُتَّقُونَ ۚ كَانَتْ لَهُمْ جَزَآءًۭ وَمَصِيرًۭا
entries.t: Say, "Is this better, or the Garden of Eternity promised to the righteous? It is for them a reward and a destination.
entries.na: قل اذلك خير ام جنه الخلد التي وعد المتقون كانت لهم جزا ومصيرا
entries.nt: say is this better or the garden of eternity promised to the righteous it is for them a reward and a destination

entries.a: لَّهُمْ فِيهَا مَا يَشَآءُونَ خَٰلِدِينَ ۚ كَانَ عَلَىٰ رَبِّكَ وَعْدًۭا مَّسْـُٔولًۭا
entries.t: They will have therein whatever they desire, forever. That is upon your Lord a binding promise.
entries.na: لهم فيها ما يشاون خلدين كان علي ربك وعدا مسولا
entries.nt: they will have therein whatever they desire forever that is upon your lord a binding promise

entries.a: وَيَوْمَ يَحْشُرُهُمْ وَمَا يَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ فَيَقُولُ ءَأَنتُمْ أَضْلَلْتُمْ عِبَادِى هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ أَمْ هُمْ ضَلُّوا۟ ٱلسَّبِيلَ
entries.t: On the Day when He gathers them, and what they worshiped besides God, He will say, "Was it you who misled these servants of Mine, or was it they who lost the way?"
entries.na: ويوم يحشرهم وما يعبدون من دون الله فيقول انتم اضللتم عبادي هولا ام هم ضلوا السبيل
entries.nt: on the day when he gathers them and what they worshiped besides god he will say was it you who misled these servants of mine or was it they who lost the way

entries.a: قَالُوا۟ سُبْحَٰنَكَ مَا كَانَ يَنۢبَغِى لَنَآ أَن نَّتَّخِذَ مِن دُونِكَ مِنْ أَوْلِيَآءَ وَلَٰكِن مَّتَّعْتَهُمْ وَءَابَآءَهُمْ حَتَّىٰ نَسُوا۟ ٱلذِّكْرَ وَكَانُوا۟ قَوْمًۢا بُورًۭا
entries.t: They will say, "Glory be to You. It was not for us to take any lords besides You. But you gave them enjoyments, and their ancestors, until they forgot the Message, and became ruined people."
entries.na: قالوا سبحنك ما كان ينبغي لنا ان نتخذ من دونك من اوليا ولكن متعتهم واباهم حتي نسوا الذكر وكانوا قوما بورا
entries.nt: they will say glory be to you it was not for us to take any lords besides you but you gave them enjoyments and their ancestors until they forgot the message and became ruined people

entries.a: فَقَدْ كَذَّبُوكُم بِمَا تَقُولُونَ فَمَا تَسْتَطِيعُونَ صَرْفًۭا وَلَا نَصْرًۭا ۚ وَمَن يَظْلِم مِّنكُمْ نُذِقْهُ عَذَابًۭا كَبِيرًۭا
entries.t: They have denied you because of what you say; so you can neither avert, nor help. Whoever among you commits injustice, We will make him taste a grievous punishment.
entries.na: فقد كذبوكم بما تقولون فما تستطيعون صرفا ولا نصرا ومن يظلم منكم نذقه عذابا كبيرا
entries.nt: they have denied you because of what you say so you can neither avert nor help whoever among you commits injustice we will make him taste a grievous punishment

entries.a: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا قَبْلَكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ إِلَّآ إِنَّهُمْ لَيَأْكُلُونَ ٱلطَّعَامَ وَيَمْشُونَ فِى ٱلْأَسْوَاقِ ۗ وَجَعَلْنَا بَعْضَكُمْ لِبَعْضٍۢ فِتْنَةً أَتَصْبِرُونَ ۗ وَكَانَ رَبُّكَ بَصِيرًۭا
entries.t: We never sent any messengers before you, but they ate food and walked in the marketplaces. And We made some of you tempters for one another-will you be patient? Your Lord is always Observing.
entries.na: وما ارسلنا قبلك من المرسلين الا انهم لياكلون الطعام ويمشون في الاسواق وجعلنا بعضكم لبعض فتنه اتصبرون وكان ربك بصيرا
entries.nt: we never sent any messengers before you but they ate food and walked in the marketplaces and we made some of you tempters for one another will you be patient your lord is always observing

entries.a: ۞ وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَرْجُونَ لِقَآءَنَا لَوْلَآ أُنزِلَ عَلَيْنَا ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ أَوْ نَرَىٰ رَبَّنَا ۗ لَقَدِ ٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ فِىٓ أَنفُسِهِمْ وَعَتَوْ عُتُوًّۭا كَبِيرًۭا
entries.t: Those who do not expect to meet Us say, "If only the angels were sent down to us, or we could see our Lord." They have grown arrogant within themselves, and have become excessively defiant.
entries.na: وقال الذين لا يرجون لقانا لولا انزل علينا المليكه او نري ربنا لقد استكبروا في انفسهم وعتو عتوا كبيرا
entries.nt: those who do not expect to meet us say if only the angels were sent down to us or we could see our lord they have grown arrogant within themselves and have become excessively defiant

entries.a: يَوْمَ يَرَوْنَ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ لَا بُشْرَىٰ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُجْرِمِينَ وَيَقُولُونَ حِجْرًۭا مَّحْجُورًۭا
entries.t: On the Day when they see the angels-there will be no good news for sinners on that Day; and they will say, "A protective refuge."
entries.na: يوم يرون المليكه لا بشري يوميذ للمجرمين ويقولون حجرا محجورا
entries.nt: on the day when they see the angels there will be no good news for sinners on that day and they will say a protective refuge

entries.a: وَقَدِمْنَآ إِلَىٰ مَا عَمِلُوا۟ مِنْ عَمَلٍۢ فَجَعَلْنَٰهُ هَبَآءًۭ مَّنثُورًا
entries.t: We will proceed to the works they did, and will turn them into scattered dust.
entries.na: وقدمنا الي ما عملوا من عمل فجعلنه هبا منثورا
entries.nt: we will proceed to the works they did and will turn them into scattered dust

entries.a: أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْجَنَّةِ يَوْمَئِذٍ خَيْرٌۭ مُّسْتَقَرًّۭا وَأَحْسَنُ مَقِيلًۭا
entries.t: The companions of Paradise on that Day will be better lodged, and more fairly accommodated.
entries.na: اصحب الجنه يوميذ خير مستقرا واحسن مقيلا
entries.nt: the companions of paradise on that day will be better lodged and more fairly accommodated

entries.a: وَيَوْمَ تَشَقَّقُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ بِٱلْغَمَٰمِ وَنُزِّلَ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ تَنزِيلًا
entries.t: The Day when the sky is cleft with clouds, and the angels are sent down in streams.
entries.na: ويوم تشقق السما بالغمم ونزل المليكه تنزيلا
entries.nt: the day when the sky is cleft with clouds and the angels are sent down in streams

entries.a: ٱلْمُلْكُ يَوْمَئِذٍ ٱلْحَقُّ لِلرَّحْمَٰنِ ۚ وَكَانَ يَوْمًا عَلَى ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ عَسِيرًۭا
entries.t: On that Day, true sovereignty will belong to the Merciful, and it will be a difficult Day for the disbelievers.
entries.na: الملك يوميذ الحق للرحمن وكان يوما علي الكفرين عسيرا
entries.nt: on that day true sovereignty will belong to the merciful and it will be a difficult day for the disbelievers

entries.a: وَيَوْمَ يَعَضُّ ٱلظَّالِمُ عَلَىٰ يَدَيْهِ يَقُولُ يَٰلَيْتَنِى ٱتَّخَذْتُ مَعَ ٱلرَّسُولِ سَبِيلًۭا
entries.t: On that Day, the wrongdoer will bite his hands, and say, "If only I had followed the way with the Messenger.
entries.na: ويوم يعض الظالم علي يديه يقول يليتني اتخذت مع الرسول سبيلا
entries.nt: on that day the wrongdoer will bite his hands and say if only i had followed the way with the messenger

entries.a: يَٰوَيْلَتَىٰ لَيْتَنِى لَمْ أَتَّخِذْ فُلَانًا خَلِيلًۭا
entries.t: Oh, woe to me; I wish I never took so-and-so for a friend.
entries.na: يويلتي ليتني لم اتخذ فلانا خليلا
entries.nt: oh woe to me i wish i never took so and so for a friend

entries.a: لَّقَدْ أَضَلَّنِى عَنِ ٱلذِّكْرِ بَعْدَ إِذْ جَآءَنِى ۗ وَكَانَ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ لِلْإِنسَٰنِ خَذُولًۭا
entries.t: He led me away from the Message after it had come to me; for Satan has always been a betrayer of man."
entries.na: لقد اضلني عن الذكر بعد اذ جاني وكان الشيطن للانسن خذولا
entries.nt: he led me away from the message after it had come to me for satan has always been a betrayer of man

entries.a: وَقَالَ ٱلرَّسُولُ يَٰرَبِّ إِنَّ قَوْمِى ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ هَٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ مَهْجُورًۭا
entries.t: And the Messenger will say, "My Lord, my people have abandoned this Quran."
entries.na: وقال الرسول يرب ان قومي اتخذوا هذا القران مهجورا
entries.nt: and the messenger will say my lord my people have abandoned this quran

entries.a: وَكَذَٰلِكَ جَعَلْنَا لِكُلِّ نَبِىٍّ عَدُوًّۭا مِّنَ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ ۗ وَكَفَىٰ بِرَبِّكَ هَادِيًۭا وَنَصِيرًۭا
entries.t: Likewise, to every prophet We assign enemies from among the wicked. But your Lord suffices as a Guide and Savior.
entries.na: وكذلك جعلنا لكل نبي عدوا من المجرمين وكفي بربك هاديا ونصيرا
entries.nt: likewise to every prophet we assign enemies from among the wicked but your lord suffices as a guide and savior

entries.a: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَوْلَا نُزِّلَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلْقُرْءَانُ جُمْلَةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ لِنُثَبِّتَ بِهِۦ فُؤَادَكَ ۖ وَرَتَّلْنَٰهُ تَرْتِيلًۭا
entries.t: Those who disbelieve say, "Why was the Quran not revealed to him at once?" Thus in order to strengthen your heart thereby, and We revealed it in stages.
entries.na: وقال الذين كفروا لولا نزل عليه القران جمله وحده كذلك لنثبت به فوادك ورتلنه ترتيلا
entries.nt: those who disbelieve say why was the quran not revealed to him at once thus in order to strengthen your heart thereby and we revealed it in stages

entries.a: وَلَا يَأْتُونَكَ بِمَثَلٍ إِلَّا جِئْنَٰكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَأَحْسَنَ تَفْسِيرًا
entries.t: Whatever argument they come to you with, We provide you with the truth, and a better exposition.
entries.na: ولا ياتونك بمثل الا جينك بالحق واحسن تفسيرا
entries.nt: whatever argument they come to you with we provide you with the truth and a better exposition

entries.a: ٱلَّذِينَ يُحْشَرُونَ عَلَىٰ وُجُوهِهِمْ إِلَىٰ جَهَنَّمَ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ شَرٌّۭ مَّكَانًۭا وَأَضَلُّ سَبِيلًۭا
entries.t: Those who are herded into Hell on their faces-those are in a worse position, and further astray from the way.
entries.na: الذين يحشرون علي وجوههم الي جهنم اوليك شر مكانا واضل سبيلا
entries.nt: those who are herded into hell on their faces those are in a worse position and further astray from the way

entries.a: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَى ٱلْكِتَٰبَ وَجَعَلْنَا مَعَهُۥٓ أَخَاهُ هَٰرُونَ وَزِيرًۭا
entries.t: We gave Moses the Scripture, and appointed his brother Aaron as his assistant.
entries.na: ولقد اتينا موسي الكتب وجعلنا معه اخاه هرون وزيرا
entries.nt: we gave moses the scripture and appointed his brother aaron as his assistant

entries.a: فَقُلْنَا ٱذْهَبَآ إِلَى ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا فَدَمَّرْنَٰهُمْ تَدْمِيرًۭا
entries.t: We said, "Go to the people who rejected Our signs," and We destroyed them completely.
entries.na: فقلنا اذهبا الي القوم الذين كذبوا بايتنا فدمرنهم تدميرا
entries.nt: we said go to the people who rejected our signs and we destroyed them completely

entries.a: وَقَوْمَ نُوحٍۢ لَّمَّا كَذَّبُوا۟ ٱلرُّسُلَ أَغْرَقْنَٰهُمْ وَجَعَلْنَٰهُمْ لِلنَّاسِ ءَايَةًۭ ۖ وَأَعْتَدْنَا لِلظَّٰلِمِينَ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًۭا
entries.t: And the people of Noah: when they rejected the messengers, We drowned them, and made them a lesson for mankind. We have prepared for the wrongdoers a painful retribution.
entries.na: وقوم نوح لما كذبوا الرسل اغرقنهم وجعلنهم للناس ايه واعتدنا للظلمين عذابا اليما
entries.nt: and the people of noah when they rejected the messengers we drowned them and made them a lesson for mankind we have prepared for the wrongdoers a painful retribution

entries.a: وَعَادًۭا وَثَمُودَا۟ وَأَصْحَٰبَ ٱلرَّسِّ وَقُرُونًۢا بَيْنَ ذَٰلِكَ كَثِيرًۭا
entries.t: And Aad, and Thamood, and the inhabitants of Arras, and many generations in between.
entries.na: وعادا وثمودا واصحب الرس وقرونا بين ذلك كثيرا
entries.nt: and aad and thamood and the inhabitants of arras and many generations in between

entries.a: وَكُلًّۭا ضَرَبْنَا لَهُ ٱلْأَمْثَٰلَ ۖ وَكُلًّۭا تَبَّرْنَا تَتْبِيرًۭا
entries.t: To each We presented the parables; and each We devastated utterly.
entries.na: وكلا ضربنا له الامثل وكلا تبرنا تتبيرا
entries.nt: to each we presented the parables and each we devastated utterly

entries.a: وَلَقَدْ أَتَوْا۟ عَلَى ٱلْقَرْيَةِ ٱلَّتِىٓ أُمْطِرَتْ مَطَرَ ٱلسَّوْءِ ۚ أَفَلَمْ يَكُونُوا۟ يَرَوْنَهَا ۚ بَلْ كَانُوا۟ لَا يَرْجُونَ نُشُورًۭا
entries.t: And they came upon the city that was drenched by the terrible rain. Did they not see it? But they do not expect resurrection.
entries.na: ولقد اتوا علي القريه التي امطرت مطر السو افلم يكونوا يرونها بل كانوا لا يرجون نشورا
entries.nt: and they came upon the city that was drenched by the terrible rain did they not see it but they do not expect resurrection

entries.a: وَإِذَا رَأَوْكَ إِن يَتَّخِذُونَكَ إِلَّا هُزُوًا أَهَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى بَعَثَ ٱللَّهُ رَسُولًا
entries.t: And when they see you, they take you for nothing but mockery: "Is this the one God sent as a messenger?"
entries.na: واذا راوك ان يتخذونك الا هزوا اهذا الذي بعث الله رسولا
entries.nt: and when they see you they take you for nothing but mockery is this the one god sent as a messenger

entries.a: إِن كَادَ لَيُضِلُّنَا عَنْ ءَالِهَتِنَا لَوْلَآ أَن صَبَرْنَا عَلَيْهَا ۚ وَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ حِينَ يَرَوْنَ ٱلْعَذَابَ مَنْ أَضَلُّ سَبِيلًا
entries.t: "He nearly led us away from our gods, had we not patiently adhered to them." But they will know, when they witness the torment, who is further away from the way.
entries.na: ان كاد ليضلنا عن الهتنا لولا ان صبرنا عليها وسوف يعلمون حين يرون العذاب من اضل سبيلا
entries.nt: he nearly led us away from our gods had we not patiently adhered to them but they will know when they witness the torment who is further away from the way

entries.a: أَرَءَيْتَ مَنِ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَٰهَهُۥ هَوَىٰهُ أَفَأَنتَ تَكُونُ عَلَيْهِ وَكِيلًا
entries.t: Have you seen him who chose his desire as his god? Would you be an agent for him?
entries.na: اريت من اتخذ الهه هويه افانت تكون عليه وكيلا
entries.nt: have you seen him who chose his desire as his god would you be an agent for him

entries.a: أَمْ تَحْسَبُ أَنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ يَسْمَعُونَ أَوْ يَعْقِلُونَ ۚ إِنْ هُمْ إِلَّا كَٱلْأَنْعَٰمِ ۖ بَلْ هُمْ أَضَلُّ سَبِيلًا
entries.t: Or do you assume that most of them hear or understand? They are just like cattle, but even more errant in their way.
entries.na: ام تحسب ان اكثرهم يسمعون او يعقلون ان هم الا كالانعم بل هم اضل سبيلا
entries.nt: or do you assume that most of them hear or understand they are just like cattle but even more errant in their way

entries.a: أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ كَيْفَ مَدَّ ٱلظِّلَّ وَلَوْ شَآءَ لَجَعَلَهُۥ سَاكِنًۭا ثُمَّ جَعَلْنَا ٱلشَّمْسَ عَلَيْهِ دَلِيلًۭا
entries.t: Do you not see how your Lord extends the shadow? Had He willed, He could have made it still. And We made the sun a pointer to it.
entries.na: الم تر الي ربك كيف مد الظل ولو شا لجعله ساكنا ثم جعلنا الشمس عليه دليلا
entries.nt: do you not see how your lord extends the shadow had he willed he could have made it still and we made the sun a pointer to it

entries.a: ثُمَّ قَبَضْنَٰهُ إِلَيْنَا قَبْضًۭا يَسِيرًۭا
entries.t: Then We withdraw it towards Us gradually.
entries.na: ثم قبضنه الينا قبضا يسيرا
entries.nt: then we withdraw it towards us gradually

entries.a: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلَّيْلَ لِبَاسًۭا وَٱلنَّوْمَ سُبَاتًۭا وَجَعَلَ ٱلنَّهَارَ نُشُورًۭا
entries.t: And it is He who made the night a covering for you, and sleep for rest; and He made the day a revival.
entries.na: وهو الذي جعل لكم اليل لباسا والنوم سباتا وجعل النهار نشورا
entries.nt: and it is he who made the night a covering for you and sleep for rest and he made the day a revival

entries.a: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَرْسَلَ ٱلرِّيَٰحَ بُشْرًۢا بَيْنَ يَدَىْ رَحْمَتِهِۦ ۚ وَأَنزَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۭ طَهُورًۭا
entries.t: And it is He who sends the winds, bringing advance news of His mercy; and We send down from the sky pure water.
entries.na: وهو الذي ارسل الريح بشرا بين يدي رحمته وانزلنا من السما ما طهورا
entries.nt: and it is he who sends the winds bringing advance news of his mercy and we send down from the sky pure water

entries.a: لِّنُحْۦِىَ بِهِۦ بَلْدَةًۭ مَّيْتًۭا وَنُسْقِيَهُۥ مِمَّا خَلَقْنَآ أَنْعَٰمًۭا وَأَنَاسِىَّ كَثِيرًۭا
entries.t: To revive dead lands thereby, and to provide drink for the multitude of animals and humans We created.
entries.na: لنحي به بلده ميتا ونسقيه مما خلقنا انعما واناسي كثيرا
entries.nt: to revive dead lands thereby and to provide drink for the multitude of animals and humans we created

entries.a: وَلَقَدْ صَرَّفْنَٰهُ بَيْنَهُمْ لِيَذَّكَّرُوا۟ فَأَبَىٰٓ أَكْثَرُ ٱلنَّاسِ إِلَّا كُفُورًۭا
entries.t: We have circulated it among them, that they may reflect, but most people persist in thanklessness.
entries.na: ولقد صرفنه بينهم ليذكروا فابي اكثر الناس الا كفورا
entries.nt: we have circulated it among them that they may reflect but most people persist in thanklessness

entries.a: وَلَوْ شِئْنَا لَبَعَثْنَا فِى كُلِّ قَرْيَةٍۢ نَّذِيرًۭا
entries.t: Had We willed, We could have sent to every town a warner.
entries.na: ولو شينا لبعثنا في كل قريه نذيرا
entries.nt: had we willed we could have sent to every town a warner

entries.a: فَلَا تُطِعِ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ وَجَٰهِدْهُم بِهِۦ جِهَادًۭا كَبِيرًۭا
entries.t: So do not obey the disbelievers, but strive against them with it, a mighty struggle.
entries.na: فلا تطع الكفرين وجهدهم به جهادا كبيرا
entries.nt: so do not obey the disbelievers but strive against them with it a mighty struggle

entries.a: ۞ وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى مَرَجَ ٱلْبَحْرَيْنِ هَٰذَا عَذْبٌۭ فُرَاتٌۭ وَهَٰذَا مِلْحٌ أُجَاجٌۭ وَجَعَلَ بَيْنَهُمَا بَرْزَخًۭا وَحِجْرًۭا مَّحْجُورًۭا
entries.t: And it is He who merged the two seas; this one fresh and sweet, and that one salty and bitter; and He placed between them a barrier, and an impassable boundary.
entries.na: وهو الذي مرج البحرين هذا عذب فرات وهذا ملح اجاج وجعل بينهما برزخا وحجرا محجورا
entries.nt: and it is he who merged the two seas this one fresh and sweet and that one salty and bitter and he placed between them a barrier and an impassable boundary

entries.a: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ مِنَ ٱلْمَآءِ بَشَرًۭا فَجَعَلَهُۥ نَسَبًۭا وَصِهْرًۭا ۗ وَكَانَ رَبُّكَ قَدِيرًۭا
entries.t: And it is He who, from fluid, created the human being. Then He made relationships through marriage and mating. Your Lord is Omnipotent.
entries.na: وهو الذي خلق من الما بشرا فجعله نسبا وصهرا وكان ربك قديرا
entries.nt: and it is he who from fluid created the human being then he made relationships through marriage and mating your lord is omnipotent

entries.a: وَيَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا يَنفَعُهُمْ وَلَا يَضُرُّهُمْ ۗ وَكَانَ ٱلْكَافِرُ عَلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ ظَهِيرًۭا
entries.t: And yet, instead of God, they serve what neither profits them nor harms them. The disbeliever has always turned his back on his Lord.
entries.na: ويعبدون من دون الله ما لا ينفعهم ولا يضرهم وكان الكافر علي ربه ظهيرا
entries.nt: and yet instead of god they serve what neither profits them nor harms them the disbeliever has always turned his back on his lord

entries.a: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَٰكَ إِلَّا مُبَشِّرًۭا وَنَذِيرًۭا
entries.t: We sent you only as a herald of good news and a warner.
entries.na: وما ارسلنك الا مبشرا ونذيرا
entries.nt: we sent you only as a herald of good news and a warner

entries.a: قُلْ مَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ إِلَّا مَن شَآءَ أَن يَتَّخِذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلًۭا
entries.t: Say, "I ask of you no payment for this-only that whoever wills may take a path to his Lord."
entries.na: قل ما اسلكم عليه من اجر الا من شا ان يتخذ الي ربه سبيلا
entries.nt: say i ask of you no payment for this only that whoever wills may take a path to his lord

entries.a: وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى ٱلْحَىِّ ٱلَّذِى لَا يَمُوتُ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِهِۦ ۚ وَكَفَىٰ بِهِۦ بِذُنُوبِ عِبَادِهِۦ خَبِيرًا
entries.t: And put your trust in the Living, the One who never dies; and celebrate His praise. He suffices as the All-Informed Knower of the faults of His creatures.
entries.na: وتوكل علي الحي الذي لا يموت وسبح بحمده وكفي به بذنوب عباده خبيرا
entries.nt: and put your trust in the living the one who never dies and celebrate his praise he suffices as the all informed knower of the faults of his creatures

entries.a: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فِى سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍۢ ثُمَّ ٱسْتَوَىٰ عَلَى ٱلْعَرْشِ ۚ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ فَسْـَٔلْ بِهِۦ خَبِيرًۭا
entries.t: He who created the heavens and the earth and everything between them in six days, then settled on the Throne. The Most Merciful. Ask about Him a well-informed.
entries.na: الذي خلق السموت والارض وما بينهما في سته ايام ثم استوي علي العرش الرحمن فسل به خبيرا
entries.nt: he who created the heavens and the earth and everything between them in six days then settled on the throne the most merciful ask about him a well informed

entries.a: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ٱسْجُدُوا۟ لِلرَّحْمَٰنِ قَالُوا۟ وَمَا ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ أَنَسْجُدُ لِمَا تَأْمُرُنَا وَزَادَهُمْ نُفُورًۭا ۩
entries.t: And when it is said to them, "Bow down to the Merciful," they say, "And what is the Merciful? Are we to bow down to whatever you command us?" And it increases their aversion.
entries.na: واذا قيل لهم اسجدوا للرحمن قالوا وما الرحمن انسجد لما تامرنا وزادهم نفورا
entries.nt: and when it is said to them bow down to the merciful they say and what is the merciful are we to bow down to whatever you command us and it increases their aversion

entries.a: تَبَارَكَ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ بُرُوجًۭا وَجَعَلَ فِيهَا سِرَٰجًۭا وَقَمَرًۭا مُّنِيرًۭا
entries.t: Blessed is He who placed constellations in the sky, and placed in it a lamp, and an illuminating moon.
entries.na: تبارك الذي جعل في السما بروجا وجعل فيها سرجا وقمرا منيرا
entries.nt: blessed is he who placed constellations in the sky and placed in it a lamp and an illuminating moon

entries.a: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ ٱلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ خِلْفَةًۭ لِّمَنْ أَرَادَ أَن يَذَّكَّرَ أَوْ أَرَادَ شُكُورًۭا
entries.t: And it is He who made the night and the day alternate-for whoever desires to reflect, or desires to show gratitude.
entries.na: وهو الذي جعل اليل والنهار خلفه لمن اراد ان يذكر او اراد شكورا
entries.nt: and it is he who made the night and the day alternate for whoever desires to reflect or desires to show gratitude

entries.a: وَعِبَادُ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلَّذِينَ يَمْشُونَ عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ هَوْنًۭا وَإِذَا خَاطَبَهُمُ ٱلْجَٰهِلُونَ قَالُوا۟ سَلَٰمًۭا
entries.t: The servants of the Merciful are those who walk the earth in humility, and when the ignorant address them, they say, "Peace."
entries.na: وعباد الرحمن الذين يمشون علي الارض هونا واذا خاطبهم الجهلون قالوا سلما
entries.nt: the servants of the merciful are those who walk the earth in humility and when the ignorant address them they say peace

entries.a: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَبِيتُونَ لِرَبِّهِمْ سُجَّدًۭا وَقِيَٰمًۭا
entries.t: And those who pass the night prostrating themselves to their Lord and standing up.
entries.na: والذين يبيتون لربهم سجدا وقيما
entries.nt: and those who pass the night prostrating themselves to their lord and standing up

entries.a: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا ٱصْرِفْ عَنَّا عَذَابَ جَهَنَّمَ ۖ إِنَّ عَذَابَهَا كَانَ غَرَامًا
entries.t: And those who say, ''Our Lord, avert from us the suffering of Hell, for its suffering is continuous.
entries.na: والذين يقولون ربنا اصرف عنا عذاب جهنم ان عذابها كان غراما
entries.nt: and those who say our lord avert from us the suffering of hell for its suffering is continuous

entries.a: إِنَّهَا سَآءَتْ مُسْتَقَرًّۭا وَمُقَامًۭا
entries.t: It is indeed a miserable residence and destination."
entries.na: انها سات مستقرا ومقاما
entries.nt: it is indeed a miserable residence and destination

entries.a: وَٱلَّذِينَ إِذَآ أَنفَقُوا۟ لَمْ يُسْرِفُوا۟ وَلَمْ يَقْتُرُوا۟ وَكَانَ بَيْنَ ذَٰلِكَ قَوَامًۭا
entries.t: And those who, when they spend, are neither wasteful nor stingy, but choose a middle course between that.
entries.na: والذين اذا انفقوا لم يسرفوا ولم يقتروا وكان بين ذلك قواما
entries.nt: and those who when they spend are neither wasteful nor stingy but choose a middle course between that

entries.a: وَٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَدْعُونَ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ وَلَا يَقْتُلُونَ ٱلنَّفْسَ ٱلَّتِى حَرَّمَ ٱللَّهُ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَا يَزْنُونَ ۚ وَمَن يَفْعَلْ ذَٰلِكَ يَلْقَ أَثَامًۭا
entries.t: And those who do not implore besides God any other god, and do not kill the soul which God has made sacred-except in the pursuit of justice-and do not commit adultery. Whoever does that will face penalties.
entries.na: والذين لا يدعون مع الله الها اخر ولا يقتلون النفس التي حرم الله الا بالحق ولا يزنون ومن يفعل ذلك يلق اثاما
entries.nt: and those who do not implore besides god any other god and do not kill the soul which god has made sacred except in the pursuit of justice and do not commit adultery whoever does that will face penalties

entries.a: يُضَٰعَفْ لَهُ ٱلْعَذَابُ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ وَيَخْلُدْ فِيهِۦ مُهَانًا
entries.t: The punishment will be doubled for him on the Day of Resurrection, and he will dwell therein in humiliation forever.
entries.na: يضعف له العذاب يوم القيمه ويخلد فيه مهانا
entries.nt: the punishment will be doubled for him on the day of resurrection and he will dwell therein in humiliation forever

entries.a: إِلَّا مَن تَابَ وَءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ عَمَلًۭا صَٰلِحًۭا فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ يُبَدِّلُ ٱللَّهُ سَيِّـَٔاتِهِمْ حَسَنَٰتٍۢ ۗ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ غَفُورًۭا رَّحِيمًۭا
entries.t: Except for those who repent, and believe, and do good deeds. These-God will replace their bad deeds with good deeds. God is ever Forgiving and Merciful.
entries.na: الا من تاب وامن وعمل عملا صلحا فاوليك يبدل الله سياتهم حسنت وكان الله غفورا رحيما
entries.nt: except for those who repent and believe and do good deeds these god will replace their bad deeds with good deeds god is ever forgiving and merciful

entries.a: وَمَن تَابَ وَعَمِلَ صَٰلِحًۭا فَإِنَّهُۥ يَتُوبُ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ مَتَابًۭا
entries.t: Whoever repents and acts righteously-has inclined towards God with repentance.
entries.na: ومن تاب وعمل صلحا فانه يتوب الي الله متابا
entries.nt: whoever repents and acts righteously has inclined towards god with repentance

entries.a: وَٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَشْهَدُونَ ٱلزُّورَ وَإِذَا مَرُّوا۟ بِٱللَّغْوِ مَرُّوا۟ كِرَامًۭا
entries.t: And those who do not bear false witness; and when they come across indecencies, they pass by with dignity.
entries.na: والذين لا يشهدون الزور واذا مروا باللغو مروا كراما
entries.nt: and those who do not bear false witness and when they come across indecencies they pass by with dignity

entries.a: وَٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ذُكِّرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ لَمْ يَخِرُّوا۟ عَلَيْهَا صُمًّۭا وَعُمْيَانًۭا
entries.t: And those who, when reminded of the revelations of their Lord, do not fall before them deaf and blind.
entries.na: والذين اذا ذكروا بايت ربهم لم يخروا عليها صما وعميانا
entries.nt: and those who when reminded of the revelations of their lord do not fall before them deaf and blind

entries.a: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَٰجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّٰتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍۢ وَٱجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا
entries.t: And those who say, "Our Lord, grant us delight in our spouses and our children, and make us a good example for the righteous."
entries.na: والذين يقولون ربنا هب لنا من ازوجنا وذريتنا قره اعين واجعلنا للمتقين اماما
entries.nt: and those who say our lord grant us delight in our spouses and our children and make us a good example for the righteous

entries.a: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ يُجْزَوْنَ ٱلْغُرْفَةَ بِمَا صَبَرُوا۟ وَيُلَقَّوْنَ فِيهَا تَحِيَّةًۭ وَسَلَٰمًا
entries.t: Those will be awarded the Chamber for their patience, and will be greeted therein with greetings and peace.
entries.na: اوليك يجزون الغرفه بما صبروا ويلقون فيها تحيه وسلما
entries.nt: those will be awarded the chamber for their patience and will be greeted therein with greetings and peace

entries.a: خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا ۚ حَسُنَتْ مُسْتَقَرًّۭا وَمُقَامًۭا
entries.t: Abiding therein forever-it is an excellent residence and destination.
entries.na: خلدين فيها حسنت مستقرا ومقاما
entries.nt: abiding therein forever it is an excellent residence and destination

entries.a: قُلْ مَا يَعْبَؤُا۟ بِكُمْ رَبِّى لَوْلَا دُعَآؤُكُمْ ۖ فَقَدْ كَذَّبْتُمْ فَسَوْفَ يَكُونُ لِزَامًۢا
entries.t: Say, "What are you to my Lord without your prayers? You have denied the truth, and the inevitable will happen."
entries.na: قل ما يعبوا بكم ربي لولا دعاوكم فقد كذبتم فسوف يكون لزاما
entries.nt: say what are you to my lord without your prayers you have denied the truth and the inevitable will happen

entries.a: طسٓمٓ
entries.t: Ta, Seen, Meem.
entries.na: طسم
entries.nt: ta seen meem

entries.a: تِلْكَ ءَايَٰتُ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ ٱلْمُبِينِ
entries.t: These are the Verses of the Clarifying Book.
entries.na: تلك ايت الكتب المبين
entries.nt: these are the verses of the clarifying book

entries.a: لَعَلَّكَ بَٰخِعٌۭ نَّفْسَكَ أَلَّا يَكُونُوا۟ مُؤْمِنِينَ
entries.t: Perhaps you will destroy yourself with grief, because they do not become believers.
entries.na: لعلك بخع نفسك الا يكونوا مومنين
entries.nt: perhaps you will destroy yourself with grief because they do not become believers

entries.a: إِن نَّشَأْ نُنَزِّلْ عَلَيْهِم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ ءَايَةًۭ فَظَلَّتْ أَعْنَٰقُهُمْ لَهَا خَٰضِعِينَ
entries.t: If We will, We can send down upon them a sign from heaven, at which their necks will stay bent in humility.
entries.na: ان نشا ننزل عليهم من السما ايه فظلت اعنقهم لها خضعين
entries.nt: if we will we can send down upon them a sign from heaven at which their necks will stay bent in humility

entries.a: وَمَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن ذِكْرٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ مُحْدَثٍ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ عَنْهُ مُعْرِضِينَ
entries.t: No fresh reminder comes to them from the Most Merciful, but they turn their backs at it.
entries.na: وما ياتيهم من ذكر من الرحمن محدث الا كانوا عنه معرضين
entries.nt: no fresh reminder comes to them from the most merciful but they turn their backs at it

entries.a: فَقَدْ كَذَّبُوا۟ فَسَيَأْتِيهِمْ أَنۢبَٰٓؤُا۟ مَا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
entries.t: They have denied the truth, but soon will come to them the news of what they ridiculed.
entries.na: فقد كذبوا فسياتيهم انبوا ما كانوا به يستهزون
entries.nt: they have denied the truth but soon will come to them the news of what they ridiculed

entries.a: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ إِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ كَمْ أَنۢبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ زَوْجٍۢ كَرِيمٍ
entries.t: Have they not seen the earth, and how many beautiful pairs We produced therein?
entries.na: اولم يروا الي الارض كم انبتنا فيها من كل زوج كريم
entries.nt: have they not seen the earth and how many beautiful pairs we produced therein

entries.a: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
entries.t: Surely in this is a sign, but most of them are not believers.
entries.na: ان في ذلك لايه وما كان اكثرهم مومنين
entries.nt: surely in this is a sign but most of them are not believers

entries.a: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
entries.t: Most surely, your Lord is the Almighty, the Merciful.
entries.na: وان ربك لهو العزيز الرحيم
entries.nt: most surely your lord is the almighty the merciful

entries.a: وَإِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبُّكَ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنِ ٱئْتِ ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
entries.t: Your Lord called to Moses, "Go to the tyrannical people.
entries.na: واذ نادي ربك موسي ان ايت القوم الظلمين
entries.nt: your lord called to moses go to the tyrannical people

entries.a: قَوْمَ فِرْعَوْنَ ۚ أَلَا يَتَّقُونَ
entries.t: The people of Pharaoh. Will they not fear?"
entries.na: قوم فرعون الا يتقون
entries.nt: the people of pharaoh will they not fear

entries.a: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ أَن يُكَذِّبُونِ
entries.t: He said, "My Lord, I fear they will reject me.
entries.na: قال رب اني اخاف ان يكذبون
entries.nt: he said my lord i fear they will reject me

entries.a: وَيَضِيقُ صَدْرِى وَلَا يَنطَلِقُ لِسَانِى فَأَرْسِلْ إِلَىٰ هَٰرُونَ
entries.t: And I become stressed, and my tongue is not fluent, so send Aaron too.
entries.na: ويضيق صدري ولا ينطلق لساني فارسل الي هرون
entries.nt: and i become stressed and my tongue is not fluent so send aaron too

entries.a: وَلَهُمْ عَلَىَّ ذَنۢبٌۭ فَأَخَافُ أَن يَقْتُلُونِ
entries.t: And they have a charge against me, so I fear they will kill me."
entries.na: ولهم علي ذنب فاخاف ان يقتلون
entries.nt: and they have a charge against me so i fear they will kill me

entries.a: قَالَ كَلَّا ۖ فَٱذْهَبَا بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ ۖ إِنَّا مَعَكُم مُّسْتَمِعُونَ
entries.t: He said, "No. Go, both of you, with Our proofs. We will be with you, listening.
entries.na: قال كلا فاذهبا بايتنا انا معكم مستمعون
entries.nt: he said no go both of you with our proofs we will be with you listening

entries.a: فَأْتِيَا فِرْعَوْنَ فَقُولَآ إِنَّا رَسُولُ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
entries.t: Go to Pharaoh, and say, 'We are the Messengers of the Lord of the Worlds.
entries.na: فاتيا فرعون فقولا انا رسول رب العلمين
entries.nt: go to pharaoh and say we are the messengers of the lord of the worlds

entries.a: أَنْ أَرْسِلْ مَعَنَا بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ
entries.t: Let the Children of Israel go with us.'"
entries.na: ان ارسل معنا بني اسريل
entries.nt: let the children of israel go with us

entries.a: قَالَ أَلَمْ نُرَبِّكَ فِينَا وَلِيدًۭا وَلَبِثْتَ فِينَا مِنْ عُمُرِكَ سِنِينَ
entries.t: He said, "Did we not raise you among us as a child, and you stayed among us for many of your years?
entries.na: قال الم نربك فينا وليدا ولبثت فينا من عمرك سنين
entries.nt: he said did we not raise you among us as a child and you stayed among us for many of your years

entries.a: وَفَعَلْتَ فَعْلَتَكَ ٱلَّتِى فَعَلْتَ وَأَنتَ مِنَ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ
entries.t: And you committed that deed you committed, and you were ungrateful."
entries.na: وفعلت فعلتك التي فعلت وانت من الكفرين
entries.nt: and you committed that deed you committed and you were ungrateful

entries.a: قَالَ فَعَلْتُهَآ إِذًۭا وَأَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ
entries.t: He said, "I did it then, when I was of those astray.
entries.na: قال فعلتها اذا وانا من الضالين
entries.nt: he said i did it then when i was of those astray

entries.a: فَفَرَرْتُ مِنكُمْ لَمَّا خِفْتُكُمْ فَوَهَبَ لِى رَبِّى حُكْمًۭا وَجَعَلَنِى مِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
entries.t: And I fled from you when I feared you; but my Lord gave me wisdom, and made me one of the messengers.
entries.na: ففررت منكم لما خفتكم فوهب لي ربي حكما وجعلني من المرسلين
entries.nt: and i fled from you when i feared you but my lord gave me wisdom and made me one of the messengers

entries.a: وَتِلْكَ نِعْمَةٌۭ تَمُنُّهَا عَلَىَّ أَنْ عَبَّدتَّ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ
entries.t: Is that the favor you taunt me with, although you have enslaved the Children of Israel?"
entries.na: وتلك نعمه تمنها علي ان عبدت بني اسريل
entries.nt: is that the favor you taunt me with although you have enslaved the children of israel

entries.a: قَالَ فِرْعَوْنُ وَمَا رَبُّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
entries.t: Pharaoh said, "And what is the Lord of the Worlds?"
entries.na: قال فرعون وما رب العلمين
entries.nt: pharaoh said and what is the lord of the worlds

entries.a: قَالَ رَبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ ۖ إِن كُنتُم مُّوقِنِينَ
entries.t: He said, "The Lord of the heavens and the earth, and everything between them, if you are aware."
entries.na: قال رب السموت والارض وما بينهما ان كنتم موقنين
entries.nt: he said the lord of the heavens and the earth and everything between them if you are aware

entries.a: قَالَ لِمَنْ حَوْلَهُۥٓ أَلَا تَسْتَمِعُونَ
entries.t: He said to those around him, "Do you not hear?"
entries.na: قال لمن حوله الا تستمعون
entries.nt: he said to those around him do you not hear

entries.a: قَالَ رَبُّكُمْ وَرَبُّ ءَابَآئِكُمُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
entries.t: He said, "Your Lord and the Lord of your ancestors of old."
entries.na: قال ربكم ورب ابايكم الاولين
entries.nt: he said your lord and the lord of your ancestors of old

entries.a: قَالَ إِنَّ رَسُولَكُمُ ٱلَّذِىٓ أُرْسِلَ إِلَيْكُمْ لَمَجْنُونٌۭ
entries.t: He said, "This messenger of yours, who is sent to you, is crazy."
entries.na: قال ان رسولكم الذي ارسل اليكم لمجنون
entries.nt: he said this messenger of yours who is sent to you is crazy

entries.a: قَالَ رَبُّ ٱلْمَشْرِقِ وَٱلْمَغْرِبِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ ۖ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ
entries.t: He said, "Lord of the East and the West, and everything between them, if you understand."
entries.na: قال رب المشرق والمغرب وما بينهما ان كنتم تعقلون
entries.nt: he said lord of the east and the west and everything between them if you understand

entries.a: قَالَ لَئِنِ ٱتَّخَذْتَ إِلَٰهًا غَيْرِى لَأَجْعَلَنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْمَسْجُونِينَ
entries.t: He said, "If you accept any god other than me, I will make you a prisoner."
entries.na: قال لين اتخذت الها غيري لاجعلنك من المسجونين
entries.nt: he said if you accept any god other than me i will make you a prisoner

entries.a: قَالَ أَوَلَوْ جِئْتُكَ بِشَىْءٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
entries.t: He said, "What if I bring you something convincing?"
entries.na: قال اولو جيتك بشي مبين
entries.nt: he said what if i bring you something convincing

entries.a: قَالَ فَأْتِ بِهِۦٓ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ
entries.t: He said, "Bring it, if you are being truthful."
entries.na: قال فات به ان كنت من الصدقين
entries.nt: he said bring it if you are being truthful

entries.a: فَأَلْقَىٰ عَصَاهُ فَإِذَا هِىَ ثُعْبَانٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
entries.t: So he cast his staff; and it was a serpent, plain to see.
entries.na: فالقي عصاه فاذا هي ثعبان مبين
entries.nt: so he cast his staff and it was a serpent plain to see

entries.a: وَنَزَعَ يَدَهُۥ فَإِذَا هِىَ بَيْضَآءُ لِلنَّٰظِرِينَ
entries.t: And he pulled his hand; and it was white, for all to see.
entries.na: ونزع يده فاذا هي بيضا للنظرين
entries.nt: and he pulled his hand and it was white for all to see

entries.a: قَالَ لِلْمَلَإِ حَوْلَهُۥٓ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَسَٰحِرٌ عَلِيمٌۭ
entries.t: He said to the dignitaries around him, "This is a skilled magician.
entries.na: قال للملا حوله ان هذا لسحر عليم
entries.nt: he said to the dignitaries around him this is a skilled magician

entries.a: يُرِيدُ أَن يُخْرِجَكُم مِّنْ أَرْضِكُم بِسِحْرِهِۦ فَمَاذَا تَأْمُرُونَ
entries.t: He intends to drive you out of your land with his magic, so what do you recommend?"
entries.na: يريد ان يخرجكم من ارضكم بسحره فماذا تامرون
entries.nt: he intends to drive you out of your land with his magic so what do you recommend

entries.a: قَالُوٓا۟ أَرْجِهْ وَأَخَاهُ وَٱبْعَثْ فِى ٱلْمَدَآئِنِ حَٰشِرِينَ
entries.t: They said, "Delay him and his brother, and send recruiters to the cities.
entries.na: قالوا ارجه واخاه وابعث في المداين حشرين
entries.nt: they said delay him and his brother and send recruiters to the cities

entries.a: يَأْتُوكَ بِكُلِّ سَحَّارٍ عَلِيمٍۢ
entries.t: To bring you every experienced magician."
entries.na: ياتوك بكل سحار عليم
entries.nt: to bring you every experienced magician

entries.a: فَجُمِعَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ لِمِيقَٰتِ يَوْمٍۢ مَّعْلُومٍۢ
entries.t: So the magicians were gathered for the appointment on a specified day.
entries.na: فجمع السحره لميقت يوم معلوم
entries.nt: so the magicians were gathered for the appointment on a specified day

entries.a: وَقِيلَ لِلنَّاسِ هَلْ أَنتُم مُّجْتَمِعُونَ
entries.t: And it was said to the people, "Are you all gathered?
entries.na: وقيل للناس هل انتم مجتمعون
entries.nt: and it was said to the people are you all gathered

entries.a: لَعَلَّنَا نَتَّبِعُ ٱلسَّحَرَةَ إِن كَانُوا۟ هُمُ ٱلْغَٰلِبِينَ
entries.t: That we may follow the magicians, if they are the winners."
entries.na: لعلنا نتبع السحره ان كانوا هم الغلبين
entries.nt: that we may follow the magicians if they are the winners

entries.a: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ قَالُوا۟ لِفِرْعَوْنَ أَئِنَّ لَنَا لَأَجْرًا إِن كُنَّا نَحْنُ ٱلْغَٰلِبِينَ
entries.t: When the magicians arrived, they said to Pharaoh, "Is there a reward for us, if we are the winners?"
entries.na: فلما جا السحره قالوا لفرعون اين لنا لاجرا ان كنا نحن الغلبين
entries.nt: when the magicians arrived they said to pharaoh is there a reward for us if we are the winners

entries.a: قَالَ نَعَمْ وَإِنَّكُمْ إِذًۭا لَّمِنَ ٱلْمُقَرَّبِينَ
entries.t: He said, "Yes, and you will be among those favored."
entries.na: قال نعم وانكم اذا لمن المقربين
entries.nt: he said yes and you will be among those favored

entries.a: قَالَ لَهُم مُّوسَىٰٓ أَلْقُوا۟ مَآ أَنتُم مُّلْقُونَ
entries.t: Moses said to them, "Present what you intend to present."
entries.na: قال لهم موسي القوا ما انتم ملقون
entries.nt: moses said to them present what you intend to present

entries.a: فَأَلْقَوْا۟ حِبَالَهُمْ وَعِصِيَّهُمْ وَقَالُوا۟ بِعِزَّةِ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّا لَنَحْنُ ٱلْغَٰلِبُونَ
entries.t: So they threw their ropes and their sticks, and said, "By the majesty of Pharaoh, we will be the winners."
entries.na: فالقوا حبالهم وعصيهم وقالوا بعزه فرعون انا لنحن الغلبون
entries.nt: so they threw their ropes and their sticks and said by the majesty of pharaoh we will be the winners

entries.a: فَأَلْقَىٰ مُوسَىٰ عَصَاهُ فَإِذَا هِىَ تَلْقَفُ مَا يَأْفِكُونَ
entries.t: Then Moses threw his staff, and behold, it began swallowing their trickery.
entries.na: فالقي موسي عصاه فاذا هي تلقف ما يافكون
entries.nt: then moses threw his staff and behold it began swallowing their trickery

entries.a: فَأُلْقِىَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ سَٰجِدِينَ
entries.t: And the magicians fell down prostrating.
entries.na: فالقي السحره سجدين
entries.nt: and the magicians fell down prostrating

entries.a: قَالُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا بِرَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
entries.t: They said, "We have believed in the Lord of the Worlds.
entries.na: قالوا امنا برب العلمين
entries.nt: they said we have believed in the lord of the worlds

entries.a: رَبِّ مُوسَىٰ وَهَٰرُونَ
entries.t: The Lord of Moses and Aaron."
entries.na: رب موسي وهرون
entries.nt: the lord of moses and aaron

entries.a: قَالَ ءَامَنتُمْ لَهُۥ قَبْلَ أَنْ ءَاذَنَ لَكُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكَبِيرُكُمُ ٱلَّذِى عَلَّمَكُمُ ٱلسِّحْرَ فَلَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ ۚ لَأُقَطِّعَنَّ أَيْدِيَكُمْ وَأَرْجُلَكُم مِّنْ خِلَٰفٍۢ وَلَأُصَلِّبَنَّكُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
entries.t: He said, "Did you believe in Him before I have given you permission? He must be your chief, who taught you magic. You will soon know. I will cut off your hands and feet on opposite sides, and I will crucify you all."
entries.na: قال امنتم له قبل ان اذن لكم انه لكبيركم الذي علمكم السحر فلسوف تعلمون لاقطعن ايديكم وارجلكم من خلف ولاصلبنكم اجمعين
entries.nt: he said did you believe in him before i have given you permission he must be your chief who taught you magic you will soon know i will cut off your hands and feet on opposite sides and i will crucify you all

entries.a: قَالُوا۟ لَا ضَيْرَ ۖ إِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا مُنقَلِبُونَ
entries.t: They said, "No problem. To our Lord we will return.
entries.na: قالوا لا ضير انا الي ربنا منقلبون
entries.nt: they said no problem to our lord we will return

entries.a: إِنَّا نَطْمَعُ أَن يَغْفِرَ لَنَا رَبُّنَا خَطَٰيَٰنَآ أَن كُنَّآ أَوَّلَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
entries.t: We are eager for our Lord to forgive us our sins, since we are the first of the believers."
entries.na: انا نطمع ان يغفر لنا ربنا خطينا ان كنا اول المومنين
entries.nt: we are eager for our lord to forgive us our sins since we are the first of the believers

entries.a: ۞ وَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنْ أَسْرِ بِعِبَادِىٓ إِنَّكُم مُّتَّبَعُونَ
entries.t: And We inspired Moses: "Travel with My servants by night. You will be followed."
entries.na: واوحينا الي موسي ان اسر بعبادي انكم متبعون
entries.nt: and we inspired moses travel with my servants by night you will be followed

entries.a: فَأَرْسَلَ فِرْعَوْنُ فِى ٱلْمَدَآئِنِ حَٰشِرِينَ
entries.t: Pharaoh sent heralds to the cities.
entries.na: فارسل فرعون في المداين حشرين
entries.nt: pharaoh sent heralds to the cities

entries.a: إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَشِرْذِمَةٌۭ قَلِيلُونَ
entries.t: "These are a small gang.
entries.na: ان هولا لشرذمه قليلون
entries.nt: these are a small gang

entries.a: وَإِنَّهُمْ لَنَا لَغَآئِظُونَ
entries.t: And they are enraging us.
entries.na: وانهم لنا لغايظون
entries.nt: and they are enraging us

entries.a: وَإِنَّا لَجَمِيعٌ حَٰذِرُونَ
entries.t: But we are a vigilant multitude."
entries.na: وانا لجميع حذرون
entries.nt: but we are a vigilant multitude

entries.a: فَأَخْرَجْنَٰهُم مِّن جَنَّٰتٍۢ وَعُيُونٍۢ
entries.t: So We drove them out of gardens and springs.
entries.na: فاخرجنهم من جنت وعيون
entries.nt: so we drove them out of gardens and springs

entries.a: وَكُنُوزٍۢ وَمَقَامٍۢ كَرِيمٍۢ
entries.t: And treasures and noble dwellings.
entries.na: وكنوز ومقام كريم
entries.nt: and treasures and noble dwellings

entries.a: كَذَٰلِكَ وَأَوْرَثْنَٰهَا بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ
entries.t: So it was. And We made the Children of Israel inherit them.
entries.na: كذلك واورثنها بني اسريل
entries.nt: so it was and we made the children of israel inherit them

entries.a: فَأَتْبَعُوهُم مُّشْرِقِينَ
entries.t: And they pursued them at sunrise.
entries.na: فاتبعوهم مشرقين
entries.nt: and they pursued them at sunrise

entries.a: فَلَمَّا تَرَٰٓءَا ٱلْجَمْعَانِ قَالَ أَصْحَٰبُ مُوسَىٰٓ إِنَّا لَمُدْرَكُونَ
entries.t: When the two groups sighted each other, the followers of Moses said, "We are being overtaken."
entries.na: فلما ترا الجمعان قال اصحب موسي انا لمدركون
entries.nt: when the two groups sighted each other the followers of moses said we are being overtaken

entries.a: قَالَ كَلَّآ ۖ إِنَّ مَعِىَ رَبِّى سَيَهْدِينِ
entries.t: He said, "No; my Lord is with me, He will guide me."
entries.na: قال كلا ان معي ربي سيهدين
entries.nt: he said no my lord is with me he will guide me

entries.a: فَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنِ ٱضْرِب بِّعَصَاكَ ٱلْبَحْرَ ۖ فَٱنفَلَقَ فَكَانَ كُلُّ فِرْقٍۢ كَٱلطَّوْدِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
entries.t: We inspired Moses: "Strike the sea with your staff." Whereupon it parted, and each part was like a huge hill.
entries.na: فاوحينا الي موسي ان اضرب بعصاك البحر فانفلق فكان كل فرق كالطود العظيم
entries.nt: we inspired moses strike the sea with your staff whereupon it parted and each part was like a huge hill

entries.a: وَأَزْلَفْنَا ثَمَّ ٱلْءَاخَرِينَ
entries.t: And there We brought the others near.
entries.na: وازلفنا ثم الاخرين
entries.nt: and there we brought the others near

entries.a: وَأَنجَيْنَا مُوسَىٰ وَمَن مَّعَهُۥٓ أَجْمَعِينَ
entries.t: And We saved Moses and those with him, all together.
entries.na: وانجينا موسي ومن معه اجمعين
entries.nt: and we saved moses and those with him all together

entries.a: ثُمَّ أَغْرَقْنَا ٱلْءَاخَرِينَ
entries.t: Then We drowned the others.
entries.na: ثم اغرقنا الاخرين
entries.nt: then we drowned the others

entries.a: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
entries.t: In that there is a sign, but most of them are not believers.
entries.na: ان في ذلك لايه وما كان اكثرهم مومنين
entries.nt: in that there is a sign but most of them are not believers

entries.a: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
entries.t: Surely, your Lord is the Almighty, the Merciful.
entries.na: وان ربك لهو العزيز الرحيم
entries.nt: surely your lord is the almighty the merciful

entries.a: وَٱتْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ نَبَأَ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ
entries.t: And relate to them the story of Abraham.
entries.na: واتل عليهم نبا ابرهيم
entries.nt: and relate to them the story of abraham

entries.a: إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِۦ مَا تَعْبُدُونَ
entries.t: When he said to his father and his people, "What do you worship?"
entries.na: اذ قال لابيه وقومه ما تعبدون
entries.nt: when he said to his father and his people what do you worship

entries.a: قَالُوا۟ نَعْبُدُ أَصْنَامًۭا فَنَظَلُّ لَهَا عَٰكِفِينَ
entries.t: They said, "We worship idols, and we remain devoted to them."
entries.na: قالوا نعبد اصناما فنظل لها عكفين
entries.nt: they said we worship idols and we remain devoted to them

entries.a: قَالَ هَلْ يَسْمَعُونَكُمْ إِذْ تَدْعُونَ
entries.t: He said, "Do they hear you when you pray?
entries.na: قال هل يسمعونكم اذ تدعون
entries.nt: he said do they hear you when you pray

entries.a: أَوْ يَنفَعُونَكُمْ أَوْ يَضُرُّونَ
entries.t: Or do they benefit you, or harm you?"
entries.na: او ينفعونكم او يضرون
entries.nt: or do they benefit you or harm you

entries.a: قَالُوا۟ بَلْ وَجَدْنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا كَذَٰلِكَ يَفْعَلُونَ
entries.t: They said, "But we found our ancestors doing so."
entries.na: قالوا بل وجدنا ابانا كذلك يفعلون
entries.nt: they said but we found our ancestors doing so

entries.a: قَالَ أَفَرَءَيْتُم مَّا كُنتُمْ تَعْبُدُونَ
entries.t: He said, "Have you considered what you worship.
entries.na: قال افريتم ما كنتم تعبدون
entries.nt: he said have you considered what you worship

entries.a: أَنتُمْ وَءَابَآؤُكُمُ ٱلْأَقْدَمُونَ
entries.t: You and your ancient ancestors?
entries.na: انتم واباوكم الاقدمون
entries.nt: you and your ancient ancestors

entries.a: فَإِنَّهُمْ عَدُوٌّۭ لِّىٓ إِلَّا رَبَّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
entries.t: They are enemies to me, but not so the Lord of the Worlds.
entries.na: فانهم عدو لي الا رب العلمين
entries.nt: they are enemies to me but not so the lord of the worlds

entries.a: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَنِى فَهُوَ يَهْدِينِ
entries.t: He who created me, and guides me.
entries.na: الذي خلقني فهو يهدين
entries.nt: he who created me and guides me

entries.a: وَٱلَّذِى هُوَ يُطْعِمُنِى وَيَسْقِينِ
entries.t: He who feeds me, and waters me.
entries.na: والذي هو يطعمني ويسقين
entries.nt: he who feeds me and waters me

entries.a: وَإِذَا مَرِضْتُ فَهُوَ يَشْفِينِ
entries.t: And when I get sick, He heals me.
entries.na: واذا مرضت فهو يشفين
entries.nt: and when i get sick he heals me

entries.a: وَٱلَّذِى يُمِيتُنِى ثُمَّ يُحْيِينِ
entries.t: He who makes me die, and then revives me.
entries.na: والذي يميتني ثم يحيين
entries.nt: he who makes me die and then revives me

entries.a: وَٱلَّذِىٓ أَطْمَعُ أَن يَغْفِرَ لِى خَطِيٓـَٔتِى يَوْمَ ٱلدِّينِ
entries.t: He who, I hope, will forgive my sins on the Day of the Reckoning."
entries.na: والذي اطمع ان يغفر لي خطيتي يوم الدين
entries.nt: he who i hope will forgive my sins on the day of the reckoning

entries.a: رَبِّ هَبْ لِى حُكْمًۭا وَأَلْحِقْنِى بِٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
entries.t: "My Lord! Grant me wisdom, and include me with the righteous.
entries.na: رب هب لي حكما والحقني بالصلحين
entries.nt: my lord grant me wisdom and include me with the righteous

entries.a: وَٱجْعَل لِّى لِسَانَ صِدْقٍۢ فِى ٱلْءَاخِرِينَ
entries.t: And give me a reputation of truth among the others.
entries.na: واجعل لي لسان صدق في الاخرين
entries.nt: and give me a reputation of truth among the others

entries.a: وَٱجْعَلْنِى مِن وَرَثَةِ جَنَّةِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
entries.t: And make me of the inheritors of the Garden of Bliss.
entries.na: واجعلني من ورثه جنه النعيم
entries.nt: and make me of the inheritors of the garden of bliss

entries.a: وَٱغْفِرْ لِأَبِىٓ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ
entries.t: And forgive my father-he was one of the misguided.
entries.na: واغفر لابي انه كان من الضالين
entries.nt: and forgive my father he was one of the misguided

entries.a: وَلَا تُخْزِنِى يَوْمَ يُبْعَثُونَ
entries.t: And do not disgrace me on the Day they are resurrected.
entries.na: ولا تخزني يوم يبعثون
entries.nt: and do not disgrace me on the day they are resurrected

entries.a: يَوْمَ لَا يَنفَعُ مَالٌۭ وَلَا بَنُونَ
entries.t: The Day when neither wealth nor children will help.
entries.na: يوم لا ينفع مال ولا بنون
entries.nt: the day when neither wealth nor children will help

entries.a: إِلَّا مَنْ أَتَى ٱللَّهَ بِقَلْبٍۢ سَلِيمٍۢ
entries.t: Except for him who comes to God with a sound heart."
entries.na: الا من اتي الله بقلب سليم
entries.nt: except for him who comes to god with a sound heart

entries.a: وَأُزْلِفَتِ ٱلْجَنَّةُ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ
entries.t: And Paradise will be brought near for the righteous.
entries.na: وازلفت الجنه للمتقين
entries.nt: and paradise will be brought near for the righteous

entries.a: وَبُرِّزَتِ ٱلْجَحِيمُ لِلْغَاوِينَ
entries.t: And the Blaze will be displayed to the deviators.
entries.na: وبرزت الجحيم للغاوين
entries.nt: and the blaze will be displayed to the deviators

entries.a: وَقِيلَ لَهُمْ أَيْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْبُدُونَ
entries.t: And it will be said to them, "Where are those you used to worship?"
entries.na: وقيل لهم اين ما كنتم تعبدون
entries.nt: and it will be said to them where are those you used to worship

entries.a: مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ هَلْ يَنصُرُونَكُمْ أَوْ يَنتَصِرُونَ
entries.t: Besides God? Can they help you, or help themselves?"
entries.na: من دون الله هل ينصرونكم او ينتصرون
entries.nt: besides god can they help you or help themselves

entries.a: فَكُبْكِبُوا۟ فِيهَا هُمْ وَٱلْغَاوُۥنَ
entries.t: Then they will be toppled into it, together with the seducers.
entries.na: فكبكبوا فيها هم والغاون
entries.nt: then they will be toppled into it together with the seducers

entries.a: وَجُنُودُ إِبْلِيسَ أَجْمَعُونَ
entries.t: And the soldiers of Satan, all of them.
entries.na: وجنود ابليس اجمعون
entries.nt: and the soldiers of satan all of them

entries.a: قَالُوا۟ وَهُمْ فِيهَا يَخْتَصِمُونَ
entries.t: They will say, as they feud in it.
entries.na: قالوا وهم فيها يختصمون
entries.nt: they will say as they feud in it

entries.a: تَٱللَّهِ إِن كُنَّا لَفِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ مُّبِينٍ
entries.t: "By God, We were in evident error.
entries.na: تالله ان كنا لفي ضلل مبين
entries.nt: by god we were in evident error

entries.a: إِذْ نُسَوِّيكُم بِرَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
entries.t: For equating you with the Lord of the Worlds.
entries.na: اذ نسويكم برب العلمين
entries.nt: for equating you with the lord of the worlds

entries.a: وَمَآ أَضَلَّنَآ إِلَّا ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ
entries.t: No one misled us except the sinners.
entries.na: وما اضلنا الا المجرمون
entries.nt: no one misled us except the sinners

entries.a: فَمَا لَنَا مِن شَٰفِعِينَ
entries.t: Now we have no intercessors.
entries.na: فما لنا من شفعين
entries.nt: now we have no intercessors

entries.a: وَلَا صَدِيقٍ حَمِيمٍۢ
entries.t: And no sincere friend.
entries.na: ولا صديق حميم
entries.nt: and no sincere friend

entries.a: فَلَوْ أَنَّ لَنَا كَرَّةًۭ فَنَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
entries.t: If only we could have another chance, we would be among the faithful."
entries.na: فلو ان لنا كره فنكون من المومنين
entries.nt: if only we could have another chance we would be among the faithful

entries.a: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
entries.t: Surely in this is a sign, but most of them are not believers.
entries.na: ان في ذلك لايه وما كان اكثرهم مومنين
entries.nt: surely in this is a sign but most of them are not believers

entries.a: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
entries.t: Your Lord is the Almighty, the Merciful.
entries.na: وان ربك لهو العزيز الرحيم
entries.nt: your lord is the almighty the merciful

entries.a: كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
entries.t: The people of Noah disbelieved the messengers.
entries.na: كذبت قوم نوح المرسلين
entries.nt: the people of noah disbelieved the messengers

entries.a: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ نُوحٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
entries.t: Their brother Noah said to them, "Do you not fear?
entries.na: اذ قال لهم اخوهم نوح الا تتقون
entries.nt: their brother noah said to them do you not fear

entries.na: اني لكم رسول امين
entries.nt: i am to you a faithful messenger

entries.t: So fear God, and obey me.
entries.na: فاتقوا الله واطيعون
entries.nt: so fear god and obey me

entries.nt: so fear god and obey me

entries.t: They said, "Shall we believe in you, when it is the lowliest who follow you?"

entries.nt: they said shall we believe in you when it is the lowliest who follow you

entries.t: He said, "What do I know about what they do?
entries.na: قال وما علمي بما كانوا يعملون
entries.nt: he said what do i know about what they do

entries.a: إِنْ حِسَابُهُمْ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّى ۖ لَوْ تَشْعُرُونَ
entries.t: Their account rests only with my Lord, if you have sense.
entries.na: ان حسابهم الا علي ربي لو تشعرون
entries.nt: their account rests only with my lord if you have sense

entries.a: وَمَآ أَنَا۠ بِطَارِدِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
entries.t: And I am not about to drive away the believers.
entries.na: وما انا بطارد المومنين
entries.nt: and i am not about to drive away the believers

entries.a: إِنْ أَنَا۠ إِلَّا نَذِيرٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
entries.t: I am only a clear warner."
entries.na: ان انا الا نذير مبين
entries.nt: i am only a clear warner

entries.a: قَالُوا۟ لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهِ يَٰنُوحُ لَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْمَرْجُومِينَ
entries.t: They said, "If you do not refrain, O Noah, you will be stoned."
entries.na: قالوا لين لم تنته ينوح لتكونن من المرجومين
entries.nt: they said if you do not refrain o noah you will be stoned

entries.a: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنَّ قَوْمِى كَذَّبُونِ
entries.t: He said, "My Lord, my people have denied me.
entries.na: قال رب ان قومي كذبون
entries.nt: he said my lord my people have denied me

entries.a: فَٱفْتَحْ بَيْنِى وَبَيْنَهُمْ فَتْحًۭا وَنَجِّنِى وَمَن مَّعِىَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ

entries.na: فافتح بيني وبينهم فتحا ونجني ومن معي من المومنين
entries.nt: so judge between me and them decisively and deliver me and the believers who are with me

entries.a: فَأَنجَيْنَٰهُ وَمَن مَّعَهُۥ فِى ٱلْفُلْكِ ٱلْمَشْحُونِ
entries.t: So We delivered him and those with him in the laden Ark.
entries.na: فانجينه ومن معه في الفلك المشحون
entries.nt: so we delivered him and those with him in the laden ark

entries.a: ثُمَّ أَغْرَقْنَا بَعْدُ ٱلْبَاقِينَ

entries.na: ثم اغرقنا بعد الباقين
entries.nt: then we drowned the rest

entries.t: Do you build a monument on every height for vanity's sake?

entries.t: And when you strike, you strike mercilessly?
entries.na: واذا بطشتم بطشتم جبارين
entries.nt: and when you strike you strike mercilessly

entries.nt: and reverence him who supplied you with everything you know

entries.nt: and gardens and springs

entries.na: قالوا سوا علينا اوعظت ام لم تكن من الوعظين
entries.nt: they said it is the same for us whether you lecture us or do not lecture

entries.t: Will you be left secure in what is here?

entries.nt: they said you are surely one of the bewitched

entries.nt: you are nothing but a man like us so bring us a sign if you are truthful

entries.t: Your Lord is the Almighty, the Merciful.
entries.na: وان ربك لهو العزيز الرحيم
entries.nt: your lord is the almighty the merciful

entries.a: كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ لُوطٍ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
entries.t: The people of Lot disbelieved the messengers.
entries.na: كذبت قوم لوط المرسلين
entries.nt: the people of lot disbelieved the messengers

entries.a: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ لُوطٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
entries.t: When their brother Lot said to them, "Do you not fear?
entries.na: اذ قال لهم اخوهم لوط الا تتقون
entries.nt: when their brother lot said to them do you not fear

entries.a: إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌۭ
entries.t: I am to you a faithful messenger.
entries.na: اني لكم رسول امين
entries.nt: i am to you a faithful messenger

entries.a: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
entries.t: So fear God, and obey me.
entries.na: فاتقوا الله واطيعون
entries.nt: so fear god and obey me

entries.a: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
entries.t: I ask of you no payment for it. My payment is only from the Lord of the Worlds.
entries.na: وما اسلكم عليه من اجر ان اجري الا علي رب العلمين
entries.nt: i ask of you no payment for it my payment is only from the lord of the worlds

entries.a: أَتَأْتُونَ ٱلذُّكْرَانَ مِنَ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
entries.t: Do you approach the males of the world?
entries.na: اتاتون الذكران من العلمين
entries.nt: do you approach the males of the world

entries.a: وَتَذَرُونَ مَا خَلَقَ لَكُمْ رَبُّكُم مِّنْ أَزْوَٰجِكُم ۚ بَلْ أَنتُمْ قَوْمٌ عَادُونَ
entries.t: And forsake the wives your Lord created for you? Indeed, you are intrusive people."
entries.na: وتذرون ما خلق لكم ربكم من ازوجكم بل انتم قوم عادون
entries.nt: and forsake the wives your lord created for you indeed you are intrusive people

entries.a: قَالُوا۟ لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهِ يَٰلُوطُ لَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْمُخْرَجِينَ
entries.t: They said, "Unless you refrain, O Lot, you will be expelled."
entries.na: قالوا لين لم تنته يلوط لتكونن من المخرجين
entries.nt: they said unless you refrain o lot you will be expelled

entries.a: قَالَ إِنِّى لِعَمَلِكُم مِّنَ ٱلْقَالِينَ
entries.t: He said, "I certainly deplore your conduct."
entries.na: قال اني لعملكم من القالين
entries.nt: he said i certainly deplore your conduct

entries.a: رَبِّ نَجِّنِى وَأَهْلِى مِمَّا يَعْمَلُونَ
entries.t: "My Lord, save me and my family from what they do."
entries.na: رب نجني واهلي مما يعملون
entries.nt: my lord save me and my family from what they do

entries.a: فَنَجَّيْنَٰهُ وَأَهْلَهُۥٓ أَجْمَعِينَ
entries.t: So We saved him and his family, altogether.
entries.na: فنجينه واهله اجمعين
entries.nt: so we saved him and his family altogether

entries.a: إِلَّا عَجُوزًۭا فِى ٱلْغَٰبِرِينَ
entries.t: Except for an old woman among those who tarried.
entries.na: الا عجوزا في الغبرين
entries.nt: except for an old woman among those who tarried

entries.a: ثُمَّ دَمَّرْنَا ٱلْءَاخَرِينَ
entries.t: Then We destroyed the others.
entries.na: ثم دمرنا الاخرين
entries.nt: then we destroyed the others

entries.a: وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهِم مَّطَرًۭا ۖ فَسَآءَ مَطَرُ ٱلْمُنذَرِينَ
entries.t: And We rained down on them a rain. Dreadful is the rain of those forewarned.
entries.na: وامطرنا عليهم مطرا فسا مطر المنذرين
entries.nt: and we rained down on them a rain dreadful is the rain of those forewarned

entries.a: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
entries.t: Surely in this is a sign, but most of them are not believers.
entries.na: ان في ذلك لايه وما كان اكثرهم مومنين
entries.nt: surely in this is a sign but most of them are not believers

entries.a: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
entries.t: Your Lord is the Almighty, the Merciful.
entries.na: وان ربك لهو العزيز الرحيم
entries.nt: your lord is the almighty the merciful

entries.a: كَذَّبَ أَصْحَٰبُ لْـَٔيْكَةِ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
entries.t: The People of the Woods disbelieved the messengers.
entries.na: كذب اصحب ليكه المرسلين
entries.nt: the people of the woods disbelieved the messengers

entries.a: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ شُعَيْبٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
entries.t: When Shuaib said to them, "Do you not fear?
entries.na: اذ قال لهم شعيب الا تتقون
entries.nt: when shuaib said to them do you not fear

entries.a: إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌۭ
entries.t: I am to you a trustworthy messenger.
entries.na: اني لكم رسول امين
entries.nt: i am to you a trustworthy messenger

entries.a: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
entries.t: So fear God, and obey me.
entries.na: فاتقوا الله واطيعون
entries.nt: so fear god and obey me

entries.a: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
entries.t: I ask of you no payment for it. My payment is only from the Lord of the Worlds.
entries.na: وما اسلكم عليه من اجر ان اجري الا علي رب العلمين
entries.nt: i ask of you no payment for it my payment is only from the lord of the worlds

entries.a: ۞ أَوْفُوا۟ ٱلْكَيْلَ وَلَا تَكُونُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْمُخْسِرِينَ
entries.t: Give full measure, and do not cheat.
entries.na: اوفوا الكيل ولا تكونوا من المخسرين
entries.nt: give full measure and do not cheat

entries.a: وَزِنُوا۟ بِٱلْقِسْطَاسِ ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمِ
entries.t: And weigh with accurate scales.
entries.na: وزنوا بالقسطاس المستقيم
entries.nt: and weigh with accurate scales

entries.a: وَلَا تَبْخَسُوا۟ ٱلنَّاسَ أَشْيَآءَهُمْ وَلَا تَعْثَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مُفْسِدِينَ
entries.t: And do not defraud people of their belongings, and do not work corruption in the land.
entries.na: ولا تبخسوا الناس اشياهم ولا تعثوا في الارض مفسدين
entries.nt: and do not defraud people of their belongings and do not work corruption in the land

entries.a: وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَكُمْ وَٱلْجِبِلَّةَ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
entries.t: And fear Him who created you and the masses of old."
entries.na: واتقوا الذي خلقكم والجبله الاولين
entries.nt: and fear him who created you and the masses of old

entries.a: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مِنَ ٱلْمُسَحَّرِينَ
entries.t: They said, "You are one of those bewitched.
entries.na: قالوا انما انت من المسحرين
entries.nt: they said you are one of those bewitched

entries.a: وَمَآ أَنتَ إِلَّا بَشَرٌۭ مِّثْلُنَا وَإِن نَّظُنُّكَ لَمِنَ ٱلْكَٰذِبِينَ
entries.t: And you are nothing but a man like us; and we think that you are a liar.
entries.na: وما انت الا بشر مثلنا وان نظنك لمن الكذبين
entries.nt: and you are nothing but a man like us and we think that you are a liar

entries.a: فَأَسْقِطْ عَلَيْنَا كِسَفًۭا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ
entries.t: So bring down on us pieces from the sky, if you are truthful."
entries.na: فاسقط علينا كسفا من السما ان كنت من الصدقين
entries.nt: so bring down on us pieces from the sky if you are truthful

entries.a: قَالَ رَبِّىٓ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ
entries.t: He said, "My Lord is Well Aware of what you do."
entries.na: قال ربي اعلم بما تعملون
entries.nt: he said my lord is well aware of what you do

entries.a: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَخَذَهُمْ عَذَابُ يَوْمِ ٱلظُّلَّةِ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
entries.t: But they denied him. So the punishment of the day of gloom gripped them. It was the punishment of a great day.
entries.na: فكذبوه فاخذهم عذاب يوم الظله انه كان عذاب يوم عظيم
entries.nt: but they denied him so the punishment of the day of gloom gripped them it was the punishment of a great day

entries.a: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
entries.t: Surely in this is a sign, but most of them are not believers.
entries.na: ان في ذلك لايه وما كان اكثرهم مومنين
entries.nt: surely in this is a sign but most of them are not believers

entries.a: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
entries.t: Your Lord is the Almighty, the Merciful.
entries.na: وان ربك لهو العزيز الرحيم
entries.nt: your lord is the almighty the merciful

entries.a: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَتَنزِيلُ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
entries.t: It is a revelation from the Lord of the Worlds.
entries.na: وانه لتنزيل رب العلمين
entries.nt: it is a revelation from the lord of the worlds

entries.a: نَزَلَ بِهِ ٱلرُّوحُ ٱلْأَمِينُ
entries.t: The Honest Spirit came down with it.
entries.na: نزل به الروح الامين
entries.nt: the honest spirit came down with it

entries.a: عَلَىٰ قَلْبِكَ لِتَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُنذِرِينَ
entries.t: Upon your heart, that you may be one of the warners.
entries.na: علي قلبك لتكون من المنذرين
entries.nt: upon your heart that you may be one of the warners

entries.a: بِلِسَانٍ عَرَبِىٍّۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
entries.t: In a clear Arabic tongue.
entries.na: بلسان عربي مبين
entries.nt: in a clear arabic tongue

entries.a: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَفِى زُبُرِ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
entries.t: And it is in the scriptures of the ancients.
entries.na: وانه لفي زبر الاولين
entries.nt: and it is in the scriptures of the ancients

entries.a: أَوَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُمْ ءَايَةً أَن يَعْلَمَهُۥ عُلَمَٰٓؤُا۟ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ
entries.t: Is it not a sign for them that the scholars of the Children of Israel recognized it?
entries.na: اولم يكن لهم ايه ان يعلمه علموا بني اسريل
entries.nt: is it not a sign for them that the scholars of the children of israel recognized it

entries.a: وَلَوْ نَزَّلْنَٰهُ عَلَىٰ بَعْضِ ٱلْأَعْجَمِينَ
entries.t: Had We revealed it to one of the foreigners.
entries.na: ولو نزلنه علي بعض الاعجمين
entries.nt: had we revealed it to one of the foreigners

entries.a: فَقَرَأَهُۥ عَلَيْهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ مُؤْمِنِينَ
entries.t: And he had recited it to them, they still would not have believed in it.
entries.na: فقراه عليهم ما كانوا به مومنين
entries.nt: and he had recited it to them they still would not have believed in it

entries.a: كَذَٰلِكَ سَلَكْنَٰهُ فِى قُلُوبِ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
entries.t: Thus We make it pass through the hearts of the guilty.
entries.na: كذلك سلكنه في قلوب المجرمين
entries.nt: thus we make it pass through the hearts of the guilty

entries.a: لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِۦ حَتَّىٰ يَرَوُا۟ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلْأَلِيمَ
entries.t: They will not believe in it until they witness the painful punishment.
entries.na: لا يومنون به حتي يروا العذاب الاليم
entries.nt: they will not believe in it until they witness the painful punishment

entries.a: فَيَأْتِيَهُم بَغْتَةًۭ وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ
entries.t: It will come to them suddenly, while they are unaware.
entries.na: فياتيهم بغته وهم لا يشعرون
entries.nt: it will come to them suddenly while they are unaware

entries.a: فَيَقُولُوا۟ هَلْ نَحْنُ مُنظَرُونَ
entries.t: Then they will say, "Are we given any respite?"
entries.na: فيقولوا هل نحن منظرون
entries.nt: then they will say are we given any respite

entries.a: أَفَبِعَذَابِنَا يَسْتَعْجِلُونَ
entries.t: Do they seek to hasten Our punishment?
entries.na: افبعذابنا يستعجلون
entries.nt: do they seek to hasten our punishment

entries.a: أَفَرَءَيْتَ إِن مَّتَّعْنَٰهُمْ سِنِينَ
entries.t: Have you considered: if We let them enjoy themselves for some years.
entries.na: افريت ان متعنهم سنين
entries.nt: have you considered if we let them enjoy themselves for some years

entries.a: ثُمَّ جَآءَهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يُوعَدُونَ
entries.t: Then there comes to them what they were promised.
entries.na: ثم جاهم ما كانوا يوعدون
entries.nt: then there comes to them what they were promised

entries.a: مَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يُمَتَّعُونَ
entries.t: Of what avail to them will be their past enjoyments?
entries.na: ما اغني عنهم ما كانوا يمتعون
entries.nt: of what avail to them will be their past enjoyments

entries.a: وَمَآ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَرْيَةٍ إِلَّا لَهَا مُنذِرُونَ
entries.t: Never did We destroy a town, but it had warners.
entries.na: وما اهلكنا من قريه الا لها منذرون
entries.nt: never did we destroy a town but it had warners

entries.a: ذِكْرَىٰ وَمَا كُنَّا ظَٰلِمِينَ
entries.t: As a reminder-We are never unjust.
entries.na: ذكري وما كنا ظلمين
entries.nt: as a reminder we are never unjust

entries.a: وَمَا تَنَزَّلَتْ بِهِ ٱلشَّيَٰطِينُ
entries.t: It was not the devils that revealed it.
entries.na: وما تنزلت به الشيطين
entries.nt: it was not the devils that revealed it

entries.a: وَمَا يَنۢبَغِى لَهُمْ وَمَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ
entries.t: It is not in their interests, nor in their power.
entries.na: وما ينبغي لهم وما يستطيعون
entries.nt: it is not in their interests nor in their power

entries.a: إِنَّهُمْ عَنِ ٱلسَّمْعِ لَمَعْزُولُونَ
entries.t: They are barred from hearing.
entries.na: انهم عن السمع لمعزولون
entries.nt: they are barred from hearing

entries.a: فَلَا تَدْعُ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ فَتَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُعَذَّبِينَ
entries.t: So do not pray to another god with God, else you will be of those tormented.
entries.na: فلا تدع مع الله الها اخر فتكون من المعذبين
entries.nt: so do not pray to another god with god else you will be of those tormented

entries.a: وَأَنذِرْ عَشِيرَتَكَ ٱلْأَقْرَبِينَ
entries.t: And warn your close relatives.
entries.na: وانذر عشيرتك الاقربين
entries.nt: and warn your close relatives

entries.a: وَٱخْفِضْ جَنَاحَكَ لِمَنِ ٱتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
entries.t: And lower your wing to those of the believers who follow you.
entries.na: واخفض جناحك لمن اتبعك من المومنين
entries.nt: and lower your wing to those of the believers who follow you

entries.a: فَإِنْ عَصَوْكَ فَقُلْ إِنِّى بَرِىٓءٌۭ مِّمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ
entries.t: And if they disobey you, say, "I am innocent of what you do."
entries.na: فان عصوك فقل اني بري مما تعملون
entries.nt: and if they disobey you say i am innocent of what you do

entries.a: وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
entries.t: And put your trust in the Almighty, the Merciful.
entries.na: وتوكل علي العزيز الرحيم
entries.nt: and put your trust in the almighty the merciful

entries.a: ٱلَّذِى يَرَىٰكَ حِينَ تَقُومُ
entries.t: He Who sees you when you rise.
entries.na: الذي يريك حين تقوم
entries.nt: he who sees you when you rise

entries.a: وَتَقَلُّبَكَ فِى ٱلسَّٰجِدِينَ
entries.t: And your devotions amidst the worshipers.
entries.na: وتقلبك في السجدين
entries.nt: and your devotions amidst the worshipers

entries.a: إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
entries.t: He is indeed the Hearer, the Aware.
entries.na: انه هو السميع العليم
entries.nt: he is indeed the hearer the aware

entries.a: هَلْ أُنَبِّئُكُمْ عَلَىٰ مَن تَنَزَّلُ ٱلشَّيَٰطِينُ
entries.t: Shall I inform you upon whom the devils descend?
entries.na: هل انبيكم علي من تنزل الشيطين
entries.nt: shall i inform you upon whom the devils descend

entries.a: تَنَزَّلُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ أَفَّاكٍ أَثِيمٍۢ
entries.t: They descend upon every sinful liar.
entries.na: تنزل علي كل افاك اثيم
entries.nt: they descend upon every sinful liar

entries.a: يُلْقُونَ ٱلسَّمْعَ وَأَكْثَرُهُمْ كَٰذِبُونَ
entries.t: They give ear, and most of them are liars.
entries.na: يلقون السمع واكثرهم كذبون
entries.nt: they give ear and most of them are liars

entries.a: وَٱلشُّعَرَآءُ يَتَّبِعُهُمُ ٱلْغَاوُۥنَ
entries.t: And as for the poets-the deviators follow them.
entries.na: والشعرا يتبعهم الغاون
entries.nt: and as for the poets the deviators follow them

entries.a: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّهُمْ فِى كُلِّ وَادٍۢ يَهِيمُونَ
entries.t: Do you not see how they ramble in every style?
entries.na: الم تر انهم في كل واد يهيمون
entries.nt: do you not see how they ramble in every style

entries.a: وَأَنَّهُمْ يَقُولُونَ مَا لَا يَفْعَلُونَ
entries.t: And how they say what they do not do?
entries.na: وانهم يقولون ما لا يفعلون
entries.nt: and how they say what they do not do

entries.a: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَذَكَرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ كَثِيرًۭا وَٱنتَصَرُوا۟ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا ظُلِمُوا۟ ۗ وَسَيَعْلَمُ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوٓا۟ أَىَّ مُنقَلَبٍۢ يَنقَلِبُونَ
entries.t: Except for those who believe, and do good deeds, and remember God frequently, and defend themselves after they are wronged. As for those who do wrong, they will know by what overturning they will be overturned.
entries.na: الا الذين امنوا وعملوا الصلحت وذكروا الله كثيرا وانتصروا من بعد ما ظلموا وسيعلم الذين ظلموا اي منقلب ينقلبون
