entries.nt: if we will we can blind their eyes as they rush towards the path but how will they see

entries.a: وَلَوْ نَشَآءُ لَمَسَخْنَٰهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَكَانَتِهِمْ فَمَا ٱسْتَطَٰعُوا۟ مُضِيًّۭا وَلَا يَرْجِعُونَ
entries.t: And if We will, We can cripple them in their place; so they can neither move forward, nor go back.
entries.na: ولو نشا لمسخنهم علي مكانتهم فما استطعوا مضيا ولا يرجعون
entries.nt: and if we will we can cripple them in their place so they can neither move forward nor go back

entries.a: وَمَن نُّعَمِّرْهُ نُنَكِّسْهُ فِى ٱلْخَلْقِ ۖ أَفَلَا يَعْقِلُونَ
entries.t: Whomever We grant old age, We reverse his development. Do they not understand?
entries.na: ومن نعمره ننكسه في الخلق افلا يعقلون
entries.nt: whomever we grant old age we reverse his development do they not understand

entries.a: وَمَا عَلَّمْنَٰهُ ٱلشِّعْرَ وَمَا يَنۢبَغِى لَهُۥٓ ۚ إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌۭ وَقُرْءَانٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
entries.t: We did not teach him poetry, nor is it proper for him. It is only a reminder, and a Clear Quran.
entries.na: وما علمنه الشعر وما ينبغي له ان هو الا ذكر وقران مبين
entries.nt: we did not teach him poetry nor is it proper for him it is only a reminder and a clear quran

entries.a: لِّيُنذِرَ مَن كَانَ حَيًّۭا وَيَحِقَّ ٱلْقَوْلُ عَلَى ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ
entries.t: That he may warn whoever is alive, and prove the Word against the faithless.
entries.na: لينذر من كان حيا ويحق القول علي الكفرين
entries.nt: that he may warn whoever is alive and prove the word against the faithless

entries.a: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ أَنَّا خَلَقْنَا لَهُم مِّمَّا عَمِلَتْ أَيْدِينَآ أَنْعَٰمًۭا فَهُمْ لَهَا مَٰلِكُونَ
entries.t: Have they not seen that We created for them, of Our Handiwork, livestock that they own?
entries.na: اولم يروا انا خلقنا لهم مما عملت ايدينا انعما فهم لها ملكون
entries.nt: have they not seen that we created for them of our handiwork livestock that they own

entries.a: وَذَلَّلْنَٰهَا لَهُمْ فَمِنْهَا رَكُوبُهُمْ وَمِنْهَا يَأْكُلُونَ
entries.t: And We subdued them for them. Some they ride, and some they eat.
entries.na: وذللنها لهم فمنها ركوبهم ومنها ياكلون
entries.nt: and we subdued them for them some they ride and some they eat

entries.a: وَلَهُمْ فِيهَا مَنَٰفِعُ وَمَشَارِبُ ۖ أَفَلَا يَشْكُرُونَ
entries.t: And they have in them other benefits, and drinks. Will they not give thanks?
entries.na: ولهم فيها منفع ومشارب افلا يشكرون
entries.nt: and they have in them other benefits and drinks will they not give thanks

entries.a: وَٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ءَالِهَةًۭ لَّعَلَّهُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
entries.t: Yet they have taken to themselves gods other than God, that perhaps they may be helped.
entries.na: واتخذوا من دون الله الهه لعلهم ينصرون
entries.nt: yet they have taken to themselves gods other than god that perhaps they may be helped

entries.a: لَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ نَصْرَهُمْ وَهُمْ لَهُمْ جُندٌۭ مُّحْضَرُونَ
entries.t: They cannot help them, although they are arrayed as troops for them.
entries.na: لا يستطيعون نصرهم وهم لهم جند محضرون
entries.nt: they cannot help them although they are arrayed as troops for them

entries.a: فَلَا يَحْزُنكَ قَوْلُهُمْ ۘ إِنَّا نَعْلَمُ مَا يُسِرُّونَ وَمَا يُعْلِنُونَ
entries.t: So let their words not sadden you. We know what they conceal, and what they reveal.
entries.na: فلا يحزنك قولهم انا نعلم ما يسرون وما يعلنون
entries.nt: so let their words not sadden you we know what they conceal and what they reveal

entries.a: أَوَلَمْ يَرَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ أَنَّا خَلَقْنَٰهُ مِن نُّطْفَةٍۢ فَإِذَا هُوَ خَصِيمٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
entries.t: Does the human being not consider that We created him from a seed? Yet he becomes a fierce adversary.
entries.na: اولم ير الانسن انا خلقنه من نطفه فاذا هو خصيم مبين
entries.nt: does the human being not consider that we created him from a seed yet he becomes a fierce adversary

entries.a: وَضَرَبَ لَنَا مَثَلًۭا وَنَسِىَ خَلْقَهُۥ ۖ قَالَ مَن يُحْىِ ٱلْعِظَٰمَ وَهِىَ رَمِيمٌۭ
entries.t: And he produces arguments against Us, and he forgets his own creation. He says, "Who will revive the bones when they have decayed?"
entries.na: وضرب لنا مثلا ونسي خلقه قال من يحي العظم وهي رميم
entries.nt: and he produces arguments against us and he forgets his own creation he says who will revive the bones when they have decayed

entries.a: قُلْ يُحْيِيهَا ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنشَأَهَآ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍۢ ۖ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ خَلْقٍ عَلِيمٌ
entries.t: Say, "He who initiated them in the first instance will revive them. He has knowledge of every creation."
entries.na: قل يحييها الذي انشاها اول مره وهو بكل خلق عليم
entries.nt: say he who initiated them in the first instance will revive them he has knowledge of every creation

entries.a: ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلشَّجَرِ ٱلْأَخْضَرِ نَارًۭا فَإِذَآ أَنتُم مِّنْهُ تُوقِدُونَ
entries.t: He who produced fuel for you from the green trees, with which you kindle a fire.
entries.na: الذي جعل لكم من الشجر الاخضر نارا فاذا انتم منه توقدون
entries.nt: he who produced fuel for you from the green trees with which you kindle a fire

entries.a: أَوَلَيْسَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ بِقَٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يَخْلُقَ مِثْلَهُم ۚ بَلَىٰ وَهُوَ ٱلْخَلَّٰقُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
entries.t: Is not He who created the heavens and the earth able to create the like of them? Certainly. He is the Supreme All-Knowing Creator.
entries.na: اوليس الذي خلق السموت والارض بقدر علي ان يخلق مثلهم بلي وهو الخلق العليم
entries.nt: is not he who created the heavens and the earth able to create the like of them certainly he is the supreme all knowing creator

entries.a: إِنَّمَآ أَمْرُهُۥٓ إِذَآ أَرَادَ شَيْـًٔا أَن يَقُولَ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ
entries.t: His command, when He wills a thing, is to say to it, "Be," and it comes to be.
entries.na: انما امره اذا اراد شيا ان يقول له كن فيكون
entries.nt: his command when he wills a thing is to say to it be and it comes to be

entries.a: فَسُبْحَٰنَ ٱلَّذِى بِيَدِهِۦ مَلَكُوتُ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
entries.t: So glory be to Him in whose hand is the dominion of everything, and to Him you will be returned.
entries.na: فسبحن الذي بيده ملكوت كل شي واليه ترجعون
entries.nt: so glory be to him in whose hand is the dominion of everything and to him you will be returned

entries.a: وَٱلصَّٰٓفَّٰتِ صَفًّۭا
entries.t: By the aligners aligning.
entries.na: والصفت صفا
entries.nt: by the aligners aligning

entries.a: فَٱلزَّٰجِرَٰتِ زَجْرًۭا
entries.t: And the drivers driving.
entries.na: فالزجرت زجرا
entries.nt: and the drivers driving

entries.a: فَٱلتَّٰلِيَٰتِ ذِكْرًا
entries.t: And the reciters of the Reminder.
entries.na: فالتليت ذكرا
entries.nt: and the reciters of the reminder

entries.a: إِنَّ إِلَٰهَكُمْ لَوَٰحِدٌۭ
entries.t: Your God is indeed One.
entries.na: ان الهكم لوحد
entries.nt: your god is indeed one

entries.a: رَّبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَرَبُّ ٱلْمَشَٰرِقِ
entries.t: Lord of the heavens and the earth, and everything between them; and Lord of the Easts.
entries.na: رب السموت والارض وما بينهما ورب المشرق
entries.nt: lord of the heavens and the earth and everything between them and lord of the easts

entries.a: إِنَّا زَيَّنَّا ٱلسَّمَآءَ ٱلدُّنْيَا بِزِينَةٍ ٱلْكَوَاكِبِ
entries.t: We have adorned the lower heaven with the beauty of the planets.
entries.na: انا زينا السما الدنيا بزينه الكواكب
entries.nt: we have adorned the lower heaven with the beauty of the planets

entries.a: وَحِفْظًۭا مِّن كُلِّ شَيْطَٰنٍۢ مَّارِدٍۢ
entries.t: And guarded it against every defiant devil.
entries.na: وحفظا من كل شيطن مارد
entries.nt: and guarded it against every defiant devil

entries.a: لَّا يَسَّمَّعُونَ إِلَى ٱلْمَلَإِ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ وَيُقْذَفُونَ مِن كُلِّ جَانِبٍۢ
entries.t: They cannot eavesdrop on the Supernal Elite, for they get bombarded from every side.
entries.na: لا يسمعون الي الملا الاعلي ويقذفون من كل جانب
entries.nt: they cannot eavesdrop on the supernal elite for they get bombarded from every side

entries.a: دُحُورًۭا ۖ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌۭ وَاصِبٌ
entries.t: Repelled-they will have a lingering torment.
entries.na: دحورا ولهم عذاب واصب
entries.nt: repelled they will have a lingering torment

entries.a: إِلَّا مَنْ خَطِفَ ٱلْخَطْفَةَ فَأَتْبَعَهُۥ شِهَابٌۭ ثَاقِبٌۭ
entries.t: Except for him who snatches a fragment-he gets pursued by a piercing projectile.
entries.na: الا من خطف الخطفه فاتبعه شهاب ثاقب
entries.nt: except for him who snatches a fragment he gets pursued by a piercing projectile

entries.a: فَٱسْتَفْتِهِمْ أَهُمْ أَشَدُّ خَلْقًا أَم مَّنْ خَلَقْنَآ ۚ إِنَّا خَلَقْنَٰهُم مِّن طِينٍۢ لَّازِبٍۭ
entries.t: Inquire of them, "Are they more difficult to create, or the others We created?" We created them from sticky clay.
entries.na: فاستفتهم اهم اشد خلقا ام من خلقنا انا خلقنهم من طين لازب
entries.nt: inquire of them are they more difficult to create or the others we created we created them from sticky clay

entries.a: بَلْ عَجِبْتَ وَيَسْخَرُونَ
entries.t: But you wonder, and they ridicule.
entries.na: بل عجبت ويسخرون
entries.nt: but you wonder and they ridicule

entries.a: وَإِذَا ذُكِّرُوا۟ لَا يَذْكُرُونَ
entries.t: And when reminded, they pay no attention.
entries.na: واذا ذكروا لا يذكرون
entries.nt: and when reminded they pay no attention

entries.a: وَإِذَا رَأَوْا۟ ءَايَةًۭ يَسْتَسْخِرُونَ
entries.t: And when they see a sign, they ridicule.
entries.na: واذا راوا ايه يستسخرون
entries.nt: and when they see a sign they ridicule

entries.a: وَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحْرٌۭ مُّبِينٌ
entries.t: And they say, "This is nothing but plain magic.
entries.na: وقالوا ان هذا الا سحر مبين
entries.nt: and they say this is nothing but plain magic

entries.a: أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًۭا وَعِظَٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ
entries.t: When we have died and become dust and bones, shall we be resurrected?
entries.na: اذا متنا وكنا ترابا وعظما انا لمبعوثون
entries.nt: when we have died and become dust and bones shall we be resurrected

entries.a: أَوَءَابَآؤُنَا ٱلْأَوَّلُونَ
entries.t: And our ancestors of old?"
entries.na: اواباونا الاولون
entries.nt: and our ancestors of old

entries.a: قُلْ نَعَمْ وَأَنتُمْ دَٰخِرُونَ
entries.t: Say, "Yes indeed, and you will be totally subdued."
entries.na: قل نعم وانتم دخرون
entries.nt: say yes indeed and you will be totally subdued

entries.a: فَإِنَّمَا هِىَ زَجْرَةٌۭ وَٰحِدَةٌۭ فَإِذَا هُمْ يَنظُرُونَ
entries.t: It will be a single nudge, and they will be staring.
entries.na: فانما هي زجره وحده فاذا هم ينظرون
entries.nt: it will be a single nudge and they will be staring

entries.a: وَقَالُوا۟ يَٰوَيْلَنَا هَٰذَا يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ
entries.t: They will say, "Woe to us. This is the Day of Judgment."
entries.na: وقالوا يويلنا هذا يوم الدين
entries.nt: they will say woe to us this is the day of judgment

entries.a: هَٰذَا يَوْمُ ٱلْفَصْلِ ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
entries.t: "This is the Day of Separation which you used to deny.
entries.na: هذا يوم الفصل الذي كنتم به تكذبون
entries.nt: this is the day of separation which you used to deny

entries.a: ۞ ٱحْشُرُوا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ وَأَزْوَٰجَهُمْ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْبُدُونَ
entries.t: Gather those who did wrong, and their mates, and what they used to worship.
entries.na: احشروا الذين ظلموا وازوجهم وما كانوا يعبدون
entries.nt: gather those who did wrong and their mates and what they used to worship

entries.a: مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ فَٱهْدُوهُمْ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
entries.t: Besides God, and lead them to the way to Hell.
entries.na: من دون الله فاهدوهم الي صرط الجحيم
entries.nt: besides god and lead them to the way to hell

entries.a: وَقِفُوهُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُم مَّسْـُٔولُونَ
entries.t: And stop them. They are to be questioned."
entries.na: وقفوهم انهم مسولون
entries.nt: and stop them they are to be questioned

entries.a: مَا لَكُمْ لَا تَنَاصَرُونَ
entries.t: What is the matter with you? Why do you not help one another?
entries.na: ما لكم لا تناصرون
entries.nt: what is the matter with you why do you not help one another

entries.a: بَلْ هُمُ ٱلْيَوْمَ مُسْتَسْلِمُونَ
entries.t: In fact, on that Day, they will be submissive.
entries.na: بل هم اليوم مستسلمون
entries.nt: in fact on that day they will be submissive

entries.a: وَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍۢ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
entries.t: They will come to one another, questioning one another.
entries.na: واقبل بعضهم علي بعض يتسالون
entries.nt: they will come to one another questioning one another

entries.a: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّكُمْ كُنتُمْ تَأْتُونَنَا عَنِ ٱلْيَمِينِ
entries.t: They will say, "You used to come at us from the right."
entries.na: قالوا انكم كنتم تاتوننا عن اليمين
entries.nt: they will say you used to come at us from the right

entries.a: قَالُوا۟ بَل لَّمْ تَكُونُوا۟ مُؤْمِنِينَ
entries.t: They will say, "You yourselves were not believers.
entries.na: قالوا بل لم تكونوا مومنين
entries.nt: they will say you yourselves were not believers

entries.a: وَمَا كَانَ لَنَا عَلَيْكُم مِّن سُلْطَٰنٍۭ ۖ بَلْ كُنتُمْ قَوْمًۭا طَٰغِينَ
entries.t: We had no authority over you. You yourselves were rebellious people.
entries.na: وما كان لنا عليكم من سلطن بل كنتم قوما طغين
entries.nt: we had no authority over you you yourselves were rebellious people

entries.a: فَحَقَّ عَلَيْنَا قَوْلُ رَبِّنَآ ۖ إِنَّا لَذَآئِقُونَ
entries.t: The Word of our Lord has been realized against us. We are tasting it.
entries.na: فحق علينا قول ربنا انا لذايقون
entries.nt: the word of our lord has been realized against us we are tasting it

entries.a: فَأَغْوَيْنَٰكُمْ إِنَّا كُنَّا غَٰوِينَ
entries.t: We seduced you. We were seducers."
entries.na: فاغوينكم انا كنا غوين
entries.nt: we seduced you we were seducers

entries.a: فَإِنَّهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ مُشْتَرِكُونَ
entries.t: On that Day, they will share in the punishment.
entries.na: فانهم يوميذ في العذاب مشتركون
entries.nt: on that day they will share in the punishment

entries.a: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَفْعَلُ بِٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
entries.t: Thus We deal with the sinners.
entries.na: انا كذلك نفعل بالمجرمين
entries.nt: thus we deal with the sinners

entries.a: إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوٓا۟ إِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ
entries.t: When it was said to them, "There is no god except God," they grew arrogant.
entries.na: انهم كانوا اذا قيل لهم لا اله الا الله يستكبرون
entries.nt: when it was said to them there is no god except god they grew arrogant

entries.a: وَيَقُولُونَ أَئِنَّا لَتَارِكُوٓا۟ ءَالِهَتِنَا لِشَاعِرٍۢ مَّجْنُونٍۭ
entries.t: And said, "Are we to abandon our gods for a mad poet?"
entries.na: ويقولون اينا لتاركوا الهتنا لشاعر مجنون
entries.nt: and said are we to abandon our gods for a mad poet

entries.a: بَلْ جَآءَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَصَدَّقَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
entries.t: In fact, he came with the truth, and he confirmed the messengers.
entries.na: بل جا بالحق وصدق المرسلين
entries.nt: in fact he came with the truth and he confirmed the messengers

entries.a: إِنَّكُمْ لَذَآئِقُوا۟ ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْأَلِيمِ
entries.t: Most assuredly, you will taste the painful punishment.
entries.na: انكم لذايقوا العذاب الاليم
entries.nt: most assuredly you will taste the painful punishment

entries.a: وَمَا تُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
entries.t: And you will be repaid only for what you used to do.
entries.na: وما تجزون الا ما كنتم تعملون
entries.nt: and you will be repaid only for what you used to do

entries.a: إِلَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
entries.t: Except for God's sincere servants.
entries.na: الا عباد الله المخلصين
entries.nt: except for god s sincere servants

entries.a: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ رِزْقٌۭ مَّعْلُومٌۭ
entries.t: For them is a known provision.
entries.na: اوليك لهم رزق معلوم
entries.nt: for them is a known provision

entries.a: فَوَٰكِهُ ۖ وَهُم مُّكْرَمُونَ
entries.t: Fruits; and they will be honored.
entries.na: فوكه وهم مكرمون
entries.nt: fruits and they will be honored

entries.a: فِى جَنَّٰتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
entries.t: In the Gardens of Bliss.
entries.na: في جنت النعيم
entries.nt: in the gardens of bliss

entries.a: عَلَىٰ سُرُرٍۢ مُّتَقَٰبِلِينَ
entries.t: On furnishings, facing one another.
entries.na: علي سرر متقبلين
entries.nt: on furnishings facing one another

entries.a: يُطَافُ عَلَيْهِم بِكَأْسٍۢ مِّن مَّعِينٍۭ
entries.t: They will be offered a cup of pure drink.
entries.na: يطاف عليهم بكاس من معين
entries.nt: they will be offered a cup of pure drink

entries.a: بَيْضَآءَ لَذَّةٍۢ لِّلشَّٰرِبِينَ
entries.t: White; a delight to those who drink.
entries.na: بيضا لذه للشربين
entries.nt: white a delight to those who drink

entries.a: لَا فِيهَا غَوْلٌۭ وَلَا هُمْ عَنْهَا يُنزَفُونَ
entries.t: Never polluted, and never intoxicating.
entries.na: لا فيها غول ولا هم عنها ينزفون
entries.nt: never polluted and never intoxicating

entries.a: وَعِندَهُمْ قَٰصِرَٰتُ ٱلطَّرْفِ عِينٌۭ
entries.t: With them will be bashful women with lovely eyes.
entries.na: وعندهم قصرت الطرف عين
entries.nt: with them will be bashful women with lovely eyes

entries.a: كَأَنَّهُنَّ بَيْضٌۭ مَّكْنُونٌۭ
entries.t: As if they were closely guarded pearls.
entries.na: كانهن بيض مكنون
entries.nt: as if they were closely guarded pearls

entries.a: فَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍۢ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
entries.t: Then they will approach one another, questioning.
entries.na: فاقبل بعضهم علي بعض يتسالون
entries.nt: then they will approach one another questioning

entries.a: قَالَ قَآئِلٌۭ مِّنْهُمْ إِنِّى كَانَ لِى قَرِينٌۭ
entries.t: One of them will say, "I used to have a friend.
entries.na: قال قايل منهم اني كان لي قرين
entries.nt: one of them will say i used to have a friend

entries.a: يَقُولُ أَءِنَّكَ لَمِنَ ٱلْمُصَدِّقِينَ
entries.t: Who used to say, "Are you of those who believe?
entries.na: يقول انك لمن المصدقين
entries.nt: who used to say are you of those who believe

entries.a: أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًۭا وَعِظَٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَدِينُونَ
entries.t: That after we die and become dust and bones, we will be called to account?"
entries.na: اذا متنا وكنا ترابا وعظما انا لمدينون
entries.nt: that after we die and become dust and bones we will be called to account

entries.a: قَالَ هَلْ أَنتُم مُّطَّلِعُونَ
entries.t: He will say, "Will you have a look?"
entries.na: قال هل انتم مطلعون
entries.nt: he will say will you have a look

entries.a: فَٱطَّلَعَ فَرَءَاهُ فِى سَوَآءِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
entries.t: He will look, and will see him in the pit of Hell.
entries.na: فاطلع فراه في سوا الجحيم
entries.nt: he will look and will see him in the pit of hell

entries.a: قَالَ تَٱللَّهِ إِن كِدتَّ لَتُرْدِينِ
entries.t: He will say, "By God, you almost ruined me.
entries.na: قال تالله ان كدت لتردين
entries.nt: he will say by god you almost ruined me

entries.a: وَلَوْلَا نِعْمَةُ رَبِّى لَكُنتُ مِنَ ٱلْمُحْضَرِينَ
entries.t: Were it not for the grace of my Lord, I would have been among the arraigned."
entries.na: ولولا نعمه ربي لكنت من المحضرين
entries.nt: were it not for the grace of my lord i would have been among the arraigned

entries.a: أَفَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَيِّتِينَ
entries.t: "We will not die.
entries.na: افما نحن بميتين
entries.nt: we will not die

entries.a: إِلَّا مَوْتَتَنَا ٱلْأُولَىٰ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُعَذَّبِينَ
entries.t: Except for our first death, and we will not be punished."
entries.na: الا موتتنا الاولي وما نحن بمعذبين
entries.nt: except for our first death and we will not be punished

entries.a: إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَهُوَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ
entries.t: This is the supreme triumph.
entries.na: ان هذا لهو الفوز العظيم
entries.nt: this is the supreme triumph

entries.a: لِمِثْلِ هَٰذَا فَلْيَعْمَلِ ٱلْعَٰمِلُونَ
entries.t: For the like of this let the workers work.
entries.na: لمثل هذا فليعمل العملون
entries.nt: for the like of this let the workers work

entries.a: أَذَٰلِكَ خَيْرٌۭ نُّزُلًا أَمْ شَجَرَةُ ٱلزَّقُّومِ
entries.t: Is this a better hospitality, or the Tree of Bitterness?
entries.na: اذلك خير نزلا ام شجره الزقوم
entries.nt: is this a better hospitality or the tree of bitterness

entries.a: إِنَّا جَعَلْنَٰهَا فِتْنَةًۭ لِّلظَّٰلِمِينَ
entries.t: We made it an ordeal for the unjust.
entries.na: انا جعلنها فتنه للظلمين
entries.nt: we made it an ordeal for the unjust

entries.a: إِنَّهَا شَجَرَةٌۭ تَخْرُجُ فِىٓ أَصْلِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
entries.t: It is a tree that grows from the bottom of Hell.
entries.na: انها شجره تخرج في اصل الجحيم
entries.nt: it is a tree that grows from the bottom of hell

entries.a: طَلْعُهَا كَأَنَّهُۥ رُءُوسُ ٱلشَّيَٰطِينِ
entries.t: Its fruits are like the devils' heads.
entries.na: طلعها كانه روس الشيطين
entries.nt: its fruits are like the devils heads

entries.a: فَإِنَّهُمْ لَءَاكِلُونَ مِنْهَا فَمَالِـُٔونَ مِنْهَا ٱلْبُطُونَ
entries.t: They will eat from it, and fill their bellies with it.
entries.na: فانهم لاكلون منها فمالون منها البطون
entries.nt: they will eat from it and fill their bellies with it

entries.a: ثُمَّ إِنَّ لَهُمْ عَلَيْهَا لَشَوْبًۭا مِّنْ حَمِيمٍۢ
entries.t: Then, on top of it, they will have a brew of boiling liquid.
entries.na: ثم ان لهم عليها لشوبا من حميم
entries.nt: then on top of it they will have a brew of boiling liquid

entries.a: ثُمَّ إِنَّ مَرْجِعَهُمْ لَإِلَى ٱلْجَحِيمِ
entries.t: Then their return will be to the Blaze.
entries.na: ثم ان مرجعهم لالي الجحيم
entries.nt: then their return will be to the blaze

entries.a: إِنَّهُمْ أَلْفَوْا۟ ءَابَآءَهُمْ ضَآلِّينَ
entries.t: They had found their parents astray.
entries.na: انهم الفوا اباهم ضالين
entries.nt: they had found their parents astray

entries.a: فَهُمْ عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَٰرِهِمْ يُهْرَعُونَ
entries.t: And rushed along in their footsteps.
entries.na: فهم علي اثرهم يهرعون
entries.nt: and rushed along in their footsteps

entries.a: وَلَقَدْ ضَلَّ قَبْلَهُمْ أَكْثَرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
entries.t: And most of the ancients before them went astray.
entries.na: ولقد ضل قبلهم اكثر الاولين
entries.nt: and most of the ancients before them went astray

entries.a: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا فِيهِم مُّنذِرِينَ
entries.t: Even though We sent messengers to warn them.
entries.na: ولقد ارسلنا فيهم منذرين
entries.nt: even though we sent messengers to warn them

entries.a: فَٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلْمُنذَرِينَ
entries.t: So observe the end of those who were warned.
entries.na: فانظر كيف كان عقبه المنذرين
entries.nt: so observe the end of those who were warned

entries.a: إِلَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
entries.t: Except for the sincere servants of God.
entries.na: الا عباد الله المخلصين
entries.nt: except for the sincere servants of god

entries.a: وَلَقَدْ نَادَىٰنَا نُوحٌۭ فَلَنِعْمَ ٱلْمُجِيبُونَ
entries.t: And Noah called out to Us, and We are the Best of responders.
entries.na: ولقد نادينا نوح فلنعم المجيبون
entries.nt: and noah called out to us and we are the best of responders

entries.a: وَنَجَّيْنَٰهُ وَأَهْلَهُۥ مِنَ ٱلْكَرْبِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
entries.t: And We saved him and his family from the great calamity.
entries.na: ونجينه واهله من الكرب العظيم
entries.nt: and we saved him and his family from the great calamity

entries.a: وَجَعَلْنَا ذُرِّيَّتَهُۥ هُمُ ٱلْبَاقِينَ
entries.t: And We made his descendants the survivors.
entries.na: وجعلنا ذريته هم الباقين
entries.nt: and we made his descendants the survivors

entries.a: وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ فِى ٱلْءَاخِرِينَ
entries.t: And We left mention of him among those who succeeded.
entries.na: وتركنا عليه في الاخرين
entries.nt: and we left mention of him among those who succeeded

entries.a: سَلَٰمٌ عَلَىٰ نُوحٍۢ فِى ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
entries.t: Peace be upon Noah among all people.
entries.na: سلم علي نوح في العلمين
entries.nt: peace be upon noah among all people

entries.a: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
entries.t: We thus reward the righteous.
entries.na: انا كذلك نجزي المحسنين
entries.nt: we thus reward the righteous

entries.a: إِنَّهُۥ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
entries.t: He was one of Our believing servants.
entries.na: انه من عبادنا المومنين
entries.nt: he was one of our believing servants

entries.a: ثُمَّ أَغْرَقْنَا ٱلْءَاخَرِينَ
entries.t: Then We drowned the others.
entries.na: ثم اغرقنا الاخرين
entries.nt: then we drowned the others

entries.a: ۞ وَإِنَّ مِن شِيعَتِهِۦ لَإِبْرَٰهِيمَ
entries.t: Of his kind was Abraham.
entries.na: وان من شيعته لابرهيم
entries.nt: of his kind was abraham

entries.a: إِذْ جَآءَ رَبَّهُۥ بِقَلْبٍۢ سَلِيمٍ
entries.t: When he came to his Lord with a sound heart.
entries.na: اذ جا ربه بقلب سليم
entries.nt: when he came to his lord with a sound heart

entries.a: إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِۦ مَاذَا تَعْبُدُونَ
entries.t: He said to his father and his people, "What are you worshiping?
entries.na: اذ قال لابيه وقومه ماذا تعبدون
entries.nt: he said to his father and his people what are you worshiping

entries.a: أَئِفْكًا ءَالِهَةًۭ دُونَ ٱللَّهِ تُرِيدُونَ
entries.t: Is it falsified gods, instead of God, that you want?
entries.na: ايفكا الهه دون الله تريدون
entries.nt: is it falsified gods instead of god that you want

entries.a: فَمَا ظَنُّكُم بِرَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
entries.t: So what is your opinion about the Lord of the Worlds?"
entries.na: فما ظنكم برب العلمين
entries.nt: so what is your opinion about the lord of the worlds

entries.a: فَنَظَرَ نَظْرَةًۭ فِى ٱلنُّجُومِ
entries.t: Then he took a glance at the stars.
entries.na: فنظر نظره في النجوم
entries.nt: then he took a glance at the stars

entries.a: فَقَالَ إِنِّى سَقِيمٌۭ
entries.t: And said, "I am sick."
entries.na: فقال اني سقيم
entries.nt: and said i am sick

entries.a: فَتَوَلَّوْا۟ عَنْهُ مُدْبِرِينَ
entries.t: But they turned their backs on him, and went away.
entries.na: فتولوا عنه مدبرين
entries.nt: but they turned their backs on him and went away

entries.a: فَرَاغَ إِلَىٰٓ ءَالِهَتِهِمْ فَقَالَ أَلَا تَأْكُلُونَ
entries.t: Then he turned to their gods, and said, "will you not eat?
entries.na: فراغ الي الهتهم فقال الا تاكلون
entries.nt: then he turned to their gods and said will you not eat

entries.a: مَا لَكُمْ لَا تَنطِقُونَ
entries.t: What is it with you, that you do not speak?"
entries.na: ما لكم لا تنطقون
entries.nt: what is it with you that you do not speak

entries.a: فَرَاغَ عَلَيْهِمْ ضَرْبًۢا بِٱلْيَمِينِ
entries.t: Then he turned on them, striking with his right hand.
entries.na: فراغ عليهم ضربا باليمين
entries.nt: then he turned on them striking with his right hand

entries.a: فَأَقْبَلُوٓا۟ إِلَيْهِ يَزِفُّونَ
entries.t: And they came running towards him.
entries.na: فاقبلوا اليه يزفون
entries.nt: and they came running towards him

entries.a: قَالَ أَتَعْبُدُونَ مَا تَنْحِتُونَ
entries.t: He said, "Do you worship what you carve?
entries.na: قال اتعبدون ما تنحتون
entries.nt: he said do you worship what you carve

entries.a: وَٱللَّهُ خَلَقَكُمْ وَمَا تَعْمَلُونَ
entries.t: When God created you, and what you manufacture?"
entries.na: والله خلقكم وما تعملون
entries.nt: when god created you and what you manufacture

entries.a: قَالُوا۟ ٱبْنُوا۟ لَهُۥ بُنْيَٰنًۭا فَأَلْقُوهُ فِى ٱلْجَحِيمِ
entries.t: They said, "Build a pyre for him, and throw him into the furnace."
entries.na: قالوا ابنوا له بنينا فالقوه في الجحيم
entries.nt: they said build a pyre for him and throw him into the furnace

entries.a: فَأَرَادُوا۟ بِهِۦ كَيْدًۭا فَجَعَلْنَٰهُمُ ٱلْأَسْفَلِينَ
entries.t: They wished him ill, but We made them the losers.
entries.na: فارادوا به كيدا فجعلنهم الاسفلين
entries.nt: they wished him ill but we made them the losers

entries.a: وَقَالَ إِنِّى ذَاهِبٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّى سَيَهْدِينِ
entries.t: He said, "I am going towards my Lord, and He will guide me."
entries.na: وقال اني ذاهب الي ربي سيهدين
entries.nt: he said i am going towards my lord and he will guide me

entries.a: رَبِّ هَبْ لِى مِنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
entries.t: "My Lord, give me one of the righteous."
entries.na: رب هب لي من الصلحين
entries.nt: my lord give me one of the righteous

entries.a: فَبَشَّرْنَٰهُ بِغُلَٰمٍ حَلِيمٍۢ
entries.t: So We gave him good news of a clement boy.
entries.na: فبشرنه بغلم حليم
entries.nt: so we gave him good news of a clement boy

entries.a: فَلَمَّا بَلَغَ مَعَهُ ٱلسَّعْىَ قَالَ يَٰبُنَىَّ إِنِّىٓ أَرَىٰ فِى ٱلْمَنَامِ أَنِّىٓ أَذْبَحُكَ فَٱنظُرْ مَاذَا تَرَىٰ ۚ قَالَ يَٰٓأَبَتِ ٱفْعَلْ مَا تُؤْمَرُ ۖ سَتَجِدُنِىٓ إِن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰبِرِينَ
entries.t: Then, when he was old enough to accompany him, he said, "O My son, I see in a dream that I am sacrificing you; see what you think." He said, "O my Father, do as you are commanded; you will find me, God willing, one of the steadfast."
entries.na: فلما بلغ معه السعي قال يبني اني اري في المنام اني اذبحك فانظر ماذا تري قال يابت افعل ما تومر ستجدني ان شا الله من الصبرين
entries.nt: then when he was old enough to accompany him he said o my son i see in a dream that i am sacrificing you see what you think he said o my father do as you are commanded you will find me god willing one of the steadfast

entries.a: فَلَمَّآ أَسْلَمَا وَتَلَّهُۥ لِلْجَبِينِ
entries.t: Then, when they had submitted, and he put his forehead down.
entries.na: فلما اسلما وتله للجبين
entries.nt: then when they had submitted and he put his forehead down

entries.a: وَنَٰدَيْنَٰهُ أَن يَٰٓإِبْرَٰهِيمُ
entries.t: We called out to him, "O Abraham!
entries.na: وندينه ان يابرهيم
entries.nt: we called out to him o abraham

entries.a: قَدْ صَدَّقْتَ ٱلرُّءْيَآ ۚ إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
entries.t: You have fulfilled the vision." Thus We reward the doers of good.
entries.na: قد صدقت الريا انا كذلك نجزي المحسنين
entries.nt: you have fulfilled the vision thus we reward the doers of good

entries.a: إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَهُوَ ٱلْبَلَٰٓؤُا۟ ٱلْمُبِينُ
entries.t: This was certainly an evident test.
entries.na: ان هذا لهو البلوا المبين
entries.nt: this was certainly an evident test

entries.a: وَفَدَيْنَٰهُ بِذِبْحٍ عَظِيمٍۢ
entries.t: And We redeemed him with a great sacrifice.
entries.na: وفدينه بذبح عظيم
entries.nt: and we redeemed him with a great sacrifice

entries.a: وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ فِى ٱلْءَاخِرِينَ
entries.t: And We left with him for later generations.
entries.na: وتركنا عليه في الاخرين
entries.nt: and we left with him for later generations

entries.a: سَلَٰمٌ عَلَىٰٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ
entries.t: Peace be upon Abraham.
entries.na: سلم علي ابرهيم
entries.nt: peace be upon abraham

entries.a: كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
entries.t: Thus We reward the doers of good.
entries.na: كذلك نجزي المحسنين
entries.nt: thus we reward the doers of good

entries.a: إِنَّهُۥ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
entries.t: He was one of Our believing servants.
entries.na: انه من عبادنا المومنين
entries.nt: he was one of our believing servants

entries.a: وَبَشَّرْنَٰهُ بِإِسْحَٰقَ نَبِيًّۭا مِّنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
entries.t: And We gave him good news of Isaac, a prophet, one of the righteous.
entries.na: وبشرنه باسحق نبيا من الصلحين
entries.nt: and we gave him good news of isaac a prophet one of the righteous

entries.a: وَبَٰرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَىٰٓ إِسْحَٰقَ ۚ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِهِمَا مُحْسِنٌۭ وَظَالِمٌۭ لِّنَفْسِهِۦ مُبِينٌۭ
entries.t: And We blessed him, and Isaac. But among their descendants are some who are righteous, and some who are clearly unjust to themselves.
entries.na: وبركنا عليه وعلي اسحق ومن ذريتهما محسن وظالم لنفسه مبين
entries.nt: and we blessed him and isaac but among their descendants are some who are righteous and some who are clearly unjust to themselves

entries.a: وَلَقَدْ مَنَنَّا عَلَىٰ مُوسَىٰ وَهَٰرُونَ
entries.t: And We blessed Moses and Aaron.
entries.na: ولقد مننا علي موسي وهرون
entries.nt: and we blessed moses and aaron

entries.a: وَنَجَّيْنَٰهُمَا وَقَوْمَهُمَا مِنَ ٱلْكَرْبِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
entries.t: And We delivered them and their people from the terrible disaster.
entries.na: ونجينهما وقومهما من الكرب العظيم
entries.nt: and we delivered them and their people from the terrible disaster

entries.a: وَنَصَرْنَٰهُمْ فَكَانُوا۟ هُمُ ٱلْغَٰلِبِينَ
entries.t: And We supported them, and so they were the victors.
entries.na: ونصرنهم فكانوا هم الغلبين
entries.nt: and we supported them and so they were the victors

entries.a: وَءَاتَيْنَٰهُمَا ٱلْكِتَٰبَ ٱلْمُسْتَبِينَ
entries.t: And We gave them the Clarifying Scripture.
entries.na: واتينهما الكتب المستبين
entries.nt: and we gave them the clarifying scripture

entries.a: وَهَدَيْنَٰهُمَا ٱلصِّرَٰطَ ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمَ
entries.t: And We guided them upon the straight path.
entries.na: وهدينهما الصرط المستقيم
entries.nt: and we guided them upon the straight path

entries.a: وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِمَا فِى ٱلْءَاخِرِينَ
entries.t: And We left with them for later generations.
entries.na: وتركنا عليهما في الاخرين
entries.nt: and we left with them for later generations

entries.a: سَلَٰمٌ عَلَىٰ مُوسَىٰ وَهَٰرُونَ
entries.t: Peace be upon Moses and Aaron.
entries.na: سلم علي موسي وهرون
entries.nt: peace be upon moses and aaron

entries.a: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
entries.t: Thus We reward the righteous.
entries.na: انا كذلك نجزي المحسنين
entries.nt: thus we reward the righteous

entries.a: إِنَّهُمَا مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
entries.t: They were of Our believing servants.
entries.na: انهما من عبادنا المومنين
entries.nt: they were of our believing servants

entries.a: وَإِنَّ إِلْيَاسَ لَمِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
entries.t: Also Elijah was one of the messengers.
entries.na: وان الياس لمن المرسلين
entries.nt: also elijah was one of the messengers

entries.a: إِذْ قَالَ لِقَوْمِهِۦٓ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
entries.t: He said to his people, "Do you not fear?
entries.na: اذ قال لقومه الا تتقون
entries.nt: he said to his people do you not fear

entries.a: أَتَدْعُونَ بَعْلًۭا وَتَذَرُونَ أَحْسَنَ ٱلْخَٰلِقِينَ
entries.t: Do you call on Baal, and forsake the Best of creators?
entries.na: اتدعون بعلا وتذرون احسن الخلقين
entries.nt: do you call on baal and forsake the best of creators

entries.a: ٱللَّهَ رَبَّكُمْ وَرَبَّ ءَابَآئِكُمُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
entries.t: God is your Lord, and the Lord of your ancestors."
entries.na: الله ربكم ورب ابايكم الاولين
entries.nt: god is your lord and the lord of your ancestors

entries.a: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَإِنَّهُمْ لَمُحْضَرُونَ
entries.t: But they called him a liar, and thus they will be brought forward.
entries.na: فكذبوه فانهم لمحضرون
entries.nt: but they called him a liar and thus they will be brought forward

entries.a: إِلَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
entries.t: Except for God's sincere servants.
entries.na: الا عباد الله المخلصين
entries.nt: except for god s sincere servants

entries.a: وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ فِى ٱلْءَاخِرِينَ
entries.t: And We left with him for later generations.
entries.na: وتركنا عليه في الاخرين
entries.nt: and we left with him for later generations

entries.a: سَلَٰمٌ عَلَىٰٓ إِلْ يَاسِينَ
entries.t: Peace be upon the House of Elijah.
entries.na: سلم علي ال ياسين
entries.nt: peace be upon the house of elijah

entries.a: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
entries.t: Thus We reward the virtuous.
entries.na: انا كذلك نجزي المحسنين
entries.nt: thus we reward the virtuous

entries.a: إِنَّهُۥ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
entries.t: He was one of Our believing servants.
entries.na: انه من عبادنا المومنين
entries.nt: he was one of our believing servants

entries.a: وَإِنَّ لُوطًۭا لَّمِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
entries.t: And Lot was one of the messengers.
entries.na: وان لوطا لمن المرسلين
entries.nt: and lot was one of the messengers

entries.a: إِذْ نَجَّيْنَٰهُ وَأَهْلَهُۥٓ أَجْمَعِينَ
entries.t: We saved him and his family, all of them.
entries.na: اذ نجينه واهله اجمعين
entries.nt: we saved him and his family all of them

entries.a: إِلَّا عَجُوزًۭا فِى ٱلْغَٰبِرِينَ
entries.t: Except for an old woman who lagged behind.
entries.na: الا عجوزا في الغبرين
entries.nt: except for an old woman who lagged behind

entries.a: ثُمَّ دَمَّرْنَا ٱلْءَاخَرِينَ
entries.t: Then We annihilated the others.
entries.na: ثم دمرنا الاخرين
entries.nt: then we annihilated the others

entries.a: وَإِنَّكُمْ لَتَمُرُّونَ عَلَيْهِم مُّصْبِحِينَ
entries.t: You pass by them in the morning.
entries.na: وانكم لتمرون عليهم مصبحين
entries.nt: you pass by them in the morning

entries.a: وَبِٱلَّيْلِ ۗ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ
entries.t: And at night. Do you not understand?
entries.na: وباليل افلا تعقلون
entries.nt: and at night do you not understand

entries.a: وَإِنَّ يُونُسَ لَمِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
entries.t: And Jonah was one of the messengers.
entries.na: وان يونس لمن المرسلين
entries.nt: and jonah was one of the messengers

entries.a: إِذْ أَبَقَ إِلَى ٱلْفُلْكِ ٱلْمَشْحُونِ
entries.t: When he fled to the laden boat.
entries.na: اذ ابق الي الفلك المشحون
entries.nt: when he fled to the laden boat

entries.a: فَسَاهَمَ فَكَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُدْحَضِينَ
entries.t: He gambled and lost.
entries.na: فساهم فكان من المدحضين
entries.nt: he gambled and lost

entries.a: فَٱلْتَقَمَهُ ٱلْحُوتُ وَهُوَ مُلِيمٌۭ
entries.t: Then the fish swallowed him, and he was to blame.
entries.na: فالتقمه الحوت وهو مليم
entries.nt: then the fish swallowed him and he was to blame

entries.a: فَلَوْلَآ أَنَّهُۥ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُسَبِّحِينَ
entries.t: Had he not been one of those who praised.
entries.na: فلولا انه كان من المسبحين
entries.nt: had he not been one of those who praised

entries.a: لَلَبِثَ فِى بَطْنِهِۦٓ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ
entries.t: He would have stayed in its belly until the Day they are raised.
entries.na: للبث في بطنه الي يوم يبعثون
entries.nt: he would have stayed in its belly until the day they are raised

entries.a: ۞ فَنَبَذْنَٰهُ بِٱلْعَرَآءِ وَهُوَ سَقِيمٌۭ
entries.t: Then We threw him into the wilderness, and he was sick.
entries.na: فنبذنه بالعرا وهو سقيم
entries.nt: then we threw him into the wilderness and he was sick

entries.a: وَأَنۢبَتْنَا عَلَيْهِ شَجَرَةًۭ مِّن يَقْطِينٍۢ
entries.t: And We made a gourd tree grow over him.
entries.na: وانبتنا عليه شجره من يقطين
entries.nt: and we made a gourd tree grow over him

entries.a: وَأَرْسَلْنَٰهُ إِلَىٰ مِا۟ئَةِ أَلْفٍ أَوْ يَزِيدُونَ
entries.t: Then We sent him to a hundred thousand, or more.
entries.na: وارسلنه الي مايه الف او يزيدون
entries.nt: then we sent him to a hundred thousand or more

entries.a: فَـَٔامَنُوا۟ فَمَتَّعْنَٰهُمْ إِلَىٰ حِينٍۢ
entries.t: And they believed, so We gave them enjoyment for a while.
entries.na: فامنوا فمتعنهم الي حين
entries.nt: and they believed so we gave them enjoyment for a while

entries.a: فَٱسْتَفْتِهِمْ أَلِرَبِّكَ ٱلْبَنَاتُ وَلَهُمُ ٱلْبَنُونَ
entries.t: Ask them, "Are the daughters for your Lord, while for them the sons?"
entries.na: فاستفتهم الربك البنات ولهم البنون
entries.nt: ask them are the daughters for your lord while for them the sons

entries.a: أَمْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ إِنَٰثًۭا وَهُمْ شَٰهِدُونَ
entries.t: Or did We create the angels females, as they witnessed?"
entries.na: ام خلقنا المليكه انثا وهم شهدون
entries.nt: or did we create the angels females as they witnessed

entries.a: أَلَآ إِنَّهُم مِّنْ إِفْكِهِمْ لَيَقُولُونَ
entries.t: No indeed! It is one of their lies when they say.
entries.na: الا انهم من افكهم ليقولون
entries.nt: no indeed it is one of their lies when they say

entries.a: وَلَدَ ٱللَّهُ وَإِنَّهُمْ لَكَٰذِبُونَ
entries.t: "God has begotten." They are indeed lying.
entries.na: ولد الله وانهم لكذبون
entries.nt: god has begotten they are indeed lying

entries.a: أَصْطَفَى ٱلْبَنَاتِ عَلَى ٱلْبَنِينَ
entries.t: So He preferred girls over boys?
entries.na: اصطفي البنات علي البنين
entries.nt: so he preferred girls over boys

entries.a: مَا لَكُمْ كَيْفَ تَحْكُمُونَ
entries.t: What is the matter with you? How do you judge?
entries.na: ما لكم كيف تحكمون
entries.nt: what is the matter with you how do you judge

entries.a: أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ
entries.t: Will you not reflect?
entries.na: افلا تذكرون
entries.nt: will you not reflect

entries.a: أَمْ لَكُمْ سُلْطَٰنٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
entries.t: Or do you have some clear proof?
entries.na: ام لكم سلطن مبين
entries.nt: or do you have some clear proof

entries.a: فَأْتُوا۟ بِكِتَٰبِكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ
entries.t: Then bring your book, if you are telling the truth.
entries.na: فاتوا بكتبكم ان كنتم صدقين
entries.nt: then bring your book if you are telling the truth

entries.a: وَجَعَلُوا۟ بَيْنَهُۥ وَبَيْنَ ٱلْجِنَّةِ نَسَبًۭا ۚ وَلَقَدْ عَلِمَتِ ٱلْجِنَّةُ إِنَّهُمْ لَمُحْضَرُونَ
entries.t: And they invented a relationship between Him and the jinn. But the jinn know that they will be arraigned.
entries.na: وجعلوا بينه وبين الجنه نسبا ولقد علمت الجنه انهم لمحضرون
entries.nt: and they invented a relationship between him and the jinn but the jinn know that they will be arraigned

entries.a: سُبْحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
entries.t: God be glorified, far above what they allege.
entries.na: سبحن الله عما يصفون
entries.nt: god be glorified far above what they allege

entries.a: إِلَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
entries.t: Except for God's sincere servants.
entries.na: الا عباد الله المخلصين
entries.nt: except for god s sincere servants

entries.a: فَإِنَّكُمْ وَمَا تَعْبُدُونَ
entries.t: Surely, you and what you serve.
entries.na: فانكم وما تعبدون
entries.nt: surely you and what you serve

entries.a: مَآ أَنتُمْ عَلَيْهِ بِفَٰتِنِينَ
entries.t: Cannot seduce away from Him.
entries.na: ما انتم عليه بفتنين
entries.nt: cannot seduce away from him

entries.a: إِلَّا مَنْ هُوَ صَالِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
entries.t: Except for he who will be roasting in Hell.
entries.na: الا من هو صال الجحيم
entries.nt: except for he who will be roasting in hell

entries.a: وَمَا مِنَّآ إِلَّا لَهُۥ مَقَامٌۭ مَّعْلُومٌۭ
entries.t: "There is not one of us but has an assigned position.
entries.na: وما منا الا له مقام معلوم
entries.nt: there is not one of us but has an assigned position

entries.a: وَإِنَّا لَنَحْنُ ٱلصَّآفُّونَ
entries.t: And we are the arrangers.
entries.na: وانا لنحن الصافون
entries.nt: and we are the arrangers

entries.a: وَإِنَّا لَنَحْنُ ٱلْمُسَبِّحُونَ
entries.t: And we are the glorifiers."
entries.na: وانا لنحن المسبحون
entries.nt: and we are the glorifiers

entries.a: وَإِن كَانُوا۟ لَيَقُولُونَ
entries.t: Even though they used to say.
entries.na: وان كانوا ليقولون
entries.nt: even though they used to say

entries.a: لَوْ أَنَّ عِندَنَا ذِكْرًۭا مِّنَ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
entries.t: "Had we received advice from the ancients.
entries.na: لو ان عندنا ذكرا من الاولين
entries.nt: had we received advice from the ancients

entries.a: لَكُنَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
entries.t: We would have been God's faithful servants."
entries.na: لكنا عباد الله المخلصين
entries.nt: we would have been god s faithful servants

entries.a: فَكَفَرُوا۟ بِهِۦ ۖ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ
entries.t: But they rejected it, so they will find out.
entries.na: فكفروا به فسوف يعلمون
entries.nt: but they rejected it so they will find out

entries.a: وَلَقَدْ سَبَقَتْ كَلِمَتُنَا لِعِبَادِنَا ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
entries.t: Our Word has already gone out to our servant messengers.
entries.na: ولقد سبقت كلمتنا لعبادنا المرسلين
entries.nt: our word has already gone out to our servant messengers

entries.a: إِنَّهُمْ لَهُمُ ٱلْمَنصُورُونَ
entries.t: It is they who will be supported.
entries.na: انهم لهم المنصورون
entries.nt: it is they who will be supported

entries.a: وَإِنَّ جُندَنَا لَهُمُ ٱلْغَٰلِبُونَ
entries.t: And Our troops will be the victors.
entries.na: وان جندنا لهم الغلبون
entries.nt: and our troops will be the victors

entries.a: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍۢ
entries.t: So disregard them for a while.
entries.na: فتول عنهم حتي حين
entries.nt: so disregard them for a while

entries.a: وَأَبْصِرْهُمْ فَسَوْفَ يُبْصِرُونَ
entries.t: And watch them-they will soon see.
entries.na: وابصرهم فسوف يبصرون
entries.nt: and watch them they will soon see

entries.a: أَفَبِعَذَابِنَا يَسْتَعْجِلُونَ
entries.t: Are they seeking to hasten Our punishment?
entries.na: افبعذابنا يستعجلون
entries.nt: are they seeking to hasten our punishment

entries.a: فَإِذَا نَزَلَ بِسَاحَتِهِمْ فَسَآءَ صَبَاحُ ٱلْمُنذَرِينَ
entries.t: When it descends into their yard, miserable will be the morning of those forewarned.
entries.na: فاذا نزل بساحتهم فسا صباح المنذرين
entries.nt: when it descends into their yard miserable will be the morning of those forewarned

entries.a: وَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍۢ
entries.t: So avoid them for a while.
entries.na: وتول عنهم حتي حين
entries.nt: so avoid them for a while

entries.a: وَأَبْصِرْ فَسَوْفَ يُبْصِرُونَ
entries.t: And watch-they will soon see.
entries.na: وابصر فسوف يبصرون
entries.nt: and watch they will soon see

entries.a: سُبْحَٰنَ رَبِّكَ رَبِّ ٱلْعِزَّةِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
entries.t: Exalted be your Lord, the Lord of Glory, beyond their allegations.
entries.na: سبحن ربك رب العزه عما يصفون
entries.nt: exalted be your lord the lord of glory beyond their allegations

entries.a: وَسَلَٰمٌ عَلَى ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
entries.t: And peace be upon the messengers.
entries.na: وسلم علي المرسلين
entries.nt: and peace be upon the messengers

entries.a: وَٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
entries.t: And praise be to God, the Lord of the Worlds.
entries.na: والحمد لله رب العلمين
entries.nt: and praise be to god the lord of the worlds

entries.a: صٓ ۚ وَٱلْقُرْءَانِ ذِى ٱلذِّكْرِ
entries.t: Saad. By the renowned Quran.
entries.na: ص والقران ذي الذكر
entries.nt: saad by the renowned quran

entries.a: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فِى عِزَّةٍۢ وَشِقَاقٍۢ
entries.t: Those who disbelieve are steeped in arrogance and defiance.
entries.na: بل الذين كفروا في عزه وشقاق
entries.nt: those who disbelieve are steeped in arrogance and defiance

entries.a: كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّن قَرْنٍۢ فَنَادَوا۟ وَّلَاتَ حِينَ مَنَاصٍۢ
entries.t: How many generations have We destroyed before them? They cried out when it was too late to escape.
entries.na: كم اهلكنا من قبلهم من قرن فنادوا ولات حين مناص
entries.nt: how many generations have we destroyed before them they cried out when it was too late to escape

entries.a: وَعَجِبُوٓا۟ أَن جَآءَهُم مُّنذِرٌۭ مِّنْهُمْ ۖ وَقَالَ ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ هَٰذَا سَٰحِرٌۭ كَذَّابٌ
entries.t: And they marveled that a warner has come to them from among them. The disbelievers said, "This is a lying magician."
entries.na: وعجبوا ان جاهم منذر منهم وقال الكفرون هذا سحر كذاب
entries.nt: and they marveled that a warner has come to them from among them the disbelievers said this is a lying magician

entries.a: أَجَعَلَ ٱلْءَالِهَةَ إِلَٰهًۭا وَٰحِدًا ۖ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَشَىْءٌ عُجَابٌۭ
entries.t: "Did he turn all the gods into one God? This is something strange."
entries.na: اجعل الالهه الها وحدا ان هذا لشي عجاب
entries.nt: did he turn all the gods into one god this is something strange

entries.a: وَٱنطَلَقَ ٱلْمَلَأُ مِنْهُمْ أَنِ ٱمْشُوا۟ وَٱصْبِرُوا۟ عَلَىٰٓ ءَالِهَتِكُمْ ۖ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَشَىْءٌۭ يُرَادُ
entries.t: The notables among them announced: "Go on, and hold fast to your gods. This is something planned.
entries.na: وانطلق الملا منهم ان امشوا واصبروا علي الهتكم ان هذا لشي يراد
entries.nt: the notables among them announced go on and hold fast to your gods this is something planned

entries.a: مَا سَمِعْنَا بِهَٰذَا فِى ٱلْمِلَّةِ ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ إِنْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا ٱخْتِلَٰقٌ
entries.t: We never heard of this in the former faith. This is nothing but a fabrication.
entries.na: ما سمعنا بهذا في المله الاخره ان هذا الا اختلق
entries.nt: we never heard of this in the former faith this is nothing but a fabrication

entries.a: أَءُنزِلَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلذِّكْرُ مِنۢ بَيْنِنَا ۚ بَلْ هُمْ فِى شَكٍّۢ مِّن ذِكْرِى ۖ بَل لَّمَّا يَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِ
entries.t: Was the message sent down to him, out of all of us?" In fact, they are doubtful of My warning. In fact, they have not yet tasted My punishment.
entries.na: انزل عليه الذكر من بيننا بل هم في شك من ذكري بل لما يذوقوا عذاب
entries.nt: was the message sent down to him out of all of us in fact they are doubtful of my warning in fact they have not yet tasted my punishment

entries.a: أَمْ عِندَهُمْ خَزَآئِنُ رَحْمَةِ رَبِّكَ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْوَهَّابِ
entries.t: Or do they possess the treasuries of the mercy of your Lord-the Majestic, the Giver?
entries.na: ام عندهم خزاين رحمه ربك العزيز الوهاب
entries.nt: or do they possess the treasuries of the mercy of your lord the majestic the giver

entries.a: أَمْ لَهُم مُّلْكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ۖ فَلْيَرْتَقُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَسْبَٰبِ
entries.t: Or do they possess the sovereignty of the heavens and the earth and what is between them? Then let them ascend the ropes.
entries.na: ام لهم ملك السموت والارض وما بينهما فليرتقوا في الاسبب
entries.nt: or do they possess the sovereignty of the heavens and the earth and what is between them then let them ascend the ropes

entries.a: جُندٌۭ مَّا هُنَالِكَ مَهْزُومٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلْأَحْزَابِ
entries.t: An army of confederates with be defeated there.
entries.na: جند ما هنالك مهزوم من الاحزاب
entries.nt: an army of confederates with be defeated there

entries.a: كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍۢ وَعَادٌۭ وَفِرْعَوْنُ ذُو ٱلْأَوْتَادِ
entries.t: Before them the people of Noah denied the truth; as did Aad, and Pharaoh of the Stakes.
entries.na: كذبت قبلهم قوم نوح وعاد وفرعون ذو الاوتاد
entries.nt: before them the people of noah denied the truth as did aad and pharaoh of the stakes

entries.a: وَثَمُودُ وَقَوْمُ لُوطٍۢ وَأَصْحَٰبُ لْـَٔيْكَةِ ۚ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلْأَحْزَابُ
entries.t: And Thamood, and the people of Lot, and the dwellers of the Woods-these were the confederates.
entries.na: وثمود وقوم لوط واصحب ليكه اوليك الاحزاب
entries.nt: and thamood and the people of lot and the dwellers of the woods these were the confederates

entries.a: إِن كُلٌّ إِلَّا كَذَّبَ ٱلرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ عِقَابِ
entries.t: None of them but denied the messengers, so My retribution was deserved.
entries.na: ان كل الا كذب الرسل فحق عقاب
entries.nt: none of them but denied the messengers so my retribution was deserved

entries.a: وَمَا يَنظُرُ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ إِلَّا صَيْحَةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ مَّا لَهَا مِن فَوَاقٍۢ
entries.t: These can expect only a single scream, from which there is no recovery.
entries.na: وما ينظر هولا الا صيحه وحده ما لها من فواق
entries.nt: these can expect only a single scream from which there is no recovery

entries.a: وَقَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَا عَجِّل لَّنَا قِطَّنَا قَبْلَ يَوْمِ ٱلْحِسَابِ
entries.t: And they say, "Our Lord, hasten Your writ upon us, before the Day of Account."
entries.na: وقالوا ربنا عجل لنا قطنا قبل يوم الحساب
entries.nt: and they say our lord hasten your writ upon us before the day of account

entries.a: ٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَٱذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَا دَاوُۥدَ ذَا ٱلْأَيْدِ ۖ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ
entries.t: Be patient in the face of what they say, and mention Our servant David, the resourceful. He was obedient.
entries.na: اصبر علي ما يقولون واذكر عبدنا داود ذا الايد انه اواب
entries.nt: be patient in the face of what they say and mention our servant david the resourceful he was obedient

entries.a: إِنَّا سَخَّرْنَا ٱلْجِبَالَ مَعَهُۥ يُسَبِّحْنَ بِٱلْعَشِىِّ وَٱلْإِشْرَاقِ
entries.t: We committed the mountains to glorify with him, in the evening and at daybreak.
entries.na: انا سخرنا الجبال معه يسبحن بالعشي والاشراق
entries.nt: we committed the mountains to glorify with him in the evening and at daybreak

entries.a: وَٱلطَّيْرَ مَحْشُورَةًۭ ۖ كُلٌّۭ لَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌۭ
entries.t: And the birds, gathered together. All obedient to him.
entries.na: والطير محشوره كل له اواب
entries.nt: and the birds gathered together all obedient to him

entries.a: وَشَدَدْنَا مُلْكَهُۥ وَءَاتَيْنَٰهُ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ وَفَصْلَ ٱلْخِطَابِ
entries.t: And We strengthened his kingdom, and gave him wisdom and decisive speech.
entries.na: وشددنا ملكه واتينه الحكمه وفصل الخطاب
entries.nt: and we strengthened his kingdom and gave him wisdom and decisive speech

entries.a: ۞ وَهَلْ أَتَىٰكَ نَبَؤُا۟ ٱلْخَصْمِ إِذْ تَسَوَّرُوا۟ ٱلْمِحْرَابَ
entries.t: Has the story of the two disputants reached you? When they scaled the sanctuary?
entries.na: وهل اتيك نبوا الخصم اذ تسوروا المحراب
entries.nt: has the story of the two disputants reached you when they scaled the sanctuary

entries.a: إِذْ دَخَلُوا۟ عَلَىٰ دَاوُۥدَ فَفَزِعَ مِنْهُمْ ۖ قَالُوا۟ لَا تَخَفْ ۖ خَصْمَانِ بَغَىٰ بَعْضُنَا عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍۢ فَٱحْكُم بَيْنَنَا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَا تُشْطِطْ وَٱهْدِنَآ إِلَىٰ سَوَآءِ ٱلصِّرَٰطِ
entries.t: When they entered upon David, and he was startled by them. They said, "Do not fear. Two disputants; one of us has wronged the other; so judge between us fairly, and do not be biased, and guide us to the straight way."
entries.na: اذ دخلوا علي داود ففزع منهم قالوا لا تخف خصمان بغي بعضنا علي بعض فاحكم بيننا بالحق ولا تشطط واهدنا الي سوا الصرط
entries.nt: when they entered upon david and he was startled by them they said do not fear two disputants one of us has wronged the other so judge between us fairly and do not be biased and guide us to the straight way

entries.a: إِنَّ هَٰذَآ أَخِى لَهُۥ تِسْعٌۭ وَتِسْعُونَ نَعْجَةًۭ وَلِىَ نَعْجَةٌۭ وَٰحِدَةٌۭ فَقَالَ أَكْفِلْنِيهَا وَعَزَّنِى فِى ٱلْخِطَابِ
entries.t: "This brother of mine has ninety nine ewes, and I have one ewe, and he said, 'Entrust it to me,' and he pressured me with words."
entries.na: ان هذا اخي له تسع وتسعون نعجه ولي نعجه وحده فقال اكفلنيها وعزني في الخطاب
entries.nt: this brother of mine has ninety nine ewes and i have one ewe and he said entrust it to me and he pressured me with words

entries.a: قَالَ لَقَدْ ظَلَمَكَ بِسُؤَالِ نَعْجَتِكَ إِلَىٰ نِعَاجِهِۦ ۖ وَإِنَّ كَثِيرًۭا مِّنَ ٱلْخُلَطَآءِ لَيَبْغِى بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَقَلِيلٌۭ مَّا هُمْ ۗ وَظَنَّ دَاوُۥدُ أَنَّمَا فَتَنَّٰهُ فَٱسْتَغْفَرَ رَبَّهُۥ وَخَرَّ رَاكِعًۭا وَأَنَابَ ۩
entries.t: He said, "He has done you wrong by asking your ewe in addition to his ewes. Many partners take advantage of one another, except those who believe and do good deeds, but these are so few." David realized that We were testing him, so he sought forgiveness from his Lord, and fell down to his knees, and repented.
entries.na: قال لقد ظلمك بسوال نعجتك الي نعاجه وان كثيرا من الخلطا ليبغي بعضهم علي بعض الا الذين امنوا وعملوا الصلحت وقليل ما هم وظن داود انما فتنه فاستغفر ربه وخر راكعا واناب
entries.nt: he said he has done you wrong by asking your ewe in addition to his ewes many partners take advantage of one another except those who believe and do good deeds but these are so few david realized that we were testing him so he sought forgiveness from his lord and fell down to his knees and repented

entries.a: فَغَفَرْنَا لَهُۥ ذَٰلِكَ ۖ وَإِنَّ لَهُۥ عِندَنَا لَزُلْفَىٰ وَحُسْنَ مَـَٔابٍۢ
entries.t: So We forgave him that. And for him is nearness to Us, and a good place of return.
entries.na: فغفرنا له ذلك وان له عندنا لزلفي وحسن ماب
entries.nt: so we forgave him that and for him is nearness to us and a good place of return

entries.a: يَٰدَاوُۥدُ إِنَّا جَعَلْنَٰكَ خَلِيفَةًۭ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَٱحْكُم بَيْنَ ٱلنَّاسِ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَا تَتَّبِعِ ٱلْهَوَىٰ فَيُضِلَّكَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَضِلُّونَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌۭ شَدِيدٌۢ بِمَا نَسُوا۟ يَوْمَ ٱلْحِسَابِ
entries.t: "O David, We made you a ruler in the land, so judge between the people with justice, and do not follow desire, lest it diverts you from God's path. Those who stray from God's path will have a painful punishment, for having ignored the Day of Account."
entries.na: يداود انا جعلنك خليفه في الارض فاحكم بين الناس بالحق ولا تتبع الهوي فيضلك عن سبيل الله ان الذين يضلون عن سبيل الله لهم عذاب شديد بما نسوا يوم الحساب
entries.nt: o david we made you a ruler in the land so judge between the people with justice and do not follow desire lest it diverts you from god s path those who stray from god s path will have a painful punishment for having ignored the day of account

entries.a: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا بَٰطِلًۭا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ظَنُّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ۚ فَوَيْلٌۭ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلنَّارِ
entries.t: We did not create the heaven and the earth and everything between them in vain. That is the assumption of those who disbelieve-so woe to those who disbelieve because of the Fire.
entries.na: وما خلقنا السما والارض وما بينهما بطلا ذلك ظن الذين كفروا فويل للذين كفروا من النار
entries.nt: we did not create the heaven and the earth and everything between them in vain that is the assumption of those who disbelieve so woe to those who disbelieve because of the fire

entries.a: أَمْ نَجْعَلُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ كَٱلْمُفْسِدِينَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ أَمْ نَجْعَلُ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ كَٱلْفُجَّارِ
entries.t: Or are We to treat those who believe and do righteous deeds like those who make trouble on earth? Or are We to treat the pious like the shameless?
entries.na: ام نجعل الذين امنوا وعملوا الصلحت كالمفسدين في الارض ام نجعل المتقين كالفجار
entries.nt: or are we to treat those who believe and do righteous deeds like those who make trouble on earth or are we to treat the pious like the shameless

entries.a: كِتَٰبٌ أَنزَلْنَٰهُ إِلَيْكَ مُبَٰرَكٌۭ لِّيَدَّبَّرُوٓا۟ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ وَلِيَتَذَكَّرَ أُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْأَلْبَٰبِ
entries.t: A blessed Book that We sent down to you, that they may ponder its Verses, and for those with intelligence to take heed.
entries.na: كتب انزلنه اليك مبرك ليدبروا ايته وليتذكر اولوا الالبب
entries.nt: a blessed book that we sent down to you that they may ponder its verses and for those with intelligence to take heed

entries.a: وَوَهَبْنَا لِدَاوُۥدَ سُلَيْمَٰنَ ۚ نِعْمَ ٱلْعَبْدُ ۖ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ
entries.t: And We granted David, Solomon, an excellent servant. He was penitent.
entries.na: ووهبنا لداود سليمن نعم العبد انه اواب
entries.nt: and we granted david solomon an excellent servant he was penitent

entries.a: إِذْ عُرِضَ عَلَيْهِ بِٱلْعَشِىِّ ٱلصَّٰفِنَٰتُ ٱلْجِيَادُ
entries.t: When the beautiful horses were paraded before him in the evening.
entries.na: اذ عرض عليه بالعشي الصفنت الجياد
entries.nt: when the beautiful horses were paraded before him in the evening

entries.a: فَقَالَ إِنِّىٓ أَحْبَبْتُ حُبَّ ٱلْخَيْرِ عَن ذِكْرِ رَبِّى حَتَّىٰ تَوَارَتْ بِٱلْحِجَابِ
entries.t: He said, "I have preferred the love of niceties to the remembrance of my Lord-until it disappeared behind the veil.
entries.na: فقال اني احببت حب الخير عن ذكر ربي حتي توارت بالحجاب
entries.nt: he said i have preferred the love of niceties to the remembrance of my lord until it disappeared behind the veil

entries.a: رُدُّوهَا عَلَىَّ ۖ فَطَفِقَ مَسْحًۢا بِٱلسُّوقِ وَٱلْأَعْنَاقِ
entries.t: Bring them back to me." And he began caressing their legs and necks.
entries.na: ردوها علي فطفق مسحا بالسوق والاعناق
entries.nt: bring them back to me and he began caressing their legs and necks

entries.a: وَلَقَدْ فَتَنَّا سُلَيْمَٰنَ وَأَلْقَيْنَا عَلَىٰ كُرْسِيِّهِۦ جَسَدًۭا ثُمَّ أَنَابَ
entries.t: We tested Solomon, and placed a body on his throne; then he repented.
entries.na: ولقد فتنا سليمن والقينا علي كرسيه جسدا ثم اناب
entries.nt: we tested solomon and placed a body on his throne then he repented

entries.a: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱغْفِرْ لِى وَهَبْ لِى مُلْكًۭا لَّا يَنۢبَغِى لِأَحَدٍۢ مِّنۢ بَعْدِىٓ ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْوَهَّابُ
entries.t: He said, "My Lord, forgive me, and grant me a kingdom never to be attained by anyone after me. You are the Giver."
entries.na: قال رب اغفر لي وهب لي ملكا لا ينبغي لاحد من بعدي انك انت الوهاب
entries.nt: he said my lord forgive me and grant me a kingdom never to be attained by anyone after me you are the giver

entries.a: فَسَخَّرْنَا لَهُ ٱلرِّيحَ تَجْرِى بِأَمْرِهِۦ رُخَآءً حَيْثُ أَصَابَ
entries.t: So We placed the wind at his service, blowing gently by his command, wherever he directed.
entries.na: فسخرنا له الريح تجري بامره رخا حيث اصاب
entries.nt: so we placed the wind at his service blowing gently by his command wherever he directed

entries.a: وَٱلشَّيَٰطِينَ كُلَّ بَنَّآءٍۢ وَغَوَّاصٍۢ
entries.t: And the demons-every builder and diver.
entries.na: والشيطين كل بنا وغواص
entries.nt: and the demons every builder and diver

entries.a: وَءَاخَرِينَ مُقَرَّنِينَ فِى ٱلْأَصْفَادِ
entries.t: And others fettered in chains.
entries.na: واخرين مقرنين في الاصفاد
entries.nt: and others fettered in chains

entries.a: هَٰذَا عَطَآؤُنَا فَٱمْنُنْ أَوْ أَمْسِكْ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍۢ
entries.t: "This is Our gift; so give generously, or withhold; without account."
entries.na: هذا عطاونا فامنن او امسك بغير حساب
entries.nt: this is our gift so give generously or withhold without account

entries.a: وَإِنَّ لَهُۥ عِندَنَا لَزُلْفَىٰ وَحُسْنَ مَـَٔابٍۢ
entries.t: For him is nearness to Us, and a beautiful resort.
entries.na: وان له عندنا لزلفي وحسن ماب
entries.nt: for him is nearness to us and a beautiful resort

entries.a: وَٱذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَآ أَيُّوبَ إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَسَّنِىَ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ بِنُصْبٍۢ وَعَذَابٍ
entries.t: And mention Our servant Job, when he called out to his Lord, "Satan has afflicted me with hardship and pain."
entries.na: واذكر عبدنا ايوب اذ نادي ربه اني مسني الشيطن بنصب وعذاب
entries.nt: and mention our servant job when he called out to his lord satan has afflicted me with hardship and pain

entries.a: ٱرْكُضْ بِرِجْلِكَ ۖ هَٰذَا مُغْتَسَلٌۢ بَارِدٌۭ وَشَرَابٌۭ
entries.t: "Stamp with your foot-here is cool water to wash with, and to drink."
entries.na: اركض برجلك هذا مغتسل بارد وشراب
entries.nt: stamp with your foot here is cool water to wash with and to drink

entries.a: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُۥٓ أَهْلَهُۥ وَمِثْلَهُم مَّعَهُمْ رَحْمَةًۭ مِّنَّا وَذِكْرَىٰ لِأُو۟لِى ٱلْأَلْبَٰبِ
entries.t: And We restored his family for him, and their like with them; as a mercy from Us, and a lesson for those who possess insight.
entries.na: ووهبنا له اهله ومثلهم معهم رحمه منا وذكري لاولي الالبب
entries.nt: and we restored his family for him and their like with them as a mercy from us and a lesson for those who possess insight

entries.a: وَخُذْ بِيَدِكَ ضِغْثًۭا فَٱضْرِب بِّهِۦ وَلَا تَحْنَثْ ۗ إِنَّا وَجَدْنَٰهُ صَابِرًۭا ۚ نِّعْمَ ٱلْعَبْدُ ۖ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌۭ
entries.t: "Take with your hand a bundle, and strike with it, and do not break your oath." We found him patient. What an excellent servant! He was obedient.
entries.na: وخذ بيدك ضغثا فاضرب به ولا تحنث انا وجدنه صابرا نعم العبد انه اواب
entries.nt: take with your hand a bundle and strike with it and do not break your oath we found him patient what an excellent servant he was obedient

entries.a: وَٱذْكُرْ عِبَٰدَنَآ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَإِسْحَٰقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ أُو۟لِى ٱلْأَيْدِى وَٱلْأَبْصَٰرِ
entries.t: And mention Our servants Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob-endowed with ability and vision.
entries.na: واذكر عبدنا ابرهيم واسحق ويعقوب اولي الايدي والابصر
entries.nt: and mention our servants abraham isaac and jacob endowed with ability and vision

entries.a: إِنَّآ أَخْلَصْنَٰهُم بِخَالِصَةٍۢ ذِكْرَى ٱلدَّارِ
entries.t: We distinguished them with a distinct quality: the remembrance of the Home.
entries.na: انا اخلصنهم بخالصه ذكري الدار
entries.nt: we distinguished them with a distinct quality the remembrance of the home

entries.a: وَإِنَّهُمْ عِندَنَا لَمِنَ ٱلْمُصْطَفَيْنَ ٱلْأَخْيَارِ
entries.t: To Us they are among the chosen, the outstanding.
entries.na: وانهم عندنا لمن المصطفين الاخيار
entries.nt: to us they are among the chosen the outstanding

entries.a: وَٱذْكُرْ إِسْمَٰعِيلَ وَٱلْيَسَعَ وَذَا ٱلْكِفْلِ ۖ وَكُلٌّۭ مِّنَ ٱلْأَخْيَارِ
entries.t: And mention Ishmael, Elisha, and Ezekiel; all are among the outstanding.
entries.na: واذكر اسمعيل واليسع وذا الكفل وكل من الاخيار
entries.nt: and mention ishmael elisha and ezekiel all are among the outstanding

entries.a: هَٰذَا ذِكْرٌۭ ۚ وَإِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ لَحُسْنَ مَـَٔابٍۢ
entries.t: This is a reminder. The devout will have a good place of return.
entries.na: هذا ذكر وان للمتقين لحسن ماب
entries.nt: this is a reminder the devout will have a good place of return

entries.a: جَنَّٰتِ عَدْنٍۢ مُّفَتَّحَةًۭ لَّهُمُ ٱلْأَبْوَٰبُ
entries.t: The Gardens of Eden, with their doors wide-open for them.
entries.na: جنت عدن مفتحه لهم الابوب
entries.nt: the gardens of eden with their doors wide open for them

entries.a: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ فِيهَا يَدْعُونَ فِيهَا بِفَٰكِهَةٍۢ كَثِيرَةٍۢ وَشَرَابٍۢ
entries.t: Relaxing therein, and calling for abundant fruit and beverage.
entries.na: متكين فيها يدعون فيها بفكهه كثيره وشراب
entries.nt: relaxing therein and calling for abundant fruit and beverage

entries.a: ۞ وَعِندَهُمْ قَٰصِرَٰتُ ٱلطَّرْفِ أَتْرَابٌ
entries.t: With them will be attendants with modest gaze, of same age.
entries.na: وعندهم قصرت الطرف اتراب
entries.nt: with them will be attendants with modest gaze of same age

entries.a: هَٰذَا مَا تُوعَدُونَ لِيَوْمِ ٱلْحِسَابِ
entries.t: This is what you are promised for the Day of Account.
entries.na: هذا ما توعدون ليوم الحساب
entries.nt: this is what you are promised for the day of account

entries.a: إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَرِزْقُنَا مَا لَهُۥ مِن نَّفَادٍ
entries.t: Such is Our bounty, inexhaustible.
entries.na: ان هذا لرزقنا ما له من نفاد
entries.nt: such is our bounty inexhaustible

entries.a: هَٰذَا ۚ وَإِنَّ لِلطَّٰغِينَ لَشَرَّ مَـَٔابٍۢ
entries.t: All This. But the transgressors will have a miserable return.
entries.na: هذا وان للطغين لشر ماب
entries.nt: all this but the transgressors will have a miserable return

entries.a: جَهَنَّمَ يَصْلَوْنَهَا فَبِئْسَ ٱلْمِهَادُ
entries.t: Hell; in which they will roast; what a miserable abode!
entries.na: جهنم يصلونها فبيس المهاد
entries.nt: hell in which they will roast what a miserable abode

entries.a: هَٰذَا فَلْيَذُوقُوهُ حَمِيمٌۭ وَغَسَّاقٌۭ
entries.t: All this. Let them taste it-boiling and bitter cold.
entries.na: هذا فليذوقوه حميم وغساق
entries.nt: all this let them taste it boiling and bitter cold

entries.a: وَءَاخَرُ مِن شَكْلِهِۦٓ أَزْوَٰجٌ
entries.t: And similar torments of diverse kinds.
entries.na: واخر من شكله ازوج
entries.nt: and similar torments of diverse kinds

entries.a: هَٰذَا فَوْجٌۭ مُّقْتَحِمٌۭ مَّعَكُمْ ۖ لَا مَرْحَبًۢا بِهِمْ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ صَالُوا۟ ٱلنَّارِ
entries.t: "This is a crowd rushing headlong with you." There is no welcome for them. They will be scorched by the Fire.
entries.na: هذا فوج مقتحم معكم لا مرحبا بهم انهم صالوا النار
entries.nt: this is a crowd rushing headlong with you there is no welcome for them they will be scorched by the fire

entries.a: قَالُوا۟ بَلْ أَنتُمْ لَا مَرْحَبًۢا بِكُمْ ۖ أَنتُمْ قَدَّمْتُمُوهُ لَنَا ۖ فَبِئْسَ ٱلْقَرَارُ
entries.t: They will say, "But it is you! There is no welcome for you! It is you who brought it upon us! What a miserable end!"
entries.na: قالوا بل انتم لا مرحبا بكم انتم قدمتموه لنا فبيس القرار
entries.nt: they will say but it is you there is no welcome for you it is you who brought it upon us what a miserable end

entries.a: قَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَا مَن قَدَّمَ لَنَا هَٰذَا فَزِدْهُ عَذَابًۭا ضِعْفًۭا فِى ٱلنَّارِ
entries.t: They will say, "Our Lord, whoever brought this upon us, give him double torment in the Fire."
entries.na: قالوا ربنا من قدم لنا هذا فزده عذابا ضعفا في النار
entries.nt: they will say our lord whoever brought this upon us give him double torment in the fire

entries.a: وَقَالُوا۟ مَا لَنَا لَا نَرَىٰ رِجَالًۭا كُنَّا نَعُدُّهُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَشْرَارِ
entries.t: And they will say, "What is it with us that we do not see men we used to count among the wicked?
entries.na: وقالوا ما لنا لا نري رجالا كنا نعدهم من الاشرار
entries.nt: and they will say what is it with us that we do not see men we used to count among the wicked

entries.a: أَتَّخَذْنَٰهُمْ سِخْرِيًّا أَمْ زَاغَتْ عَنْهُمُ ٱلْأَبْصَٰرُ
entries.t: Did we take them for mockery, or have our eyes swerved from them?
entries.na: اتخذنهم سخريا ام زاغت عنهم الابصر
entries.nt: did we take them for mockery or have our eyes swerved from them

entries.a: إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ لَحَقٌّۭ تَخَاصُمُ أَهْلِ ٱلنَّارِ
entries.t: This is certainly true-the feuding of the people of the Fire.
entries.na: ان ذلك لحق تخاصم اهل النار
entries.nt: this is certainly true the feuding of the people of the fire

entries.a: قُلْ إِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ مُنذِرٌۭ ۖ وَمَا مِنْ إِلَٰهٍ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ ٱلْوَٰحِدُ ٱلْقَهَّارُ
entries.t: Say, "I am only a warner, and there is no god except God-the One, the Conqueror.
entries.na: قل انما انا منذر وما من اله الا الله الوحد القهار
entries.nt: say i am only a warner and there is no god except god the one the conqueror

entries.a: رَبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْغَفَّٰرُ
entries.t: The Lord of the heavens and the earth, and everything between them; the Mighty, the Forgiver."
entries.na: رب السموت والارض وما بينهما العزيز الغفر
entries.nt: the lord of the heavens and the earth and everything between them the mighty the forgiver

entries.a: قُلْ هُوَ نَبَؤٌا۟ عَظِيمٌ
entries.t: Say, "It is a message of great importance.
entries.na: قل هو نبوا عظيم
entries.nt: say it is a message of great importance

entries.a: أَنتُمْ عَنْهُ مُعْرِضُونَ
entries.t: From which you are turning away.
entries.na: انتم عنه معرضون
entries.nt: from which you are turning away

entries.a: مَا كَانَ لِىَ مِنْ عِلْمٍۭ بِٱلْمَلَإِ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰٓ إِذْ يَخْتَصِمُونَ
entries.t: I have no knowledge of the Highest Assembly as they dispute.
entries.na: ما كان لي من علم بالملا الاعلي اذ يختصمون
entries.nt: i have no knowledge of the highest assembly as they dispute

entries.a: إِن يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَىَّ إِلَّآ أَنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ نَذِيرٌۭ مُّبِينٌ
entries.t: It is only revealed to me that I am a clear warner."
entries.na: ان يوحي الي الا انما انا نذير مبين
entries.nt: it is only revealed to me that i am a clear warner

entries.a: إِذْ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ إِنِّى خَٰلِقٌۢ بَشَرًۭا مِّن طِينٍۢ
entries.t: Your Lord said to the angels, "I am creating a human being from clay.
entries.na: اذ قال ربك للمليكه اني خلق بشرا من طين
entries.nt: your lord said to the angels i am creating a human being from clay

entries.a: فَإِذَا سَوَّيْتُهُۥ وَنَفَخْتُ فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِى فَقَعُوا۟ لَهُۥ سَٰجِدِينَ
entries.t: When I have formed him, and breathed into him of My spirit, fall prostrate before him.
entries.na: فاذا سويته ونفخت فيه من روحي فقعوا له سجدين
entries.nt: when i have formed him and breathed into him of my spirit fall prostrate before him

entries.a: فَسَجَدَ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ كُلُّهُمْ أَجْمَعُونَ
entries.t: So the angels fell prostrate, all of them.
entries.na: فسجد المليكه كلهم اجمعون
entries.nt: so the angels fell prostrate all of them

entries.a: إِلَّآ إِبْلِيسَ ٱسْتَكْبَرَ وَكَانَ مِنَ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ
entries.t: Except for Satan. He was too proud, and one of the faithless.
entries.na: الا ابليس استكبر وكان من الكفرين
entries.nt: except for satan he was too proud and one of the faithless

entries.a: قَالَ يَٰٓإِبْلِيسُ مَا مَنَعَكَ أَن تَسْجُدَ لِمَا خَلَقْتُ بِيَدَىَّ ۖ أَسْتَكْبَرْتَ أَمْ كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلْعَالِينَ
entries.t: He said, "O Satan, what prevented you from prostrating before what I created with My Own hands? Are you too proud, or were you one of the exalted?"
entries.na: قال يابليس ما منعك ان تسجد لما خلقت بيدي استكبرت ام كنت من العالين
entries.nt: he said o satan what prevented you from prostrating before what i created with my own hands are you too proud or were you one of the exalted

entries.a: قَالَ أَنَا۠ خَيْرٌۭ مِّنْهُ ۖ خَلَقْتَنِى مِن نَّارٍۢ وَخَلَقْتَهُۥ مِن طِينٍۢ
entries.t: He said, "I am better than he; You created me from fire, and You created him from clay."
entries.na: قال انا خير منه خلقتني من نار وخلقته من طين
entries.nt: he said i am better than he you created me from fire and you created him from clay

entries.a: قَالَ فَٱخْرُجْ مِنْهَا فَإِنَّكَ رَجِيمٌۭ
entries.t: He said, "Then get out of here! You are an outcast!
entries.na: قال فاخرج منها فانك رجيم
entries.nt: he said then get out of here you are an outcast

entries.a: وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكَ لَعْنَتِىٓ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
entries.t: And My curse will be upon you until the Day of Judgment."
entries.na: وان عليك لعنتي الي يوم الدين
entries.nt: and my curse will be upon you until the day of judgment

entries.a: قَالَ رَبِّ فَأَنظِرْنِىٓ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ
entries.t: He said, "Lord, defer me until the Day they are resurrected."
entries.na: قال رب فانظرني الي يوم يبعثون
entries.nt: he said lord defer me until the day they are resurrected

entries.a: قَالَ فَإِنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُنظَرِينَ
entries.t: He said, "You are one of those deferred.
entries.na: قال فانك من المنظرين
entries.nt: he said you are one of those deferred

entries.a: إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْوَقْتِ ٱلْمَعْلُومِ
entries.t: Until the Day of the Time Appointed."
entries.na: الي يوم الوقت المعلوم
entries.nt: until the day of the time appointed

entries.a: قَالَ فَبِعِزَّتِكَ لَأُغْوِيَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
entries.t: He said, "By Your majesty, I will seduce them all.
entries.na: قال فبعزتك لاغوينهم اجمعين
entries.nt: he said by your majesty i will seduce them all

entries.a: إِلَّا عِبَادَكَ مِنْهُمُ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
entries.t: Except for your loyal servants among them."
entries.na: الا عبادك منهم المخلصين
entries.nt: except for your loyal servants among them

entries.a: قَالَ فَٱلْحَقُّ وَٱلْحَقَّ أَقُولُ
entries.t: He said, "The truth is, and I say the truth.
entries.na: قال فالحق والحق اقول
entries.nt: he said the truth is and i say the truth

entries.a: لَأَمْلَأَنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنكَ وَمِمَّن تَبِعَكَ مِنْهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
entries.t: I will fill Hell with you, and with every one of them who follows you."
entries.na: لاملان جهنم منك وممن تبعك منهم اجمعين
entries.nt: i will fill hell with you and with every one of them who follows you

entries.a: قُلْ مَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍۢ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلْمُتَكَلِّفِينَ
entries.t: Say, "I ask of you no wage for this, and I am not a pretender.
entries.na: قل ما اسلكم عليه من اجر وما انا من المتكلفين
entries.nt: say i ask of you no wage for this and i am not a pretender

entries.a: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌۭ لِّلْعَٰلَمِينَ
entries.t: It is but a reminder to mankind.
entries.na: ان هو الا ذكر للعلمين
entries.nt: it is but a reminder to mankind

entries.a: وَلَتَعْلَمُنَّ نَبَأَهُۥ بَعْدَ حِينٍۭ
entries.t: And you will know its message after a while."
entries.na: ولتعلمن نباه بعد حين
entries.nt: and you will know its message after a while

entries.a: تَنزِيلُ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَكِيمِ
entries.t: The revelation of the Book is from God, the Mighty and Wise.
entries.na: تنزيل الكتب من الله العزيز الحكيم
entries.nt: the revelation of the book is from god the mighty and wise

entries.a: إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَآ إِلَيْكَ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ بِٱلْحَقِّ فَٱعْبُدِ ٱللَّهَ مُخْلِصًۭا لَّهُ ٱلدِّينَ
entries.t: We sent down to you the Book with the truth, so serve God, devoting your religion to Him.
entries.na: انا انزلنا اليك الكتب بالحق فاعبد الله مخلصا له الدين
entries.nt: we sent down to you the book with the truth so serve god devoting your religion to him

entries.a: أَلَا لِلَّهِ ٱلدِّينُ ٱلْخَالِصُ ۚ وَٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ أَوْلِيَآءَ مَا نَعْبُدُهُمْ إِلَّا لِيُقَرِّبُونَآ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ زُلْفَىٰٓ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَحْكُمُ بَيْنَهُمْ فِى مَا هُمْ فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِى مَنْ هُوَ كَٰذِبٌۭ كَفَّارٌۭ
entries.t: Is not to God that sincere faith is due? As for those who take guardians besides Him, "We only worship them that they may bring us nearer to God." God will judge between them regarding their differences. God does not guide the lying blasphemer.
entries.na: الا لله الدين الخالص والذين اتخذوا من دونه اوليا ما نعبدهم الا ليقربونا الي الله زلفي ان الله يحكم بينهم في ما هم فيه يختلفون ان الله لا يهدي من هو كذب كفار
entries.nt: is not to god that sincere faith is due as for those who take guardians besides him we only worship them that they may bring us nearer to god god will judge between them regarding their differences god does not guide the lying blasphemer

entries.a: لَّوْ أَرَادَ ٱللَّهُ أَن يَتَّخِذَ وَلَدًۭا لَّٱصْطَفَىٰ مِمَّا يَخْلُقُ مَا يَشَآءُ ۚ سُبْحَٰنَهُۥ ۖ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْوَٰحِدُ ٱلْقَهَّارُ
entries.t: If God wanted to have a son, He could have selected from His creation at will. Glory be to Him. He is God, the One, the Prevailing.
entries.na: لو اراد الله ان يتخذ ولدا لاصطفي مما يخلق ما يشا سبحنه هو الله الوحد القهار
entries.nt: if god wanted to have a son he could have selected from his creation at will glory be to him he is god the one the prevailing

entries.a: خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۖ يُكَوِّرُ ٱلَّيْلَ عَلَى ٱلنَّهَارِ وَيُكَوِّرُ ٱلنَّهَارَ عَلَى ٱلَّيْلِ ۖ وَسَخَّرَ ٱلشَّمْسَ وَٱلْقَمَرَ ۖ كُلٌّۭ يَجْرِى لِأَجَلٍۢ مُّسَمًّى ۗ أَلَا هُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْغَفَّٰرُ
entries.t: He created the heavens and the earth with reason. He wraps the night around the day, and He wraps the day around the night. And He regulates the sun and the moon, each running along a specific course. He is indeed the Almighty, the Forgiver.
entries.na: خلق السموت والارض بالحق يكور اليل علي النهار ويكور النهار علي اليل وسخر الشمس والقمر كل يجري لاجل مسمي الا هو العزيز الغفر
entries.nt: he created the heavens and the earth with reason he wraps the night around the day and he wraps the day around the night and he regulates the sun and the moon each running along a specific course he is indeed the almighty the forgiver

entries.a: خَلَقَكُم مِّن نَّفْسٍۢ وَٰحِدَةٍۢ ثُمَّ جَعَلَ مِنْهَا زَوْجَهَا وَأَنزَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَنْعَٰمِ ثَمَٰنِيَةَ أَزْوَٰجٍۢ ۚ يَخْلُقُكُمْ فِى بُطُونِ أُمَّهَٰتِكُمْ خَلْقًۭا مِّنۢ بَعْدِ خَلْقٍۢ فِى ظُلُمَٰتٍۢ ثَلَٰثٍۢ ۚ ذَٰلِكُمُ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّكُمْ لَهُ ٱلْمُلْكُ ۖ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ فَأَنَّىٰ تُصْرَفُونَ
entries.t: He created you from one person, then made from it its mate, and brought down livestock for you-eight kinds in pairs. He creates you in the wombs of your mothers, in successive formations, in a triple darkness. Such is God, your Lord. His is the kingdom. There is no god but He. So what made you deviate?
entries.na: خلقكم من نفس وحده ثم جعل منها زوجها وانزل لكم من الانعم ثمنيه ازوج يخلقكم في بطون امهتكم خلقا من بعد خلق في ظلمت ثلث ذلكم الله ربكم له الملك لا اله الا هو فاني تصرفون
entries.nt: he created you from one person then made from it its mate and brought down livestock for you eight kinds in pairs he creates you in the wombs of your mothers in successive formations in a triple darkness such is god your lord his is the kingdom there is no god but he so what made you deviate

entries.a: إِن تَكْفُرُوا۟ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ عَنكُمْ ۖ وَلَا يَرْضَىٰ لِعِبَادِهِ ٱلْكُفْرَ ۖ وَإِن تَشْكُرُوا۟ يَرْضَهُ لَكُمْ ۗ وَلَا تَزِرُ وَازِرَةٌۭ وِزْرَ أُخْرَىٰ ۗ ثُمَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكُم مَّرْجِعُكُمْ فَيُنَبِّئُكُم بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِيمٌۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ
entries.t: If you disbelieve, God is Independent of you, yet He does not approve ingratitude on the part of His servants. And if you are thankful, He will approve that in you. No bearer of burden can bear the burden of another. Then to your Lord is your return; and He will inform you of what you used to do. He is aware of what the hearts contain.
entries.na: ان تكفروا فان الله غني عنكم ولا يرضي لعباده الكفر وان تشكروا يرضه لكم ولا تزر وازره وزر اخري ثم الي ربكم مرجعكم فينبيكم بما كنتم تعملون انه عليم بذات الصدور
entries.nt: if you disbelieve god is independent of you yet he does not approve ingratitude on the part of his servants and if you are thankful he will approve that in you no bearer of burden can bear the burden of another then to your lord is your return and he will inform you of what you used to do he is aware of what the hearts contain

entries.a: ۞ وَإِذَا مَسَّ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ ضُرٌّۭ دَعَا رَبَّهُۥ مُنِيبًا إِلَيْهِ ثُمَّ إِذَا خَوَّلَهُۥ نِعْمَةًۭ مِّنْهُ نَسِىَ مَا كَانَ يَدْعُوٓا۟ إِلَيْهِ مِن قَبْلُ وَجَعَلَ لِلَّهِ أَندَادًۭا لِّيُضِلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ ۚ قُلْ تَمَتَّعْ بِكُفْرِكَ قَلِيلًا ۖ إِنَّكَ مِنْ أَصْحَٰبِ ٱلنَّارِ
entries.t: When some adversity touches the human being, he prays to his Lord, repenting to Him. But then, when He confers on him a grace of His, he forgets what he was praying for before, and he attributes rivals to God, in order to lead astray from His way. Say, "Enjoy your disbelief for a little while; you will be among the inmates of the Fire."
entries.na: واذا مس الانسن ضر دعا ربه منيبا اليه ثم اذا خوله نعمه منه نسي ما كان يدعوا اليه من قبل وجعل لله اندادا ليضل عن سبيله قل تمتع بكفرك قليلا انك من اصحب النار
entries.nt: when some adversity touches the human being he prays to his lord repenting to him but then when he confers on him a grace of his he forgets what he was praying for before and he attributes rivals to god in order to lead astray from his way say enjoy your disbelief for a little while you will be among the inmates of the fire
