entries.na: ام يقولون تقوله بل لا يومنون
entries.nt: or do they say he made it up rather they do not believe

entries.a: فَلْيَأْتُوا۟ بِحَدِيثٍۢ مِّثْلِهِۦٓ إِن كَانُوا۟ صَٰدِقِينَ
entries.t: So let them produce a discourse like it, if they are truthful.
entries.na: فلياتوا بحديث مثله ان كانوا صدقين
entries.nt: so let them produce a discourse like it if they are truthful

entries.a: أَمْ خُلِقُوا۟ مِنْ غَيْرِ شَىْءٍ أَمْ هُمُ ٱلْخَٰلِقُونَ
entries.t: Or were they created out of nothing? Or are they the creators?
entries.na: ام خلقوا من غير شي ام هم الخلقون
entries.nt: or were they created out of nothing or are they the creators

entries.a: أَمْ خَلَقُوا۟ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ ۚ بَل لَّا يُوقِنُونَ
entries.t: Or did they create the heavens and the earth? In fact, they are not certain.
entries.na: ام خلقوا السموت والارض بل لا يوقنون
entries.nt: or did they create the heavens and the earth in fact they are not certain

entries.a: أَمْ عِندَهُمْ خَزَآئِنُ رَبِّكَ أَمْ هُمُ ٱلْمُصَۣيْطِرُونَ
entries.t: Or do they possess the treasuries of your Lord? Or are they the controllers?
entries.na: ام عندهم خزاين ربك ام هم المصيطرون
entries.nt: or do they possess the treasuries of your lord or are they the controllers

entries.a: أَمْ لَهُمْ سُلَّمٌۭ يَسْتَمِعُونَ فِيهِ ۖ فَلْيَأْتِ مُسْتَمِعُهُم بِسُلْطَٰنٍۢ مُّبِينٍ
entries.t: Or do they have a stairway by means of which they listen? Then let their listener produce a clear proof.
entries.na: ام لهم سلم يستمعون فيه فليات مستمعهم بسلطن مبين
entries.nt: or do they have a stairway by means of which they listen then let their listener produce a clear proof

entries.a: أَمْ لَهُ ٱلْبَنَٰتُ وَلَكُمُ ٱلْبَنُونَ
entries.t: Or for Him the daughters, and for you the sons?
entries.na: ام له البنت ولكم البنون
entries.nt: or for him the daughters and for you the sons

entries.a: أَمْ تَسْـَٔلُهُمْ أَجْرًۭا فَهُم مِّن مَّغْرَمٍۢ مُّثْقَلُونَ
entries.t: Or do you demand a payment from them, and they are burdened by debt?
entries.na: ام تسلهم اجرا فهم من مغرم مثقلون
entries.nt: or do you demand a payment from them and they are burdened by debt

entries.a: أَمْ عِندَهُمُ ٱلْغَيْبُ فَهُمْ يَكْتُبُونَ
entries.t: Or do they know the future, and they are writing it down?
entries.na: ام عندهم الغيب فهم يكتبون
entries.nt: or do they know the future and they are writing it down

entries.a: أَمْ يُرِيدُونَ كَيْدًۭا ۖ فَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ هُمُ ٱلْمَكِيدُونَ
entries.t: Or are they planning a conspiracy? The conspiracy will befall the disbelievers.
entries.na: ام يريدون كيدا فالذين كفروا هم المكيدون
entries.nt: or are they planning a conspiracy the conspiracy will befall the disbelievers

entries.a: أَمْ لَهُمْ إِلَٰهٌ غَيْرُ ٱللَّهِ ۚ سُبْحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
entries.t: Or do they have a god besides God? God transcends what they associate.
entries.na: ام لهم اله غير الله سبحن الله عما يشركون
entries.nt: or do they have a god besides god god transcends what they associate

entries.a: وَإِن يَرَوْا۟ كِسْفًۭا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ سَاقِطًۭا يَقُولُوا۟ سَحَابٌۭ مَّرْكُومٌۭ
entries.t: Even if they were to see lumps of the sky falling down, they would say, "A mass of clouds."
entries.na: وان يروا كسفا من السما ساقطا يقولوا سحاب مركوم
entries.nt: even if they were to see lumps of the sky falling down they would say a mass of clouds

entries.a: فَذَرْهُمْ حَتَّىٰ يُلَٰقُوا۟ يَوْمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِى فِيهِ يُصْعَقُونَ
entries.t: So leave them until they meet their Day in which they will be stunned.
entries.na: فذرهم حتي يلقوا يومهم الذي فيه يصعقون
entries.nt: so leave them until they meet their day in which they will be stunned

entries.a: يَوْمَ لَا يُغْنِى عَنْهُمْ كَيْدُهُمْ شَيْـًۭٔا وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
entries.t: The Day when their ploys will avail them nothing; and they will not be helped.
entries.na: يوم لا يغني عنهم كيدهم شيا ولا هم ينصرون
entries.nt: the day when their ploys will avail them nothing and they will not be helped

entries.a: وَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ عَذَابًۭا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
entries.t: For those who do wrong, there is a punishment besides that; but most of them do not know.
entries.na: وان للذين ظلموا عذابا دون ذلك ولكن اكثرهم لا يعلمون
entries.nt: for those who do wrong there is a punishment besides that but most of them do not know

entries.a: وَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ فَإِنَّكَ بِأَعْيُنِنَا ۖ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ حِينَ تَقُومُ
entries.t: So patiently await the decision of your Lord, for you are before Our Eyes; and proclaim the praises of your Lord when you arise.
entries.na: واصبر لحكم ربك فانك باعيننا وسبح بحمد ربك حين تقوم
entries.nt: so patiently await the decision of your lord for you are before our eyes and proclaim the praises of your lord when you arise

entries.a: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْهُ وَإِدْبَٰرَ ٱلنُّجُومِ
entries.t: And glorify Him during the night, and at the receding of the stars.
entries.na: ومن اليل فسبحه وادبر النجوم
entries.nt: and glorify him during the night and at the receding of the stars

entries.a: وَٱلنَّجْمِ إِذَا هَوَىٰ
entries.t: By the star as it goes down.
entries.na: والنجم اذا هوي
entries.nt: by the star as it goes down

entries.a: مَا ضَلَّ صَاحِبُكُمْ وَمَا غَوَىٰ
entries.t: Your friend has not gone astray, nor has he erred.
entries.na: ما ضل صاحبكم وما غوي
entries.nt: your friend has not gone astray nor has he erred

entries.a: وَمَا يَنطِقُ عَنِ ٱلْهَوَىٰٓ
entries.t: Nor does he speak out of desire.
entries.na: وما ينطق عن الهوي
entries.nt: nor does he speak out of desire

entries.a: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا وَحْىٌۭ يُوحَىٰ
entries.t: It is but a revelation revealed.
entries.na: ان هو الا وحي يوحي
entries.nt: it is but a revelation revealed

entries.a: عَلَّمَهُۥ شَدِيدُ ٱلْقُوَىٰ
entries.t: Taught to him by the Extremely Powerful.
entries.na: علمه شديد القوي
entries.nt: taught to him by the extremely powerful

entries.a: ذُو مِرَّةٍۢ فَٱسْتَوَىٰ
entries.t: The one of vigor. He settled.
entries.na: ذو مره فاستوي
entries.nt: the one of vigor he settled

entries.a: وَهُوَ بِٱلْأُفُقِ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ
entries.t: While he was at the highest horizon.
entries.na: وهو بالافق الاعلي
entries.nt: while he was at the highest horizon

entries.a: ثُمَّ دَنَا فَتَدَلَّىٰ
entries.t: Then he came near, and hovered around.
entries.na: ثم دنا فتدلي
entries.nt: then he came near and hovered around

entries.a: فَكَانَ قَابَ قَوْسَيْنِ أَوْ أَدْنَىٰ
entries.t: He was within two bows' length, or closer.
entries.na: فكان قاب قوسين او ادني
entries.nt: he was within two bows length or closer

entries.a: فَأَوْحَىٰٓ إِلَىٰ عَبْدِهِۦ مَآ أَوْحَىٰ
entries.t: Then He revealed to His servant what He revealed.
entries.na: فاوحي الي عبده ما اوحي
entries.nt: then he revealed to his servant what he revealed

entries.a: مَا كَذَبَ ٱلْفُؤَادُ مَا رَأَىٰٓ
entries.t: The heart did not lie about what it saw.
entries.na: ما كذب الفواد ما راي
entries.nt: the heart did not lie about what it saw

entries.a: أَفَتُمَٰرُونَهُۥ عَلَىٰ مَا يَرَىٰ
entries.t: Will you dispute with him concerning what he saw?
entries.na: افتمرونه علي ما يري
entries.nt: will you dispute with him concerning what he saw

entries.a: وَلَقَدْ رَءَاهُ نَزْلَةً أُخْرَىٰ
entries.t: He saw him on another descent.
entries.na: ولقد راه نزله اخري
entries.nt: he saw him on another descent

entries.a: عِندَ سِدْرَةِ ٱلْمُنتَهَىٰ
entries.t: At the Lotus Tree of the Extremity.
entries.na: عند سدره المنتهي
entries.nt: at the lotus tree of the extremity

entries.a: عِندَهَا جَنَّةُ ٱلْمَأْوَىٰٓ
entries.t: Near which is the Garden of Repose.
entries.na: عندها جنه الماوي
entries.nt: near which is the garden of repose

entries.a: إِذْ يَغْشَى ٱلسِّدْرَةَ مَا يَغْشَىٰ
entries.t: As there covered the Lotus Tree what covered it.
entries.na: اذ يغشي السدره ما يغشي
entries.nt: as there covered the lotus tree what covered it

entries.a: مَا زَاغَ ٱلْبَصَرُ وَمَا طَغَىٰ
entries.t: The sight did not waver, nor did it exceed.
entries.na: ما زاغ البصر وما طغي
entries.nt: the sight did not waver nor did it exceed

entries.a: لَقَدْ رَأَىٰ مِنْ ءَايَٰتِ رَبِّهِ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰٓ
entries.t: He saw some of the Great Signs of his Lord.
entries.na: لقد راي من ايت ربه الكبري
entries.nt: he saw some of the great signs of his lord

entries.a: أَفَرَءَيْتُمُ ٱللَّٰتَ وَٱلْعُزَّىٰ
entries.t: Have you considered al-Lat and al-Uzza?
entries.na: افريتم اللت والعزي
entries.nt: have you considered al lat and al uzza

entries.a: وَمَنَوٰةَ ٱلثَّالِثَةَ ٱلْأُخْرَىٰٓ
entries.t: And Manat, the third one, the other?
entries.na: ومنوه الثالثه الاخري
entries.nt: and manat the third one the other

entries.a: أَلَكُمُ ٱلذَّكَرُ وَلَهُ ٱلْأُنثَىٰ
entries.t: Are you to have the males, and He the females?
entries.na: الكم الذكر وله الانثي
entries.nt: are you to have the males and he the females

entries.a: تِلْكَ إِذًۭا قِسْمَةٌۭ ضِيزَىٰٓ
entries.t: What a bizarre distribution.
entries.na: تلك اذا قسمه ضيزي
entries.nt: what a bizarre distribution

entries.a: إِنْ هِىَ إِلَّآ أَسْمَآءٌۭ سَمَّيْتُمُوهَآ أَنتُمْ وَءَابَآؤُكُم مَّآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَا مِن سُلْطَٰنٍ ۚ إِن يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا ٱلظَّنَّ وَمَا تَهْوَى ٱلْأَنفُسُ ۖ وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُم مِّن رَّبِّهِمُ ٱلْهُدَىٰٓ
entries.t: These are nothing but names, which you have devised, you and your ancestors, for which God sent down no authority. They follow nothing but assumptions, and what the ego desires, even though guidance has come to them from their Lord.
entries.na: ان هي الا اسما سميتموها انتم واباوكم ما انزل الله بها من سلطن ان يتبعون الا الظن وما تهوي الانفس ولقد جاهم من ربهم الهدي
entries.nt: these are nothing but names which you have devised you and your ancestors for which god sent down no authority they follow nothing but assumptions and what the ego desires even though guidance has come to them from their lord

entries.a: أَمْ لِلْإِنسَٰنِ مَا تَمَنَّىٰ
entries.t: Or is the human being to have whatever he desires?
entries.na: ام للانسن ما تمني
entries.nt: or is the human being to have whatever he desires

entries.a: فَلِلَّهِ ٱلْءَاخِرَةُ وَٱلْأُولَىٰ
entries.t: To God belong the Last and the First.
entries.na: فلله الاخره والاولي
entries.nt: to god belong the last and the first

entries.a: ۞ وَكَم مِّن مَّلَكٍۢ فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ لَا تُغْنِى شَفَٰعَتُهُمْ شَيْـًٔا إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِ أَن يَأْذَنَ ٱللَّهُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَرْضَىٰٓ
entries.t: How many an angel is there in the heavens whose intercession avails nothing, except after God gives permission to whomever He wills, and approves?
entries.na: وكم من ملك في السموت لا تغني شفعتهم شيا الا من بعد ان ياذن الله لمن يشا ويرضي
entries.nt: how many an angel is there in the heavens whose intercession avails nothing except after god gives permission to whomever he wills and approves

entries.a: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْءَاخِرَةِ لَيُسَمُّونَ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ تَسْمِيَةَ ٱلْأُنثَىٰ
entries.t: Those who do not believe in the Hereafter give the angels the names of females.
entries.na: ان الذين لا يومنون بالاخره ليسمون المليكه تسميه الانثي
entries.nt: those who do not believe in the hereafter give the angels the names of females

entries.a: وَمَا لَهُم بِهِۦ مِنْ عِلْمٍ ۖ إِن يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا ٱلظَّنَّ ۖ وَإِنَّ ٱلظَّنَّ لَا يُغْنِى مِنَ ٱلْحَقِّ شَيْـًۭٔا
entries.t: They have no knowledge of that. They only follow assumptions, and assumptions are no substitute for the truth.
entries.na: وما لهم به من علم ان يتبعون الا الظن وان الظن لا يغني من الحق شيا
entries.nt: they have no knowledge of that they only follow assumptions and assumptions are no substitute for the truth

entries.a: فَأَعْرِضْ عَن مَّن تَوَلَّىٰ عَن ذِكْرِنَا وَلَمْ يُرِدْ إِلَّا ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا
entries.t: So avoid him who has turned away from Our remembrance, and desires nothing but the present life.
entries.na: فاعرض عن من تولي عن ذكرنا ولم يرد الا الحيوه الدنيا
entries.nt: so avoid him who has turned away from our remembrance and desires nothing but the present life

entries.a: ذَٰلِكَ مَبْلَغُهُم مِّنَ ٱلْعِلْمِ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَن ضَلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَنِ ٱهْتَدَىٰ
entries.t: That is the extent of their knowledge. Your Lord knows best who has strayed from His path, and He knows best who has accepted guidance.
entries.na: ذلك مبلغهم من العلم ان ربك هو اعلم بمن ضل عن سبيله وهو اعلم بمن اهتدي
entries.nt: that is the extent of their knowledge your lord knows best who has strayed from his path and he knows best who has accepted guidance

entries.a: وَلِلَّهِ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ لِيَجْزِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَسَٰٓـُٔوا۟ بِمَا عَمِلُوا۟ وَيَجْزِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَحْسَنُوا۟ بِٱلْحُسْنَى
entries.t: To God belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on earth. He will repay those who do evil according to their deeds, and recompense those who do good with the best.
entries.na: ولله ما في السموت وما في الارض ليجزي الذين اسوا بما عملوا ويجزي الذين احسنوا بالحسني
entries.nt: to god belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on earth he will repay those who do evil according to their deeds and recompense those who do good with the best

entries.a: ٱلَّذِينَ يَجْتَنِبُونَ كَبَٰٓئِرَ ٱلْإِثْمِ وَٱلْفَوَٰحِشَ إِلَّا ٱللَّمَمَ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ وَٰسِعُ ٱلْمَغْفِرَةِ ۚ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِكُمْ إِذْ أَنشَأَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ وَإِذْ أَنتُمْ أَجِنَّةٌۭ فِى بُطُونِ أُمَّهَٰتِكُمْ ۖ فَلَا تُزَكُّوٓا۟ أَنفُسَكُمْ ۖ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَنِ ٱتَّقَىٰٓ
entries.t: Those who avoid gross sins and indecencies-except for minor lapses-your Lord is of Vast Forgiveness. He knows you well, ever since He created you from the earth, and ever since you were embryos in your mothers' wombs. So do not acclaim your own virtue; He is fully aware of the righteous.
entries.na: الذين يجتنبون كبير الاثم والفوحش الا اللمم ان ربك وسع المغفره هو اعلم بكم اذ انشاكم من الارض واذ انتم اجنه في بطون امهتكم فلا تزكوا انفسكم هو اعلم بمن اتقي
entries.nt: those who avoid gross sins and indecencies except for minor lapses your lord is of vast forgiveness he knows you well ever since he created you from the earth and ever since you were embryos in your mothers wombs so do not acclaim your own virtue he is fully aware of the righteous

entries.a: أَفَرَءَيْتَ ٱلَّذِى تَوَلَّىٰ
entries.t: Have you considered him who turned away?
entries.na: افريت الذي تولي
entries.nt: have you considered him who turned away

entries.a: وَأَعْطَىٰ قَلِيلًۭا وَأَكْدَىٰٓ
entries.t: And gave a little, and held back?
entries.na: واعطي قليلا واكدي
entries.nt: and gave a little and held back

entries.a: أَعِندَهُۥ عِلْمُ ٱلْغَيْبِ فَهُوَ يَرَىٰٓ
entries.t: Does he possess knowledge of the unseen, and can therefore foresee?
entries.na: اعنده علم الغيب فهو يري
entries.nt: does he possess knowledge of the unseen and can therefore foresee

entries.a: أَمْ لَمْ يُنَبَّأْ بِمَا فِى صُحُفِ مُوسَىٰ
entries.t: Or was he not informed of what is in the Scrolls of Moses?
entries.na: ام لم ينبا بما في صحف موسي
entries.nt: or was he not informed of what is in the scrolls of moses

entries.a: وَإِبْرَٰهِيمَ ٱلَّذِى وَفَّىٰٓ
entries.t: And of Abraham, who fulfilled?
entries.na: وابرهيم الذي وفي
entries.nt: and of abraham who fulfilled

entries.a: أَلَّا تَزِرُ وَازِرَةٌۭ وِزْرَ أُخْرَىٰ
entries.t: That no soul bears the burdens of another soul.
entries.na: الا تزر وازره وزر اخري
entries.nt: that no soul bears the burdens of another soul

entries.a: وَأَن لَّيْسَ لِلْإِنسَٰنِ إِلَّا مَا سَعَىٰ
entries.t: And that the human being attains only what he strives for.
entries.na: وان ليس للانسن الا ما سعي
entries.nt: and that the human being attains only what he strives for

entries.a: وَأَنَّ سَعْيَهُۥ سَوْفَ يُرَىٰ
entries.t: And that his efforts will be witnessed.
entries.na: وان سعيه سوف يري
entries.nt: and that his efforts will be witnessed

entries.a: ثُمَّ يُجْزَىٰهُ ٱلْجَزَآءَ ٱلْأَوْفَىٰ
entries.t: Then he will be rewarded for it the fullest reward.
entries.na: ثم يجزيه الجزا الاوفي
entries.nt: then he will be rewarded for it the fullest reward

entries.a: وَأَنَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ ٱلْمُنتَهَىٰ
entries.t: And that to your Lord is the finality.
entries.na: وان الي ربك المنتهي
entries.nt: and that to your lord is the finality

entries.a: وَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ أَضْحَكَ وَأَبْكَىٰ
entries.t: And that it is He who causes laughter and weeping.
entries.na: وانه هو اضحك وابكي
entries.nt: and that it is he who causes laughter and weeping

entries.a: وَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ أَمَاتَ وَأَحْيَا
entries.t: And that it is He who gives death and life.
entries.na: وانه هو امات واحيا
entries.nt: and that it is he who gives death and life

entries.a: وَأَنَّهُۥ خَلَقَ ٱلزَّوْجَيْنِ ٱلذَّكَرَ وَٱلْأُنثَىٰ
entries.t: And that it is He who created the two kinds-the male and the female.
entries.na: وانه خلق الزوجين الذكر والانثي
entries.nt: and that it is he who created the two kinds the male and the female

entries.a: مِن نُّطْفَةٍ إِذَا تُمْنَىٰ
entries.t: From a sperm drop, when emitted.
entries.na: من نطفه اذا تمني
entries.nt: from a sperm drop when emitted

entries.a: وَأَنَّ عَلَيْهِ ٱلنَّشْأَةَ ٱلْأُخْرَىٰ
entries.t: And that upon Him is the next existence.
entries.na: وان عليه النشاه الاخري
entries.nt: and that upon him is the next existence

entries.a: وَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ أَغْنَىٰ وَأَقْنَىٰ
entries.t: And that it is He who enriches and impoverishes.
entries.na: وانه هو اغني واقني
entries.nt: and that it is he who enriches and impoverishes

entries.a: وَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ رَبُّ ٱلشِّعْرَىٰ
entries.t: And that it is He who is the Lord of Sirius.
entries.na: وانه هو رب الشعري
entries.nt: and that it is he who is the lord of sirius

entries.a: وَأَنَّهُۥٓ أَهْلَكَ عَادًا ٱلْأُولَىٰ
entries.t: And that it is He who destroyed the first Aad.
entries.na: وانه اهلك عادا الاولي
entries.nt: and that it is he who destroyed the first aad

entries.a: وَثَمُودَا۟ فَمَآ أَبْقَىٰ
entries.t: And Thamood, sparing no one.
entries.na: وثمودا فما ابقي
entries.nt: and thamood sparing no one

entries.a: وَقَوْمَ نُوحٍۢ مِّن قَبْلُ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ هُمْ أَظْلَمَ وَأَطْغَىٰ
entries.t: And the people of Noah before that; for they were most unjust and most oppressive.
entries.na: وقوم نوح من قبل انهم كانوا هم اظلم واطغي
entries.nt: and the people of noah before that for they were most unjust and most oppressive

entries.a: وَٱلْمُؤْتَفِكَةَ أَهْوَىٰ
entries.t: And He toppled the ruined cities.
entries.na: والموتفكه اهوي
entries.nt: and he toppled the ruined cities

entries.a: فَغَشَّىٰهَا مَا غَشَّىٰ
entries.t: And covered them with whatever covered them.
entries.na: فغشيها ما غشي
entries.nt: and covered them with whatever covered them

entries.a: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكَ تَتَمَارَىٰ
entries.t: So which of your Lord's marvels can you deny?
entries.na: فباي الا ربك تتماري
entries.nt: so which of your lord s marvels can you deny

entries.a: هَٰذَا نَذِيرٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلنُّذُرِ ٱلْأُولَىٰٓ
entries.t: This is a warning, just like the first warnings.
entries.na: هذا نذير من النذر الاولي
entries.nt: this is a warning just like the first warnings

entries.a: أَزِفَتِ ٱلْءَازِفَةُ
entries.t: The inevitable is imminent.
entries.na: ازفت الازفه
entries.nt: the inevitable is imminent

entries.a: لَيْسَ لَهَا مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ كَاشِفَةٌ
entries.t: None besides God can unveil it.
entries.na: ليس لها من دون الله كاشفه
entries.nt: none besides god can unveil it

entries.a: أَفَمِنْ هَٰذَا ٱلْحَدِيثِ تَعْجَبُونَ
entries.t: Do you marvel at this discourse?
entries.na: افمن هذا الحديث تعجبون
entries.nt: do you marvel at this discourse

entries.a: وَتَضْحَكُونَ وَلَا تَبْكُونَ
entries.t: And laugh, and do not weep?
entries.na: وتضحكون ولا تبكون
entries.nt: and laugh and do not weep

entries.a: وَأَنتُمْ سَٰمِدُونَ
entries.t: Lost in your frivolity?
entries.na: وانتم سمدون
entries.nt: lost in your frivolity

entries.a: فَٱسْجُدُوا۟ لِلَّهِ وَٱعْبُدُوا۟ ۩
entries.t: So bow down to God, and worship!
entries.na: فاسجدوا لله واعبدوا
entries.nt: so bow down to god and worship

entries.a: ٱقْتَرَبَتِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ وَٱنشَقَّ ٱلْقَمَرُ
entries.t: The Hour has drawn near, and the moon has split.
entries.na: اقتربت الساعه وانشق القمر
entries.nt: the hour has drawn near and the moon has split

entries.a: وَإِن يَرَوْا۟ ءَايَةًۭ يُعْرِضُوا۟ وَيَقُولُوا۟ سِحْرٌۭ مُّسْتَمِرٌّۭ
entries.t: Yet whenever they see a miracle, they turn away, and say, "Continuous magic."
entries.na: وان يروا ايه يعرضوا ويقولوا سحر مستمر
entries.nt: yet whenever they see a miracle they turn away and say continuous magic

entries.a: وَكَذَّبُوا۟ وَٱتَّبَعُوٓا۟ أَهْوَآءَهُمْ ۚ وَكُلُّ أَمْرٍۢ مُّسْتَقِرٌّۭ
entries.t: They lied, and followed their opinions, but everything has its time.
entries.na: وكذبوا واتبعوا اهواهم وكل امر مستقر
entries.nt: they lied and followed their opinions but everything has its time

entries.a: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَنۢبَآءِ مَا فِيهِ مُزْدَجَرٌ
entries.t: And there came to them news containing a deterrent.
entries.na: ولقد جاهم من الانبا ما فيه مزدجر
entries.nt: and there came to them news containing a deterrent

entries.a: حِكْمَةٌۢ بَٰلِغَةٌۭ ۖ فَمَا تُغْنِ ٱلنُّذُرُ
entries.t: Profound wisdom-but warnings are of no avail.
entries.na: حكمه بلغه فما تغن النذر
entries.nt: profound wisdom but warnings are of no avail

entries.a: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ ۘ يَوْمَ يَدْعُ ٱلدَّاعِ إِلَىٰ شَىْءٍۢ نُّكُرٍ
entries.t: So turn away from them. On the Day when the Caller calls to something terrible.
entries.na: فتول عنهم يوم يدع الداع الي شي نكر
entries.nt: so turn away from them on the day when the caller calls to something terrible

entries.a: خُشَّعًا أَبْصَٰرُهُمْ يَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ ٱلْأَجْدَاثِ كَأَنَّهُمْ جَرَادٌۭ مُّنتَشِرٌۭ
entries.t: Their eyes humiliated, they will emerge from the graves, as if they were swarming locusts.
entries.na: خشعا ابصرهم يخرجون من الاجداث كانهم جراد منتشر
entries.nt: their eyes humiliated they will emerge from the graves as if they were swarming locusts

entries.a: مُّهْطِعِينَ إِلَى ٱلدَّاعِ ۖ يَقُولُ ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ هَٰذَا يَوْمٌ عَسِرٌۭ
entries.t: Scrambling towards the Caller, the disbelievers will say, "This is a difficult Day."
entries.na: مهطعين الي الداع يقول الكفرون هذا يوم عسر
entries.nt: scrambling towards the caller the disbelievers will say this is a difficult day

entries.a: ۞ كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍۢ فَكَذَّبُوا۟ عَبْدَنَا وَقَالُوا۟ مَجْنُونٌۭ وَٱزْدُجِرَ
entries.t: Before them the people of Noah disbelieved. They rejected Our servant, and said, "Crazy," and he was rebuked.
entries.na: كذبت قبلهم قوم نوح فكذبوا عبدنا وقالوا مجنون وازدجر
entries.nt: before them the people of noah disbelieved they rejected our servant and said crazy and he was rebuked

entries.a: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَغْلُوبٌۭ فَٱنتَصِرْ
entries.t: So he appealed to his Lord, "I am overwhelmed, so help me."
entries.na: فدعا ربه اني مغلوب فانتصر
entries.nt: so he appealed to his lord i am overwhelmed so help me

entries.a: فَفَتَحْنَآ أَبْوَٰبَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ بِمَآءٍۢ مُّنْهَمِرٍۢ
entries.t: So We opened the floodgates of heaven with water pouring down.
entries.na: ففتحنا ابوب السما بما منهمر
entries.nt: so we opened the floodgates of heaven with water pouring down

entries.a: وَفَجَّرْنَا ٱلْأَرْضَ عُيُونًۭا فَٱلْتَقَى ٱلْمَآءُ عَلَىٰٓ أَمْرٍۢ قَدْ قُدِرَ
entries.t: And We made the earth burst with springs, and the waters met for a purpose already destined.
entries.na: وفجرنا الارض عيونا فالتقي الما علي امر قد قدر
entries.nt: and we made the earth burst with springs and the waters met for a purpose already destined

entries.a: وَحَمَلْنَٰهُ عَلَىٰ ذَاتِ أَلْوَٰحٍۢ وَدُسُرٍۢ
entries.t: And We carried him on a craft of planks and nails.
entries.na: وحملنه علي ذات الوح ودسر
entries.nt: and we carried him on a craft of planks and nails

entries.a: تَجْرِى بِأَعْيُنِنَا جَزَآءًۭ لِّمَن كَانَ كُفِرَ
entries.t: Sailing before Our eyes; a reward for him who was rejected.
entries.na: تجري باعيننا جزا لمن كان كفر
entries.nt: sailing before our eyes a reward for him who was rejected

entries.a: وَلَقَد تَّرَكْنَٰهَآ ءَايَةًۭ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍۢ
entries.t: And We left it as a sign. Is there anyone who would take heed?
entries.na: ولقد تركنها ايه فهل من مدكر
entries.nt: and we left it as a sign is there anyone who would take heed

entries.a: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
entries.t: So how were My punishment and My warnings?
entries.na: فكيف كان عذابي ونذر
entries.nt: so how were my punishment and my warnings

entries.a: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍۢ
entries.t: We made the Quran easy to learn. Is there anyone who would learn?
entries.na: ولقد يسرنا القران للذكر فهل من مدكر
entries.nt: we made the quran easy to learn is there anyone who would learn

entries.a: كَذَّبَتْ عَادٌۭ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
entries.t: Aad denied the truth. So how were My punishment and My warnings?
entries.na: كذبت عاد فكيف كان عذابي ونذر
entries.nt: aad denied the truth so how were my punishment and my warnings

entries.a: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ رِيحًۭا صَرْصَرًۭا فِى يَوْمِ نَحْسٍۢ مُّسْتَمِرٍّۢ
entries.t: We unleashed upon them a screaming wind, on a day of unrelenting misery.
entries.na: انا ارسلنا عليهم ريحا صرصرا في يوم نحس مستمر
entries.nt: we unleashed upon them a screaming wind on a day of unrelenting misery

entries.a: تَنزِعُ ٱلنَّاسَ كَأَنَّهُمْ أَعْجَازُ نَخْلٍۢ مُّنقَعِرٍۢ
entries.t: Plucking the people away, as though they were trunks of uprooted palm-trees.
entries.na: تنزع الناس كانهم اعجاز نخل منقعر
entries.nt: plucking the people away as though they were trunks of uprooted palm trees

entries.a: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
entries.t: So how were My punishment and My warnings?
entries.na: فكيف كان عذابي ونذر
entries.nt: so how were my punishment and my warnings

entries.a: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍۢ
entries.t: We made the Quran easy to remember. Is there anyone who would remember?
entries.na: ولقد يسرنا القران للذكر فهل من مدكر
entries.nt: we made the quran easy to remember is there anyone who would remember

entries.a: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
entries.t: Thamood rejected the warnings.
entries.na: كذبت ثمود بالنذر
entries.nt: thamood rejected the warnings

entries.a: فَقَالُوٓا۟ أَبَشَرًۭا مِّنَّا وَٰحِدًۭا نَّتَّبِعُهُۥٓ إِنَّآ إِذًۭا لَّفِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ وَسُعُرٍ
entries.t: They said, "Are we to follow one of us, a human being? We would then go astray, and end up in Hell.
entries.na: فقالوا ابشرا منا وحدا نتبعه انا اذا لفي ضلل وسعر
entries.nt: they said are we to follow one of us a human being we would then go astray and end up in hell

entries.a: أَءُلْقِىَ ٱلذِّكْرُ عَلَيْهِ مِنۢ بَيْنِنَا بَلْ هُوَ كَذَّابٌ أَشِرٌۭ
entries.t: Was the message given to him, out of all of us? In fact, he is a wicked liar."
entries.na: القي الذكر عليه من بيننا بل هو كذاب اشر
entries.nt: was the message given to him out of all of us in fact he is a wicked liar

entries.a: سَيَعْلَمُونَ غَدًۭا مَّنِ ٱلْكَذَّابُ ٱلْأَشِرُ
entries.t: They will know tomorrow who the wicked liar is.
entries.na: سيعلمون غدا من الكذاب الاشر
entries.nt: they will know tomorrow who the wicked liar is

entries.a: إِنَّا مُرْسِلُوا۟ ٱلنَّاقَةِ فِتْنَةًۭ لَّهُمْ فَٱرْتَقِبْهُمْ وَٱصْطَبِرْ
entries.t: We are sending the she-camel as a test for them; so watch them and be patient.
entries.na: انا مرسلوا الناقه فتنه لهم فارتقبهم واصطبر
entries.nt: we are sending the she camel as a test for them so watch them and be patient

entries.a: وَنَبِّئْهُمْ أَنَّ ٱلْمَآءَ قِسْمَةٌۢ بَيْنَهُمْ ۖ كُلُّ شِرْبٍۢ مُّحْتَضَرٌۭ
entries.t: And inform them that the water is to be shared between them; each share of drink made available.
entries.na: ونبيهم ان الما قسمه بينهم كل شرب محتضر
entries.nt: and inform them that the water is to be shared between them each share of drink made available

entries.a: فَنَادَوْا۟ صَاحِبَهُمْ فَتَعَاطَىٰ فَعَقَرَ
entries.t: But they called their friend, and he dared, and he slaughtered.
entries.na: فنادوا صاحبهم فتعاطي فعقر
entries.nt: but they called their friend and he dared and he slaughtered

entries.a: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
entries.t: So how were My punishment and My warnings?
entries.na: فكيف كان عذابي ونذر
entries.nt: so how were my punishment and my warnings

entries.a: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ صَيْحَةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ فَكَانُوا۟ كَهَشِيمِ ٱلْمُحْتَظِرِ
entries.t: We sent against them a single Scream, and they became like crushed hay.
entries.na: انا ارسلنا عليهم صيحه وحده فكانوا كهشيم المحتظر
entries.nt: we sent against them a single scream and they became like crushed hay

entries.a: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍۢ
entries.t: We made the Quran easy to understand. Is there anyone who would understand?
entries.na: ولقد يسرنا القران للذكر فهل من مدكر
entries.nt: we made the quran easy to understand is there anyone who would understand

entries.a: كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ لُوطٍۭ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
entries.t: The people of Lot rejected the warnings.
entries.na: كذبت قوم لوط بالنذر
entries.nt: the people of lot rejected the warnings

entries.a: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ حَاصِبًا إِلَّآ ءَالَ لُوطٍۢ ۖ نَّجَّيْنَٰهُم بِسَحَرٍۢ
entries.t: We unleashed upon them a shower of stones, except for the family of Lot; We rescued them at dawn.
entries.na: انا ارسلنا عليهم حاصبا الا ال لوط نجينهم بسحر
entries.nt: we unleashed upon them a shower of stones except for the family of lot we rescued them at dawn

entries.a: نِّعْمَةًۭ مِّنْ عِندِنَا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى مَن شَكَرَ
entries.t: A blessing from Us. Thus We reward the thankful.
entries.na: نعمه من عندنا كذلك نجزي من شكر
entries.nt: a blessing from us thus we reward the thankful

entries.a: وَلَقَدْ أَنذَرَهُم بَطْشَتَنَا فَتَمَارَوْا۟ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
entries.t: He had warned them of Our onslaught, but they dismissed the warnings.
entries.na: ولقد انذرهم بطشتنا فتماروا بالنذر
entries.nt: he had warned them of our onslaught but they dismissed the warnings

entries.a: وَلَقَدْ رَٰوَدُوهُ عَن ضَيْفِهِۦ فَطَمَسْنَآ أَعْيُنَهُمْ فَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
entries.t: They even lusted for his guest, so We obliterated their eyes. "So taste My punishment and My warnings."
entries.na: ولقد رودوه عن ضيفه فطمسنا اعينهم فذوقوا عذابي ونذر
entries.nt: they even lusted for his guest so we obliterated their eyes so taste my punishment and my warnings

entries.a: وَلَقَدْ صَبَّحَهُم بُكْرَةً عَذَابٌۭ مُّسْتَقِرٌّۭ
entries.t: Early morning brought upon them enduring punishment.
entries.na: ولقد صبحهم بكره عذاب مستقر
entries.nt: early morning brought upon them enduring punishment

entries.a: فَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
entries.t: So taste My punishment and My warnings.
entries.na: فذوقوا عذابي ونذر
entries.nt: so taste my punishment and my warnings

entries.a: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍۢ
entries.t: We made the Quran easy to memorize. Is there anyone who would memorize?
entries.na: ولقد يسرنا القران للذكر فهل من مدكر
entries.nt: we made the quran easy to memorize is there anyone who would memorize

entries.a: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَ ءَالَ فِرْعَوْنَ ٱلنُّذُرُ
entries.t: The warnings also came to the people of Pharaoh.
entries.na: ولقد جا ال فرعون النذر
entries.nt: the warnings also came to the people of pharaoh

entries.a: كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا كُلِّهَا فَأَخَذْنَٰهُمْ أَخْذَ عَزِيزٍۢ مُّقْتَدِرٍ
entries.t: They rejected Our signs, all of them, so We seized them-the seizure of an Almighty Omnipotent.
entries.na: كذبوا بايتنا كلها فاخذنهم اخذ عزيز مقتدر
entries.nt: they rejected our signs all of them so we seized them the seizure of an almighty omnipotent

entries.a: أَكُفَّارُكُمْ خَيْرٌۭ مِّنْ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكُمْ أَمْ لَكُم بَرَآءَةٌۭ فِى ٱلزُّبُرِ
entries.t: Are your unbelievers better than all those? Or do you have immunity in the scriptures?
entries.na: اكفاركم خير من اوليكم ام لكم براه في الزبر
entries.nt: are your unbelievers better than all those or do you have immunity in the scriptures

entries.a: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ نَحْنُ جَمِيعٌۭ مُّنتَصِرٌۭ
entries.t: Or do they say, "We are united, and we will be victorious"?
entries.na: ام يقولون نحن جميع منتصر
entries.nt: or do they say we are united and we will be victorious

entries.a: سَيُهْزَمُ ٱلْجَمْعُ وَيُوَلُّونَ ٱلدُّبُرَ
entries.t: The multitude will be defeated, and they will turn their backs.
entries.na: سيهزم الجمع ويولون الدبر
entries.nt: the multitude will be defeated and they will turn their backs

entries.a: بَلِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ مَوْعِدُهُمْ وَٱلسَّاعَةُ أَدْهَىٰ وَأَمَرُّ
entries.t: The Hour is their appointed time-the Hour is more disastrous, and most bitter.
entries.na: بل الساعه موعدهم والساعه ادهي وامر
entries.nt: the hour is their appointed time the hour is more disastrous and most bitter

entries.a: إِنَّ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ فِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ وَسُعُرٍۢ
entries.t: The wicked are in confusion and madness.
entries.na: ان المجرمين في ضلل وسعر
entries.nt: the wicked are in confusion and madness

entries.a: يَوْمَ يُسْحَبُونَ فِى ٱلنَّارِ عَلَىٰ وُجُوهِهِمْ ذُوقُوا۟ مَسَّ سَقَرَ
entries.t: The Day when they are dragged upon their faces into the Fire: "Taste the touch of Saqar."
entries.na: يوم يسحبون في النار علي وجوههم ذوقوا مس سقر
entries.nt: the day when they are dragged upon their faces into the fire taste the touch of saqar

entries.a: إِنَّا كُلَّ شَىْءٍ خَلَقْنَٰهُ بِقَدَرٍۢ
entries.t: Everything We created is precisely measured.
entries.na: انا كل شي خلقنه بقدر
entries.nt: everything we created is precisely measured

entries.a: وَمَآ أَمْرُنَآ إِلَّا وَٰحِدَةٌۭ كَلَمْحٍۭ بِٱلْبَصَرِ
entries.t: And Our command is but once, like the twinkling of an eye.
entries.na: وما امرنا الا وحده كلمح بالبصر
entries.nt: and our command is but once like the twinkling of an eye

entries.a: وَلَقَدْ أَهْلَكْنَآ أَشْيَاعَكُمْ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍۢ
entries.t: We have destroyed your likes. Is there anyone who would ponder?
entries.na: ولقد اهلكنا اشياعكم فهل من مدكر
entries.nt: we have destroyed your likes is there anyone who would ponder

entries.a: وَكُلُّ شَىْءٍۢ فَعَلُوهُ فِى ٱلزُّبُرِ
entries.t: Everything they have done is in the Books.
entries.na: وكل شي فعلوه في الزبر
entries.nt: everything they have done is in the books

entries.a: وَكُلُّ صَغِيرٍۢ وَكَبِيرٍۢ مُّسْتَطَرٌ
entries.t: Everything, small or large, is written down.
entries.na: وكل صغير وكبير مستطر
entries.nt: everything small or large is written down

entries.a: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّٰتٍۢ وَنَهَرٍۢ
entries.t: The righteous will be amidst gardens and rivers.
entries.na: ان المتقين في جنت ونهر
entries.nt: the righteous will be amidst gardens and rivers

entries.a: فِى مَقْعَدِ صِدْقٍ عِندَ مَلِيكٍۢ مُّقْتَدِرٍۭ
entries.t: In an assembly of virtue, in the presence of an Omnipotent King.
entries.na: في مقعد صدق عند مليك مقتدر
entries.nt: in an assembly of virtue in the presence of an omnipotent king

entries.a: ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ
entries.t: The Compassionate.
entries.na: الرحمن
entries.nt: the compassionate

entries.a: عَلَّمَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ
entries.t: Has taught the Quran.
entries.na: علم القران
entries.nt: has taught the quran

entries.a: خَلَقَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ
entries.t: He created man.
entries.na: خلق الانسن
entries.nt: he created man

entries.a: عَلَّمَهُ ٱلْبَيَانَ
entries.t: And taught him clear expression.
entries.na: علمه البيان
entries.nt: and taught him clear expression

entries.a: ٱلشَّمْسُ وَٱلْقَمَرُ بِحُسْبَانٍۢ
entries.t: The sun and the moon move according to plan.
entries.na: الشمس والقمر بحسبان
entries.nt: the sun and the moon move according to plan

entries.a: وَٱلنَّجْمُ وَٱلشَّجَرُ يَسْجُدَانِ

entries.t: So which of your Lord's marvels will you deny?
entries.na: فباي الا ربكما تكذبان
entries.nt: so which of your lord s marvels will you deny

entries.a: لَمْ يَطْمِثْهُنَّ إِنسٌۭ قَبْلَهُمْ وَلَا جَآنٌّۭ
entries.t: Whom no human has touched before, nor jinn.
entries.na: لم يطمثهن انس قبلهم ولا جان
entries.nt: whom no human has touched before nor jinn

entries.a: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
entries.t: So which of your Lord's marvels will you deny?
entries.na: فباي الا ربكما تكذبان
entries.nt: so which of your lord s marvels will you deny

entries.a: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَىٰ رَفْرَفٍ خُضْرٍۢ وَعَبْقَرِىٍّ حِسَانٍۢ
entries.t: Reclining on green cushions, and exquisite carpets.
entries.na: متكين علي رفرف خضر وعبقري حسان
entries.nt: reclining on green cushions and exquisite carpets

entries.a: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
entries.t: So which of your Lord's marvels will you deny?
entries.na: فباي الا ربكما تكذبان
entries.nt: so which of your lord s marvels will you deny

entries.a: تَبَٰرَكَ ٱسْمُ رَبِّكَ ذِى ٱلْجَلَٰلِ وَٱلْإِكْرَامِ
entries.t: Blessed be the name of your Lord, Full of Majesty and Splendor.
entries.na: تبرك اسم ربك ذي الجلل والاكرام
entries.nt: blessed be the name of your lord full of majesty and splendor

entries.a: إِذَا وَقَعَتِ ٱلْوَاقِعَةُ
entries.t: When the inevitable occurs.
entries.na: اذا وقعت الواقعه
entries.nt: when the inevitable occurs

entries.a: لَيْسَ لِوَقْعَتِهَا كَاذِبَةٌ
entries.t: Of its occurrence, there is no denial.
entries.na: ليس لوقعتها كاذبه
entries.nt: of its occurrence there is no denial

entries.a: خَافِضَةٌۭ رَّافِعَةٌ
entries.t: Bringing low, raising high.
entries.na: خافضه رافعه
entries.nt: bringing low raising high

entries.a: إِذَا رُجَّتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ رَجًّۭا
entries.t: When the earth is shaken with a shock.
entries.na: اذا رجت الارض رجا
entries.nt: when the earth is shaken with a shock

entries.a: وَبُسَّتِ ٱلْجِبَالُ بَسًّۭا
entries.t: And the mountains are crushed and crumbled.
entries.na: وبست الجبال بسا
entries.nt: and the mountains are crushed and crumbled

entries.a: فَكَانَتْ هَبَآءًۭ مُّنۢبَثًّۭا
entries.t: And they become scattered dust.
entries.na: فكانت هبا منبثا
entries.nt: and they become scattered dust

entries.a: وَكُنتُمْ أَزْوَٰجًۭا ثَلَٰثَةًۭ
entries.t: And you become three classes.
entries.na: وكنتم ازوجا ثلثه
entries.nt: and you become three classes

entries.a: فَأَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْمَيْمَنَةِ مَآ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْمَيْمَنَةِ
entries.t: Those on the Right-what of those on the Right?
entries.na: فاصحب الميمنه ما اصحب الميمنه
entries.nt: those on the right what of those on the right

entries.a: وَأَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْمَشْـَٔمَةِ مَآ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْمَشْـَٔمَةِ
entries.t: And those on the Left-what of those on the Left?
entries.na: واصحب المشمه ما اصحب المشمه
entries.nt: and those on the left what of those on the left

entries.a: وَٱلسَّٰبِقُونَ ٱلسَّٰبِقُونَ
entries.t: And the forerunners, the forerunners.
entries.na: والسبقون السبقون
entries.nt: and the forerunners the forerunners

entries.a: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلْمُقَرَّبُونَ
entries.t: Those are the nearest.
entries.na: اوليك المقربون
entries.nt: those are the nearest

entries.a: فِى جَنَّٰتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
entries.t: In the Gardens of Bliss.
entries.na: في جنت النعيم
entries.nt: in the gardens of bliss

entries.a: ثُلَّةٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
entries.t: A throng from the ancients.
entries.na: ثله من الاولين
entries.nt: a throng from the ancients

entries.a: وَقَلِيلٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلْءَاخِرِينَ
entries.t: And a small band from the latecomers.
entries.na: وقليل من الاخرين
entries.nt: and a small band from the latecomers

entries.a: عَلَىٰ سُرُرٍۢ مَّوْضُونَةٍۢ
entries.t: On luxurious furnishings.
entries.na: علي سرر موضونه
entries.nt: on luxurious furnishings

entries.a: مُّتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَيْهَا مُتَقَٰبِلِينَ
entries.t: Reclining on them, facing one another.
entries.na: متكين عليها متقبلين
entries.nt: reclining on them facing one another

entries.a: يَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ وِلْدَٰنٌۭ مُّخَلَّدُونَ
entries.t: Serving them will be immortalized youth.
entries.na: يطوف عليهم ولدن مخلدون
entries.nt: serving them will be immortalized youth

entries.a: بِأَكْوَابٍۢ وَأَبَارِيقَ وَكَأْسٍۢ مِّن مَّعِينٍۢ
entries.t: With cups, pitchers, and sparkling drinks.
entries.na: باكواب واباريق وكاس من معين
entries.nt: with cups pitchers and sparkling drinks

entries.a: لَّا يُصَدَّعُونَ عَنْهَا وَلَا يُنزِفُونَ
entries.t: Causing them neither headache, nor intoxication.
entries.na: لا يصدعون عنها ولا ينزفون
entries.nt: causing them neither headache nor intoxication

entries.a: وَفَٰكِهَةٍۢ مِّمَّا يَتَخَيَّرُونَ
entries.t: And fruits of their choice.
entries.na: وفكهه مما يتخيرون
entries.nt: and fruits of their choice

entries.a: وَلَحْمِ طَيْرٍۢ مِّمَّا يَشْتَهُونَ
entries.t: And meat of birds that they may desire.
entries.na: ولحم طير مما يشتهون
entries.nt: and meat of birds that they may desire

entries.a: وَحُورٌ عِينٌۭ
entries.t: And lovely companions.
entries.na: وحور عين
entries.nt: and lovely companions

entries.a: كَأَمْثَٰلِ ٱللُّؤْلُؤِ ٱلْمَكْنُونِ
entries.t: The likenesses of treasured pearls.
entries.na: كامثل اللولو المكنون
entries.nt: the likenesses of treasured pearls

entries.a: جَزَآءًۢ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
entries.t: As a reward for what they used to do.
entries.na: جزا بما كانوا يعملون
entries.nt: as a reward for what they used to do

entries.a: لَا يَسْمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغْوًۭا وَلَا تَأْثِيمًا
entries.t: Therein they will hear no nonsense, and no accusations.
entries.na: لا يسمعون فيها لغوا ولا تاثيما
entries.nt: therein they will hear no nonsense and no accusations

entries.a: إِلَّا قِيلًۭا سَلَٰمًۭا سَلَٰمًۭا
entries.t: But only the greeting: "Peace, peace."
entries.na: الا قيلا سلما سلما
entries.nt: but only the greeting peace peace

entries.a: وَأَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْيَمِينِ مَآ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْيَمِينِ
entries.t: And those on the Right-what of those on the Right?
entries.na: واصحب اليمين ما اصحب اليمين
entries.nt: and those on the right what of those on the right

entries.a: فِى سِدْرٍۢ مَّخْضُودٍۢ
entries.t: In lush orchards.
entries.na: في سدر مخضود
entries.nt: in lush orchards

entries.a: وَطَلْحٍۢ مَّنضُودٍۢ
entries.t: And sweet-smelling plants.
entries.na: وطلح منضود
entries.nt: and sweet smelling plants

entries.a: وَظِلٍّۢ مَّمْدُودٍۢ
entries.t: And extended shade.
entries.na: وظل ممدود
entries.nt: and extended shade

entries.a: وَمَآءٍۢ مَّسْكُوبٍۢ
entries.t: And outpouring water.
entries.na: وما مسكوب
entries.nt: and outpouring water

entries.a: وَفَٰكِهَةٍۢ كَثِيرَةٍۢ
entries.t: And abundant fruit.
entries.na: وفكهه كثيره
entries.nt: and abundant fruit

entries.a: لَّا مَقْطُوعَةٍۢ وَلَا مَمْنُوعَةٍۢ
entries.t: Neither withheld, nor forbidden.
entries.na: لا مقطوعه ولا ممنوعه
entries.nt: neither withheld nor forbidden

entries.a: وَفُرُشٍۢ مَّرْفُوعَةٍ
entries.t: And uplifted mattresses.
entries.na: وفرش مرفوعه
entries.nt: and uplifted mattresses

entries.a: إِنَّآ أَنشَأْنَٰهُنَّ إِنشَآءًۭ
entries.t: We have created them of special creation.
entries.na: انا انشانهن انشا
entries.nt: we have created them of special creation

entries.a: فَجَعَلْنَٰهُنَّ أَبْكَارًا
entries.t: And made them virgins.
entries.na: فجعلنهن ابكارا
entries.nt: and made them virgins

entries.a: عُرُبًا أَتْرَابًۭا
entries.t: Tender and un-aging.
entries.na: عربا اترابا
entries.nt: tender and un aging

entries.a: لِّأَصْحَٰبِ ٱلْيَمِينِ
entries.t: For those on the Right.
entries.na: لاصحب اليمين
entries.nt: for those on the right

entries.a: ثُلَّةٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
entries.t: A throng from the ancients.
entries.na: ثله من الاولين
entries.nt: a throng from the ancients

entries.a: وَثُلَّةٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلْءَاخِرِينَ
entries.t: And a throng from the latecomers.
entries.na: وثله من الاخرين
entries.nt: and a throng from the latecomers

entries.a: وَأَصْحَٰبُ ٱلشِّمَالِ مَآ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلشِّمَالِ
entries.t: And those on the Left-what of those on the Left?
entries.na: واصحب الشمال ما اصحب الشمال
entries.nt: and those on the left what of those on the left

entries.a: فِى سَمُومٍۢ وَحَمِيمٍۢ
entries.t: Amid searing wind and boiling water.
entries.na: في سموم وحميم
entries.nt: amid searing wind and boiling water

entries.a: وَظِلٍّۢ مِّن يَحْمُومٍۢ
entries.t: And a shadow of thick smoke.
entries.na: وظل من يحموم
entries.nt: and a shadow of thick smoke

entries.a: لَّا بَارِدٍۢ وَلَا كَرِيمٍ
entries.t: Neither cool, nor refreshing.
entries.na: لا بارد ولا كريم
entries.nt: neither cool nor refreshing

entries.a: إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَبْلَ ذَٰلِكَ مُتْرَفِينَ
entries.t: They had lived before that in luxury.
entries.na: انهم كانوا قبل ذلك مترفين
entries.nt: they had lived before that in luxury

entries.a: وَكَانُوا۟ يُصِرُّونَ عَلَى ٱلْحِنثِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
entries.t: And they used to persist in immense wrongdoing.
entries.na: وكانوا يصرون علي الحنث العظيم
entries.nt: and they used to persist in immense wrongdoing

entries.a: وَكَانُوا۟ يَقُولُونَ أَئِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًۭا وَعِظَٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ
entries.t: And they used to say, "When we are dead and turned into dust and bones, are we to be resurrected?
entries.na: وكانوا يقولون ايذا متنا وكنا ترابا وعظما انا لمبعوثون
entries.nt: and they used to say when we are dead and turned into dust and bones are we to be resurrected

entries.a: أَوَءَابَآؤُنَا ٱلْأَوَّلُونَ
entries.t: And our ancient ancestors too?"
entries.na: اواباونا الاولون
entries.nt: and our ancient ancestors too

entries.a: قُلْ إِنَّ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ وَٱلْءَاخِرِينَ
entries.t: Say, "The first and the last.
entries.na: قل ان الاولين والاخرين
entries.nt: say the first and the last

entries.a: لَمَجْمُوعُونَ إِلَىٰ مِيقَٰتِ يَوْمٍۢ مَّعْلُومٍۢ
entries.t: Will be gathered for the appointment of a familiar Day."
entries.na: لمجموعون الي ميقت يوم معلوم
entries.nt: will be gathered for the appointment of a familiar day

entries.a: ثُمَّ إِنَّكُمْ أَيُّهَا ٱلضَّآلُّونَ ٱلْمُكَذِّبُونَ
entries.t: Then you, you misguided, who deny the truth.
entries.na: ثم انكم ايها الضالون المكذبون
entries.nt: then you you misguided who deny the truth

entries.a: لَءَاكِلُونَ مِن شَجَرٍۢ مِّن زَقُّومٍۢ
entries.t: Will be eating from the Tree of Bitterness.
entries.na: لاكلون من شجر من زقوم
entries.nt: will be eating from the tree of bitterness

entries.a: فَمَالِـُٔونَ مِنْهَا ٱلْبُطُونَ
entries.t: Will be filling your bellies with it.
entries.na: فمالون منها البطون
entries.nt: will be filling your bellies with it

entries.a: فَشَٰرِبُونَ عَلَيْهِ مِنَ ٱلْحَمِيمِ
entries.t: Will be drinking on top of it boiling water.
entries.na: فشربون عليه من الحميم
entries.nt: will be drinking on top of it boiling water

entries.a: فَشَٰرِبُونَ شُرْبَ ٱلْهِيمِ
entries.t: Drinking like thirsty camels drink.
entries.na: فشربون شرب الهيم
entries.nt: drinking like thirsty camels drink

entries.a: هَٰذَا نُزُلُهُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلدِّينِ
entries.t: That is their hospitality on the Day of Retribution.
entries.na: هذا نزلهم يوم الدين
entries.nt: that is their hospitality on the day of retribution

entries.a: نَحْنُ خَلَقْنَٰكُمْ فَلَوْلَا تُصَدِّقُونَ
entries.t: We created you-if only you would believe!
entries.na: نحن خلقنكم فلولا تصدقون
entries.nt: we created you if only you would believe

entries.a: أَفَرَءَيْتُم مَّا تُمْنُونَ
entries.t: Have you seen what you ejaculate?
entries.na: افريتم ما تمنون
entries.nt: have you seen what you ejaculate

entries.a: ءَأَنتُمْ تَخْلُقُونَهُۥٓ أَمْ نَحْنُ ٱلْخَٰلِقُونَ
entries.t: Is it you who create it, or are We the Creator?
entries.na: انتم تخلقونه ام نحن الخلقون
entries.nt: is it you who create it or are we the creator

entries.a: نَحْنُ قَدَّرْنَا بَيْنَكُمُ ٱلْمَوْتَ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَسْبُوقِينَ
entries.t: We have decreed death among you, and We will not be outstripped.
entries.na: نحن قدرنا بينكم الموت وما نحن بمسبوقين
entries.nt: we have decreed death among you and we will not be outstripped

entries.a: عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّبَدِّلَ أَمْثَٰلَكُمْ وَنُنشِئَكُمْ فِى مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
entries.t: In replacing you with your likes, and transforming you into what you do not know.
entries.na: علي ان نبدل امثلكم وننشيكم في ما لا تعلمون
entries.nt: in replacing you with your likes and transforming you into what you do not know

entries.a: وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْتُمُ ٱلنَّشْأَةَ ٱلْأُولَىٰ فَلَوْلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ
entries.t: You have known the first formation; if only you would remember.
entries.na: ولقد علمتم النشاه الاولي فلولا تذكرون
entries.nt: you have known the first formation if only you would remember

entries.a: أَفَرَءَيْتُم مَّا تَحْرُثُونَ
entries.t: Have you seen what you cultivate?
entries.na: افريتم ما تحرثون
entries.nt: have you seen what you cultivate

entries.a: ءَأَنتُمْ تَزْرَعُونَهُۥٓ أَمْ نَحْنُ ٱلزَّٰرِعُونَ
entries.t: Is it you who make it grow, or are We the Grower?
entries.na: انتم تزرعونه ام نحن الزرعون
entries.nt: is it you who make it grow or are we the grower

entries.a: لَوْ نَشَآءُ لَجَعَلْنَٰهُ حُطَٰمًۭا فَظَلْتُمْ تَفَكَّهُونَ
entries.t: If We will, We can turn it into rubble; then you will lament.
entries.na: لو نشا لجعلنه حطما فظلتم تفكهون
entries.nt: if we will we can turn it into rubble then you will lament

entries.a: إِنَّا لَمُغْرَمُونَ
entries.t: "We are penalized.
entries.na: انا لمغرمون
entries.nt: we are penalized

entries.a: بَلْ نَحْنُ مَحْرُومُونَ
entries.t: No, we are being deprived."
entries.na: بل نحن محرومون
entries.nt: no we are being deprived

entries.a: أَفَرَءَيْتُمُ ٱلْمَآءَ ٱلَّذِى تَشْرَبُونَ
entries.t: Have you seen the water you drink?
entries.na: افريتم الما الذي تشربون
entries.nt: have you seen the water you drink

entries.a: ءَأَنتُمْ أَنزَلْتُمُوهُ مِنَ ٱلْمُزْنِ أَمْ نَحْنُ ٱلْمُنزِلُونَ
entries.t: Is it you who sent it down from the clouds, or are We the Sender?
entries.na: انتم انزلتموه من المزن ام نحن المنزلون
entries.nt: is it you who sent it down from the clouds or are we the sender

entries.a: لَوْ نَشَآءُ جَعَلْنَٰهُ أُجَاجًۭا فَلَوْلَا تَشْكُرُونَ
entries.t: If We will, We can make it salty. Will you not be thankful?
entries.na: لو نشا جعلنه اجاجا فلولا تشكرون
entries.nt: if we will we can make it salty will you not be thankful

entries.a: أَفَرَءَيْتُمُ ٱلنَّارَ ٱلَّتِى تُورُونَ
entries.t: Have you seen the fire you kindle?
entries.na: افريتم النار التي تورون
entries.nt: have you seen the fire you kindle

entries.a: ءَأَنتُمْ أَنشَأْتُمْ شَجَرَتَهَآ أَمْ نَحْنُ ٱلْمُنشِـُٔونَ
entries.t: Is it you who produce its tree, or are We the Producer?
entries.na: انتم انشاتم شجرتها ام نحن المنشون
entries.nt: is it you who produce its tree or are we the producer

entries.a: نَحْنُ جَعَلْنَٰهَا تَذْكِرَةًۭ وَمَتَٰعًۭا لِّلْمُقْوِينَ
entries.t: We have made it a reminder, and a comfort for the users.
entries.na: نحن جعلنها تذكره ومتعا للمقوين
entries.nt: we have made it a reminder and a comfort for the users

entries.a: فَسَبِّحْ بِٱسْمِ رَبِّكَ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
entries.t: So glorify the Name of your Great Lord.
entries.na: فسبح باسم ربك العظيم
entries.nt: so glorify the name of your great lord

entries.a: ۞ فَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِمَوَٰقِعِ ٱلنُّجُومِ
entries.t: I swear by the locations of the stars.
entries.na: فلا اقسم بموقع النجوم
entries.nt: i swear by the locations of the stars

entries.a: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَقَسَمٌۭ لَّوْ تَعْلَمُونَ عَظِيمٌ
entries.t: It is an oath, if you only knew, that is tremendous.
entries.na: وانه لقسم لو تعلمون عظيم
entries.nt: it is an oath if you only knew that is tremendous

entries.a: إِنَّهُۥ لَقُرْءَانٌۭ كَرِيمٌۭ
entries.t: It is a noble Quran.
entries.na: انه لقران كريم
entries.nt: it is a noble quran

entries.a: فِى كِتَٰبٍۢ مَّكْنُونٍۢ
entries.t: In a well-protected Book.
entries.na: في كتب مكنون
entries.nt: in a well protected book

entries.a: لَّا يَمَسُّهُۥٓ إِلَّا ٱلْمُطَهَّرُونَ
entries.t: None can grasp it except the purified.
entries.na: لا يمسه الا المطهرون
entries.nt: none can grasp it except the purified

entries.a: تَنزِيلٌۭ مِّن رَّبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
entries.t: A revelation from the Lord of the Worlds.
entries.na: تنزيل من رب العلمين
entries.nt: a revelation from the lord of the worlds

entries.a: أَفَبِهَٰذَا ٱلْحَدِيثِ أَنتُم مُّدْهِنُونَ
entries.t: Is it this discourse that you take so lightly?
entries.na: افبهذا الحديث انتم مدهنون
entries.nt: is it this discourse that you take so lightly

entries.a: وَتَجْعَلُونَ رِزْقَكُمْ أَنَّكُمْ تُكَذِّبُونَ
entries.t: And you make it your livelihood to deny it?
entries.na: وتجعلون رزقكم انكم تكذبون
entries.nt: and you make it your livelihood to deny it

entries.a: فَلَوْلَآ إِذَا بَلَغَتِ ٱلْحُلْقُومَ
entries.t: So when it has reached the throat.
entries.na: فلولا اذا بلغت الحلقوم
entries.nt: so when it has reached the throat

entries.a: وَأَنتُمْ حِينَئِذٍۢ تَنظُرُونَ
entries.t: As you are looking on.
entries.na: وانتم حينيذ تنظرون
entries.nt: as you are looking on

entries.a: وَنَحْنُ أَقْرَبُ إِلَيْهِ مِنكُمْ وَلَٰكِن لَّا تُبْصِرُونَ
entries.t: We are nearer to it than you are, but you do not see.
entries.na: ونحن اقرب اليه منكم ولكن لا تبصرون
entries.nt: we are nearer to it than you are but you do not see

entries.a: فَلَوْلَآ إِن كُنتُمْ غَيْرَ مَدِينِينَ
entries.t: If you are not held to account.
entries.na: فلولا ان كنتم غير مدينين
entries.nt: if you are not held to account

entries.a: تَرْجِعُونَهَآ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ
entries.t: Then bring it back, if you are truthful.
entries.na: ترجعونها ان كنتم صدقين
entries.nt: then bring it back if you are truthful

entries.a: فَأَمَّآ إِن كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُقَرَّبِينَ
entries.t: But if he is one of those brought near.
entries.na: فاما ان كان من المقربين
entries.nt: but if he is one of those brought near

entries.a: فَرَوْحٌۭ وَرَيْحَانٌۭ وَجَنَّتُ نَعِيمٍۢ
entries.t: Then happiness, and flowers, and Garden of Delights.
entries.na: فروح وريحان وجنت نعيم
entries.nt: then happiness and flowers and garden of delights

entries.a: وَأَمَّآ إِن كَانَ مِنْ أَصْحَٰبِ ٱلْيَمِينِ
entries.t: And if he is one of those on the Right.
entries.na: واما ان كان من اصحب اليمين
entries.nt: and if he is one of those on the right

entries.a: فَسَلَٰمٌۭ لَّكَ مِنْ أَصْحَٰبِ ٱلْيَمِينِ
entries.t: Then, "Peace upon you," from those on the Right.
entries.na: فسلم لك من اصحب اليمين
entries.nt: then peace upon you from those on the right

entries.a: وَأَمَّآ إِن كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ
entries.t: But if he is one of the deniers, the mistaken.
entries.na: واما ان كان من المكذبين الضالين
entries.nt: but if he is one of the deniers the mistaken

entries.a: فَنُزُلٌۭ مِّنْ حَمِيمٍۢ
entries.t: Then a welcome of Inferno.
entries.na: فنزل من حميم
entries.nt: then a welcome of inferno

entries.a: وَتَصْلِيَةُ جَحِيمٍ
entries.t: And burning in Hell.
entries.na: وتصليه جحيم
entries.nt: and burning in hell

entries.a: إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَهُوَ حَقُّ ٱلْيَقِينِ
entries.t: This is the certain truth.
entries.na: ان هذا لهو حق اليقين
entries.nt: this is the certain truth

entries.a: فَسَبِّحْ بِٱسْمِ رَبِّكَ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
entries.t: So glorify the Name of your Lord, the Magnificent
entries.na: فسبح باسم ربك العظيم
entries.nt: so glorify the name of your lord the magnificent

entries.a: سَبَّحَ لِلَّهِ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
entries.t: Glorifying God is everything in the heavens and the earth. He is the Almighty, the Wise.
entries.na: سبح لله ما في السموت والارض وهو العزيز الحكيم
entries.nt: glorifying god is everything in the heavens and the earth he is the almighty the wise

entries.a: لَهُۥ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ يُحْىِۦ وَيُمِيتُ ۖ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ قَدِيرٌ
entries.t: To Him belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth. He gives life and causes death, and He has power over all things.
entries.na: له ملك السموت والارض يحي ويميت وهو علي كل شي قدير
entries.nt: to him belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth he gives life and causes death and he has power over all things

entries.a: هُوَ ٱلْأَوَّلُ وَٱلْءَاخِرُ وَٱلظَّٰهِرُ وَٱلْبَاطِنُ ۖ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌ
entries.t: He is the First and the Last, and the Outer and the Inner, and He has knowledge of all things.
entries.na: هو الاول والاخر والظهر والباطن وهو بكل شي عليم
entries.nt: he is the first and the last and the outer and the inner and he has knowledge of all things

entries.a: هُوَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ فِى سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍۢ ثُمَّ ٱسْتَوَىٰ عَلَى ٱلْعَرْشِ ۚ يَعْلَمُ مَا يَلِجُ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا يَخْرُجُ مِنْهَا وَمَا يَنزِلُ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَمَا يَعْرُجُ فِيهَا ۖ وَهُوَ مَعَكُمْ أَيْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌۭ
entries.t: It is He who created the heavens and the earth in six days, then settled over the Throne. He knows what penetrates into the earth, and what comes out of it, and what descends from the sky, and what ascends to it. And He is with you wherever you may be. God is Seeing of everything you do.
entries.na: هو الذي خلق السموت والارض في سته ايام ثم استوي علي العرش يعلم ما يلج في الارض وما يخرج منها وما ينزل من السما وما يعرج فيها وهو معكم اين ما كنتم والله بما تعملون بصير
entries.nt: it is he who created the heavens and the earth in six days then settled over the throne he knows what penetrates into the earth and what comes out of it and what descends from the sky and what ascends to it and he is with you wherever you may be god is seeing of everything you do

entries.a: لَّهُۥ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ وَإِلَى ٱللَّهِ تُرْجَعُ ٱلْأُمُورُ
entries.t: To Him belongs the kingship of the heavens and the earth, and to God all matters are referred.
entries.na: له ملك السموت والارض والي الله ترجع الامور
entries.nt: to him belongs the kingship of the heavens and the earth and to god all matters are referred

entries.a: يُولِجُ ٱلَّيْلَ فِى ٱلنَّهَارِ وَيُولِجُ ٱلنَّهَارَ فِى ٱلَّيْلِ ۚ وَهُوَ عَلِيمٌۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ
entries.t: He merges the night into the day, and He merges the day into the night; and He knows what the hearts contains.
entries.na: يولج اليل في النهار ويولج النهار في اليل وهو عليم بذات الصدور
entries.nt: he merges the night into the day and he merges the day into the night and he knows what the hearts contains

entries.a: ءَامِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ وَأَنفِقُوا۟ مِمَّا جَعَلَكُم مُّسْتَخْلَفِينَ فِيهِ ۖ فَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مِنكُمْ وَأَنفَقُوا۟ لَهُمْ أَجْرٌۭ كَبِيرٌۭ
entries.t: Believe in God and His Messenger, and spend from what He made you inherit. Those among you who believe and give will have a great reward.
entries.na: امنوا بالله ورسوله وانفقوا مما جعلكم مستخلفين فيه فالذين امنوا منكم وانفقوا لهم اجر كبير
entries.nt: believe in god and his messenger and spend from what he made you inherit those among you who believe and give will have a great reward

entries.a: وَمَا لَكُمْ لَا تُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱللَّهِ ۙ وَٱلرَّسُولُ يَدْعُوكُمْ لِتُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِرَبِّكُمْ وَقَدْ أَخَذَ مِيثَٰقَكُمْ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
entries.t: What is the matter with you that you do not believe in God, when the Messenger calls you to believe in your Lord, and He has received a pledge from you, if you are believers?
entries.na: وما لكم لا تومنون بالله والرسول يدعوكم لتومنوا بربكم وقد اخذ ميثقكم ان كنتم مومنين
entries.nt: what is the matter with you that you do not believe in god when the messenger calls you to believe in your lord and he has received a pledge from you if you are believers

entries.a: هُوَ ٱلَّذِى يُنَزِّلُ عَلَىٰ عَبْدِهِۦٓ ءَايَٰتٍۭ بَيِّنَٰتٍۢ لِّيُخْرِجَكُم مِّنَ ٱلظُّلُمَٰتِ إِلَى ٱلنُّورِ ۚ وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِكُمْ لَرَءُوفٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۭ
entries.t: It is He who sends down upon His servant clear revelations, to bring you out of darkness into the light. God is Gentle towards you, Most Compassionate.
entries.na: هو الذي ينزل علي عبده ايت بينت ليخرجكم من الظلمت الي النور وان الله بكم لروف رحيم
entries.nt: it is he who sends down upon his servant clear revelations to bring you out of darkness into the light god is gentle towards you most compassionate

entries.a: وَمَا لَكُمْ أَلَّا تُنفِقُوا۟ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَلِلَّهِ مِيرَٰثُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ لَا يَسْتَوِى مِنكُم مَّنْ أَنفَقَ مِن قَبْلِ ٱلْفَتْحِ وَقَٰتَلَ ۚ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ أَعْظَمُ دَرَجَةًۭ مِّنَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَنفَقُوا۟ مِنۢ بَعْدُ وَقَٰتَلُوا۟ ۚ وَكُلًّۭا وَعَدَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْحُسْنَىٰ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرٌۭ
entries.t: And why is it that you do not spend in the cause of God, when to God belongs the inheritance of the heavens and the earth? Not equal among you are those who contributed before the conquest, and fought. Those are higher in rank than those who contributed afterwards, and fought. But God promises both a good reward. God is Well Experienced in what you do.
entries.na: وما لكم الا تنفقوا في سبيل الله ولله ميرث السموت والارض لا يستوي منكم من انفق من قبل الفتح وقتل اوليك اعظم درجه من الذين انفقوا من بعد وقتلوا وكلا وعد الله الحسني والله بما تعملون خبير
entries.nt: and why is it that you do not spend in the cause of god when to god belongs the inheritance of the heavens and the earth not equal among you are those who contributed before the conquest and fought those are higher in rank than those who contributed afterwards and fought but god promises both a good reward god is well experienced in what you do

entries.a: مَّن ذَا ٱلَّذِى يُقْرِضُ ٱللَّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًۭا فَيُضَٰعِفَهُۥ لَهُۥ وَلَهُۥٓ أَجْرٌۭ كَرِيمٌۭ
entries.t: Who is he who will lend God a loan of goodness, that He may double it for him, and will have a generous reward?
entries.na: من ذا الذي يقرض الله قرضا حسنا فيضعفه له وله اجر كريم
entries.nt: who is he who will lend god a loan of goodness that he may double it for him and will have a generous reward

entries.a: يَوْمَ تَرَى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَٰتِ يَسْعَىٰ نُورُهُم بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَبِأَيْمَٰنِهِم بُشْرَىٰكُمُ ٱلْيَوْمَ جَنَّٰتٌۭ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ
entries.t: On the Day when you see the believing men and believing women-their light radiating ahead of them, and to their right: "Good news for you today: gardens beneath which rivers flow, dwelling therein forever. That is the great triumph."
entries.na: يوم تري المومنين والمومنت يسعي نورهم بين ايديهم وبايمنهم بشريكم اليوم جنت تجري من تحتها الانهر خلدين فيها ذلك هو الفوز العظيم
entries.nt: on the day when you see the believing men and believing women their light radiating ahead of them and to their right good news for you today gardens beneath which rivers flow dwelling therein forever that is the great triumph

entries.a: يَوْمَ يَقُولُ ٱلْمُنَٰفِقُونَ وَٱلْمُنَٰفِقَٰتُ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱنظُرُونَا نَقْتَبِسْ مِن نُّورِكُمْ قِيلَ ٱرْجِعُوا۟ وَرَآءَكُمْ فَٱلْتَمِسُوا۟ نُورًۭا فَضُرِبَ بَيْنَهُم بِسُورٍۢ لَّهُۥ بَابٌۢ بَاطِنُهُۥ فِيهِ ٱلرَّحْمَةُ وَظَٰهِرُهُۥ مِن قِبَلِهِ ٱلْعَذَابُ
entries.t: On the Day when the hypocritical men and hypocritical women will say to those who believed, "Wait for us; let us absorb some of your light." It will be said, "Go back behind you, and seek light." A wall will be raised between them, in which is a door; within it is mercy, and outside it is agony.
entries.na: يوم يقول المنفقون والمنفقت للذين امنوا انظرونا نقتبس من نوركم قيل ارجعوا وراكم فالتمسوا نورا فضرب بينهم بسور له باب باطنه فيه الرحمه وظهره من قبله العذاب
entries.nt: on the day when the hypocritical men and hypocritical women will say to those who believed wait for us let us absorb some of your light it will be said go back behind you and seek light a wall will be raised between them in which is a door within it is mercy and outside it is agony

entries.a: يُنَادُونَهُمْ أَلَمْ نَكُن مَّعَكُمْ ۖ قَالُوا۟ بَلَىٰ وَلَٰكِنَّكُمْ فَتَنتُمْ أَنفُسَكُمْ وَتَرَبَّصْتُمْ وَٱرْتَبْتُمْ وَغَرَّتْكُمُ ٱلْأَمَانِىُّ حَتَّىٰ جَآءَ أَمْرُ ٱللَّهِ وَغَرَّكُم بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْغَرُورُ
entries.t: They will call to them, "Were we not with you?" They will say, "Yes, but you cheated your souls, and waited, and doubted, and became deluded by wishful thinking, until the command of God arrived; and arrogance deceived you regarding God."
entries.na: ينادونهم الم نكن معكم قالوا بلي ولكنكم فتنتم انفسكم وتربصتم وارتبتم وغرتكم الاماني حتي جا امر الله وغركم بالله الغرور
entries.nt: they will call to them were we not with you they will say yes but you cheated your souls and waited and doubted and became deluded by wishful thinking until the command of god arrived and arrogance deceived you regarding god

entries.a: فَٱلْيَوْمَ لَا يُؤْخَذُ مِنكُمْ فِدْيَةٌۭ وَلَا مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ۚ مَأْوَىٰكُمُ ٱلنَّارُ ۖ هِىَ مَوْلَىٰكُمْ ۖ وَبِئْسَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
entries.t: "Therefore, today no ransom will be accepted from you, nor from those who disbelieved. The Fire is your refuge. It is your companion-what an evil fate!"
entries.na: فاليوم لا يوخذ منكم فديه ولا من الذين كفروا ماويكم النار هي موليكم وبيس المصير
entries.nt: therefore today no ransom will be accepted from you nor from those who disbelieved the fire is your refuge it is your companion what an evil fate

entries.a: ۞ أَلَمْ يَأْنِ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ أَن تَخْشَعَ قُلُوبُهُمْ لِذِكْرِ ٱللَّهِ وَمَا نَزَلَ مِنَ ٱلْحَقِّ وَلَا يَكُونُوا۟ كَٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ مِن قَبْلُ فَطَالَ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْأَمَدُ فَقَسَتْ قُلُوبُهُمْ ۖ وَكَثِيرٌۭ مِّنْهُمْ فَٰسِقُونَ
entries.t: Is it not time for those who believe to surrender their hearts to the remembrance of God, and to the truth that has come down, and not be like those who were given the Book previously, but time became prolonged for them, so their hearts hardened, and many of them are sinners?
entries.na: الم يان للذين امنوا ان تخشع قلوبهم لذكر الله وما نزل من الحق ولا يكونوا كالذين اوتوا الكتب من قبل فطال عليهم الامد فقست قلوبهم وكثير منهم فسقون
entries.nt: is it not time for those who believe to surrender their hearts to the remembrance of god and to the truth that has come down and not be like those who were given the book previously but time became prolonged for them so their hearts hardened and many of them are sinners

entries.a: ٱعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُحْىِ ٱلْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَا ۚ قَدْ بَيَّنَّا لَكُمُ ٱلْءَايَٰتِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ
entries.t: Know that God revives the earth after its death. We thus explain the revelations for you, so that you may understand.
entries.na: اعلموا ان الله يحي الارض بعد موتها قد بينا لكم الايت لعلكم تعقلون
entries.nt: know that god revives the earth after its death we thus explain the revelations for you so that you may understand

entries.a: إِنَّ ٱلْمُصَّدِّقِينَ وَٱلْمُصَّدِّقَٰتِ وَأَقْرَضُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًۭا يُضَٰعَفُ لَهُمْ وَلَهُمْ أَجْرٌۭ كَرِيمٌۭ
entries.t: The charitable men and charitable women, who have loaned God a loan of righteousness-it will be multiplied for them, and for them is a generous reward.
entries.na: ان المصدقين والمصدقت واقرضوا الله قرضا حسنا يضعف لهم ولهم اجر كريم
entries.nt: the charitable men and charitable women who have loaned god a loan of righteousness it will be multiplied for them and for them is a generous reward

entries.a: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ وَرُسُلِهِۦٓ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلصِّدِّيقُونَ ۖ وَٱلشُّهَدَآءُ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ لَهُمْ أَجْرُهُمْ وَنُورُهُمْ ۖ وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَكَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
entries.t: Those who believe in God and His messengers-these are the sincere and the witnesses with their Lord; they will have their reward and their light. But as for those who disbelieve and deny Our revelations-these are the inmates of the Blaze.
entries.na: والذين امنوا بالله ورسله اوليك هم الصديقون والشهدا عند ربهم لهم اجرهم ونورهم والذين كفروا وكذبوا بايتنا اوليك اصحب الجحيم
entries.nt: those who believe in god and his messengers these are the sincere and the witnesses with their lord they will have their reward and their light but as for those who disbelieve and deny our revelations these are the inmates of the blaze

entries.a: ٱعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّمَا ٱلْحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنْيَا لَعِبٌۭ وَلَهْوٌۭ وَزِينَةٌۭ وَتَفَاخُرٌۢ بَيْنَكُمْ وَتَكَاثُرٌۭ فِى ٱلْأَمْوَٰلِ وَٱلْأَوْلَٰدِ ۖ كَمَثَلِ غَيْثٍ أَعْجَبَ ٱلْكُفَّارَ نَبَاتُهُۥ ثُمَّ يَهِيجُ فَتَرَىٰهُ مُصْفَرًّۭا ثُمَّ يَكُونُ حُطَٰمًۭا ۖ وَفِى ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ عَذَابٌۭ شَدِيدٌۭ وَمَغْفِرَةٌۭ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَرِضْوَٰنٌۭ ۚ وَمَا ٱلْحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنْيَآ إِلَّا مَتَٰعُ ٱلْغُرُورِ
entries.t: Know that the worldly life is only play, and distraction, and glitter, and boasting among you, and rivalry in wealth and children. It is like a rainfall that produces plants, and delights the disbelievers. But then it withers, and you see it yellowing, and then it becomes debris. While in the Hereafter there is severe agony, and forgiveness from God, and acceptance. The life of this world is nothing but enjoyment of vanity.
entries.na: اعلموا انما الحيوه الدنيا لعب ولهو وزينه وتفاخر بينكم وتكاثر في الامول والاولد كمثل غيث اعجب الكفار نباته ثم يهيج فتريه مصفرا ثم يكون حطما وفي الاخره عذاب شديد ومغفره من الله ورضون وما الحيوه الدنيا الا متع الغرور
entries.nt: know that the worldly life is only play and distraction and glitter and boasting among you and rivalry in wealth and children it is like a rainfall that produces plants and delights the disbelievers but then it withers and you see it yellowing and then it becomes debris while in the hereafter there is severe agony and forgiveness from god and acceptance the life of this world is nothing but enjoyment of vanity

entries.a: سَابِقُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ مَغْفِرَةٍۢ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ وَجَنَّةٍ عَرْضُهَا كَعَرْضِ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ أُعِدَّتْ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ وَرُسُلِهِۦ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ فَضْلُ ٱللَّهِ يُؤْتِيهِ مَن يَشَآءُ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ ذُو ٱلْفَضْلِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
entries.t: Race towards forgiveness from your Lord; and a Garden as vast as the heavens and the earth, prepared for those who believe in God and His messengers. That is the grace of God; He bestows it on whomever He wills. God is the Possessor of Immense Grace.
entries.na: سابقوا الي مغفره من ربكم وجنه عرضها كعرض السما والارض اعدت للذين امنوا بالله ورسله ذلك فضل الله يوتيه من يشا والله ذو الفضل العظيم
entries.nt: race towards forgiveness from your lord and a garden as vast as the heavens and the earth prepared for those who believe in god and his messengers that is the grace of god he bestows it on whomever he wills god is the possessor of immense grace

entries.a: مَآ أَصَابَ مِن مُّصِيبَةٍۢ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِىٓ أَنفُسِكُمْ إِلَّا فِى كِتَٰبٍۢ مِّن قَبْلِ أَن نَّبْرَأَهَآ ۚ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ يَسِيرٌۭ
entries.t: No calamity occurs on earth, or in your souls, but it is in a Book, even before We make it happen. That is easy for God.
entries.na: ما اصاب من مصيبه في الارض ولا في انفسكم الا في كتب من قبل ان نبراها ان ذلك علي الله يسير
entries.nt: no calamity occurs on earth or in your souls but it is in a book even before we make it happen that is easy for god

entries.a: لِّكَيْلَا تَأْسَوْا۟ عَلَىٰ مَا فَاتَكُمْ وَلَا تَفْرَحُوا۟ بِمَآ ءَاتَىٰكُمْ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ لَا يُحِبُّ كُلَّ مُخْتَالٍۢ فَخُورٍ
entries.t: That you may not sorrow over what eludes you, nor exult over what He has given you. God does not love the proud snob.
entries.na: لكيلا تاسوا علي ما فاتكم ولا تفرحوا بما اتيكم والله لا يحب كل مختال فخور
entries.nt: that you may not sorrow over what eludes you nor exult over what he has given you god does not love the proud snob

entries.a: ٱلَّذِينَ يَبْخَلُونَ وَيَأْمُرُونَ ٱلنَّاسَ بِٱلْبُخْلِ ۗ وَمَن يَتَوَلَّ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلْغَنِىُّ ٱلْحَمِيدُ
entries.t: Those who are stingy, and induce people to be stingy. Whoever turns away-God is the Independent, the Praiseworthy.
entries.na: الذين يبخلون ويامرون الناس بالبخل ومن يتول فان الله هو الغني الحميد
entries.nt: those who are stingy and induce people to be stingy whoever turns away god is the independent the praiseworthy

entries.a: لَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا رُسُلَنَا بِٱلْبَيِّنَٰتِ وَأَنزَلْنَا مَعَهُمُ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ وَٱلْمِيزَانَ لِيَقُومَ ٱلنَّاسُ بِٱلْقِسْطِ ۖ وَأَنزَلْنَا ٱلْحَدِيدَ فِيهِ بَأْسٌۭ شَدِيدٌۭ وَمَنَٰفِعُ لِلنَّاسِ وَلِيَعْلَمَ ٱللَّهُ مَن يَنصُرُهُۥ وَرُسُلَهُۥ بِٱلْغَيْبِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ قَوِىٌّ عَزِيزٌۭ
entries.t: We sent Our messengers with the clear proofs, and We sent down with them the Book and the Balance, that humanity may uphold justice. And We sent down iron, in which is violent force, and benefits for humanity. That God may know who supports Him and His messengers invisibly. God is Strong and Powerful.
entries.na: لقد ارسلنا رسلنا بالبينت وانزلنا معهم الكتب والميزان ليقوم الناس بالقسط وانزلنا الحديد فيه باس شديد ومنفع للناس وليعلم الله من ينصره ورسله بالغيب ان الله قوي عزيز
entries.nt: we sent our messengers with the clear proofs and we sent down with them the book and the balance that humanity may uphold justice and we sent down iron in which is violent force and benefits for humanity that god may know who supports him and his messengers invisibly god is strong and powerful

entries.a: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًۭا وَإِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَجَعَلْنَا فِى ذُرِّيَّتِهِمَا ٱلنُّبُوَّةَ وَٱلْكِتَٰبَ ۖ فَمِنْهُم مُّهْتَدٍۢ ۖ وَكَثِيرٌۭ مِّنْهُمْ فَٰسِقُونَ
entries.t: We sent Noah and Abraham, and established in their line Prophethood and the Scripture. Some of them are guided, but many of them are sinners.
entries.na: ولقد ارسلنا نوحا وابرهيم وجعلنا في ذريتهما النبوه والكتب فمنهم مهتد وكثير منهم فسقون
entries.nt: we sent noah and abraham and established in their line prophethood and the scripture some of them are guided but many of them are sinners

entries.a: ثُمَّ قَفَّيْنَا عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَٰرِهِم بِرُسُلِنَا وَقَفَّيْنَا بِعِيسَى ٱبْنِ مَرْيَمَ وَءَاتَيْنَٰهُ ٱلْإِنجِيلَ وَجَعَلْنَا فِى قُلُوبِ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّبَعُوهُ رَأْفَةًۭ وَرَحْمَةًۭ وَرَهْبَانِيَّةً ٱبْتَدَعُوهَا مَا كَتَبْنَٰهَا عَلَيْهِمْ إِلَّا ٱبْتِغَآءَ رِضْوَٰنِ ٱللَّهِ فَمَا رَعَوْهَا حَقَّ رِعَايَتِهَا ۖ فَـَٔاتَيْنَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ أَجْرَهُمْ ۖ وَكَثِيرٌۭ مِّنْهُمْ فَٰسِقُونَ
entries.t: Then We sent in their wake Our messengers, and followed up with Jesus son of Mary, and We gave him the Gospel, and instilled in the hearts of those who followed him compassion and mercy. But as for the monasticism which they invented-We did not ordain it for them-only to seek God's approval. But they did not observe it with its due observance. So We gave those of them who believed their reward, but many of them are sinful.
entries.na: ثم قفينا علي اثرهم برسلنا وقفينا بعيسي ابن مريم واتينه الانجيل وجعلنا في قلوب الذين اتبعوه رافه ورحمه ورهبانيه ابتدعوها ما كتبنها عليهم الا ابتغا رضون الله فما رعوها حق رعايتها فاتينا الذين امنوا منهم اجرهم وكثير منهم فسقون
entries.nt: then we sent in their wake our messengers and followed up with jesus son of mary and we gave him the gospel and instilled in the hearts of those who followed him compassion and mercy but as for the monasticism which they invented we did not ordain it for them only to seek god s approval but they did not observe it with its due observance so we gave those of them who believed their reward but many of them are sinful

entries.a: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَءَامِنُوا۟ بِرَسُولِهِۦ يُؤْتِكُمْ كِفْلَيْنِ مِن رَّحْمَتِهِۦ وَيَجْعَل لَّكُمْ نُورًۭا تَمْشُونَ بِهِۦ وَيَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ غَفُورٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۭ
entries.t: O you who believe! Fear God, and believe in His Messenger: He will give you a double portion of His mercy, and will give you a light by which you walk, and will forgive you. God is Forgiving and Merciful.
entries.na: يايها الذين امنوا اتقوا الله وامنوا برسوله يوتكم كفلين من رحمته ويجعل لكم نورا تمشون به ويغفر لكم والله غفور رحيم
entries.nt: o you who believe fear god and believe in his messenger he will give you a double portion of his mercy and will give you a light by which you walk and will forgive you god is forgiving and merciful

entries.a: لِّئَلَّا يَعْلَمَ أَهْلُ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ أَلَّا يَقْدِرُونَ عَلَىٰ شَىْءٍۢ مِّن فَضْلِ ٱللَّهِ ۙ وَأَنَّ ٱلْفَضْلَ بِيَدِ ٱللَّهِ يُؤْتِيهِ مَن يَشَآءُ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ ذُو ٱلْفَضْلِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
entries.t: That the People of the Book may know that they have no power whatsoever over God's grace, and that all grace is in God's hand; He gives it to whomever He wills. God is Possessor of Great Grace.
entries.na: ليلا يعلم اهل الكتب الا يقدرون علي شي من فضل الله وان الفضل بيد الله يوتيه من يشا والله ذو الفضل العظيم
entries.nt: that the people of the book may know that they have no power whatsoever over god s grace and that all grace is in god s hand he gives it to whomever he wills god is possessor of great grace

entries.a: قَدْ سَمِعَ ٱللَّهُ قَوْلَ ٱلَّتِى تُجَٰدِلُكَ فِى زَوْجِهَا وَتَشْتَكِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَٱللَّهُ يَسْمَعُ تَحَاوُرَكُمَآ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَمِيعٌۢ بَصِيرٌ
entries.t: God has heard the statement of she who argued with you concerning her husband, as she complained to God. God heard your conversation. God is Hearing and Seeing.
entries.na: قد سمع الله قول التي تجدلك في زوجها وتشتكي الي الله والله يسمع تحاوركما ان الله سميع بصير
entries.nt: god has heard the statement of she who argued with you concerning her husband as she complained to god god heard your conversation god is hearing and seeing

entries.a: ٱلَّذِينَ يُظَٰهِرُونَ مِنكُم مِّن نِّسَآئِهِم مَّا هُنَّ أُمَّهَٰتِهِمْ ۖ إِنْ أُمَّهَٰتُهُمْ إِلَّا ٱلَّٰٓـِٔى وَلَدْنَهُمْ ۚ وَإِنَّهُمْ لَيَقُولُونَ مُنكَرًۭا مِّنَ ٱلْقَوْلِ وَزُورًۭا ۚ وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَعَفُوٌّ غَفُورٌۭ
entries.t: Those of you who estrange their wives by equating them with their mothers-they are not their mothers. Their mothers are none else but those who gave birth to them. What they say is evil, and a blatant lie. But God is Pardoning and Forgiving.
entries.na: الذين يظهرون منكم من نسايهم ما هن امهتهم ان امهتهم الا الي ولدنهم وانهم ليقولون منكرا من القول وزورا وان الله لعفو غفور
entries.nt: those of you who estrange their wives by equating them with their mothers they are not their mothers their mothers are none else but those who gave birth to them what they say is evil and a blatant lie but god is pardoning and forgiving

entries.a: وَٱلَّذِينَ يُظَٰهِرُونَ مِن نِّسَآئِهِمْ ثُمَّ يَعُودُونَ لِمَا قَالُوا۟ فَتَحْرِيرُ رَقَبَةٍۢ مِّن قَبْلِ أَن يَتَمَآسَّا ۚ ذَٰلِكُمْ تُوعَظُونَ بِهِۦ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرٌۭ
entries.t: Those who estrange their wives by equating them with their mothers, then go back on what they said, must set free a slave before they may touch one another. To this you are exhorted, and God is well aware of what you do.
entries.na: والذين يظهرون من نسايهم ثم يعودون لما قالوا فتحرير رقبه من قبل ان يتماسا ذلكم توعظون به والله بما تعملون خبير
entries.nt: those who estrange their wives by equating them with their mothers then go back on what they said must set free a slave before they may touch one another to this you are exhorted and god is well aware of what you do

entries.a: فَمَن لَّمْ يَجِدْ فَصِيَامُ شَهْرَيْنِ مُتَتَابِعَيْنِ مِن قَبْلِ أَن يَتَمَآسَّا ۖ فَمَن لَّمْ يَسْتَطِعْ فَإِطْعَامُ سِتِّينَ مِسْكِينًۭا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ لِتُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ ۚ وَتِلْكَ حُدُودُ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَلِلْكَٰفِرِينَ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
entries.t: But whoever cannot find the means must fast for two consecutive months before they may touch one another. And if he is unable, then the feeding of sixty needy people. This, in order that you affirm your faith in God and His Messenger. These are the ordinances of God. The unbelievers will have a painful punishment.
entries.na: فمن لم يجد فصيام شهرين متتابعين من قبل ان يتماسا فمن لم يستطع فاطعام ستين مسكينا ذلك لتومنوا بالله ورسوله وتلك حدود الله وللكفرين عذاب اليم
entries.nt: but whoever cannot find the means must fast for two consecutive months before they may touch one another and if he is unable then the feeding of sixty needy people this in order that you affirm your faith in god and his messenger these are the ordinances of god the unbelievers will have a painful punishment

entries.a: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يُحَآدُّونَ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ كُبِتُوا۟ كَمَا كُبِتَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ وَقَدْ أَنزَلْنَآ ءَايَٰتٍۭ بَيِّنَٰتٍۢ ۚ وَلِلْكَٰفِرِينَ عَذَابٌۭ مُّهِينٌۭ
entries.t: Those who oppose God and His Messenger will be subdued, as those before them were subdued. We have revealed clear messages. The unbelievers will have a demeaning punishment.
entries.na: ان الذين يحادون الله ورسوله كبتوا كما كبت الذين من قبلهم وقد انزلنا ايت بينت وللكفرين عذاب مهين
entries.nt: those who oppose god and his messenger will be subdued as those before them were subdued we have revealed clear messages the unbelievers will have a demeaning punishment

entries.a: يَوْمَ يَبْعَثُهُمُ ٱللَّهُ جَمِيعًۭا فَيُنَبِّئُهُم بِمَا عَمِلُوٓا۟ ۚ أَحْصَىٰهُ ٱللَّهُ وَنَسُوهُ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ شَهِيدٌ
entries.t: On the Day when God resurrects them all, and informs them of what they did. God has kept count of it, but they have forgotten it. God is Witness over everything.
entries.na: يوم يبعثهم الله جميعا فينبيهم بما عملوا احصيه الله ونسوه والله علي كل شي شهيد
