entries.nt: it tasted the result of its decisions and the outcome of its decisions was perdition

entries.a: أَعَدَّ ٱللَّهُ لَهُمْ عَذَابًۭا شَدِيدًۭا ۖ فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ يَٰٓأُو۟لِى ٱلْأَلْبَٰبِ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ۚ قَدْ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ إِلَيْكُمْ ذِكْرًۭا
entries.t: God has prepared for them a severe retribution. So beware of God, O you who possess intellect and have faith. God has sent down to you a Reminder.
entries.na: اعد الله لهم عذابا شديدا فاتقوا الله ياولي الالبب الذين امنوا قد انزل الله اليكم ذكرا
entries.nt: god has prepared for them a severe retribution so beware of god o you who possess intellect and have faith god has sent down to you a reminder

entries.a: رَّسُولًۭا يَتْلُوا۟ عَلَيْكُمْ ءَايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ مُبَيِّنَٰتٍۢ لِّيُخْرِجَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ مِنَ ٱلظُّلُمَٰتِ إِلَى ٱلنُّورِ ۚ وَمَن يُؤْمِنۢ بِٱللَّهِ وَيَعْمَلْ صَٰلِحًۭا يُدْخِلْهُ جَنَّٰتٍۢ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدًۭا ۖ قَدْ أَحْسَنَ ٱللَّهُ لَهُۥ رِزْقًا
entries.t: A messenger who recites to you God's Verses, clear and distinct, that he may bring those who believe and work righteousness from darkness into light. Whoever believes in God and acts with integrity, He will admit him into gardens beneath which rivers flow, therein to abide forever. God has given him an excellent provision.
entries.na: رسولا يتلوا عليكم ايت الله مبينت ليخرج الذين امنوا وعملوا الصلحت من الظلمت الي النور ومن يومن بالله ويعمل صلحا يدخله جنت تجري من تحتها الانهر خلدين فيها ابدا قد احسن الله له رزقا
entries.nt: a messenger who recites to you god s verses clear and distinct that he may bring those who believe and work righteousness from darkness into light whoever believes in god and acts with integrity he will admit him into gardens beneath which rivers flow therein to abide forever god has given him an excellent provision

entries.a: ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ سَبْعَ سَمَٰوَٰتٍۢ وَمِنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ مِثْلَهُنَّ يَتَنَزَّلُ ٱلْأَمْرُ بَيْنَهُنَّ لِتَعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ قَدِيرٌۭ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ قَدْ أَحَاطَ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عِلْمًۢا
entries.t: God is He Who created seven heavens, and their like of earth. The command descends through them, so that you may know that God is Capable of everything, and that God Encompasses everything in knowledge.
entries.na: الله الذي خلق سبع سموت ومن الارض مثلهن يتنزل الامر بينهن لتعلموا ان الله علي كل شي قدير وان الله قد احاط بكل شي علما
entries.nt: god is he who created seven heavens and their like of earth the command descends through them so that you may know that god is capable of everything and that god encompasses everything in knowledge

entries.a: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّبِىُّ لِمَ تُحَرِّمُ مَآ أَحَلَّ ٱللَّهُ لَكَ ۖ تَبْتَغِى مَرْضَاتَ أَزْوَٰجِكَ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ غَفُورٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۭ
entries.t: O prophet! Why do you prohibit what God has permitted for you, seeking to please your wives? God is Forgiving and Merciful.
entries.na: يايها النبي لم تحرم ما احل الله لك تبتغي مرضات ازوجك والله غفور رحيم
entries.nt: o prophet why do you prohibit what god has permitted for you seeking to please your wives god is forgiving and merciful

entries.a: قَدْ فَرَضَ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمْ تَحِلَّةَ أَيْمَٰنِكُمْ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ مَوْلَىٰكُمْ ۖ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَلِيمُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
entries.t: God has decreed for you the dissolution of your oaths. God is your Master. He is the All-Knowing, the Most Wise.
entries.na: قد فرض الله لكم تحله ايمنكم والله موليكم وهو العليم الحكيم
entries.nt: god has decreed for you the dissolution of your oaths god is your master he is the all knowing the most wise

entries.a: وَإِذْ أَسَرَّ ٱلنَّبِىُّ إِلَىٰ بَعْضِ أَزْوَٰجِهِۦ حَدِيثًۭا فَلَمَّا نَبَّأَتْ بِهِۦ وَأَظْهَرَهُ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ عَرَّفَ بَعْضَهُۥ وَأَعْرَضَ عَنۢ بَعْضٍۢ ۖ فَلَمَّا نَبَّأَهَا بِهِۦ قَالَتْ مَنْ أَنۢبَأَكَ هَٰذَا ۖ قَالَ نَبَّأَنِىَ ٱلْعَلِيمُ ٱلْخَبِيرُ
entries.t: The Prophet told something in confidence to one of his wives. But when she disclosed it, and God made it known to him; he communicated part of it, and he avoided another part. Then, when he informed her of it, she said, "Who informed you of this?" He said, "The All-Knowing, the All-Informed, informed me."
entries.na: واذ اسر النبي الي بعض ازوجه حديثا فلما نبات به واظهره الله عليه عرف بعضه واعرض عن بعض فلما نباها به قالت من انباك هذا قال نباني العليم الخبير
entries.nt: the prophet told something in confidence to one of his wives but when she disclosed it and god made it known to him he communicated part of it and he avoided another part then when he informed her of it she said who informed you of this he said the all knowing the all informed informed me

entries.a: إِن تَتُوبَآ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ فَقَدْ صَغَتْ قُلُوبُكُمَا ۖ وَإِن تَظَٰهَرَا عَلَيْهِ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ مَوْلَىٰهُ وَجِبْرِيلُ وَصَٰلِحُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ ۖ وَٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ ظَهِيرٌ
entries.t: If you repent to God, then your hearts have listened. But if you band together against him, then God is his Ally, as is Gabriel, and the righteous believers. In addition, the angels will assist him.
entries.na: ان تتوبا الي الله فقد صغت قلوبكما وان تظهرا عليه فان الله هو موليه وجبريل وصلح المومنين والمليكه بعد ذلك ظهير
entries.nt: if you repent to god then your hearts have listened but if you band together against him then god is his ally as is gabriel and the righteous believers in addition the angels will assist him

entries.a: عَسَىٰ رَبُّهُۥٓ إِن طَلَّقَكُنَّ أَن يُبْدِلَهُۥٓ أَزْوَٰجًا خَيْرًۭا مِّنكُنَّ مُسْلِمَٰتٍۢ مُّؤْمِنَٰتٍۢ قَٰنِتَٰتٍۢ تَٰٓئِبَٰتٍ عَٰبِدَٰتٍۢ سَٰٓئِحَٰتٍۢ ثَيِّبَٰتٍۢ وَأَبْكَارًۭا
entries.t: Perhaps, if he divorces you, his Lord will give him in exchange wives better than you: submissive, believing, obedient, penitent, devout, fasting-previously married, or virgins.
entries.na: عسي ربه ان طلقكن ان يبدله ازوجا خيرا منكن مسلمت مومنت قنتت تيبت عبدت سيحت ثيبت وابكارا
entries.nt: perhaps if he divorces you his lord will give him in exchange wives better than you submissive believing obedient penitent devout fasting previously married or virgins

entries.a: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ قُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَكُمْ وَأَهْلِيكُمْ نَارًۭا وَقُودُهَا ٱلنَّاسُ وَٱلْحِجَارَةُ عَلَيْهَا مَلَٰٓئِكَةٌ غِلَاظٌۭ شِدَادٌۭ لَّا يَعْصُونَ ٱللَّهَ مَآ أَمَرَهُمْ وَيَفْعَلُونَ مَا يُؤْمَرُونَ
entries.t: O you who believe! Protect yourselves and your families from a Fire, whose fuel is people and stones. Over it are angels, fierce and powerful. They never disobey God in anything He commands them, and they carry out whatever they are commanded.
entries.na: يايها الذين امنوا قوا انفسكم واهليكم نارا وقودها الناس والحجاره عليها مليكه غلاظ شداد لا يعصون الله ما امرهم ويفعلون ما يومرون
entries.nt: o you who believe protect yourselves and your families from a fire whose fuel is people and stones over it are angels fierce and powerful they never disobey god in anything he commands them and they carry out whatever they are commanded

entries.a: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَا تَعْتَذِرُوا۟ ٱلْيَوْمَ ۖ إِنَّمَا تُجْزَوْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
entries.t: O you who disbelieved! Make no excuses today. You are being repaid for what you used to do.
entries.na: يايها الذين كفروا لا تعتذروا اليوم انما تجزون ما كنتم تعملون
entries.nt: o you who disbelieved make no excuses today you are being repaid for what you used to do

entries.a: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ تُوبُوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ تَوْبَةًۭ نَّصُوحًا عَسَىٰ رَبُّكُمْ أَن يُكَفِّرَ عَنكُمْ سَيِّـَٔاتِكُمْ وَيُدْخِلَكُمْ جَنَّٰتٍۢ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ يَوْمَ لَا يُخْزِى ٱللَّهُ ٱلنَّبِىَّ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ ۖ نُورُهُمْ يَسْعَىٰ بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَبِأَيْمَٰنِهِمْ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَآ أَتْمِمْ لَنَا نُورَنَا وَٱغْفِرْ لَنَآ ۖ إِنَّكَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ قَدِيرٌۭ
entries.t: O you who believe! Repent to God with sincere repentance. Perhaps your Lord will remit your sins, and admit you into gardens beneath which rivers flow, on the Day when God will not disappoint the Prophet and those who believed with him. Their light streaming before them, and to their right, they will say, "Our Lord, complete our light for us, and forgive us; You are capable of all things."
entries.na: يايها الذين امنوا توبوا الي الله توبه نصوحا عسي ربكم ان يكفر عنكم سياتكم ويدخلكم جنت تجري من تحتها الانهر يوم لا يخزي الله النبي والذين امنوا معه نورهم يسعي بين ايديهم وبايمنهم يقولون ربنا اتمم لنا نورنا واغفر لنا انك علي كل شي قدير
entries.nt: o you who believe repent to god with sincere repentance perhaps your lord will remit your sins and admit you into gardens beneath which rivers flow on the day when god will not disappoint the prophet and those who believed with him their light streaming before them and to their right they will say our lord complete our light for us and forgive us you are capable of all things

entries.a: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّبِىُّ جَٰهِدِ ٱلْكُفَّارَ وَٱلْمُنَٰفِقِينَ وَٱغْلُظْ عَلَيْهِمْ ۚ وَمَأْوَىٰهُمْ جَهَنَّمُ ۖ وَبِئْسَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
entries.t: O prophet! Strive hard against the disbelievers and the hypocrites, and be stern with them. Their abode is Hell. What a miserable destination!
entries.na: يايها النبي جهد الكفار والمنفقين واغلظ عليهم وماويهم جهنم وبيس المصير
entries.nt: o prophet strive hard against the disbelievers and the hypocrites and be stern with them their abode is hell what a miserable destination

entries.a: ضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ٱمْرَأَتَ نُوحٍۢ وَٱمْرَأَتَ لُوطٍۢ ۖ كَانَتَا تَحْتَ عَبْدَيْنِ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا صَٰلِحَيْنِ فَخَانَتَاهُمَا فَلَمْ يُغْنِيَا عَنْهُمَا مِنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيْـًۭٔا وَقِيلَ ٱدْخُلَا ٱلنَّارَ مَعَ ٱلدَّٰخِلِينَ
entries.t: God illustrates an example of those who disbelieve: the wife of Noah and the wife of Lot. They were under two of Our righteous servants, but they betrayed them. They availed them nothing against God, and it was said, "Enter the Fire with those who are entering."
entries.na: ضرب الله مثلا للذين كفروا امرات نوح وامرات لوط كانتا تحت عبدين من عبادنا صلحين فخانتاهما فلم يغنيا عنهما من الله شيا وقيل ادخلا النار مع الدخلين
entries.nt: god illustrates an example of those who disbelieve the wife of noah and the wife of lot they were under two of our righteous servants but they betrayed them they availed them nothing against god and it was said enter the fire with those who are entering

entries.a: وَضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱمْرَأَتَ فِرْعَوْنَ إِذْ قَالَتْ رَبِّ ٱبْنِ لِى عِندَكَ بَيْتًۭا فِى ٱلْجَنَّةِ وَنَجِّنِى مِن فِرْعَوْنَ وَعَمَلِهِۦ وَنَجِّنِى مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
entries.t: And God illustrates an example of those who believe: the wife of Pharaoh, when she said, "My Lord, build for me, with you, a house in Paradise, and save me from Pharaoh and his works, and save me from the wrongdoing people."
entries.na: وضرب الله مثلا للذين امنوا امرات فرعون اذ قالت رب ابن لي عندك بيتا في الجنه ونجني من فرعون وعمله ونجني من القوم الظلمين
entries.nt: and god illustrates an example of those who believe the wife of pharaoh when she said my lord build for me with you a house in paradise and save me from pharaoh and his works and save me from the wrongdoing people

entries.a: وَمَرْيَمَ ٱبْنَتَ عِمْرَٰنَ ٱلَّتِىٓ أَحْصَنَتْ فَرْجَهَا فَنَفَخْنَا فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِنَا وَصَدَّقَتْ بِكَلِمَٰتِ رَبِّهَا وَكُتُبِهِۦ وَكَانَتْ مِنَ ٱلْقَٰنِتِينَ
entries.t: And Mary, the daughter of Imran, who guarded her womb, and so We breathed into her of Our Spirit; and she believed in the truth of her Lord's Words and His Books, and was one of the devout.
entries.na: ومريم ابنت عمرن التي احصنت فرجها فنفخنا فيه من روحنا وصدقت بكلمت ربها وكتبه وكانت من القنتين
entries.nt: and mary the daughter of imran who guarded her womb and so we breathed into her of our spirit and she believed in the truth of her lord s words and his books and was one of the devout

entries.a: تَبَٰرَكَ ٱلَّذِى بِيَدِهِ ٱلْمُلْكُ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ قَدِيرٌ
entries.t: Blessed is He in whose hand is the sovereignty, and Who has power over everything.
entries.na: تبرك الذي بيده الملك وهو علي كل شي قدير
entries.nt: blessed is he in whose hand is the sovereignty and who has power over everything

entries.a: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلْمَوْتَ وَٱلْحَيَوٰةَ لِيَبْلُوَكُمْ أَيُّكُمْ أَحْسَنُ عَمَلًۭا ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْغَفُورُ
entries.t: He who created death and life-to test you-as to which of you is better in conduct. He is the Almighty, the Forgiving.
entries.na: الذي خلق الموت والحيوه ليبلوكم ايكم احسن عملا وهو العزيز الغفور
entries.nt: he who created death and life to test you as to which of you is better in conduct he is the almighty the forgiving

entries.a: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ سَبْعَ سَمَٰوَٰتٍۢ طِبَاقًۭا ۖ مَّا تَرَىٰ فِى خَلْقِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ مِن تَفَٰوُتٍۢ ۖ فَٱرْجِعِ ٱلْبَصَرَ هَلْ تَرَىٰ مِن فُطُورٍۢ
entries.t: He who created seven heavens in layers. You see no discrepancy in the creation of the Compassionate. Look again. Can you see any cracks?
entries.na: الذي خلق سبع سموت طباقا ما تري في خلق الرحمن من تفوت فارجع البصر هل تري من فطور
entries.nt: he who created seven heavens in layers you see no discrepancy in the creation of the compassionate look again can you see any cracks

entries.a: ثُمَّ ٱرْجِعِ ٱلْبَصَرَ كَرَّتَيْنِ يَنقَلِبْ إِلَيْكَ ٱلْبَصَرُ خَاسِئًۭا وَهُوَ حَسِيرٌۭ
entries.t: Then look again, and again, and your sight will return to you dazzled and exhausted.
entries.na: ثم ارجع البصر كرتين ينقلب اليك البصر خاسيا وهو حسير
entries.nt: then look again and again and your sight will return to you dazzled and exhausted

entries.a: وَلَقَدْ زَيَّنَّا ٱلسَّمَآءَ ٱلدُّنْيَا بِمَصَٰبِيحَ وَجَعَلْنَٰهَا رُجُومًۭا لِّلشَّيَٰطِينِ ۖ وَأَعْتَدْنَا لَهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلسَّعِيرِ
entries.t: We have adorned the lower heaven with lanterns, and made them missiles against the devils; and We have prepared for them the punishment of the Blaze.
entries.na: ولقد زينا السما الدنيا بمصبيح وجعلنها رجوما للشيطين واعتدنا لهم عذاب السعير
entries.nt: we have adorned the lower heaven with lanterns and made them missiles against the devils and we have prepared for them the punishment of the blaze

entries.a: وَلِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِرَبِّهِمْ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ ۖ وَبِئْسَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
entries.t: For those who reject their Lord, there is the torment of Hell. What an evil destination!
entries.na: وللذين كفروا بربهم عذاب جهنم وبيس المصير
entries.nt: for those who reject their lord there is the torment of hell what an evil destination

entries.a: إِذَآ أُلْقُوا۟ فِيهَا سَمِعُوا۟ لَهَا شَهِيقًۭا وَهِىَ تَفُورُ
entries.t: When they are thrown into it, they will hear it roaring, as it seethes.
entries.na: اذا القوا فيها سمعوا لها شهيقا وهي تفور
entries.nt: when they are thrown into it they will hear it roaring as it seethes

entries.a: تَكَادُ تَمَيَّزُ مِنَ ٱلْغَيْظِ ۖ كُلَّمَآ أُلْقِىَ فِيهَا فَوْجٌۭ سَأَلَهُمْ خَزَنَتُهَآ أَلَمْ يَأْتِكُمْ نَذِيرٌۭ
entries.t: It almost bursts with fury. Every time a batch is thrown into it, its keepers will ask them, "Has no warner come to you?"
entries.na: تكاد تميز من الغيظ كلما القي فيها فوج سالهم خزنتها الم ياتكم نذير
entries.nt: it almost bursts with fury every time a batch is thrown into it its keepers will ask them has no warner come to you

entries.a: قَالُوا۟ بَلَىٰ قَدْ جَآءَنَا نَذِيرٌۭ فَكَذَّبْنَا وَقُلْنَا مَا نَزَّلَ ٱللَّهُ مِن شَىْءٍ إِنْ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا فِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ كَبِيرٍۢ
entries.t: They will say, "Yes, a warner did come to us, but we disbelieved, and said, 'God did not send down anything; you are very much mistaken.'"
entries.na: قالوا بلي قد جانا نذير فكذبنا وقلنا ما نزل الله من شي ان انتم الا في ضلل كبير
entries.nt: they will say yes a warner did come to us but we disbelieved and said god did not send down anything you are very much mistaken

entries.a: وَقَالُوا۟ لَوْ كُنَّا نَسْمَعُ أَوْ نَعْقِلُ مَا كُنَّا فِىٓ أَصْحَٰبِ ٱلسَّعِيرِ
entries.t: And they will say, "Had we listened or reasoned, we would not have been among the inmates of the Blaze."
entries.na: وقالوا لو كنا نسمع او نعقل ما كنا في اصحب السعير
entries.nt: and they will say had we listened or reasoned we would not have been among the inmates of the blaze

entries.a: فَٱعْتَرَفُوا۟ بِذَنۢبِهِمْ فَسُحْقًۭا لِّأَصْحَٰبِ ٱلسَّعِيرِ
entries.t: So they will acknowledge their sins. So away with the inmates of the Blaze.
entries.na: فاعترفوا بذنبهم فسحقا لاصحب السعير
entries.nt: so they will acknowledge their sins so away with the inmates of the blaze

entries.a: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُم بِٱلْغَيْبِ لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌۭ وَأَجْرٌۭ كَبِيرٌۭ
entries.t: As for those who fear their Lord in secret-for them is forgiveness and a great reward.
entries.na: ان الذين يخشون ربهم بالغيب لهم مغفره واجر كبير
entries.nt: as for those who fear their lord in secret for them is forgiveness and a great reward

entries.a: وَأَسِرُّوا۟ قَوْلَكُمْ أَوِ ٱجْهَرُوا۟ بِهِۦٓ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِيمٌۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ
entries.t: Whether you keep your words secret, or declare them-He is Aware of the inner thoughts.
entries.na: واسروا قولكم او اجهروا به انه عليم بذات الصدور
entries.nt: whether you keep your words secret or declare them he is aware of the inner thoughts

entries.a: أَلَا يَعْلَمُ مَنْ خَلَقَ وَهُوَ ٱللَّطِيفُ ٱلْخَبِيرُ
entries.t: Would He not know, He Who created? He is the Refined, the Expert.
entries.na: الا يعلم من خلق وهو اللطيف الخبير
entries.nt: would he not know he who created he is the refined the expert

entries.a: هُوَ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ ذَلُولًۭا فَٱمْشُوا۟ فِى مَنَاكِبِهَا وَكُلُوا۟ مِن رِّزْقِهِۦ ۖ وَإِلَيْهِ ٱلنُّشُورُ
entries.t: It is He who made the earth manageable for you, so travel its regions, and eat of His provisions. To Him is the Resurgence.
entries.na: هو الذي جعل لكم الارض ذلولا فامشوا في مناكبها وكلوا من رزقه واليه النشور
entries.nt: it is he who made the earth manageable for you so travel its regions and eat of his provisions to him is the resurgence

entries.a: ءَأَمِنتُم مَّن فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ أَن يَخْسِفَ بِكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ فَإِذَا هِىَ تَمُورُ
entries.t: Are you confident that the One in heaven will not cause the earth to collapse beneath you as it spins?
entries.na: امنتم من في السما ان يخسف بكم الارض فاذا هي تمور
entries.nt: are you confident that the one in heaven will not cause the earth to collapse beneath you as it spins

entries.a: أَمْ أَمِنتُم مَّن فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ أَن يُرْسِلَ عَلَيْكُمْ حَاصِبًۭا ۖ فَسَتَعْلَمُونَ كَيْفَ نَذِيرِ
entries.t: Or are you confident that the One in Heaven will not unleash against you a violent storm? Then you will know what My warning is like.
entries.na: ام امنتم من في السما ان يرسل عليكم حاصبا فستعلمون كيف نذير
entries.nt: or are you confident that the one in heaven will not unleash against you a violent storm then you will know what my warning is like

entries.a: وَلَقَدْ كَذَّبَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ نَكِيرِ
entries.t: Those before them also denied the truth; and how was My disapproval?
entries.na: ولقد كذب الذين من قبلهم فكيف كان نكير
entries.nt: those before them also denied the truth and how was my disapproval

entries.a: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ إِلَى ٱلطَّيْرِ فَوْقَهُمْ صَٰٓفَّٰتٍۢ وَيَقْبِضْنَ ۚ مَا يُمْسِكُهُنَّ إِلَّا ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍۭ بَصِيرٌ
entries.t: Have they not seen the birds above them, spreading their wings, and folding them? None holds them except the Compassionate. He is Perceiver of everything.
entries.na: اولم يروا الي الطير فوقهم صفت ويقبضن ما يمسكهن الا الرحمن انه بكل شي بصير
entries.nt: have they not seen the birds above them spreading their wings and folding them none holds them except the compassionate he is perceiver of everything

entries.a: أَمَّنْ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى هُوَ جُندٌۭ لَّكُمْ يَنصُرُكُم مِّن دُونِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ۚ إِنِ ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ إِلَّا فِى غُرُورٍ
entries.t: Or who is this who is a force for you to protect you against the Compassionate? The disbelievers are in nothing but delusion.
entries.na: امن هذا الذي هو جند لكم ينصركم من دون الرحمن ان الكفرون الا في غرور
entries.nt: or who is this who is a force for you to protect you against the compassionate the disbelievers are in nothing but delusion

entries.a: أَمَّنْ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى يَرْزُقُكُمْ إِنْ أَمْسَكَ رِزْقَهُۥ ۚ بَل لَّجُّوا۟ فِى عُتُوٍّۢ وَنُفُورٍ
entries.t: Or who is this that will provide for you, if He withholds His provision? Yet they persist in defiance and aversion.
entries.na: امن هذا الذي يرزقكم ان امسك رزقه بل لجوا في عتو ونفور
entries.nt: or who is this that will provide for you if he withholds his provision yet they persist in defiance and aversion

entries.a: أَفَمَن يَمْشِى مُكِبًّا عَلَىٰ وَجْهِهِۦٓ أَهْدَىٰٓ أَمَّن يَمْشِى سَوِيًّا عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍۢ مُّسْتَقِيمٍۢ
entries.t: Is he who walks bent on his own design better guided, or he who walks upright on a straight path?
entries.na: افمن يمشي مكبا علي وجهه اهدي امن يمشي سويا علي صرط مستقيم
entries.nt: is he who walks bent on his own design better guided or he who walks upright on a straight path

entries.a: قُلْ هُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنشَأَكُمْ وَجَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلسَّمْعَ وَٱلْأَبْصَٰرَ وَٱلْأَفْـِٔدَةَ ۖ قَلِيلًۭا مَّا تَشْكُرُونَ
entries.t: Say, "It is He who produced you; and made for you the hearing, and the vision, and the organs. But rarely do you give thanks."
entries.na: قل هو الذي انشاكم وجعل لكم السمع والابصر والافده قليلا ما تشكرون
entries.nt: say it is he who produced you and made for you the hearing and the vision and the organs but rarely do you give thanks

entries.a: قُلْ هُوَ ٱلَّذِى ذَرَأَكُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَإِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُونَ
entries.t: Say, "It is He who scattered you on earth, and to Him you will be rounded up."
entries.na: قل هو الذي ذراكم في الارض واليه تحشرون
entries.nt: say it is he who scattered you on earth and to him you will be rounded up

entries.a: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَٰذَا ٱلْوَعْدُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ
entries.t: And they say, "When will this promise be fulfilled, if you are truthful?"
entries.na: ويقولون متي هذا الوعد ان كنتم صدقين
entries.nt: and they say when will this promise be fulfilled if you are truthful

entries.a: قُلْ إِنَّمَا ٱلْعِلْمُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَإِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ نَذِيرٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
entries.t: Say, "Knowledge is with God, and I am only a clear warner."
entries.na: قل انما العلم عند الله وانما انا نذير مبين
entries.nt: say knowledge is with god and i am only a clear warner

entries.a: فَلَمَّا رَأَوْهُ زُلْفَةًۭ سِيٓـَٔتْ وُجُوهُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَقِيلَ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَدَّعُونَ
entries.t: But when they see it approaching, the faces of those who disbelieved will turn gloomy, and it will be said, "This is what you used to call for."
entries.na: فلما راوه زلفه سيت وجوه الذين كفروا وقيل هذا الذي كنتم به تدعون
entries.nt: but when they see it approaching the faces of those who disbelieved will turn gloomy and it will be said this is what you used to call for

entries.a: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَهْلَكَنِىَ ٱللَّهُ وَمَن مَّعِىَ أَوْ رَحِمَنَا فَمَن يُجِيرُ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍۢ
entries.t: Say, "Have you considered? Should God make me perish, and those with me; or else He bestows His mercy on us; who will protect the disbelievers from an agonizing torment?"
entries.na: قل اريتم ان اهلكني الله ومن معي او رحمنا فمن يجير الكفرين من عذاب اليم
entries.nt: say have you considered should god make me perish and those with me or else he bestows his mercy on us who will protect the disbelievers from an agonizing torment

entries.a: قُلْ هُوَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦ وَعَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْنَا ۖ فَسَتَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ هُوَ فِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
entries.t: Say, "He is the Compassionate. We have faith in Him, and in Him we trust. Soon you will know who is in evident error."
entries.na: قل هو الرحمن امنا به وعليه توكلنا فستعلمون من هو في ضلل مبين
entries.nt: say he is the compassionate we have faith in him and in him we trust soon you will know who is in evident error

entries.a: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَصْبَحَ مَآؤُكُمْ غَوْرًۭا فَمَن يَأْتِيكُم بِمَآءٍۢ مَّعِينٍۭ
entries.t: Say, "Have you considered? If your water drains away, who will bring you pure running water?"
entries.na: قل اريتم ان اصبح ماوكم غورا فمن ياتيكم بما معين
entries.nt: say have you considered if your water drains away who will bring you pure running water

entries.a: نٓ ۚ وَٱلْقَلَمِ وَمَا يَسْطُرُونَ
entries.t: Noon. By the pen, and by what they inscribe.
entries.na: ن والقلم وما يسطرون
entries.nt: noon by the pen and by what they inscribe

entries.a: مَآ أَنتَ بِنِعْمَةِ رَبِّكَ بِمَجْنُونٍۢ
entries.t: By the grace of your Lord, you are not insane.
entries.na: ما انت بنعمه ربك بمجنون
entries.nt: by the grace of your lord you are not insane

entries.a: وَإِنَّ لَكَ لَأَجْرًا غَيْرَ مَمْنُونٍۢ
entries.t: In fact, you will have a reward that will never end.
entries.na: وان لك لاجرا غير ممنون
entries.nt: in fact you will have a reward that will never end

entries.a: وَإِنَّكَ لَعَلَىٰ خُلُقٍ عَظِيمٍۢ
entries.t: And you are of a great moral character.
entries.na: وانك لعلي خلق عظيم
entries.nt: and you are of a great moral character

entries.a: فَسَتُبْصِرُ وَيُبْصِرُونَ
entries.t: You will see, and they will see.
entries.na: فستبصر ويبصرون
entries.nt: you will see and they will see

entries.a: بِأَييِّكُمُ ٱلْمَفْتُونُ
entries.t: Which of you is the afflicted.
entries.na: باييكم المفتون
entries.nt: which of you is the afflicted

entries.a: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَن ضَلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِٱلْمُهْتَدِينَ
entries.t: Your Lord knows best who has strayed from His path, and He knows best the well-guided.
entries.na: ان ربك هو اعلم بمن ضل عن سبيله وهو اعلم بالمهتدين
entries.nt: your lord knows best who has strayed from his path and he knows best the well guided

entries.a: فَلَا تُطِعِ ٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
entries.t: So do not obey the deniers.
entries.na: فلا تطع المكذبين
entries.nt: so do not obey the deniers

entries.a: وَدُّوا۟ لَوْ تُدْهِنُ فَيُدْهِنُونَ
entries.t: They would like you to compromise, so they would compromise.
entries.na: ودوا لو تدهن فيدهنون
entries.nt: they would like you to compromise so they would compromise

entries.a: وَلَا تُطِعْ كُلَّ حَلَّافٍۢ مَّهِينٍ
entries.t: And do not obey any vile swearer.
entries.na: ولا تطع كل حلاف مهين
entries.nt: and do not obey any vile swearer

entries.a: هَمَّازٍۢ مَّشَّآءٍۭ بِنَمِيمٍۢ
entries.t: Backbiter, spreader of slander.
entries.na: هماز مشا بنميم
entries.nt: backbiter spreader of slander

entries.a: مَّنَّاعٍۢ لِّلْخَيْرِ مُعْتَدٍ أَثِيمٍ
entries.t: Preventer of good, transgressor, sinner.
entries.na: مناع للخير معتد اثيم
entries.nt: preventer of good transgressor sinner

entries.a: عُتُلٍّۭ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ زَنِيمٍ
entries.t: Rude and fake besides.
entries.na: عتل بعد ذلك زنيم
entries.nt: rude and fake besides

entries.a: أَن كَانَ ذَا مَالٍۢ وَبَنِينَ
entries.t: Just because he has money and children.
entries.na: ان كان ذا مال وبنين
entries.nt: just because he has money and children

entries.a: إِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ ءَايَٰتُنَا قَالَ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
entries.t: When Our Verses are recited to him, he says, "Myths of the ancients!"
entries.na: اذا تتلي عليه ايتنا قال اسطير الاولين
entries.nt: when our verses are recited to him he says myths of the ancients

entries.a: سَنَسِمُهُۥ عَلَى ٱلْخُرْطُومِ
entries.t: We will brand him on the muzzle.
entries.na: سنسمه علي الخرطوم
entries.nt: we will brand him on the muzzle

entries.a: إِنَّا بَلَوْنَٰهُمْ كَمَا بَلَوْنَآ أَصْحَٰبَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ إِذْ أَقْسَمُوا۟ لَيَصْرِمُنَّهَا مُصْبِحِينَ
entries.t: We tested them, as We tested the owners of the garden, when they vowed to harvest it in the morning.
entries.na: انا بلونهم كما بلونا اصحب الجنه اذ اقسموا ليصرمنها مصبحين
entries.nt: we tested them as we tested the owners of the garden when they vowed to harvest it in the morning

entries.a: وَلَا يَسْتَثْنُونَ
entries.t: Without any reservation.
entries.na: ولا يستثنون
entries.nt: without any reservation

entries.a: فَطَافَ عَلَيْهَا طَآئِفٌۭ مِّن رَّبِّكَ وَهُمْ نَآئِمُونَ
entries.t: But a calamity from your Lord went around it while they slept.
entries.na: فطاف عليها طايف من ربك وهم نايمون
entries.nt: but a calamity from your lord went around it while they slept

entries.a: فَأَصْبَحَتْ كَٱلصَّرِيمِ
entries.t: And in the morning it was as if picked.
entries.na: فاصبحت كالصريم
entries.nt: and in the morning it was as if picked

entries.a: فَتَنَادَوْا۟ مُصْبِحِينَ
entries.t: In the morning, they called to one another.
entries.na: فتنادوا مصبحين
entries.nt: in the morning they called to one another

entries.a: أَنِ ٱغْدُوا۟ عَلَىٰ حَرْثِكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰرِمِينَ
entries.t: "Go early to your plantation, if you are going to harvest."
entries.na: ان اغدوا علي حرثكم ان كنتم صرمين
entries.nt: go early to your plantation if you are going to harvest

entries.a: فَٱنطَلَقُوا۟ وَهُمْ يَتَخَٰفَتُونَ
entries.t: So off they went, murmuring to one another.
entries.na: فانطلقوا وهم يتخفتون
entries.nt: so off they went murmuring to one another

entries.a: أَن لَّا يَدْخُلَنَّهَا ٱلْيَوْمَ عَلَيْكُم مِّسْكِينٌۭ
entries.t: "No poor person is to enter it upon you today."
entries.na: ان لا يدخلنها اليوم عليكم مسكين
entries.nt: no poor person is to enter it upon you today

entries.a: وَغَدَوْا۟ عَلَىٰ حَرْدٍۢ قَٰدِرِينَ
entries.t: And early they went, resolved in intent.
entries.na: وغدوا علي حرد قدرين
entries.nt: and early they went resolved in intent

entries.a: فَلَمَّا رَأَوْهَا قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا لَضَآلُّونَ
entries.t: But when they saw it, they said, "We were wrong.
entries.na: فلما راوها قالوا انا لضالون
entries.nt: but when they saw it they said we were wrong

entries.a: بَلْ نَحْنُ مَحْرُومُونَ
entries.t: We are now deprived."
entries.na: بل نحن محرومون
entries.nt: we are now deprived

entries.a: قَالَ أَوْسَطُهُمْ أَلَمْ أَقُل لَّكُمْ لَوْلَا تُسَبِّحُونَ
entries.t: The most reasonable of them said, "Did I not say to you, 'if only you would glorify?'"
entries.na: قال اوسطهم الم اقل لكم لولا تسبحون
entries.nt: the most reasonable of them said did i not say to you if only you would glorify

entries.a: قَالُوا۟ سُبْحَٰنَ رَبِّنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا ظَٰلِمِينَ
entries.t: They said, "Glory to our Lord-We were indeed in the wrong."
entries.na: قالوا سبحن ربنا انا كنا ظلمين
entries.nt: they said glory to our lord we were indeed in the wrong

entries.a: فَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍۢ يَتَلَٰوَمُونَ
entries.t: Then they turned to one another, blaming one another.
entries.na: فاقبل بعضهم علي بعض يتلومون
entries.nt: then they turned to one another blaming one another

entries.a: قَالُوا۟ يَٰوَيْلَنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا طَٰغِينَ
entries.t: They said, "Woe to us-we were indeed domineering.
entries.na: قالوا يويلنا انا كنا طغين
entries.nt: they said woe to us we were indeed domineering

entries.a: عَسَىٰ رَبُّنَآ أَن يُبْدِلَنَا خَيْرًۭا مِّنْهَآ إِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا رَٰغِبُونَ
entries.t: Perhaps our Lord will give us a better substitute for it. We are turning to our Lord."
entries.na: عسي ربنا ان يبدلنا خيرا منها انا الي ربنا رغبون
entries.nt: perhaps our lord will give us a better substitute for it we are turning to our lord

entries.a: كَذَٰلِكَ ٱلْعَذَابُ ۖ وَلَعَذَابُ ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ أَكْبَرُ ۚ لَوْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْلَمُونَ
entries.t: Such is the punishment; but the punishment of the Hereafter is greater, if they only knew.
entries.na: كذلك العذاب ولعذاب الاخره اكبر لو كانوا يعلمون
entries.nt: such is the punishment but the punishment of the hereafter is greater if they only knew

entries.a: إِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ جَنَّٰتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
entries.t: For the righteous are Gardens of Delight with their Lord.
entries.na: ان للمتقين عند ربهم جنت النعيم
entries.nt: for the righteous are gardens of delight with their lord

entries.a: أَفَنَجْعَلُ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ كَٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
entries.t: Shall We treat the Muslims like the villains?
entries.na: افنجعل المسلمين كالمجرمين
entries.nt: shall we treat the muslims like the villains

entries.a: مَا لَكُمْ كَيْفَ تَحْكُمُونَ
entries.t: What is the matter with you? How do you judge?
entries.na: ما لكم كيف تحكمون
entries.nt: what is the matter with you how do you judge

entries.a: أَمْ لَكُمْ كِتَٰبٌۭ فِيهِ تَدْرُسُونَ
entries.t: Or do you have a scripture in which you study.
entries.na: ام لكم كتب فيه تدرسون
entries.nt: or do you have a scripture in which you study

entries.a: إِنَّ لَكُمْ فِيهِ لَمَا تَخَيَّرُونَ
entries.t: Wherein there is whatever you choose?
entries.na: ان لكم فيه لما تخيرون
entries.nt: wherein there is whatever you choose

entries.a: أَمْ لَكُمْ أَيْمَٰنٌ عَلَيْنَا بَٰلِغَةٌ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ ۙ إِنَّ لَكُمْ لَمَا تَحْكُمُونَ
entries.t: Or do you have oaths from Us, binding until the Day of Resurrection, that you will have whatever you demand?
entries.na: ام لكم ايمن علينا بلغه الي يوم القيمه ان لكم لما تحكمون
entries.nt: or do you have oaths from us binding until the day of resurrection that you will have whatever you demand

entries.a: سَلْهُمْ أَيُّهُم بِذَٰلِكَ زَعِيمٌ
entries.t: Ask them, which of them will guarantee that.
entries.na: سلهم ايهم بذلك زعيم
entries.nt: ask them which of them will guarantee that

entries.a: أَمْ لَهُمْ شُرَكَآءُ فَلْيَأْتُوا۟ بِشُرَكَآئِهِمْ إِن كَانُوا۟ صَٰدِقِينَ
entries.t: Or do they have partners? Then let them produce their partners, if they are truthful.
entries.na: ام لهم شركا فلياتوا بشركايهم ان كانوا صدقين
entries.nt: or do they have partners then let them produce their partners if they are truthful

entries.a: يَوْمَ يُكْشَفُ عَن سَاقٍۢ وَيُدْعَوْنَ إِلَى ٱلسُّجُودِ فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ
entries.t: On the Day when the Shin will be exposed, and they will be called to bow down, but they will be unable.
entries.na: يوم يكشف عن ساق ويدعون الي السجود فلا يستطيعون
entries.nt: on the day when the shin will be exposed and they will be called to bow down but they will be unable

entries.a: خَٰشِعَةً أَبْصَٰرُهُمْ تَرْهَقُهُمْ ذِلَّةٌۭ ۖ وَقَدْ كَانُوا۟ يُدْعَوْنَ إِلَى ٱلسُّجُودِ وَهُمْ سَٰلِمُونَ
entries.t: Their eyes subdued, shame will cover them. They were invited to bow down when they were sound.
entries.na: خشعه ابصرهم ترهقهم ذله وقد كانوا يدعون الي السجود وهم سلمون
entries.nt: their eyes subdued shame will cover them they were invited to bow down when they were sound

entries.a: فَذَرْنِى وَمَن يُكَذِّبُ بِهَٰذَا ٱلْحَدِيثِ ۖ سَنَسْتَدْرِجُهُم مِّنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
entries.t: So leave Me to those who reject this discourse; We will proceed against them gradually, from where they do not know.
entries.na: فذرني ومن يكذب بهذا الحديث سنستدرجهم من حيث لا يعلمون
entries.nt: so leave me to those who reject this discourse we will proceed against them gradually from where they do not know

entries.a: وَأُمْلِى لَهُمْ ۚ إِنَّ كَيْدِى مَتِينٌ
entries.t: And I will give them respite. My plan is firm.
entries.na: واملي لهم ان كيدي متين
entries.nt: and i will give them respite my plan is firm

entries.a: أَمْ تَسْـَٔلُهُمْ أَجْرًۭا فَهُم مِّن مَّغْرَمٍۢ مُّثْقَلُونَ
entries.t: Or do you ask them for a fee, so they are burdened with debt?
entries.na: ام تسلهم اجرا فهم من مغرم مثقلون
entries.nt: or do you ask them for a fee so they are burdened with debt

entries.a: أَمْ عِندَهُمُ ٱلْغَيْبُ فَهُمْ يَكْتُبُونَ
entries.t: Or do they know the future, and so they write it down?
entries.na: ام عندهم الغيب فهم يكتبون
entries.nt: or do they know the future and so they write it down

entries.a: فَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تَكُن كَصَاحِبِ ٱلْحُوتِ إِذْ نَادَىٰ وَهُوَ مَكْظُومٌۭ
entries.t: So wait patiently for the Decision of your Lord, and do not be like the Fellow of the Fish who cried out in despair.
entries.na: فاصبر لحكم ربك ولا تكن كصاحب الحوت اذ نادي وهو مكظوم
entries.nt: so wait patiently for the decision of your lord and do not be like the fellow of the fish who cried out in despair

entries.a: لَّوْلَآ أَن تَدَٰرَكَهُۥ نِعْمَةٌۭ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦ لَنُبِذَ بِٱلْعَرَآءِ وَهُوَ مَذْمُومٌۭ
entries.t: Were it not for his Lord's favor that reached him, he would have been thrown into the wilderness, fully despised.
entries.na: لولا ان تدركه نعمه من ربه لنبذ بالعرا وهو مذموم
entries.nt: were it not for his lord s favor that reached him he would have been thrown into the wilderness fully despised

entries.a: فَٱجْتَبَٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ فَجَعَلَهُۥ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
entries.t: But his Lord chose him, and made him one of the righteous.
entries.na: فاجتبه ربه فجعله من الصلحين
entries.nt: but his lord chose him and made him one of the righteous

entries.a: وَإِن يَكَادُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَيُزْلِقُونَكَ بِأَبْصَٰرِهِمْ لَمَّا سَمِعُوا۟ ٱلذِّكْرَ وَيَقُولُونَ إِنَّهُۥ لَمَجْنُونٌۭ
entries.t: Those who disbelieve almost stab you with their glances when they hear the message, and say, "He is crazy!"
entries.na: وان يكاد الذين كفروا ليزلقونك بابصرهم لما سمعوا الذكر ويقولون انه لمجنون
entries.nt: those who disbelieve almost stab you with their glances when they hear the message and say he is crazy

entries.a: وَمَا هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌۭ لِّلْعَٰلَمِينَ
entries.t: But it is no less than a reminder to all the Worlds.
entries.na: وما هو الا ذكر للعلمين
entries.nt: but it is no less than a reminder to all the worlds

entries.a: ٱلْحَآقَّةُ
entries.t: The Reality.
entries.na: الحاقه
entries.nt: the reality

entries.a: مَا ٱلْحَآقَّةُ
entries.t: What is the Reality?
entries.na: ما الحاقه
entries.nt: what is the reality

entries.a: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلْحَآقَّةُ
entries.t: What will make you understand what the Reality is?
entries.na: وما ادريك ما الحاقه
entries.nt: what will make you understand what the reality is

entries.a: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ وَعَادٌۢ بِٱلْقَارِعَةِ
entries.t: Thamood and Aad denied the Catastrophe.
entries.na: كذبت ثمود وعاد بالقارعه
entries.nt: thamood and aad denied the catastrophe

entries.a: فَأَمَّا ثَمُودُ فَأُهْلِكُوا۟ بِٱلطَّاغِيَةِ
entries.t: As for Thamood, they were annihilated by the Overwhelming.
entries.na: فاما ثمود فاهلكوا بالطاغيه
entries.nt: as for thamood they were annihilated by the overwhelming

entries.a: وَأَمَّا عَادٌۭ فَأُهْلِكُوا۟ بِرِيحٍۢ صَرْصَرٍ عَاتِيَةٍۢ
entries.t: And as for Aad; they were annihilated by a furious, roaring wind.
entries.na: واما عاد فاهلكوا بريح صرصر عاتيه
entries.nt: and as for aad they were annihilated by a furious roaring wind

entries.a: سَخَّرَهَا عَلَيْهِمْ سَبْعَ لَيَالٍۢ وَثَمَٰنِيَةَ أَيَّامٍ حُسُومًۭا فَتَرَى ٱلْقَوْمَ فِيهَا صَرْعَىٰ كَأَنَّهُمْ أَعْجَازُ نَخْلٍ خَاوِيَةٍۢ
entries.t: He unleashed it upon them for seven nights and eight days, in succession. You could see the people tossed around, as though they were stumps of hollow palm-trees.
entries.na: سخرها عليهم سبع ليال وثمنيه ايام حسوما فتري القوم فيها صرعي كانهم اعجاز نخل خاويه
entries.nt: he unleashed it upon them for seven nights and eight days in succession you could see the people tossed around as though they were stumps of hollow palm trees

entries.a: فَهَلْ تَرَىٰ لَهُم مِّنۢ بَاقِيَةٍۢ
entries.t: Can you see any remnant of them?
entries.na: فهل تري لهم من باقيه
entries.nt: can you see any remnant of them

entries.a: وَجَآءَ فِرْعَوْنُ وَمَن قَبْلَهُۥ وَٱلْمُؤْتَفِكَٰتُ بِٱلْخَاطِئَةِ
entries.t: Then Pharaoh came, and those before him, and the Overturned Cities steeped in sin.
entries.na: وجا فرعون ومن قبله والموتفكت بالخاطيه
entries.nt: then pharaoh came and those before him and the overturned cities steeped in sin

entries.a: فَعَصَوْا۟ رَسُولَ رَبِّهِمْ فَأَخَذَهُمْ أَخْذَةًۭ رَّابِيَةً
entries.t: But they disobeyed the messenger of their Lord, so He seized them with an overpowering grip.
entries.na: فعصوا رسول ربهم فاخذهم اخذه رابيه
entries.nt: but they disobeyed the messenger of their lord so he seized them with an overpowering grip

entries.a: إِنَّا لَمَّا طَغَا ٱلْمَآءُ حَمَلْنَٰكُمْ فِى ٱلْجَارِيَةِ
entries.t: When the waters overflowed, We carried you in the cruising ship.
entries.na: انا لما طغا الما حملنكم في الجاريه
entries.nt: when the waters overflowed we carried you in the cruising ship

entries.a: لِنَجْعَلَهَا لَكُمْ تَذْكِرَةًۭ وَتَعِيَهَآ أُذُنٌۭ وَٰعِيَةٌۭ
entries.t: To make it a lesson for you-so that retaining ears may retain it.
entries.na: لنجعلها لكم تذكره وتعيها اذن وعيه
entries.nt: to make it a lesson for you so that retaining ears may retain it

entries.a: فَإِذَا نُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ نَفْخَةٌۭ وَٰحِدَةٌۭ
entries.t: Then, when the Trumpet is sounded a single time.
entries.na: فاذا نفخ في الصور نفخه وحده
entries.nt: then when the trumpet is sounded a single time

entries.a: وَحُمِلَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَٱلْجِبَالُ فَدُكَّتَا دَكَّةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ
entries.t: And the earth and the mountains are lifted up, and crushed, with a single crush.
entries.na: وحملت الارض والجبال فدكتا دكه وحده
entries.nt: and the earth and the mountains are lifted up and crushed with a single crush

entries.a: فَيَوْمَئِذٍۢ وَقَعَتِ ٱلْوَاقِعَةُ
entries.t: On that Day, the Event will come to pass.
entries.na: فيوميذ وقعت الواقعه
entries.nt: on that day the event will come to pass

entries.a: وَٱنشَقَّتِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ فَهِىَ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ وَاهِيَةٌۭ
entries.t: And the heaven will crack; so on that Day it will be frail.
entries.na: وانشقت السما فهي يوميذ واهيه
entries.nt: and the heaven will crack so on that day it will be frail

entries.a: وَٱلْمَلَكُ عَلَىٰٓ أَرْجَآئِهَا ۚ وَيَحْمِلُ عَرْشَ رَبِّكَ فَوْقَهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ ثَمَٰنِيَةٌۭ
entries.t: And the angels will be ranged around its borders, while eight will be carrying the Throne of your Lord above them that Day.
entries.na: والملك علي ارجايها ويحمل عرش ربك فوقهم يوميذ ثمنيه
entries.nt: and the angels will be ranged around its borders while eight will be carrying the throne of your lord above them that day

entries.a: يَوْمَئِذٍۢ تُعْرَضُونَ لَا تَخْفَىٰ مِنكُمْ خَافِيَةٌۭ
entries.t: On that Day you will be exposed, and no secret of yours will remain hidden.
entries.na: يوميذ تعرضون لا تخفي منكم خافيه
entries.nt: on that day you will be exposed and no secret of yours will remain hidden

entries.a: فَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ بِيَمِينِهِۦ فَيَقُولُ هَآؤُمُ ٱقْرَءُوا۟ كِتَٰبِيَهْ
entries.t: As for him who is given his book in his right hand, he will say, "Here, take my book and read it.
entries.na: فاما من اوتي كتبه بيمينه فيقول هاوم اقروا كتبيه
entries.nt: as for him who is given his book in his right hand he will say here take my book and read it

entries.a: إِنِّى ظَنَنتُ أَنِّى مُلَٰقٍ حِسَابِيَهْ
entries.t: I knew I would be held accountable."
entries.na: اني ظننت اني ملق حسابيه
entries.nt: i knew i would be held accountable

entries.a: فَهُوَ فِى عِيشَةٍۢ رَّاضِيَةٍۢ
entries.t: So he will be in pleasant living.
entries.na: فهو في عيشه راضيه
entries.nt: so he will be in pleasant living

entries.a: فِى جَنَّةٍ عَالِيَةٍۢ
entries.t: In a lofty Garden.
entries.na: في جنه عاليه
entries.nt: in a lofty garden

entries.a: قُطُوفُهَا دَانِيَةٌۭ
entries.t: Its pickings are within reach.
entries.na: قطوفها دانيه
entries.nt: its pickings are within reach

entries.a: كُلُوا۟ وَٱشْرَبُوا۟ هَنِيٓـًٔۢا بِمَآ أَسْلَفْتُمْ فِى ٱلْأَيَّامِ ٱلْخَالِيَةِ
entries.t: "Eat and drink merrily for what you did in the days gone by."
entries.na: كلوا واشربوا هنيا بما اسلفتم في الايام الخاليه
entries.nt: eat and drink merrily for what you did in the days gone by

entries.a: وَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ بِشِمَالِهِۦ فَيَقُولُ يَٰلَيْتَنِى لَمْ أُوتَ كِتَٰبِيَهْ
entries.t: But as for him who is given his book in his left hand, he will say, "I wish I was never given my book.
entries.na: واما من اوتي كتبه بشماله فيقول يليتني لم اوت كتبيه
entries.nt: but as for him who is given his book in his left hand he will say i wish i was never given my book

entries.a: وَلَمْ أَدْرِ مَا حِسَابِيَهْ
entries.t: And never knew what my account was.
entries.na: ولم ادر ما حسابيه
entries.nt: and never knew what my account was

entries.a: يَٰلَيْتَهَا كَانَتِ ٱلْقَاضِيَةَ
entries.t: If only it was the end.
entries.na: يليتها كانت القاضيه
entries.nt: if only it was the end

entries.a: مَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنِّى مَالِيَهْ ۜ
entries.t: My money cannot avail me.
entries.na: ما اغني عني ماليه
entries.nt: my money cannot avail me

entries.a: هَلَكَ عَنِّى سُلْطَٰنِيَهْ
entries.t: My power has vanished from me."
entries.na: هلك عني سلطنيه
entries.nt: my power has vanished from me

entries.a: خُذُوهُ فَغُلُّوهُ
entries.t: "Take him and shackle him.
entries.na: خذوه فغلوه
entries.nt: take him and shackle him

entries.a: ثُمَّ ٱلْجَحِيمَ صَلُّوهُ
entries.t: Then scorch him in the Blaze.
entries.na: ثم الجحيم صلوه
entries.nt: then scorch him in the blaze

entries.a: ثُمَّ فِى سِلْسِلَةٍۢ ذَرْعُهَا سَبْعُونَ ذِرَاعًۭا فَٱسْلُكُوهُ
entries.t: Then in a chain which length is seventy cubits tie him up.
entries.na: ثم في سلسله ذرعها سبعون ذراعا فاسلكوه
entries.nt: then in a chain which length is seventy cubits tie him up

entries.a: إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ لَا يُؤْمِنُ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
entries.t: For he would not believe in God the Great.
entries.na: انه كان لا يومن بالله العظيم
entries.nt: for he would not believe in god the great

entries.a: وَلَا يَحُضُّ عَلَىٰ طَعَامِ ٱلْمِسْكِينِ
entries.t: Nor would he advocate the feeding of the destitute.
entries.na: ولا يحض علي طعام المسكين
entries.nt: nor would he advocate the feeding of the destitute

entries.a: فَلَيْسَ لَهُ ٱلْيَوْمَ هَٰهُنَا حَمِيمٌۭ
entries.t: So he has no friend here today.
entries.na: فليس له اليوم ههنا حميم
entries.nt: so he has no friend here today

entries.a: وَلَا طَعَامٌ إِلَّا مِنْ غِسْلِينٍۢ
entries.t: And no food except scum.
entries.na: ولا طعام الا من غسلين
entries.nt: and no food except scum

entries.a: لَّا يَأْكُلُهُۥٓ إِلَّا ٱلْخَٰطِـُٔونَ
entries.t: Which only the sinners eat."
entries.na: لا ياكله الا الخطون
entries.nt: which only the sinners eat

entries.a: فَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِمَا تُبْصِرُونَ
entries.t: Indeed, I swear by what you see.
entries.na: فلا اقسم بما تبصرون
entries.nt: indeed i swear by what you see

entries.a: وَمَا لَا تُبْصِرُونَ
entries.t: And by what you do not see.
entries.na: وما لا تبصرون
entries.nt: and by what you do not see

entries.a: إِنَّهُۥ لَقَوْلُ رَسُولٍۢ كَرِيمٍۢ
entries.t: It is the speech of a noble messenger.
entries.na: انه لقول رسول كريم
entries.nt: it is the speech of a noble messenger

entries.a: وَمَا هُوَ بِقَوْلِ شَاعِرٍۢ ۚ قَلِيلًۭا مَّا تُؤْمِنُونَ
entries.t: And it is not the speech of a poet-little do you believe.
entries.na: وما هو بقول شاعر قليلا ما تومنون
entries.nt: and it is not the speech of a poet little do you believe

entries.a: وَلَا بِقَوْلِ كَاهِنٍۢ ۚ قَلِيلًۭا مَّا تَذَكَّرُونَ
entries.t: Nor is it the speech of a soothsayer-little do you take heed.
entries.na: ولا بقول كاهن قليلا ما تذكرون
entries.nt: nor is it the speech of a soothsayer little do you take heed

entries.a: تَنزِيلٌۭ مِّن رَّبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
entries.t: It is a revelation from the Lord of the Worlds.
entries.na: تنزيل من رب العلمين
entries.nt: it is a revelation from the lord of the worlds

entries.a: وَلَوْ تَقَوَّلَ عَلَيْنَا بَعْضَ ٱلْأَقَاوِيلِ
entries.t: Had he falsely attributed some statements to Us.
entries.na: ولو تقول علينا بعض الاقاويل
entries.nt: had he falsely attributed some statements to us

entries.a: لَأَخَذْنَا مِنْهُ بِٱلْيَمِينِ
entries.t: We would have seized him by the right arm.
entries.na: لاخذنا منه باليمين
entries.nt: we would have seized him by the right arm

entries.a: ثُمَّ لَقَطَعْنَا مِنْهُ ٱلْوَتِينَ
entries.t: Then slashed his lifeline.
entries.na: ثم لقطعنا منه الوتين
entries.nt: then slashed his lifeline

entries.a: فَمَا مِنكُم مِّنْ أَحَدٍ عَنْهُ حَٰجِزِينَ
entries.t: And none of you could have restrained Us from him.
entries.na: فما منكم من احد عنه حجزين
entries.nt: and none of you could have restrained us from him

entries.a: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَتَذْكِرَةٌۭ لِّلْمُتَّقِينَ
entries.t: Surely, it is a message for the righteous.
entries.na: وانه لتذكره للمتقين
entries.nt: surely it is a message for the righteous

entries.a: وَإِنَّا لَنَعْلَمُ أَنَّ مِنكُم مُّكَذِّبِينَ
entries.t: And We know that some of you will reject it.
entries.na: وانا لنعلم ان منكم مكذبين
entries.nt: and we know that some of you will reject it

entries.a: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَحَسْرَةٌ عَلَى ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ
entries.t: And it is surely a source of grief for the unbelievers.
entries.na: وانه لحسره علي الكفرين
entries.nt: and it is surely a source of grief for the unbelievers

entries.a: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَحَقُّ ٱلْيَقِينِ
entries.t: Yet it is the absolute truth.
entries.na: وانه لحق اليقين
entries.nt: yet it is the absolute truth

entries.a: فَسَبِّحْ بِٱسْمِ رَبِّكَ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
entries.t: So glorify the name of your Lord, the Magnificent.
entries.na: فسبح باسم ربك العظيم
entries.nt: so glorify the name of your lord the magnificent

entries.a: سَأَلَ سَآئِلٌۢ بِعَذَابٍۢ وَاقِعٍۢ
entries.t: A questioner questioned the imminent torment.
entries.na: سال سايل بعذاب واقع
entries.nt: a questioner questioned the imminent torment

entries.a: لِّلْكَٰفِرِينَ لَيْسَ لَهُۥ دَافِعٌۭ
entries.t: For the disbelievers; none can repel it.
entries.na: للكفرين ليس له دافع
entries.nt: for the disbelievers none can repel it

entries.a: مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ ذِى ٱلْمَعَارِجِ
entries.t: From God, Lord of the Ways of Ascent.
entries.na: من الله ذي المعارج
entries.nt: from god lord of the ways of ascent

entries.a: تَعْرُجُ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ إِلَيْهِ فِى يَوْمٍۢ كَانَ مِقْدَارُهُۥ خَمْسِينَ أَلْفَ سَنَةٍۢ
entries.t: Unto Him the angels and the Spirit ascend on a Day the duration of which is fifty thousand years.
entries.na: تعرج المليكه والروح اليه في يوم كان مقداره خمسين الف سنه
entries.nt: unto him the angels and the spirit ascend on a day the duration of which is fifty thousand years

entries.a: فَٱصْبِرْ صَبْرًۭا جَمِيلًا
entries.t: So be patient, with sweet patience.
entries.na: فاصبر صبرا جميلا
entries.nt: so be patient with sweet patience

entries.a: إِنَّهُمْ يَرَوْنَهُۥ بَعِيدًۭا
entries.t: They see it distant.
entries.na: انهم يرونه بعيدا
entries.nt: they see it distant

entries.a: وَنَرَىٰهُ قَرِيبًۭا
entries.t: But We see it near.
entries.na: ونريه قريبا
entries.nt: but we see it near

entries.a: يَوْمَ تَكُونُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ كَٱلْمُهْلِ
entries.t: On the Day when the sky will be like molten brass.
entries.na: يوم تكون السما كالمهل
entries.nt: on the day when the sky will be like molten brass

entries.a: وَتَكُونُ ٱلْجِبَالُ كَٱلْعِهْنِ
entries.t: And the mountains will be like tufted wool.
entries.na: وتكون الجبال كالعهن
entries.nt: and the mountains will be like tufted wool

entries.a: وَلَا يَسْـَٔلُ حَمِيمٌ حَمِيمًۭا
entries.t: No friend will care about his friend.
entries.na: ولا يسل حميم حميما
entries.nt: no friend will care about his friend

entries.a: يُبَصَّرُونَهُمْ ۚ يَوَدُّ ٱلْمُجْرِمُ لَوْ يَفْتَدِى مِنْ عَذَابِ يَوْمِئِذٍۭ بِبَنِيهِ
entries.t: They will be shown each other. The criminal wishes he would be redeemed from the punishment of that Day by his children.
entries.na: يبصرونهم يود المجرم لو يفتدي من عذاب يوميذ ببنيه
entries.nt: they will be shown each other the criminal wishes he would be redeemed from the punishment of that day by his children

entries.a: وَصَٰحِبَتِهِۦ وَأَخِيهِ
entries.t: And his spouse, and his brother.
entries.na: وصحبته واخيه
entries.nt: and his spouse and his brother

entries.a: وَفَصِيلَتِهِ ٱلَّتِى تُـْٔوِيهِ
entries.t: And his family that sheltered him.
entries.na: وفصيلته التي تويه
entries.nt: and his family that sheltered him

entries.a: وَمَن فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًۭا ثُمَّ يُنجِيهِ
entries.t: And everyone on earth, in order to save him.
entries.na: ومن في الارض جميعا ثم ينجيه
entries.nt: and everyone on earth in order to save him

entries.a: كَلَّآ ۖ إِنَّهَا لَظَىٰ
entries.t: By no means! It is a Raging Fire.
entries.na: كلا انها لظي
entries.nt: by no means it is a raging fire

entries.a: نَزَّاعَةًۭ لِّلشَّوَىٰ
entries.t: It strips away the scalps.
entries.na: نزاعه للشوي
entries.nt: it strips away the scalps

entries.a: تَدْعُوا۟ مَنْ أَدْبَرَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ
entries.t: It invites him who once turned his back and fled.
entries.na: تدعوا من ادبر وتولي
entries.nt: it invites him who once turned his back and fled

entries.a: وَجَمَعَ فَأَوْعَىٰٓ
entries.t: And accumulated and hoarded.
entries.na: وجمع فاوعي
entries.nt: and accumulated and hoarded

entries.a: ۞ إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ خُلِقَ هَلُوعًا
entries.t: Man was created restless.
entries.na: ان الانسن خلق هلوعا
entries.nt: man was created restless

entries.a: إِذَا مَسَّهُ ٱلشَّرُّ جَزُوعًۭا
entries.t: Touched by adversity, he is fretful.
entries.na: اذا مسه الشر جزوعا
entries.nt: touched by adversity he is fretful

entries.a: وَإِذَا مَسَّهُ ٱلْخَيْرُ مَنُوعًا
entries.t: Touched by good, he is ungenerous.
entries.na: واذا مسه الخير منوعا
entries.nt: touched by good he is ungenerous

entries.a: إِلَّا ٱلْمُصَلِّينَ
entries.t: Except the prayerful.
entries.na: الا المصلين
entries.nt: except the prayerful

entries.a: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَلَىٰ صَلَاتِهِمْ دَآئِمُونَ
entries.t: Those who are constant at their prayers.
entries.na: الذين هم علي صلاتهم دايمون
entries.nt: those who are constant at their prayers

entries.a: وَٱلَّذِينَ فِىٓ أَمْوَٰلِهِمْ حَقٌّۭ مَّعْلُومٌۭ
entries.t: And those in whose wealth is a rightful share.
entries.na: والذين في امولهم حق معلوم
entries.nt: and those in whose wealth is a rightful share

entries.a: لِّلسَّآئِلِ وَٱلْمَحْرُومِ
entries.t: For the beggar and the deprived.
entries.na: للسايل والمحروم
entries.nt: for the beggar and the deprived

entries.a: وَٱلَّذِينَ يُصَدِّقُونَ بِيَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
entries.t: And those who affirm the Day of Judgment.
entries.na: والذين يصدقون بيوم الدين
entries.nt: and those who affirm the day of judgment

entries.a: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم مِّنْ عَذَابِ رَبِّهِم مُّشْفِقُونَ
entries.t: And those who fear the punishment of their Lord.
entries.na: والذين هم من عذاب ربهم مشفقون
entries.nt: and those who fear the punishment of their lord

entries.a: إِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّهِمْ غَيْرُ مَأْمُونٍۢ
entries.t: Their Lord's punishment is not to be taken for granted.
entries.na: ان عذاب ربهم غير مامون
entries.nt: their lord s punishment is not to be taken for granted

entries.a: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ لِفُرُوجِهِمْ حَٰفِظُونَ
entries.t: And those who guard their chastity.
entries.na: والذين هم لفروجهم حفظون
entries.nt: and those who guard their chastity

entries.a: إِلَّا عَلَىٰٓ أَزْوَٰجِهِمْ أَوْ مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَٰنُهُمْ فَإِنَّهُمْ غَيْرُ مَلُومِينَ
entries.t: Except from their spouses or those living under their control, for then they are free of blame.
entries.na: الا علي ازوجهم او ما ملكت ايمنهم فانهم غير ملومين
entries.nt: except from their spouses or those living under their control for then they are free of blame

entries.a: فَمَنِ ٱبْتَغَىٰ وَرَآءَ ذَٰلِكَ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْعَادُونَ
entries.t: But whoever seeks to go beyond that-these are the transgressors.
entries.na: فمن ابتغي ورا ذلك فاوليك هم العادون
entries.nt: but whoever seeks to go beyond that these are the transgressors

entries.a: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ لِأَمَٰنَٰتِهِمْ وَعَهْدِهِمْ رَٰعُونَ
entries.t: And those who honor their trusts and their pledges.
entries.na: والذين هم لامنتهم وعهدهم رعون
entries.nt: and those who honor their trusts and their pledges

entries.a: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم بِشَهَٰدَٰتِهِمْ قَآئِمُونَ
entries.t: And those who stand by their testimonies.
entries.na: والذين هم بشهدتهم قايمون
entries.nt: and those who stand by their testimonies

entries.a: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَلَىٰ صَلَاتِهِمْ يُحَافِظُونَ
entries.t: And those who are dedicated to their prayers.
entries.na: والذين هم علي صلاتهم يحافظون
entries.nt: and those who are dedicated to their prayers

entries.a: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ فِى جَنَّٰتٍۢ مُّكْرَمُونَ
entries.t: These will be honored in Gardens.
entries.na: اوليك في جنت مكرمون
entries.nt: these will be honored in gardens

entries.a: فَمَالِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ قِبَلَكَ مُهْطِعِينَ
entries.t: What is with those who disbelieve, stretching their necks towards you.
entries.na: فمال الذين كفروا قبلك مهطعين
entries.nt: what is with those who disbelieve stretching their necks towards you

entries.a: عَنِ ٱلْيَمِينِ وَعَنِ ٱلشِّمَالِ عِزِينَ
entries.t: From the right, and from the left, banding together?
entries.na: عن اليمين وعن الشمال عزين
entries.nt: from the right and from the left banding together

entries.a: أَيَطْمَعُ كُلُّ ٱمْرِئٍۢ مِّنْهُمْ أَن يُدْخَلَ جَنَّةَ نَعِيمٍۢ
entries.t: Is every one of them aspiring to be admitted into a Garden of Bliss?
entries.na: ايطمع كل امري منهم ان يدخل جنه نعيم
entries.nt: is every one of them aspiring to be admitted into a garden of bliss

entries.a: كَلَّآ ۖ إِنَّا خَلَقْنَٰهُم مِّمَّا يَعْلَمُونَ
entries.t: No indeed! We created them from what they know.
entries.na: كلا انا خلقنهم مما يعلمون
entries.nt: no indeed we created them from what they know

entries.a: فَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِرَبِّ ٱلْمَشَٰرِقِ وَٱلْمَغَٰرِبِ إِنَّا لَقَٰدِرُونَ
entries.t: I swear by the Lord of the Easts and the Wests, that We are Able.
entries.na: فلا اقسم برب المشرق والمغرب انا لقدرون
entries.nt: i swear by the lord of the easts and the wests that we are able

entries.a: عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّبَدِّلَ خَيْرًۭا مِّنْهُمْ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَسْبُوقِينَ
entries.t: To replace them with better than they, and We are not to be outdone.
entries.na: علي ان نبدل خيرا منهم وما نحن بمسبوقين
entries.nt: to replace them with better than they and we are not to be outdone

entries.a: فَذَرْهُمْ يَخُوضُوا۟ وَيَلْعَبُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ يُلَٰقُوا۟ يَوْمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِى يُوعَدُونَ
entries.t: So leave them to blunder and play, until they meet their Day which they are promised.
entries.na: فذرهم يخوضوا ويلعبوا حتي يلقوا يومهم الذي يوعدون
entries.nt: so leave them to blunder and play until they meet their day which they are promised

entries.a: يَوْمَ يَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ ٱلْأَجْدَاثِ سِرَاعًۭا كَأَنَّهُمْ إِلَىٰ نُصُبٍۢ يُوفِضُونَ
entries.t: The Day when they will emerge from the tombs in a rush, as though they were hurrying towards a target.
entries.na: يوم يخرجون من الاجداث سراعا كانهم الي نصب يوفضون
entries.nt: the day when they will emerge from the tombs in a rush as though they were hurrying towards a target

entries.a: خَٰشِعَةً أَبْصَٰرُهُمْ تَرْهَقُهُمْ ذِلَّةٌۭ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمُ ٱلَّذِى كَانُوا۟ يُوعَدُونَ
entries.t: Their eyes cast down; overwhelmed by humiliation. This is the Day which they were promised.
entries.na: خشعه ابصرهم ترهقهم ذله ذلك اليوم الذي كانوا يوعدون
entries.nt: their eyes cast down overwhelmed by humiliation this is the day which they were promised

entries.a: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦٓ أَنْ أَنذِرْ قَوْمَكَ مِن قَبْلِ أَن يَأْتِيَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌۭ
entries.t: We sent Noah to his people: "Warn your people before there comes upon them a painful punishment."
entries.na: انا ارسلنا نوحا الي قومه ان انذر قومك من قبل ان ياتيهم عذاب اليم
entries.nt: we sent noah to his people warn your people before there comes upon them a painful punishment

entries.a: قَالَ يَٰقَوْمِ إِنِّى لَكُمْ نَذِيرٌۭ مُّبِينٌ
entries.t: He said, "O my people, I am to you a clear warner.
entries.na: قال يقوم اني لكم نذير مبين
entries.nt: he said o my people i am to you a clear warner

entries.a: أَنِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱتَّقُوهُ وَأَطِيعُونِ
entries.t: Worship God and reverence Him, and obey me.
entries.na: ان اعبدوا الله واتقوه واطيعون
entries.nt: worship god and reverence him and obey me

entries.a: يَغْفِرْ لَكُم مِّن ذُنُوبِكُمْ وَيُؤَخِّرْكُمْ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍۢ مُّسَمًّى ۚ إِنَّ أَجَلَ ٱللَّهِ إِذَا جَآءَ لَا يُؤَخَّرُ ۖ لَوْ كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
entries.t: And He will forgive you of your sins, and reprieve you until a stated term. God's term cannot be deferred once it has arrived, if you only knew."
entries.na: يغفر لكم من ذنوبكم ويوخركم الي اجل مسمي ان اجل الله اذا جا لا يوخر لو كنتم تعلمون
entries.nt: and he will forgive you of your sins and reprieve you until a stated term god s term cannot be deferred once it has arrived if you only knew

entries.a: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّى دَعَوْتُ قَوْمِى لَيْلًۭا وَنَهَارًۭا
entries.t: He said, "My Lord, I have called my people night and day.
entries.na: قال رب اني دعوت قومي ليلا ونهارا
entries.nt: he said my lord i have called my people night and day

entries.a: فَلَمْ يَزِدْهُمْ دُعَآءِىٓ إِلَّا فِرَارًۭا
entries.t: But my call added only to their flight.
entries.na: فلم يزدهم دعاي الا فرارا
entries.nt: but my call added only to their flight

entries.a: وَإِنِّى كُلَّمَا دَعَوْتُهُمْ لِتَغْفِرَ لَهُمْ جَعَلُوٓا۟ أَصَٰبِعَهُمْ فِىٓ ءَاذَانِهِمْ وَٱسْتَغْشَوْا۟ ثِيَابَهُمْ وَأَصَرُّوا۟ وَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ ٱسْتِكْبَارًۭا
entries.t: Whenever I called them to Your forgiveness, they thrust their fingers into their ears, and wrapped themselves in their garments, and insisted, and became more and more arrogant.
entries.na: واني كلما دعوتهم لتغفر لهم جعلوا اصبعهم في اذانهم واستغشوا ثيابهم واصروا واستكبروا استكبارا
entries.nt: whenever i called them to your forgiveness they thrust their fingers into their ears and wrapped themselves in their garments and insisted and became more and more arrogant

entries.a: ثُمَّ إِنِّى دَعَوْتُهُمْ جِهَارًۭا
entries.t: Then I called them openly.
entries.na: ثم اني دعوتهم جهارا
entries.nt: then i called them openly

entries.a: ثُمَّ إِنِّىٓ أَعْلَنتُ لَهُمْ وَأَسْرَرْتُ لَهُمْ إِسْرَارًۭا
entries.t: Then I appealed to them publicly, and I spoke to them privately.
entries.na: ثم اني اعلنت لهم واسررت لهم اسرارا
entries.nt: then i appealed to them publicly and i spoke to them privately

entries.a: فَقُلْتُ ٱسْتَغْفِرُوا۟ رَبَّكُمْ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ غَفَّارًۭا
entries.t: I said, 'Ask your Lord for forgiveness; He is Forgiving.
entries.na: فقلت استغفروا ربكم انه كان غفارا
entries.nt: i said ask your lord for forgiveness he is forgiving

entries.a: يُرْسِلِ ٱلسَّمَآءَ عَلَيْكُم مِّدْرَارًۭا
entries.t: He will let loose the sky upon you in torrents.
entries.na: يرسل السما عليكم مدرارا
entries.nt: he will let loose the sky upon you in torrents

entries.a: وَيُمْدِدْكُم بِأَمْوَٰلٍۢ وَبَنِينَ وَيَجْعَل لَّكُمْ جَنَّٰتٍۢ وَيَجْعَل لَّكُمْ أَنْهَٰرًۭا
entries.t: And provide you with wealth and children, and allot for you gardens, and allot for you rivers.
entries.na: ويمددكم بامول وبنين ويجعل لكم جنت ويجعل لكم انهرا
entries.nt: and provide you with wealth and children and allot for you gardens and allot for you rivers

entries.a: مَّا لَكُمْ لَا تَرْجُونَ لِلَّهِ وَقَارًۭا
entries.t: What is the matter with you, that you do not appreciate God's Greatness?
entries.na: ما لكم لا ترجون لله وقارا
entries.nt: what is the matter with you that you do not appreciate god s greatness

entries.a: وَقَدْ خَلَقَكُمْ أَطْوَارًا
entries.t: Although He created you in stages.
entries.na: وقد خلقكم اطوارا
entries.nt: although he created you in stages

entries.a: أَلَمْ تَرَوْا۟ كَيْفَ خَلَقَ ٱللَّهُ سَبْعَ سَمَٰوَٰتٍۢ طِبَاقًۭا
entries.t: Do you not realize that God created seven heavens in layers?
entries.na: الم تروا كيف خلق الله سبع سموت طباقا
entries.nt: do you not realize that god created seven heavens in layers

entries.a: وَجَعَلَ ٱلْقَمَرَ فِيهِنَّ نُورًۭا وَجَعَلَ ٱلشَّمْسَ سِرَاجًۭا
entries.t: And He set the moon in their midst for light, and He made the sun a lamp.
entries.na: وجعل القمر فيهن نورا وجعل الشمس سراجا
entries.nt: and he set the moon in their midst for light and he made the sun a lamp

entries.a: وَٱللَّهُ أَنۢبَتَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ نَبَاتًۭا
entries.t: And God germinated you from the earth like plants.
entries.na: والله انبتكم من الارض نباتا
entries.nt: and god germinated you from the earth like plants

entries.a: ثُمَّ يُعِيدُكُمْ فِيهَا وَيُخْرِجُكُمْ إِخْرَاجًۭا
entries.t: Then He will return you into it, and will bring you out again.
entries.na: ثم يعيدكم فيها ويخرجكم اخراجا
entries.nt: then he will return you into it and will bring you out again

entries.a: وَٱللَّهُ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ بِسَاطًۭا
entries.t: And God made the earth a spread for you.
entries.na: والله جعل لكم الارض بساطا
entries.nt: and god made the earth a spread for you

entries.a: لِّتَسْلُكُوا۟ مِنْهَا سُبُلًۭا فِجَاجًۭا
entries.t: That you may travel its diverse roads.'"
entries.na: لتسلكوا منها سبلا فجاجا
entries.nt: that you may travel its diverse roads

entries.a: قَالَ نُوحٌۭ رَّبِّ إِنَّهُمْ عَصَوْنِى وَٱتَّبَعُوا۟ مَن لَّمْ يَزِدْهُ مَالُهُۥ وَوَلَدُهُۥٓ إِلَّا خَسَارًۭا
entries.t: Noah said, "My Lord, they have defied me, and followed him whose wealth and children increase him only in perdition."
entries.na: قال نوح رب انهم عصوني واتبعوا من لم يزده ماله وولده الا خسارا
entries.nt: noah said my lord they have defied me and followed him whose wealth and children increase him only in perdition

entries.a: وَمَكَرُوا۟ مَكْرًۭا كُبَّارًۭا
entries.t: And they schemed outrageous schemes.
entries.na: ومكروا مكرا كبارا
entries.nt: and they schemed outrageous schemes

entries.a: وَقَالُوا۟ لَا تَذَرُنَّ ءَالِهَتَكُمْ وَلَا تَذَرُنَّ وَدًّۭا وَلَا سُوَاعًۭا وَلَا يَغُوثَ وَيَعُوقَ وَنَسْرًۭا
entries.t: And they said, "Do not give up your gods; do not give up Wadd, nor Souwa, nor Yaghoos, and Yaooq, and Nassr.
entries.na: وقالوا لا تذرن الهتكم ولا تذرن ودا ولا سواعا ولا يغوث ويعوق ونسرا
entries.nt: and they said do not give up your gods do not give up wadd nor souwa nor yaghoos and yaooq and nassr

entries.a: وَقَدْ أَضَلُّوا۟ كَثِيرًۭا ۖ وَلَا تَزِدِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ إِلَّا ضَلَٰلًۭا
entries.t: They have misled many, so do not increase the wrongdoers except in confusion."
entries.na: وقد اضلوا كثيرا ولا تزد الظلمين الا ضللا
entries.nt: they have misled many so do not increase the wrongdoers except in confusion

entries.a: مِّمَّا خَطِيٓـَٰٔتِهِمْ أُغْرِقُوا۟ فَأُدْخِلُوا۟ نَارًۭا فَلَمْ يَجِدُوا۟ لَهُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَنصَارًۭا
entries.t: Because of their wrongs, they were drowned, and were hurled into a Fire. They did not find apart from God any helpers.
entries.na: مما خطيتهم اغرقوا فادخلوا نارا فلم يجدوا لهم من دون الله انصارا
entries.nt: because of their wrongs they were drowned and were hurled into a fire they did not find apart from god any helpers

entries.a: وَقَالَ نُوحٌۭ رَّبِّ لَا تَذَرْ عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ مِنَ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ دَيَّارًا
entries.t: Noah said, "My Lord, do not leave of the unbelievers a single dweller on earth.
entries.na: وقال نوح رب لا تذر علي الارض من الكفرين ديارا
entries.nt: noah said my lord do not leave of the unbelievers a single dweller on earth

entries.a: إِنَّكَ إِن تَذَرْهُمْ يُضِلُّوا۟ عِبَادَكَ وَلَا يَلِدُوٓا۟ إِلَّا فَاجِرًۭا كَفَّارًۭا
entries.t: If You leave them, they will mislead your servants, and will breed only wicked unbelievers.
entries.na: انك ان تذرهم يضلوا عبادك ولا يلدوا الا فاجرا كفارا
entries.nt: if you leave them they will mislead your servants and will breed only wicked unbelievers

entries.a: رَّبِّ ٱغْفِرْ لِى وَلِوَٰلِدَىَّ وَلِمَن دَخَلَ بَيْتِىَ مُؤْمِنًۭا وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَٰتِ وَلَا تَزِدِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ إِلَّا تَبَارًۢا
entries.t: My Lord! Forgive me and my parents, and anyone who enters my home in faith, and all the believing men and believing women; and do not increase the wrongdoers except in perdition."
entries.na: رب اغفر لي ولولدي ولمن دخل بيتي مومنا وللمومنين والمومنت ولا تزد الظلمين الا تبارا
entries.nt: my lord forgive me and my parents and anyone who enters my home in faith and all the believing men and believing women and do not increase the wrongdoers except in perdition

entries.a: قُلْ أُوحِىَ إِلَىَّ أَنَّهُ ٱسْتَمَعَ نَفَرٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلْجِنِّ فَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا سَمِعْنَا قُرْءَانًا عَجَبًۭا
entries.t: Say, "It was revealed to me that a band of jinn listened in, and said, 'We have heard a wondrous Quran.
entries.na: قل اوحي الي انه استمع نفر من الجن فقالوا انا سمعنا قرانا عجبا
entries.nt: say it was revealed to me that a band of jinn listened in and said we have heard a wondrous quran

entries.a: يَهْدِىٓ إِلَى ٱلرُّشْدِ فَـَٔامَنَّا بِهِۦ ۖ وَلَن نُّشْرِكَ بِرَبِّنَآ أَحَدًۭا
entries.t: It guides to rectitude, so we have believed in it; and we will never associate anyone with our Lord.
entries.na: يهدي الي الرشد فامنا به ولن نشرك بربنا احدا
entries.nt: it guides to rectitude so we have believed in it and we will never associate anyone with our lord

entries.a: وَأَنَّهُۥ تَعَٰلَىٰ جَدُّ رَبِّنَا مَا ٱتَّخَذَ صَٰحِبَةًۭ وَلَا وَلَدًۭا
entries.t: And Exalted is the Grandeur of our Lord-He never had a mate, nor a child.
entries.na: وانه تعلي جد ربنا ما اتخذ صحبه ولا ولدا
entries.nt: and exalted is the grandeur of our lord he never had a mate nor a child

entries.a: وَأَنَّهُۥ كَانَ يَقُولُ سَفِيهُنَا عَلَى ٱللَّهِ شَطَطًۭا
entries.t: But the fools among us used to say nonsense about God.
entries.na: وانه كان يقول سفيهنا علي الله شططا
entries.nt: but the fools among us used to say nonsense about god

entries.a: وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّآ أَن لَّن تَقُولَ ٱلْإِنسُ وَٱلْجِنُّ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًۭا
entries.t: And we thought that humans and jinn would never utter lies about God.
entries.na: وانا ظننا ان لن تقول الانس والجن علي الله كذبا
entries.nt: and we thought that humans and jinn would never utter lies about god

entries.a: وَأَنَّهُۥ كَانَ رِجَالٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلْإِنسِ يَعُوذُونَ بِرِجَالٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلْجِنِّ فَزَادُوهُمْ رَهَقًۭا
entries.t: Some individual humans used to seek power through some individual jinn, but they only increased them in confusion.
entries.na: وانه كان رجال من الانس يعوذون برجال من الجن فزادوهم رهقا
entries.nt: some individual humans used to seek power through some individual jinn but they only increased them in confusion

entries.a: وَأَنَّهُمْ ظَنُّوا۟ كَمَا ظَنَنتُمْ أَن لَّن يَبْعَثَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدًۭا
entries.t: They thought, as you thought, that God would never resurrect anyone.
entries.na: وانهم ظنوا كما ظننتم ان لن يبعث الله احدا
entries.nt: they thought as you thought that god would never resurrect anyone

entries.a: وَأَنَّا لَمَسْنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ فَوَجَدْنَٰهَا مُلِئَتْ حَرَسًۭا شَدِيدًۭا وَشُهُبًۭا
entries.t: We probed the heaven, and found it filled with stern guards and projectiles.
entries.na: وانا لمسنا السما فوجدنها مليت حرسا شديدا وشهبا
entries.nt: we probed the heaven and found it filled with stern guards and projectiles

entries.a: وَأَنَّا كُنَّا نَقْعُدُ مِنْهَا مَقَٰعِدَ لِلسَّمْعِ ۖ فَمَن يَسْتَمِعِ ٱلْءَانَ يَجِدْ لَهُۥ شِهَابًۭا رَّصَدًۭا
entries.t: We used to take up positions to listen in; but whoever listens now finds a projectile in wait for him.
entries.na: وانا كنا نقعد منها مقعد للسمع فمن يستمع الان يجد له شهابا رصدا
entries.nt: we used to take up positions to listen in but whoever listens now finds a projectile in wait for him

entries.a: وَأَنَّا لَا نَدْرِىٓ أَشَرٌّ أُرِيدَ بِمَن فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ أَمْ أَرَادَ بِهِمْ رَبُّهُمْ رَشَدًۭا
entries.t: We do not know whether ill is intended for those on earth, or if their Lord intends goodness for them.
entries.na: وانا لا ندري اشر اريد بمن في الارض ام اراد بهم ربهم رشدا
entries.nt: we do not know whether ill is intended for those on earth or if their lord intends goodness for them

entries.a: وَأَنَّا مِنَّا ٱلصَّٰلِحُونَ وَمِنَّا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ ۖ كُنَّا طَرَآئِقَ قِدَدًۭا
entries.t: Some of us are righteous, but some of us are less than that; we follow divergent paths.
entries.na: وانا منا الصلحون ومنا دون ذلك كنا طرايق قددا
entries.nt: some of us are righteous but some of us are less than that we follow divergent paths

entries.a: وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّآ أَن لَّن نُّعْجِزَ ٱللَّهَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَن نُّعْجِزَهُۥ هَرَبًۭا
entries.t: We realized that we cannot defeat God on earth, and that we cannot escape Him by fleeing.
entries.na: وانا ظننا ان لن نعجز الله في الارض ولن نعجزه هربا
entries.nt: we realized that we cannot defeat god on earth and that we cannot escape him by fleeing

entries.a: وَأَنَّا لَمَّا سَمِعْنَا ٱلْهُدَىٰٓ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦ ۖ فَمَن يُؤْمِنۢ بِرَبِّهِۦ فَلَا يَخَافُ بَخْسًۭا وَلَا رَهَقًۭا
entries.t: And when we heard the guidance, we believed in it. Whoever believes in his Lord fears neither loss, nor burden.
entries.na: وانا لما سمعنا الهدي امنا به فمن يومن بربه فلا يخاف بخسا ولا رهقا
entries.nt: and when we heard the guidance we believed in it whoever believes in his lord fears neither loss nor burden

entries.a: وَأَنَّا مِنَّا ٱلْمُسْلِمُونَ وَمِنَّا ٱلْقَٰسِطُونَ ۖ فَمَنْ أَسْلَمَ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ تَحَرَّوْا۟ رَشَدًۭا
entries.t: Among us are those who are submitting, and among us are the compromisers. As for those who have submitted-it is they who pursue rectitude.
entries.na: وانا منا المسلمون ومنا القسطون فمن اسلم فاوليك تحروا رشدا
entries.nt: among us are those who are submitting and among us are the compromisers as for those who have submitted it is they who pursue rectitude

entries.a: وَأَمَّا ٱلْقَٰسِطُونَ فَكَانُوا۟ لِجَهَنَّمَ حَطَبًۭا
entries.t: But as for the compromisers-they will be firewood for Hell.'"
entries.na: واما القسطون فكانوا لجهنم حطبا
entries.nt: but as for the compromisers they will be firewood for hell

entries.a: وَأَلَّوِ ٱسْتَقَٰمُوا۟ عَلَى ٱلطَّرِيقَةِ لَأَسْقَيْنَٰهُم مَّآءً غَدَقًۭا
entries.t: Had they kept true to the Path, We would have given them plenty water to drink.
entries.na: والو استقموا علي الطريقه لاسقينهم ما غدقا
entries.nt: had they kept true to the path we would have given them plenty water to drink

entries.a: لِّنَفْتِنَهُمْ فِيهِ ۚ وَمَن يُعْرِضْ عَن ذِكْرِ رَبِّهِۦ يَسْلُكْهُ عَذَابًۭا صَعَدًۭا
entries.t: To test them with it. Whoever turns away from the remembrance of his Lord, He will direct him to torment ever mounting.
entries.na: لنفتنهم فيه ومن يعرض عن ذكر ربه يسلكه عذابا صعدا
entries.nt: to test them with it whoever turns away from the remembrance of his lord he will direct him to torment ever mounting

entries.a: وَأَنَّ ٱلْمَسَٰجِدَ لِلَّهِ فَلَا تَدْعُوا۟ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ أَحَدًۭا
entries.t: The places of worship are for God. So do not call, besides God, upon anyone else.
entries.na: وان المسجد لله فلا تدعوا مع الله احدا
entries.nt: the places of worship are for god so do not call besides god upon anyone else

entries.a: وَأَنَّهُۥ لَمَّا قَامَ عَبْدُ ٱللَّهِ يَدْعُوهُ كَادُوا۟ يَكُونُونَ عَلَيْهِ لِبَدًۭا
entries.t: And when the servant of God got up calling on Him, they almost fell on him in a mass.
entries.na: وانه لما قام عبد الله يدعوه كادوا يكونون عليه لبدا
entries.nt: and when the servant of god got up calling on him they almost fell on him in a mass

entries.a: قُلْ إِنَّمَآ أَدْعُوا۟ رَبِّى وَلَآ أُشْرِكُ بِهِۦٓ أَحَدًۭا
entries.t: Say, "I pray only to my Lord, and I never associate anyone with Him."
entries.na: قل انما ادعوا ربي ولا اشرك به احدا
entries.nt: say i pray only to my lord and i never associate anyone with him

entries.a: قُلْ إِنِّى لَآ أَمْلِكُ لَكُمْ ضَرًّۭا وَلَا رَشَدًۭا
entries.t: Say, "It is not in my power to harm you, nor to bring you to right conduct."
entries.na: قل اني لا املك لكم ضرا ولا رشدا
entries.nt: say it is not in my power to harm you nor to bring you to right conduct

entries.a: قُلْ إِنِّى لَن يُجِيرَنِى مِنَ ٱللَّهِ أَحَدٌۭ وَلَنْ أَجِدَ مِن دُونِهِۦ مُلْتَحَدًا
entries.t: Say, "No one can protect me from God, and I will not find any refuge except with Him.
entries.na: قل اني لن يجيرني من الله احد ولن اجد من دونه ملتحدا
entries.nt: say no one can protect me from god and i will not find any refuge except with him

entries.a: إِلَّا بَلَٰغًۭا مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَرِسَٰلَٰتِهِۦ ۚ وَمَن يَعْصِ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ فَإِنَّ لَهُۥ نَارَ جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدًا
entries.t: Except for a proclamation from God and His messages. He who defies God and His Messenger-for him is the Fire of Hell, in which they will dwell forever."
entries.na: الا بلغا من الله ورسلته ومن يعص الله ورسوله فان له نار جهنم خلدين فيها ابدا
entries.nt: except for a proclamation from god and his messages he who defies god and his messenger for him is the fire of hell in which they will dwell forever

entries.a: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا رَأَوْا۟ مَا يُوعَدُونَ فَسَيَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ أَضْعَفُ نَاصِرًۭا وَأَقَلُّ عَدَدًۭا
entries.t: Until, when they see what they were promised, they will know who is weaker in helpers, and fewer in numbers.
entries.na: حتي اذا راوا ما يوعدون فسيعلمون من اضعف ناصرا واقل عددا
entries.nt: until when they see what they were promised they will know who is weaker in helpers and fewer in numbers

entries.a: قُلْ إِنْ أَدْرِىٓ أَقَرِيبٌۭ مَّا تُوعَدُونَ أَمْ يَجْعَلُ لَهُۥ رَبِّىٓ أَمَدًا
entries.t: Say, "I do not know whether what you are promised is near, or whether my Lord will extend it for a period."
entries.na: قل ان ادري اقريب ما توعدون ام يجعل له ربي امدا
entries.nt: say i do not know whether what you are promised is near or whether my lord will extend it for a period

entries.a: عَٰلِمُ ٱلْغَيْبِ فَلَا يُظْهِرُ عَلَىٰ غَيْبِهِۦٓ أَحَدًا
entries.t: The Knower of the Invisible; He does not disclose His Invisible to anyone.
entries.na: علم الغيب فلا يظهر علي غيبه احدا
entries.nt: the knower of the invisible he does not disclose his invisible to anyone

entries.a: إِلَّا مَنِ ٱرْتَضَىٰ مِن رَّسُولٍۢ فَإِنَّهُۥ يَسْلُكُ مِنۢ بَيْنِ يَدَيْهِ وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِۦ رَصَدًۭا
entries.t: Except to a Messenger of His choosing. He then dispatches guards before him and behind him.
entries.na: الا من ارتضي من رسول فانه يسلك من بين يديه ومن خلفه رصدا
entries.nt: except to a messenger of his choosing he then dispatches guards before him and behind him

entries.a: لِّيَعْلَمَ أَن قَدْ أَبْلَغُوا۟ رِسَٰلَٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ وَأَحَاطَ بِمَا لَدَيْهِمْ وَأَحْصَىٰ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ عَدَدًۢا
entries.t: That He may know that they have conveyed the messages of their Lord. He encompasses what they have, and has tallied everything by number.
entries.na: ليعلم ان قد ابلغوا رسلت ربهم واحاط بما لديهم واحصي كل شي عددا
entries.nt: that he may know that they have conveyed the messages of their lord he encompasses what they have and has tallied everything by number

entries.a: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْمُزَّمِّلُ
entries.t: O you Enwrapped one.
entries.na: يايها المزمل
entries.nt: o you enwrapped one

entries.a: قُمِ ٱلَّيْلَ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا
entries.t: Stay up during the night, except a little.
entries.na: قم اليل الا قليلا
entries.nt: stay up during the night except a little

entries.a: نِّصْفَهُۥٓ أَوِ ٱنقُصْ مِنْهُ قَلِيلًا
entries.t: For half of it, or reduce it a little.
entries.na: نصفه او انقص منه قليلا
entries.nt: for half of it or reduce it a little

entries.a: أَوْ زِدْ عَلَيْهِ وَرَتِّلِ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ تَرْتِيلًا
entries.t: Or add to it; and chant the Quran rhythmically.
entries.na: او زد عليه ورتل القران ترتيلا
entries.nt: or add to it and chant the quran rhythmically

entries.a: إِنَّا سَنُلْقِى عَلَيْكَ قَوْلًۭا ثَقِيلًا
entries.t: We are about to give you a heavy message.
entries.na: انا سنلقي عليك قولا ثقيلا
entries.nt: we are about to give you a heavy message

entries.a: إِنَّ نَاشِئَةَ ٱلَّيْلِ هِىَ أَشَدُّ وَطْـًۭٔا وَأَقْوَمُ قِيلًا
entries.t: The vigil of night is more effective, and better suited for recitation.
entries.na: ان ناشيه اليل هي اشد وطا واقوم قيلا
entries.nt: the vigil of night is more effective and better suited for recitation

entries.a: إِنَّ لَكَ فِى ٱلنَّهَارِ سَبْحًۭا طَوِيلًۭا
entries.t: In the daytime, you have lengthy work to do.
entries.na: ان لك في النهار سبحا طويلا
entries.nt: in the daytime you have lengthy work to do

entries.a: وَٱذْكُرِ ٱسْمَ رَبِّكَ وَتَبَتَّلْ إِلَيْهِ تَبْتِيلًۭا
entries.t: So remember the Name of your Lord, and devote yourself to Him wholeheartedly.
entries.na: واذكر اسم ربك وتبتل اليه تبتيلا
entries.nt: so remember the name of your lord and devote yourself to him wholeheartedly

entries.a: رَّبُّ ٱلْمَشْرِقِ وَٱلْمَغْرِبِ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ فَٱتَّخِذْهُ وَكِيلًۭا
entries.t: Lord of the East and the West. There is no god but He, so take Him as a Trustee.
entries.na: رب المشرق والمغرب لا اله الا هو فاتخذه وكيلا
entries.nt: lord of the east and the west there is no god but he so take him as a trustee

entries.a: وَٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَٱهْجُرْهُمْ هَجْرًۭا جَمِيلًۭا
entries.t: And endure patiently what they say, and withdraw from them politely.
entries.na: واصبر علي ما يقولون واهجرهم هجرا جميلا
entries.nt: and endure patiently what they say and withdraw from them politely

entries.a: وَذَرْنِى وَٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ أُو۟لِى ٱلنَّعْمَةِ وَمَهِّلْهُمْ قَلِيلًا
entries.t: And leave Me to those who deny the truth, those of luxury, and give them a brief respite.
entries.na: وذرني والمكذبين اولي النعمه ومهلهم قليلا
entries.nt: and leave me to those who deny the truth those of luxury and give them a brief respite

entries.a: إِنَّ لَدَيْنَآ أَنكَالًۭا وَجَحِيمًۭا
entries.t: With Us are shackles, and a Fierce Fire.
entries.na: ان لدينا انكالا وجحيما
entries.nt: with us are shackles and a fierce fire
