entries.a: وَطَعَامًۭا ذَا غُصَّةٍۢ وَعَذَابًا أَلِيمًۭا
entries.t: And food that chokes, and a painful punishment.
entries.na: وطعاما ذا غصه وعذابا اليما
entries.nt: and food that chokes and a painful punishment

entries.a: يَوْمَ تَرْجُفُ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَٱلْجِبَالُ وَكَانَتِ ٱلْجِبَالُ كَثِيبًۭا مَّهِيلًا
entries.t: On the Day when the earth and the mountains tremble, and the mountains become heaps of sand.
entries.na: يوم ترجف الارض والجبال وكانت الجبال كثيبا مهيلا
entries.nt: on the day when the earth and the mountains tremble and the mountains become heaps of sand

entries.a: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْكُمْ رَسُولًۭا شَٰهِدًا عَلَيْكُمْ كَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ رَسُولًۭا
entries.t: We have sent to you a messenger, a witness over you, as We sent to Pharaoh a messenger.
entries.na: انا ارسلنا اليكم رسولا شهدا عليكم كما ارسلنا الي فرعون رسولا
entries.nt: we have sent to you a messenger a witness over you as we sent to pharaoh a messenger

entries.a: فَعَصَىٰ فِرْعَوْنُ ٱلرَّسُولَ فَأَخَذْنَٰهُ أَخْذًۭا وَبِيلًۭا
entries.t: But Pharaoh defied the Messenger, so We seized him with a terrible seizing.
entries.na: فعصي فرعون الرسول فاخذنه اخذا وبيلا
entries.nt: but pharaoh defied the messenger so we seized him with a terrible seizing

entries.a: فَكَيْفَ تَتَّقُونَ إِن كَفَرْتُمْ يَوْمًۭا يَجْعَلُ ٱلْوِلْدَٰنَ شِيبًا
entries.t: So how will you, if you persist in unbelief, save yourself from a Day which will turn the children gray-haired?
entries.na: فكيف تتقون ان كفرتم يوما يجعل الولدن شيبا
entries.nt: so how will you if you persist in unbelief save yourself from a day which will turn the children gray haired

entries.a: ٱلسَّمَآءُ مُنفَطِرٌۢ بِهِۦ ۚ كَانَ وَعْدُهُۥ مَفْعُولًا
entries.t: The heaven will shatter thereby. His promise is always fulfilled.
entries.na: السما منفطر به كان وعده مفعولا
entries.nt: the heaven will shatter thereby his promise is always fulfilled

entries.a: إِنَّ هَٰذِهِۦ تَذْكِرَةٌۭ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلًا
entries.t: This is a reminder. So whoever wills, let him take a path to his Lord.
entries.na: ان هذه تذكره فمن شا اتخذ الي ربه سبيلا
entries.nt: this is a reminder so whoever wills let him take a path to his lord

entries.a: ۞ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَعْلَمُ أَنَّكَ تَقُومُ أَدْنَىٰ مِن ثُلُثَىِ ٱلَّيْلِ وَنِصْفَهُۥ وَثُلُثَهُۥ وَطَآئِفَةٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلَّذِينَ مَعَكَ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ يُقَدِّرُ ٱلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ ۚ عَلِمَ أَن لَّن تُحْصُوهُ فَتَابَ عَلَيْكُمْ ۖ فَٱقْرَءُوا۟ مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنَ ٱلْقُرْءَانِ ۚ عَلِمَ أَن سَيَكُونُ مِنكُم مَّرْضَىٰ ۙ وَءَاخَرُونَ يَضْرِبُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ يَبْتَغُونَ مِن فَضْلِ ٱللَّهِ ۙ وَءَاخَرُونَ يُقَٰتِلُونَ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ فَٱقْرَءُوا۟ مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنْهُ ۚ وَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتُوا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَأَقْرِضُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًۭا ۚ وَمَا تُقَدِّمُوا۟ لِأَنفُسِكُم مِّنْ خَيْرٍۢ تَجِدُوهُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ هُوَ خَيْرًۭا وَأَعْظَمَ أَجْرًۭا ۚ وَٱسْتَغْفِرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ ۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۢ
entries.t: Your Lord knows that you stay up nearly two-thirds of the night, or half of it, or one-third of it, along with a group of those with you. God designed the night and the day. He knows that you are unable to sustain it, so He has pardoned you. So read of the Quran what is possible for you. He knows that some of you may be ill; and others travelling through the land, seeking God's bounty; and others fighting in God's cause. So read of it what is possible for you, and observe the prayers, and give regular charity, and lend God a generous loan. Whatever good you advance for yourselves, you will find it with God, better and generously rewarded. And seek God's forgiveness, for God is Forgiving and Merciful.
entries.na: ان ربك يعلم انك تقوم ادني من ثلثي اليل ونصفه وثلثه وطايفه من الذين معك والله يقدر اليل والنهار علم ان لن تحصوه فتاب عليكم فاقروا ما تيسر من القران علم ان سيكون منكم مرضي واخرون يضربون في الارض يبتغون من فضل الله واخرون يقتلون في سبيل الله فاقروا ما تيسر منه واقيموا الصلوه واتوا الزكوه واقرضوا الله قرضا حسنا وما تقدموا لانفسكم من خير تجدوه عند الله هو خيرا واعظم اجرا واستغفروا الله ان الله غفور رحيم
entries.nt: your lord knows that you stay up nearly two thirds of the night or half of it or one third of it along with a group of those with you god designed the night and the day he knows that you are unable to sustain it so he has pardoned you so read of the quran what is possible for you he knows that some of you may be ill and others travelling through the land seeking god s bounty and others fighting in god s cause so read of it what is possible for you and observe the prayers and give regular charity and lend god a generous loan whatever good you advance for yourselves you will find it with god better and generously rewarded and seek god s forgiveness for god is forgiving and merciful

entries.a: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْمُدَّثِّرُ
entries.t: O you Enrobed one.
entries.na: يايها المدثر
entries.nt: o you enrobed one

entries.a: قُمْ فَأَنذِرْ
entries.t: Arise and warn.
entries.na: قم فانذر
entries.nt: arise and warn

entries.a: وَرَبَّكَ فَكَبِّرْ
entries.t: And magnify your Lord.
entries.na: وربك فكبر
entries.nt: and magnify your lord

entries.a: وَثِيَابَكَ فَطَهِّرْ
entries.t: And purify your clothes.
entries.na: وثيابك فطهر
entries.nt: and purify your clothes

entries.a: وَٱلرُّجْزَ فَٱهْجُرْ
entries.t: And abandon abominations.
entries.na: والرجز فاهجر
entries.nt: and abandon abominations

entries.a: وَلَا تَمْنُن تَسْتَكْثِرُ
entries.t: And show no favor seeking gain.
entries.na: ولا تمنن تستكثر
entries.nt: and show no favor seeking gain

entries.a: وَلِرَبِّكَ فَٱصْبِرْ
entries.t: And be constant for your Lord.
entries.na: ولربك فاصبر
entries.nt: and be constant for your lord

entries.a: فَإِذَا نُقِرَ فِى ٱلنَّاقُورِ
entries.t: When the Trumpet is blown.
entries.na: فاذا نقر في الناقور
entries.nt: when the trumpet is blown

entries.a: فَذَٰلِكَ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ يَوْمٌ عَسِيرٌ
entries.t: That Day will be a difficult day.
entries.na: فذلك يوميذ يوم عسير
entries.nt: that day will be a difficult day

entries.a: عَلَى ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ غَيْرُ يَسِيرٍۢ
entries.t: For the disbelievers-not easy.
entries.na: علي الكفرين غير يسير
entries.nt: for the disbelievers not easy

entries.a: ذَرْنِى وَمَنْ خَلَقْتُ وَحِيدًۭا
entries.t: Leave Me to him whom I created alone.
entries.na: ذرني ومن خلقت وحيدا
entries.nt: leave me to him whom i created alone

entries.a: وَجَعَلْتُ لَهُۥ مَالًۭا مَّمْدُودًۭا
entries.t: And gave him vast wealth.
entries.na: وجعلت له مالا ممدودا
entries.nt: and gave him vast wealth

entries.a: وَبَنِينَ شُهُودًۭا
entries.t: And children as witnesses.
entries.na: وبنين شهودا
entries.nt: and children as witnesses

entries.a: وَمَهَّدتُّ لَهُۥ تَمْهِيدًۭا
entries.t: And smoothed things for him.
entries.na: ومهدت له تمهيدا
entries.nt: and smoothed things for him

entries.a: ثُمَّ يَطْمَعُ أَنْ أَزِيدَ
entries.t: Then he wants Me to add yet more!
entries.na: ثم يطمع ان ازيد
entries.nt: then he wants me to add yet more

entries.a: كَلَّآ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ لِءَايَٰتِنَا عَنِيدًۭا
entries.t: By no means! He was stubborn towards Our revelations.
entries.na: كلا انه كان لايتنا عنيدا
entries.nt: by no means he was stubborn towards our revelations

entries.a: سَأُرْهِقُهُۥ صَعُودًا
entries.t: I will exhaust him increasingly.
entries.na: سارهقه صعودا
entries.nt: i will exhaust him increasingly

entries.a: إِنَّهُۥ فَكَّرَ وَقَدَّرَ
entries.t: He thought and analyzed.
entries.na: انه فكر وقدر
entries.nt: he thought and analyzed

entries.a: فَقُتِلَ كَيْفَ قَدَّرَ
entries.t: May he perish, how he analyzed.
entries.na: فقتل كيف قدر
entries.nt: may he perish how he analyzed

entries.a: ثُمَّ قُتِلَ كَيْفَ قَدَّرَ
entries.t: Again: may he perish, how he analyzed.
entries.na: ثم قتل كيف قدر
entries.nt: again may he perish how he analyzed

entries.a: ثُمَّ نَظَرَ
entries.t: Then he looked.
entries.na: ثم نظر
entries.nt: then he looked

entries.a: ثُمَّ عَبَسَ وَبَسَرَ
entries.t: Then he frowned and whined.
entries.na: ثم عبس وبسر
entries.nt: then he frowned and whined

entries.a: ثُمَّ أَدْبَرَ وَٱسْتَكْبَرَ
entries.t: Then he turned back and was proud.
entries.na: ثم ادبر واستكبر
entries.nt: then he turned back and was proud

entries.a: فَقَالَ إِنْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحْرٌۭ يُؤْثَرُ
entries.t: And said, "This is nothing but magic from the past.
entries.na: فقال ان هذا الا سحر يوثر
entries.nt: and said this is nothing but magic from the past

entries.a: إِنْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا قَوْلُ ٱلْبَشَرِ
entries.t: This is nothing but the word of a mortal."
entries.na: ان هذا الا قول البشر
entries.nt: this is nothing but the word of a mortal

entries.a: سَأُصْلِيهِ سَقَرَ
entries.t: I will roast him in Saqar.
entries.na: ساصليه سقر
entries.nt: i will roast him in saqar

entries.a: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا سَقَرُ
entries.t: But what will explain to you what Saqar is?
entries.na: وما ادريك ما سقر
entries.nt: but what will explain to you what saqar is

entries.a: لَا تُبْقِى وَلَا تَذَرُ
entries.t: It neither leaves, nor spares.
entries.na: لا تبقي ولا تذر
entries.nt: it neither leaves nor spares

entries.a: لَوَّاحَةٌۭ لِّلْبَشَرِ
entries.t: It scorches the flesh.
entries.na: لواحه للبشر
entries.nt: it scorches the flesh

entries.a: عَلَيْهَا تِسْعَةَ عَشَرَ
entries.t: Over it are Nineteen.
entries.na: عليها تسعه عشر
entries.nt: over it are nineteen

entries.a: وَمَا جَعَلْنَآ أَصْحَٰبَ ٱلنَّارِ إِلَّا مَلَٰٓئِكَةًۭ ۙ وَمَا جَعَلْنَا عِدَّتَهُمْ إِلَّا فِتْنَةًۭ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِيَسْتَيْقِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ وَيَزْدَادَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِيمَٰنًۭا ۙ وَلَا يَرْتَابَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ ۙ وَلِيَقُولَ ٱلَّذِينَ فِى قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌۭ وَٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ مَاذَآ أَرَادَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَٰذَا مَثَلًۭا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ ٱللَّهُ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَهْدِى مَن يَشَآءُ ۚ وَمَا يَعْلَمُ جُنُودَ رَبِّكَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۚ وَمَا هِىَ إِلَّا ذِكْرَىٰ لِلْبَشَرِ
entries.t: We have appointed only angels to be wardens of the Fire, and caused their number to be a stumbling block for those who disbelieve; so that those given the Scripture may attain certainty; and those who believe may increase in faith; and those given the Scripture and the believers may not doubt; and those in whose hearts is sickness and the unbelievers may say, "What did God intend by this parable?" Thus God leads astray whom He wills, and guides whom He wills. None knows the soldiers of your Lord except He. This is nothing but a reminder for the mortals.
entries.na: وما جعلنا اصحب النار الا مليكه وما جعلنا عدتهم الا فتنه للذين كفروا ليستيقن الذين اوتوا الكتب ويزداد الذين امنوا ايمنا ولا يرتاب الذين اوتوا الكتب والمومنون وليقول الذين في قلوبهم مرض والكفرون ماذا اراد الله بهذا مثلا كذلك يضل الله من يشا ويهدي من يشا وما يعلم جنود ربك الا هو وما هي الا ذكري للبشر
entries.nt: we have appointed only angels to be wardens of the fire and caused their number to be a stumbling block for those who disbelieve so that those given the scripture may attain certainty and those who believe may increase in faith and those given the scripture and the believers may not doubt and those in whose hearts is sickness and the unbelievers may say what did god intend by this parable thus god leads astray whom he wills and guides whom he wills none knows the soldiers of your lord except he this is nothing but a reminder for the mortals

entries.a: كَلَّا وَٱلْقَمَرِ
entries.t: Nay! By the moon.
entries.na: كلا والقمر
entries.nt: nay by the moon

entries.a: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذْ أَدْبَرَ
entries.t: And the night as it retreats.
entries.na: واليل اذ ادبر
entries.nt: and the night as it retreats

entries.a: وَٱلصُّبْحِ إِذَآ أَسْفَرَ
entries.t: And the morning as it lights up.
entries.na: والصبح اذا اسفر
entries.nt: and the morning as it lights up

entries.a: إِنَّهَا لَإِحْدَى ٱلْكُبَرِ
entries.t: It is one of the greatest.
entries.na: انها لاحدي الكبر
entries.nt: it is one of the greatest

entries.a: نَذِيرًۭا لِّلْبَشَرِ
entries.t: A warning to the mortals.
entries.na: نذيرا للبشر
entries.nt: a warning to the mortals

entries.a: لِمَن شَآءَ مِنكُمْ أَن يَتَقَدَّمَ أَوْ يَتَأَخَّرَ
entries.t: To whomever among you wishes to advance, or regress.
entries.na: لمن شا منكم ان يتقدم او يتاخر
entries.nt: to whomever among you wishes to advance or regress

entries.a: كُلُّ نَفْسٍۭ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ رَهِينَةٌ
entries.t: Every soul is hostage to what it has earned.
entries.na: كل نفس بما كسبت رهينه
entries.nt: every soul is hostage to what it has earned

entries.a: إِلَّآ أَصْحَٰبَ ٱلْيَمِينِ
entries.t: Except for those on the Right.
entries.na: الا اصحب اليمين
entries.nt: except for those on the right

entries.a: فِى جَنَّٰتٍۢ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
entries.t: In Gardens, inquiring.
entries.na: في جنت يتسالون
entries.nt: in gardens inquiring

entries.a: عَنِ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
entries.t: About the guilty.
entries.na: عن المجرمين
entries.nt: about the guilty

entries.a: مَا سَلَكَكُمْ فِى سَقَرَ
entries.t: "What drove you into Saqar?"
entries.na: ما سلككم في سقر
entries.nt: what drove you into saqar

entries.a: قَالُوا۟ لَمْ نَكُ مِنَ ٱلْمُصَلِّينَ
entries.t: They will say, "We were not of those who prayed.
entries.na: قالوا لم نك من المصلين
entries.nt: they will say we were not of those who prayed

entries.a: وَلَمْ نَكُ نُطْعِمُ ٱلْمِسْكِينَ
entries.t: Nor did we feed the destitute.
entries.na: ولم نك نطعم المسكين
entries.nt: nor did we feed the destitute

entries.a: وَكُنَّا نَخُوضُ مَعَ ٱلْخَآئِضِينَ
entries.t: And we used to indulge with those who indulge.
entries.na: وكنا نخوض مع الخايضين
entries.nt: and we used to indulge with those who indulge

entries.a: وَكُنَّا نُكَذِّبُ بِيَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
entries.t: And we used to deny the Day of Judgment.
entries.na: وكنا نكذب بيوم الدين
entries.nt: and we used to deny the day of judgment

entries.a: حَتَّىٰٓ أَتَىٰنَا ٱلْيَقِينُ
entries.t: Until the Inevitable came upon us."
entries.na: حتي اتينا اليقين
entries.nt: until the inevitable came upon us

entries.a: فَمَا تَنفَعُهُمْ شَفَٰعَةُ ٱلشَّٰفِعِينَ
entries.t: But the intercession of intercessors will not help them.
entries.na: فما تنفعهم شفعه الشفعين
entries.nt: but the intercession of intercessors will not help them

entries.a: فَمَا لَهُمْ عَنِ ٱلتَّذْكِرَةِ مُعْرِضِينَ
entries.t: Why are they turning away from the Reminder?
entries.na: فما لهم عن التذكره معرضين
entries.nt: why are they turning away from the reminder

entries.a: كَأَنَّهُمْ حُمُرٌۭ مُّسْتَنفِرَةٌۭ
entries.t: As though they were panicked donkeys.
entries.na: كانهم حمر مستنفره
entries.nt: as though they were panicked donkeys

entries.a: فَرَّتْ مِن قَسْوَرَةٍۭ
entries.t: Fleeing from a lion?
entries.na: فرت من قسوره
entries.nt: fleeing from a lion

entries.a: بَلْ يُرِيدُ كُلُّ ٱمْرِئٍۢ مِّنْهُمْ أَن يُؤْتَىٰ صُحُفًۭا مُّنَشَّرَةًۭ
entries.t: Yet every one of them desires to be given scrolls unrolled.
entries.na: بل يريد كل امري منهم ان يوتي صحفا منشره
entries.nt: yet every one of them desires to be given scrolls unrolled

entries.a: كَلَّا ۖ بَل لَّا يَخَافُونَ ٱلْءَاخِرَةَ
entries.t: No indeed! But they do not fear the Hereafter.
entries.na: كلا بل لا يخافون الاخره
entries.nt: no indeed but they do not fear the hereafter

entries.a: كَلَّآ إِنَّهُۥ تَذْكِرَةٌۭ
entries.t: Nevertheless, it is a reminder.
entries.na: كلا انه تذكره
entries.nt: nevertheless it is a reminder

entries.a: فَمَن شَآءَ ذَكَرَهُۥ
entries.t: So whoever wills, shall remember it.
entries.na: فمن شا ذكره
entries.nt: so whoever wills shall remember it

entries.a: وَمَا يَذْكُرُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ هُوَ أَهْلُ ٱلتَّقْوَىٰ وَأَهْلُ ٱلْمَغْفِرَةِ
entries.t: But they will not remember, unless God wills. He is the Source of Righteousness, and the Source of Forgiveness.
entries.na: وما يذكرون الا ان يشا الله هو اهل التقوي واهل المغفره
entries.nt: but they will not remember unless god wills he is the source of righteousness and the source of forgiveness

entries.a: لَآ أُقْسِمُ بِيَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ
entries.t: I swear by the Day of Resurrection.
entries.na: لا اقسم بيوم القيمه
entries.nt: i swear by the day of resurrection

entries.a: وَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِٱلنَّفْسِ ٱللَّوَّامَةِ
entries.t: And I swear by the blaming soul.
entries.na: ولا اقسم بالنفس اللوامه
entries.nt: and i swear by the blaming soul

entries.a: أَيَحْسَبُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ أَلَّن نَّجْمَعَ عِظَامَهُۥ
entries.t: Does man think that We will not reassemble his bones?
entries.na: ايحسب الانسن الن نجمع عظامه
entries.nt: does man think that we will not reassemble his bones

entries.a: بَلَىٰ قَٰدِرِينَ عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّسَوِّىَ بَنَانَهُۥ
entries.t: Yes indeed; We are Able to reconstruct his fingertips.
entries.na: بلي قدرين علي ان نسوي بنانه
entries.nt: yes indeed we are able to reconstruct his fingertips

entries.a: بَلْ يُرِيدُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ لِيَفْجُرَ أَمَامَهُۥ
entries.t: But man wants to deny what is ahead of him.
entries.na: بل يريد الانسن ليفجر امامه
entries.nt: but man wants to deny what is ahead of him

entries.a: يَسْـَٔلُ أَيَّانَ يَوْمُ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ
entries.t: He asks, "When is the Day of Resurrection?"
entries.na: يسل ايان يوم القيمه
entries.nt: he asks when is the day of resurrection

entries.a: فَإِذَا بَرِقَ ٱلْبَصَرُ
entries.t: When vision is dazzled.
entries.na: فاذا برق البصر
entries.nt: when vision is dazzled

entries.a: وَخَسَفَ ٱلْقَمَرُ
entries.t: And the moon is eclipsed.
entries.na: وخسف القمر
entries.nt: and the moon is eclipsed

entries.a: وَجُمِعَ ٱلشَّمْسُ وَٱلْقَمَرُ
entries.t: And the sun and the moon are joined together.
entries.na: وجمع الشمس والقمر
entries.nt: and the sun and the moon are joined together

entries.a: يَقُولُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ يَوْمَئِذٍ أَيْنَ ٱلْمَفَرُّ
entries.t: On that Day, man will say, "Where is the escape?"
entries.na: يقول الانسن يوميذ اين المفر
entries.nt: on that day man will say where is the escape

entries.a: كَلَّا لَا وَزَرَ
entries.t: No indeed! There is no refuge.
entries.na: كلا لا وزر
entries.nt: no indeed there is no refuge

entries.a: إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ يَوْمَئِذٍ ٱلْمُسْتَقَرُّ
entries.t: To your Lord on that Day is the settlement.
entries.na: الي ربك يوميذ المستقر
entries.nt: to your lord on that day is the settlement

entries.a: يُنَبَّؤُا۟ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بِمَا قَدَّمَ وَأَخَّرَ
entries.t: On that Day man will be informed of everything he put forward, and everything he left behind.
entries.na: ينبوا الانسن يوميذ بما قدم واخر
entries.nt: on that day man will be informed of everything he put forward and everything he left behind

entries.a: بَلِ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ عَلَىٰ نَفْسِهِۦ بَصِيرَةٌۭ
entries.t: And man will be evidence against himself.
entries.na: بل الانسن علي نفسه بصيره
entries.nt: and man will be evidence against himself

entries.a: وَلَوْ أَلْقَىٰ مَعَاذِيرَهُۥ
entries.t: Even as he presents his excuses.
entries.na: ولو القي معاذيره
entries.nt: even as he presents his excuses

entries.a: لَا تُحَرِّكْ بِهِۦ لِسَانَكَ لِتَعْجَلَ بِهِۦٓ
entries.t: Do not wag your tongue with it, to hurry on with it.
entries.na: لا تحرك به لسانك لتعجل به
entries.nt: do not wag your tongue with it to hurry on with it

entries.a: إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا جَمْعَهُۥ وَقُرْءَانَهُۥ
entries.t: Upon Us is its collection and its recitation.
entries.na: ان علينا جمعه وقرانه
entries.nt: upon us is its collection and its recitation

entries.a: فَإِذَا قَرَأْنَٰهُ فَٱتَّبِعْ قُرْءَانَهُۥ
entries.t: Then, when We have recited it, follow its recitation.
entries.na: فاذا قرانه فاتبع قرانه
entries.nt: then when we have recited it follow its recitation

entries.a: ثُمَّ إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا بَيَانَهُۥ
entries.t: Then upon Us is its explanation.
entries.na: ثم ان علينا بيانه
entries.nt: then upon us is its explanation

entries.a: كَلَّا بَلْ تُحِبُّونَ ٱلْعَاجِلَةَ
entries.t: Alas, you love the fleeting life.
entries.na: كلا بل تحبون العاجله
entries.nt: alas you love the fleeting life

entries.a: وَتَذَرُونَ ٱلْءَاخِرَةَ
entries.t: And you disregard the Hereafter.
entries.na: وتذرون الاخره
entries.nt: and you disregard the hereafter

entries.a: وُجُوهٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ نَّاضِرَةٌ
entries.t: Faces on that Day will be radiant.
entries.na: وجوه يوميذ ناضره
entries.nt: faces on that day will be radiant

entries.a: إِلَىٰ رَبِّهَا نَاظِرَةٌۭ
entries.t: Looking towards their Lord.
entries.na: الي ربها ناظره
entries.nt: looking towards their lord

entries.a: وَوُجُوهٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بَاسِرَةٌۭ
entries.t: And faces on that Day will be gloomy.
entries.na: ووجوه يوميذ باسره
entries.nt: and faces on that day will be gloomy

entries.a: تَظُنُّ أَن يُفْعَلَ بِهَا فَاقِرَةٌۭ
entries.t: Realizing that a back-breaker has befallen them.
entries.na: تظن ان يفعل بها فاقره
entries.nt: realizing that a back breaker has befallen them

entries.a: كَلَّآ إِذَا بَلَغَتِ ٱلتَّرَاقِىَ
entries.t: Indeed, when it has reached the breast-bones.
entries.na: كلا اذا بلغت التراقي
entries.nt: indeed when it has reached the breast bones

entries.a: وَقِيلَ مَنْ ۜ رَاقٍۢ
entries.t: And it is said, "Who is the healer?"
entries.na: وقيل من راق
entries.nt: and it is said who is the healer

entries.a: وَظَنَّ أَنَّهُ ٱلْفِرَاقُ
entries.t: And He realizes that it is the parting.
entries.na: وظن انه الفراق
entries.nt: and he realizes that it is the parting

entries.a: وَٱلْتَفَّتِ ٱلسَّاقُ بِٱلسَّاقِ
entries.t: And leg is entwined with leg.
entries.na: والتفت الساق بالساق
entries.nt: and leg is entwined with leg

entries.a: إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ يَوْمَئِذٍ ٱلْمَسَاقُ
entries.t: To your Lord on that Day is the drive.
entries.na: الي ربك يوميذ المساق
entries.nt: to your lord on that day is the drive

entries.a: فَلَا صَدَّقَ وَلَا صَلَّىٰ
entries.t: He neither believed nor prayed.
entries.na: فلا صدق ولا صلي
entries.nt: he neither believed nor prayed

entries.a: وَلَٰكِن كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ
entries.t: But he denied and turned away.
entries.na: ولكن كذب وتولي
entries.nt: but he denied and turned away

entries.a: ثُمَّ ذَهَبَ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِۦ يَتَمَطَّىٰٓ
entries.t: Then he went to his family, full of pride.
entries.na: ثم ذهب الي اهله يتمطي
entries.nt: then he went to his family full of pride

entries.a: أَوْلَىٰ لَكَ فَأَوْلَىٰ
entries.t: Woe to you; and woe.
entries.na: اولي لك فاولي
entries.nt: woe to you and woe

entries.a: ثُمَّ أَوْلَىٰ لَكَ فَأَوْلَىٰٓ
entries.t: Then again: Woe to you; and woe.
entries.na: ثم اولي لك فاولي
entries.nt: then again woe to you and woe

entries.a: أَيَحْسَبُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ أَن يُتْرَكَ سُدًى
entries.t: Does man think that he will be left without purpose?
entries.na: ايحسب الانسن ان يترك سدي
entries.nt: does man think that he will be left without purpose

entries.a: أَلَمْ يَكُ نُطْفَةًۭ مِّن مَّنِىٍّۢ يُمْنَىٰ
entries.t: Was he not a drop of ejaculated semen?
entries.na: الم يك نطفه من مني يمني
entries.nt: was he not a drop of ejaculated semen

entries.a: ثُمَّ كَانَ عَلَقَةًۭ فَخَلَقَ فَسَوَّىٰ
entries.t: Then he became a clot. And He created and proportioned?
entries.na: ثم كان علقه فخلق فسوي
entries.nt: then he became a clot and he created and proportioned

entries.a: فَجَعَلَ مِنْهُ ٱلزَّوْجَيْنِ ٱلذَّكَرَ وَٱلْأُنثَىٰٓ
entries.t: And made of him the two sexes, the male and the female?
entries.na: فجعل منه الزوجين الذكر والانثي
entries.nt: and made of him the two sexes the male and the female

entries.a: أَلَيْسَ ذَٰلِكَ بِقَٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يُحْۦِىَ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ
entries.t: Is He not Able to revive the dead?
entries.na: اليس ذلك بقدر علي ان يحي الموتي
entries.nt: is he not able to revive the dead

entries.a: هَلْ أَتَىٰ عَلَى ٱلْإِنسَٰنِ حِينٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلدَّهْرِ لَمْ يَكُن شَيْـًۭٔا مَّذْكُورًا
entries.t: Has there come upon man a period of time when he was nothing to be mentioned?
entries.na: هل اتي علي الانسن حين من الدهر لم يكن شيا مذكورا
entries.nt: has there come upon man a period of time when he was nothing to be mentioned

entries.a: إِنَّا خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ أَمْشَاجٍۢ نَّبْتَلِيهِ فَجَعَلْنَٰهُ سَمِيعًۢا بَصِيرًا
entries.t: We created man from a liquid mixture, to test him; and We made him hearing and seeing.
entries.na: انا خلقنا الانسن من نطفه امشاج نبتليه فجعلنه سميعا بصيرا
entries.nt: we created man from a liquid mixture to test him and we made him hearing and seeing

entries.a: إِنَّا هَدَيْنَٰهُ ٱلسَّبِيلَ إِمَّا شَاكِرًۭا وَإِمَّا كَفُورًا
entries.t: We guided him to the way, be he appreciative or unappreciative.
entries.na: انا هدينه السبيل اما شاكرا واما كفورا
entries.nt: we guided him to the way be he appreciative or unappreciative

entries.a: إِنَّآ أَعْتَدْنَا لِلْكَٰفِرِينَ سَلَٰسِلَا۟ وَأَغْلَٰلًۭا وَسَعِيرًا
entries.t: We have prepared for the faithless chains, and yokes, and a Searing Fire.
entries.na: انا اعتدنا للكفرين سلسلا واغللا وسعيرا
entries.nt: we have prepared for the faithless chains and yokes and a searing fire

entries.a: إِنَّ ٱلْأَبْرَارَ يَشْرَبُونَ مِن كَأْسٍۢ كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا كَافُورًا
entries.t: But the righteous will drink from a cup whose mixture is aroma.
entries.na: ان الابرار يشربون من كاس كان مزاجها كافورا
entries.nt: but the righteous will drink from a cup whose mixture is aroma

entries.a: عَيْنًۭا يَشْرَبُ بِهَا عِبَادُ ٱللَّهِ يُفَجِّرُونَهَا تَفْجِيرًۭا
entries.t: A spring from which the servants of God will drink, making it gush abundantly.
entries.na: عينا يشرب بها عباد الله يفجرونها تفجيرا
entries.nt: a spring from which the servants of god will drink making it gush abundantly

entries.a: يُوفُونَ بِٱلنَّذْرِ وَيَخَافُونَ يَوْمًۭا كَانَ شَرُّهُۥ مُسْتَطِيرًۭا
entries.t: They fulfill their vows, and dread a Day whose ill is widespread.
entries.na: يوفون بالنذر ويخافون يوما كان شره مستطيرا
entries.nt: they fulfill their vows and dread a day whose ill is widespread

entries.a: وَيُطْعِمُونَ ٱلطَّعَامَ عَلَىٰ حُبِّهِۦ مِسْكِينًۭا وَيَتِيمًۭا وَأَسِيرًا
entries.t: And they feed, for the love of Him, the poor, and the orphan, and the captive.
entries.na: ويطعمون الطعام علي حبه مسكينا ويتيما واسيرا
entries.nt: and they feed for the love of him the poor and the orphan and the captive

entries.a: إِنَّمَا نُطْعِمُكُمْ لِوَجْهِ ٱللَّهِ لَا نُرِيدُ مِنكُمْ جَزَآءًۭ وَلَا شُكُورًا
entries.t: "We only feed you for the sake of God. We want from you neither compensation, nor gratitude.
entries.na: انما نطعمكم لوجه الله لا نريد منكم جزا ولا شكورا
entries.nt: we only feed you for the sake of god we want from you neither compensation nor gratitude

entries.a: إِنَّا نَخَافُ مِن رَّبِّنَا يَوْمًا عَبُوسًۭا قَمْطَرِيرًۭا
entries.t: We dread from our Lord a frowning grim Day."
entries.na: انا نخاف من ربنا يوما عبوسا قمطريرا
entries.nt: we dread from our lord a frowning grim day

entries.a: فَوَقَىٰهُمُ ٱللَّهُ شَرَّ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمِ وَلَقَّىٰهُمْ نَضْرَةًۭ وَسُرُورًۭا
entries.t: So God will protect them from the ills of that Day, and will grant them radiance and joy.
entries.na: فوقيهم الله شر ذلك اليوم ولقيهم نضره وسرورا
entries.nt: so god will protect them from the ills of that day and will grant them radiance and joy

entries.a: وَجَزَىٰهُم بِمَا صَبَرُوا۟ جَنَّةًۭ وَحَرِيرًۭا
entries.t: And will reward them for their patience with a Garden and silk.
entries.na: وجزيهم بما صبروا جنه وحريرا
entries.nt: and will reward them for their patience with a garden and silk

entries.a: مُّتَّكِـِٔينَ فِيهَا عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ ۖ لَا يَرَوْنَ فِيهَا شَمْسًۭا وَلَا زَمْهَرِيرًۭا
entries.t: Reclining therein on the thrones; experiencing therein neither sun, nor frost.
entries.na: متكين فيها علي الارايك لا يرون فيها شمسا ولا زمهريرا
entries.nt: reclining therein on the thrones experiencing therein neither sun nor frost

entries.a: وَدَانِيَةً عَلَيْهِمْ ظِلَٰلُهَا وَذُلِّلَتْ قُطُوفُهَا تَذْلِيلًۭا
entries.t: Its shade hovering over them, and its fruit brought low within reach.
entries.na: ودانيه عليهم ظللها وذللت قطوفها تذليلا
entries.nt: its shade hovering over them and its fruit brought low within reach

entries.a: وَيُطَافُ عَلَيْهِم بِـَٔانِيَةٍۢ مِّن فِضَّةٍۢ وَأَكْوَابٍۢ كَانَتْ قَوَارِيرَا۠
entries.t: Passing around them are vessels of silver, and cups of crystal.
entries.na: ويطاف عليهم بانيه من فضه واكواب كانت قواريرا
entries.nt: passing around them are vessels of silver and cups of crystal

entries.a: قَوَارِيرَا۟ مِن فِضَّةٍۢ قَدَّرُوهَا تَقْدِيرًۭا
entries.t: Crystal of silver-they measured them exactly.
entries.na: قواريرا من فضه قدروها تقديرا
entries.nt: crystal of silver they measured them exactly

entries.a: وَيُسْقَوْنَ فِيهَا كَأْسًۭا كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا زَنجَبِيلًا
entries.t: They will be served therein with a cup whose flavor is Zanjabeel.
entries.na: ويسقون فيها كاسا كان مزاجها زنجبيلا
entries.nt: they will be served therein with a cup whose flavor is zanjabeel

entries.a: عَيْنًۭا فِيهَا تُسَمَّىٰ سَلْسَبِيلًۭا
entries.t: A spring therein named Salsabeel.
entries.na: عينا فيها تسمي سلسبيلا
entries.nt: a spring therein named salsabeel

entries.a: ۞ وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ وِلْدَٰنٌۭ مُّخَلَّدُونَ إِذَا رَأَيْتَهُمْ حَسِبْتَهُمْ لُؤْلُؤًۭا مَّنثُورًۭا
entries.t: Passing among them are eternalized youths. If you see them, you would think them sprinkled pearls.
entries.na: ويطوف عليهم ولدن مخلدون اذا رايتهم حسبتهم لولوا منثورا
entries.nt: passing among them are eternalized youths if you see them you would think them sprinkled pearls

entries.a: وَإِذَا رَأَيْتَ ثَمَّ رَأَيْتَ نَعِيمًۭا وَمُلْكًۭا كَبِيرًا
entries.t: Wherever you look, you see bliss, and a vast kingdom.
entries.na: واذا رايت ثم رايت نعيما وملكا كبيرا
entries.nt: wherever you look you see bliss and a vast kingdom

entries.a: عَٰلِيَهُمْ ثِيَابُ سُندُسٍ خُضْرٌۭ وَإِسْتَبْرَقٌۭ ۖ وَحُلُّوٓا۟ أَسَاوِرَ مِن فِضَّةٍۢ وَسَقَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ شَرَابًۭا طَهُورًا
entries.t: Upon them are garments of green silk, and satin. And they will be adorned with bracelets of silver. And their Lord will offer them a pure drink.
entries.na: عليهم ثياب سندس خضر واستبرق وحلوا اساور من فضه وسقيهم ربهم شرابا طهورا
entries.nt: upon them are garments of green silk and satin and they will be adorned with bracelets of silver and their lord will offer them a pure drink

entries.a: إِنَّ هَٰذَا كَانَ لَكُمْ جَزَآءًۭ وَكَانَ سَعْيُكُم مَّشْكُورًا
entries.t: "This is a reward for you. Your efforts are well appreciated."
entries.na: ان هذا كان لكم جزا وكان سعيكم مشكورا
entries.nt: this is a reward for you your efforts are well appreciated

entries.a: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَزَّلْنَا عَلَيْكَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ تَنزِيلًۭا
entries.t: It is We who sent down the Quran upon you-a gradual revelation.
entries.na: انا نحن نزلنا عليك القران تنزيلا
entries.nt: it is we who sent down the quran upon you a gradual revelation

entries.a: فَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تُطِعْ مِنْهُمْ ءَاثِمًا أَوْ كَفُورًۭا
entries.t: So be patient for the decision of your Lord, and do not obey the sinner or the blasphemer among them.
entries.na: فاصبر لحكم ربك ولا تطع منهم اثما او كفورا
entries.nt: so be patient for the decision of your lord and do not obey the sinner or the blasphemer among them

entries.a: وَٱذْكُرِ ٱسْمَ رَبِّكَ بُكْرَةًۭ وَأَصِيلًۭا
entries.t: And mention the Name of your Lord, morning and evening.
entries.na: واذكر اسم ربك بكره واصيلا
entries.nt: and mention the name of your lord morning and evening

entries.a: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَٱسْجُدْ لَهُۥ وَسَبِّحْهُ لَيْلًۭا طَوِيلًا
entries.t: And for part of the night, prostrate yourself to Him, and glorify Him long into the night.
entries.na: ومن اليل فاسجد له وسبحه ليلا طويلا
entries.nt: and for part of the night prostrate yourself to him and glorify him long into the night

entries.a: إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ يُحِبُّونَ ٱلْعَاجِلَةَ وَيَذَرُونَ وَرَآءَهُمْ يَوْمًۭا ثَقِيلًۭا
entries.t: As for these: they love the fleeting life, and leave behind a Heavy Day.
entries.na: ان هولا يحبون العاجله ويذرون وراهم يوما ثقيلا
entries.nt: as for these they love the fleeting life and leave behind a heavy day

entries.a: نَّحْنُ خَلَقْنَٰهُمْ وَشَدَدْنَآ أَسْرَهُمْ ۖ وَإِذَا شِئْنَا بَدَّلْنَآ أَمْثَٰلَهُمْ تَبْدِيلًا
entries.t: We created them, and strengthened their frame; and whenever We will, We can replace them with others like them.
entries.na: نحن خلقنهم وشددنا اسرهم واذا شينا بدلنا امثلهم تبديلا
entries.nt: we created them and strengthened their frame and whenever we will we can replace them with others like them

entries.a: إِنَّ هَٰذِهِۦ تَذْكِرَةٌۭ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلًۭا
entries.t: This is a reminder; so whoever wills, let him take a path to his Lord.
entries.na: ان هذه تذكره فمن شا اتخذ الي ربه سبيلا
entries.nt: this is a reminder so whoever wills let him take a path to his lord

entries.a: وَمَا تَشَآءُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمًۭا
entries.t: Yet you cannot will, unless God wills. God is Knowing and Wise.
entries.na: وما تشاون الا ان يشا الله ان الله كان عليما حكيما
entries.nt: yet you cannot will unless god wills god is knowing and wise

entries.a: يُدْخِلُ مَن يَشَآءُ فِى رَحْمَتِهِۦ ۚ وَٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ أَعَدَّ لَهُمْ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًۢا
entries.t: He admits into His mercy whomever He wills. But as for the wrongdoers, He has prepared for them a painful punishment.
entries.na: يدخل من يشا في رحمته والظلمين اعد لهم عذابا اليما
entries.nt: he admits into his mercy whomever he wills but as for the wrongdoers he has prepared for them a painful punishment

entries.a: وَٱلْمُرْسَلَٰتِ عُرْفًۭا
entries.t: By those unleashed in succession.
entries.na: والمرسلت عرفا
entries.nt: by those unleashed in succession

entries.a: فَٱلْعَٰصِفَٰتِ عَصْفًۭا
entries.t: Storming turbulently.
entries.na: فالعصفت عصفا
entries.nt: storming turbulently

entries.a: وَٱلنَّٰشِرَٰتِ نَشْرًۭا
entries.t: Scattering far and wide.
entries.na: والنشرت نشرا
entries.nt: scattering far and wide

entries.a: فَٱلْفَٰرِقَٰتِ فَرْقًۭا
entries.t: Separating decisively.
entries.na: فالفرقت فرقا
entries.nt: separating decisively

entries.a: فَٱلْمُلْقِيَٰتِ ذِكْرًا
entries.t: Delivering a message.
entries.na: فالملقيت ذكرا
entries.nt: delivering a message

entries.a: عُذْرًا أَوْ نُذْرًا
entries.t: Excusing or warning.
entries.na: عذرا او نذرا
entries.nt: excusing or warning

entries.a: إِنَّمَا تُوعَدُونَ لَوَٰقِعٌۭ
entries.t: Surely what you are promised will happen.
entries.na: انما توعدون لوقع
entries.nt: surely what you are promised will happen

entries.a: فَإِذَا ٱلنُّجُومُ طُمِسَتْ
entries.t: When the stars are obliterated.
entries.na: فاذا النجوم طمست
entries.nt: when the stars are obliterated

entries.a: وَإِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ فُرِجَتْ
entries.t: And the sky is fractured.
entries.na: واذا السما فرجت
entries.nt: and the sky is fractured

entries.a: وَإِذَا ٱلْجِبَالُ نُسِفَتْ
entries.t: And the mountains are blown away.
entries.na: واذا الجبال نسفت
entries.nt: and the mountains are blown away

entries.a: وَإِذَا ٱلرُّسُلُ أُقِّتَتْ
entries.t: And the messengers are alerted.
entries.na: واذا الرسل اقتت
entries.nt: and the messengers are alerted

entries.a: لِأَىِّ يَوْمٍ أُجِّلَتْ
entries.t: Until which day is it deferred?
entries.na: لاي يوم اجلت
entries.nt: until which day is it deferred

entries.a: لِيَوْمِ ٱلْفَصْلِ
entries.t: Until the Day of Decision.
entries.na: ليوم الفصل
entries.nt: until the day of decision

entries.a: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا يَوْمُ ٱلْفَصْلِ
entries.t: And what will teach you what the Day of Decision is?
entries.na: وما ادريك ما يوم الفصل
entries.nt: and what will teach you what the day of decision is

entries.a: وَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
entries.t: Woe on that Day to the liars.
entries.na: ويل يوميذ للمكذبين
entries.nt: woe on that day to the liars

entries.a: أَلَمْ نُهْلِكِ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
entries.t: Did We not destroy the ancients?
entries.na: الم نهلك الاولين
entries.nt: did we not destroy the ancients

entries.a: ثُمَّ نُتْبِعُهُمُ ٱلْءَاخِرِينَ
entries.t: Then succeeded them with the others?
entries.na: ثم نتبعهم الاخرين
entries.nt: then succeeded them with the others

entries.a: كَذَٰلِكَ نَفْعَلُ بِٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
entries.t: This is how We deal with the guilty.
entries.na: كذلك نفعل بالمجرمين
entries.nt: this is how we deal with the guilty

entries.a: وَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
entries.t: Woe on that Day to the rejecters.
entries.na: ويل يوميذ للمكذبين
entries.nt: woe on that day to the rejecters

entries.a: أَلَمْ نَخْلُقكُّم مِّن مَّآءٍۢ مَّهِينٍۢ
entries.t: Did We not create you from an insignificant fluid?
entries.na: الم نخلقكم من ما مهين
entries.nt: did we not create you from an insignificant fluid

entries.a: فَجَعَلْنَٰهُ فِى قَرَارٍۢ مَّكِينٍ
entries.t: Then lodged it in a secure place?
entries.na: فجعلنه في قرار مكين
entries.nt: then lodged it in a secure place

entries.a: إِلَىٰ قَدَرٍۢ مَّعْلُومٍۢ
entries.t: For a known term?
entries.na: الي قدر معلوم
entries.nt: for a known term

entries.a: فَقَدَرْنَا فَنِعْمَ ٱلْقَٰدِرُونَ
entries.t: We measured precisely. We are the best to measure.
entries.na: فقدرنا فنعم القدرون
entries.nt: we measured precisely we are the best to measure

entries.a: وَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
entries.t: Woe on that Day to the falsifiers.
entries.na: ويل يوميذ للمكذبين
entries.nt: woe on that day to the falsifiers

entries.a: أَلَمْ نَجْعَلِ ٱلْأَرْضَ كِفَاتًا
entries.t: Did We not make the earth a homestead?
entries.na: الم نجعل الارض كفاتا
entries.nt: did we not make the earth a homestead

entries.a: أَحْيَآءًۭ وَأَمْوَٰتًۭا
entries.t: For the living and the dead?
entries.na: احيا واموتا
entries.nt: for the living and the dead

entries.a: وَجَعَلْنَا فِيهَا رَوَٰسِىَ شَٰمِخَٰتٍۢ وَأَسْقَيْنَٰكُم مَّآءًۭ فُرَاتًۭا
entries.t: And set on it lofty mountains, and given you pure water to drink?
entries.na: وجعلنا فيها روسي شمخت واسقينكم ما فراتا
entries.nt: and set on it lofty mountains and given you pure water to drink

entries.a: وَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
entries.t: Woe on that Day to the deniers.
entries.na: ويل يوميذ للمكذبين
entries.nt: woe on that day to the deniers

entries.a: ٱنطَلِقُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ مَا كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
entries.t: "Proceed to what you used to deny."
entries.na: انطلقوا الي ما كنتم به تكذبون
entries.nt: proceed to what you used to deny

entries.a: ٱنطَلِقُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ ظِلٍّۢ ذِى ثَلَٰثِ شُعَبٍۢ
entries.t: "Proceed to a shadow of three different masses."
entries.na: انطلقوا الي ظل ذي ثلث شعب
entries.nt: proceed to a shadow of three different masses

entries.a: لَّا ظَلِيلٍۢ وَلَا يُغْنِى مِنَ ٱللَّهَبِ
entries.t: Offering no shade, and unavailing against the flames.
entries.na: لا ظليل ولا يغني من اللهب
entries.nt: offering no shade and unavailing against the flames

entries.a: إِنَّهَا تَرْمِى بِشَرَرٍۢ كَٱلْقَصْرِ
entries.t: It shoots sparks as castles.
entries.na: انها ترمي بشرر كالقصر
entries.nt: it shoots sparks as castles

entries.a: كَأَنَّهُۥ جِمَٰلَتٌۭ صُفْرٌۭ
entries.t: As if they were yellow camels.
entries.na: كانه جملت صفر
entries.nt: as if they were yellow camels

entries.a: وَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
entries.t: Woe on that Day to the liars.
entries.na: ويل يوميذ للمكذبين
entries.nt: woe on that day to the liars

entries.a: هَٰذَا يَوْمُ لَا يَنطِقُونَ
entries.t: This is a Day when they will not speak.
entries.na: هذا يوم لا ينطقون
entries.nt: this is a day when they will not speak

entries.a: وَلَا يُؤْذَنُ لَهُمْ فَيَعْتَذِرُونَ
entries.t: And they will not be allowed to apologize.
entries.na: ولا يوذن لهم فيعتذرون
entries.nt: and they will not be allowed to apologize

entries.a: وَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
entries.t: Woe on that Day to the rejecters.
entries.na: ويل يوميذ للمكذبين
entries.nt: woe on that day to the rejecters

entries.a: هَٰذَا يَوْمُ ٱلْفَصْلِ ۖ جَمَعْنَٰكُمْ وَٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
entries.t: This is the Day of Separation; We have gathered you, together with the ancients.
entries.na: هذا يوم الفصل جمعنكم والاولين
entries.nt: this is the day of separation we have gathered you together with the ancients

entries.a: فَإِن كَانَ لَكُمْ كَيْدٌۭ فَكِيدُونِ
entries.t: So if you have a strategy, use it against Me.
entries.na: فان كان لكم كيد فكيدون
entries.nt: so if you have a strategy use it against me

entries.a: وَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
entries.t: Woe on that Day to the falsifiers.
entries.na: ويل يوميذ للمكذبين
entries.nt: woe on that day to the falsifiers

entries.a: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى ظِلَٰلٍۢ وَعُيُونٍۢ
entries.t: The righteous will be amidst shades and fountains.
entries.na: ان المتقين في ظلل وعيون
entries.nt: the righteous will be amidst shades and fountains

entries.a: وَفَوَٰكِهَ مِمَّا يَشْتَهُونَ
entries.t: And fruits as they desire.
entries.na: وفوكه مما يشتهون
entries.nt: and fruits as they desire

entries.a: كُلُوا۟ وَٱشْرَبُوا۟ هَنِيٓـًٔۢا بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
entries.t: "Eat and drink pleasantly, for what you used to do."
entries.na: كلوا واشربوا هنيا بما كنتم تعملون
entries.nt: eat and drink pleasantly for what you used to do

entries.a: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
entries.t: This is how We reward the doers of good.
entries.na: انا كذلك نجزي المحسنين
entries.nt: this is how we reward the doers of good

entries.a: وَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
entries.t: Woe on that Day to the deniers.
entries.na: ويل يوميذ للمكذبين
entries.nt: woe on that day to the deniers

entries.a: كُلُوا۟ وَتَمَتَّعُوا۟ قَلِيلًا إِنَّكُم مُّجْرِمُونَ
entries.t: "Eat and enjoy yourselves a little; you are indeed criminals."
entries.na: كلوا وتمتعوا قليلا انكم مجرمون
entries.nt: eat and enjoy yourselves a little you are indeed criminals

entries.a: وَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
entries.t: Woe on that Day to the liars.
entries.na: ويل يوميذ للمكذبين
entries.nt: woe on that day to the liars

entries.a: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ٱرْكَعُوا۟ لَا يَرْكَعُونَ
entries.t: And when it is said to them, "Kneel", they do not kneel.
entries.na: واذا قيل لهم اركعوا لا يركعون
entries.nt: and when it is said to them kneel they do not kneel

entries.a: وَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
entries.t: Woe on that Day to the rejecters.
entries.na: ويل يوميذ للمكذبين
entries.nt: woe on that day to the rejecters

entries.a: فَبِأَىِّ حَدِيثٍۭ بَعْدَهُۥ يُؤْمِنُونَ
entries.t: In what message, beyond this, will they believe?
entries.na: فباي حديث بعده يومنون
entries.nt: in what message beyond this will they believe

entries.a: عَمَّ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
entries.t: What are they asking one another about?
entries.na: عم يتسالون
entries.nt: what are they asking one another about

entries.a: عَنِ ٱلنَّبَإِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
entries.t: About the Great Event.
entries.na: عن النبا العظيم
entries.nt: about the great event

entries.a: ٱلَّذِى هُمْ فِيهِ مُخْتَلِفُونَ
entries.t: About which they disagree.
entries.na: الذي هم فيه مختلفون
entries.nt: about which they disagree

entries.a: كَلَّا سَيَعْلَمُونَ
entries.t: Surely, they will find out.
entries.na: كلا سيعلمون
entries.nt: surely they will find out

entries.a: ثُمَّ كَلَّا سَيَعْلَمُونَ
entries.t: Most certainly, they will find out.
entries.na: ثم كلا سيعلمون
entries.nt: most certainly they will find out

entries.a: أَلَمْ نَجْعَلِ ٱلْأَرْضَ مِهَٰدًۭا
entries.t: Did We not make the earth a cradle?
entries.na: الم نجعل الارض مهدا
entries.nt: did we not make the earth a cradle

entries.a: وَٱلْجِبَالَ أَوْتَادًۭا
entries.t: And the mountains pegs?
entries.na: والجبال اوتادا
entries.nt: and the mountains pegs

entries.a: وَخَلَقْنَٰكُمْ أَزْوَٰجًۭا
entries.t: And created you in pairs?
entries.na: وخلقنكم ازوجا
entries.nt: and created you in pairs

entries.a: وَجَعَلْنَا نَوْمَكُمْ سُبَاتًۭا
entries.t: And made your sleep for rest?
entries.na: وجعلنا نومكم سباتا
entries.nt: and made your sleep for rest

entries.a: وَجَعَلْنَا ٱلَّيْلَ لِبَاسًۭا
entries.t: And made the night a cover?
entries.na: وجعلنا اليل لباسا
entries.nt: and made the night a cover

entries.a: وَجَعَلْنَا ٱلنَّهَارَ مَعَاشًۭا
entries.t: And made the day for livelihood?
entries.na: وجعلنا النهار معاشا
entries.nt: and made the day for livelihood

entries.a: وَبَنَيْنَا فَوْقَكُمْ سَبْعًۭا شِدَادًۭا
entries.t: And built above you seven strong ones?
entries.na: وبنينا فوقكم سبعا شدادا
entries.nt: and built above you seven strong ones

entries.a: وَجَعَلْنَا سِرَاجًۭا وَهَّاجًۭا
entries.t: And placed a blazing lamp?
entries.na: وجعلنا سراجا وهاجا
entries.nt: and placed a blazing lamp

entries.a: وَأَنزَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلْمُعْصِرَٰتِ مَآءًۭ ثَجَّاجًۭا
entries.t: And brought down from the clouds pouring water?
entries.na: وانزلنا من المعصرت ما ثجاجا
entries.nt: and brought down from the clouds pouring water

entries.a: لِّنُخْرِجَ بِهِۦ حَبًّۭا وَنَبَاتًۭا
entries.t: To produce with it grains and vegetation?
entries.na: لنخرج به حبا ونباتا
entries.nt: to produce with it grains and vegetation

entries.a: وَجَنَّٰتٍ أَلْفَافًا
entries.t: And luxuriant gardens?
entries.na: وجنت الفافا
entries.nt: and luxuriant gardens

entries.a: إِنَّ يَوْمَ ٱلْفَصْلِ كَانَ مِيقَٰتًۭا
entries.t: The Day of Sorting has been appointed.
entries.na: ان يوم الفصل كان ميقتا
entries.nt: the day of sorting has been appointed

entries.a: يَوْمَ يُنفَخُ فِى ٱلصُّورِ فَتَأْتُونَ أَفْوَاجًۭا
entries.t: The Day when the Trumpet is blown, and you will come in droves.
entries.na: يوم ينفخ في الصور فتاتون افواجا
entries.nt: the day when the trumpet is blown and you will come in droves

entries.a: وَفُتِحَتِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ فَكَانَتْ أَبْوَٰبًۭا
entries.t: And the sky is opened up, and becomes gateways.
entries.na: وفتحت السما فكانت ابوبا
entries.nt: and the sky is opened up and becomes gateways

entries.a: وَسُيِّرَتِ ٱلْجِبَالُ فَكَانَتْ سَرَابًا
entries.t: And the mountains are set in motion, and become a mirage.
entries.na: وسيرت الجبال فكانت سرابا
entries.nt: and the mountains are set in motion and become a mirage

entries.a: إِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ كَانَتْ مِرْصَادًۭا
entries.t: Hell is lying in ambush.
entries.na: ان جهنم كانت مرصادا
entries.nt: hell is lying in ambush

entries.a: لِّلطَّٰغِينَ مَـَٔابًۭا
entries.t: For the oppressors, a destination.
entries.na: للطغين مابا
entries.nt: for the oppressors a destination

entries.a: لَّٰبِثِينَ فِيهَآ أَحْقَابًۭا
entries.t: Where they will remain for eons.
entries.na: لبثين فيها احقابا
entries.nt: where they will remain for eons

entries.a: لَّا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا بَرْدًۭا وَلَا شَرَابًا
entries.t: They will taste therein neither coolness, nor drink.
entries.na: لا يذوقون فيها بردا ولا شرابا
entries.nt: they will taste therein neither coolness nor drink

entries.a: إِلَّا حَمِيمًۭا وَغَسَّاقًۭا
entries.t: Except boiling water, and freezing hail.
entries.na: الا حميما وغساقا
entries.nt: except boiling water and freezing hail

entries.a: جَزَآءًۭ وِفَاقًا
entries.t: A fitting requital.
entries.na: جزا وفاقا
entries.nt: a fitting requital

entries.a: إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ لَا يَرْجُونَ حِسَابًۭا
entries.t: For they were not anticipating any reckoning.
entries.na: انهم كانوا لا يرجون حسابا
entries.nt: for they were not anticipating any reckoning

entries.a: وَكَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا كِذَّابًۭا
entries.t: And they denied Our signs utterly.
entries.na: وكذبوا بايتنا كذابا
entries.nt: and they denied our signs utterly

entries.a: وَكُلَّ شَىْءٍ أَحْصَيْنَٰهُ كِتَٰبًۭا
entries.t: But We have enumerated everything in writing.
entries.na: وكل شي احصينه كتبا
entries.nt: but we have enumerated everything in writing

entries.a: فَذُوقُوا۟ فَلَن نَّزِيدَكُمْ إِلَّا عَذَابًا
entries.t: So taste! We will increase you only in suffering.
entries.na: فذوقوا فلن نزيدكم الا عذابا
entries.nt: so taste we will increase you only in suffering

entries.a: إِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ مَفَازًا
entries.t: But for the righteous there is triumph.
entries.na: ان للمتقين مفازا
entries.nt: but for the righteous there is triumph

entries.a: حَدَآئِقَ وَأَعْنَٰبًۭا
entries.t: Gardens and vineyards.
entries.na: حدايق واعنبا
entries.nt: gardens and vineyards

entries.a: وَكَوَاعِبَ أَتْرَابًۭا
entries.t: And splendid spouses, well matched.
entries.na: وكواعب اترابا
entries.nt: and splendid spouses well matched

entries.a: وَكَأْسًۭا دِهَاقًۭا
entries.t: And delicious drinks.
entries.na: وكاسا دهاقا
entries.nt: and delicious drinks

entries.a: لَّا يَسْمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغْوًۭا وَلَا كِذَّٰبًۭا
entries.t: They will hear therein neither gossip, nor lies.
entries.na: لا يسمعون فيها لغوا ولا كذبا
entries.nt: they will hear therein neither gossip nor lies

entries.a: جَزَآءًۭ مِّن رَّبِّكَ عَطَآءً حِسَابًۭا
entries.t: A reward from your Lord, a fitting gift.
entries.na: جزا من ربك عطا حسابا
entries.nt: a reward from your lord a fitting gift

entries.a: رَّبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ۖ لَا يَمْلِكُونَ مِنْهُ خِطَابًۭا
entries.t: Lord of the heavens and the earth, and everything between them-The Most Merciful-none can argue with Him.
entries.na: رب السموت والارض وما بينهما الرحمن لا يملكون منه خطابا
entries.nt: lord of the heavens and the earth and everything between them the most merciful none can argue with him

entries.a: يَوْمَ يَقُومُ ٱلرُّوحُ وَٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ صَفًّۭا ۖ لَّا يَتَكَلَّمُونَ إِلَّا مَنْ أَذِنَ لَهُ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ وَقَالَ صَوَابًۭا
entries.t: On the Day when the Spirit and the angels stand in row. They will not speak, unless it be one permitted by the Most Merciful, and he will say what is right.
entries.na: يوم يقوم الروح والمليكه صفا لا يتكلمون الا من اذن له الرحمن وقال صوابا
entries.nt: on the day when the spirit and the angels stand in row they will not speak unless it be one permitted by the most merciful and he will say what is right

entries.a: ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمُ ٱلْحَقُّ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ مَـَٔابًا
entries.t: That is the Day of Reality. So whoever wills, let him take a way back to his Lord.
entries.na: ذلك اليوم الحق فمن شا اتخذ الي ربه مابا
entries.nt: that is the day of reality so whoever wills let him take a way back to his lord

entries.a: إِنَّآ أَنذَرْنَٰكُمْ عَذَابًۭا قَرِيبًۭا يَوْمَ يَنظُرُ ٱلْمَرْءُ مَا قَدَّمَتْ يَدَاهُ وَيَقُولُ ٱلْكَافِرُ يَٰلَيْتَنِى كُنتُ تُرَٰبًۢا
entries.t: We have warned you of a near punishment-the Day when a person will observe what his hands have produced, and the faithless will say, "O, I wish I were dust."
entries.na: انا انذرنكم عذابا قريبا يوم ينظر المر ما قدمت يداه ويقول الكافر يليتني كنت تربا
entries.nt: we have warned you of a near punishment the day when a person will observe what his hands have produced and the faithless will say o i wish i were dust

entries.a: وَٱلنَّٰزِعَٰتِ غَرْقًۭا
entries.t: By those who snatch violently.
entries.na: والنزعت غرقا
entries.nt: by those who snatch violently

entries.a: وَٱلنَّٰشِطَٰتِ نَشْطًۭا
entries.t: And those who remove gently.
entries.na: والنشطت نشطا
entries.nt: and those who remove gently

entries.a: وَٱلسَّٰبِحَٰتِ سَبْحًۭا
entries.t: And those who glide smoothly.
entries.na: والسبحت سبحا
entries.nt: and those who glide smoothly

entries.a: فَٱلسَّٰبِقَٰتِ سَبْقًۭا
entries.t: And those who race swiftly.
entries.na: فالسبقت سبقا
entries.nt: and those who race swiftly

entries.a: فَٱلْمُدَبِّرَٰتِ أَمْرًۭا
entries.t: And those who regulate events.
entries.na: فالمدبرت امرا
entries.nt: and those who regulate events

entries.a: يَوْمَ تَرْجُفُ ٱلرَّاجِفَةُ
entries.t: On the Day when the Quake quakes.
entries.na: يوم ترجف الراجفه
entries.nt: on the day when the quake quakes

entries.a: تَتْبَعُهَا ٱلرَّادِفَةُ
entries.t: And is followed by the Successor.
entries.na: تتبعها الرادفه
entries.nt: and is followed by the successor

entries.a: قُلُوبٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ وَاجِفَةٌ
entries.t: Hearts on that Day will be pounding.
entries.na: قلوب يوميذ واجفه
entries.nt: hearts on that day will be pounding

entries.a: أَبْصَٰرُهَا خَٰشِعَةٌۭ
entries.t: Their sights downcast.
entries.na: ابصرها خشعه
entries.nt: their sights downcast

entries.a: يَقُولُونَ أَءِنَّا لَمَرْدُودُونَ فِى ٱلْحَافِرَةِ
entries.t: They say, "Are we to be restored to the original condition?
entries.na: يقولون انا لمردودون في الحافره
entries.nt: they say are we to be restored to the original condition

entries.a: أَءِذَا كُنَّا عِظَٰمًۭا نَّخِرَةًۭ
entries.t: When we have become hollow bones?"
entries.na: اذا كنا عظما نخره
entries.nt: when we have become hollow bones

entries.a: قَالُوا۟ تِلْكَ إِذًۭا كَرَّةٌ خَاسِرَةٌۭ
entries.t: They say, "This is a losing proposition."
entries.na: قالوا تلك اذا كره خاسره
entries.nt: they say this is a losing proposition

entries.a: فَإِنَّمَا هِىَ زَجْرَةٌۭ وَٰحِدَةٌۭ
entries.t: But it will be only a single nudge.
entries.na: فانما هي زجره وحده
entries.nt: but it will be only a single nudge

entries.a: فَإِذَا هُم بِٱلسَّاهِرَةِ
entries.t: And they will be awake.
entries.na: فاذا هم بالساهره
entries.nt: and they will be awake

entries.a: هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ مُوسَىٰٓ
entries.t: Has the story of Moses reached you?
entries.na: هل اتيك حديث موسي
entries.nt: has the story of moses reached you

entries.a: إِذْ نَادَىٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ بِٱلْوَادِ ٱلْمُقَدَّسِ طُوًى
entries.t: When His Lord called out to him in the sacred valley of Tuwa.
entries.na: اذ ناديه ربه بالواد المقدس طوي
entries.nt: when his lord called out to him in the sacred valley of tuwa

entries.a: ٱذْهَبْ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّهُۥ طَغَىٰ
entries.t: "Go to Pharaoh-he has transgressed."
entries.na: اذهب الي فرعون انه طغي
entries.nt: go to pharaoh he has transgressed

entries.a: فَقُلْ هَل لَّكَ إِلَىٰٓ أَن تَزَكَّىٰ
entries.t: And say, "Do you care to be cleansed?
entries.na: فقل هل لك الي ان تزكي
entries.nt: and say do you care to be cleansed

entries.a: وَأَهْدِيَكَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ فَتَخْشَىٰ
entries.t: And I will guide you to your Lord, and you will turn reverent."
entries.na: واهديك الي ربك فتخشي
entries.nt: and i will guide you to your lord and you will turn reverent

entries.a: فَأَرَىٰهُ ٱلْءَايَةَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ
entries.t: He showed him the Greatest Miracle.
entries.na: فاريه الايه الكبري
entries.nt: he showed him the greatest miracle

entries.a: فَكَذَّبَ وَعَصَىٰ
entries.t: But he denied and defied.
entries.na: فكذب وعصي
entries.nt: but he denied and defied

entries.a: ثُمَّ أَدْبَرَ يَسْعَىٰ
entries.t: Then turned his back, and tried.
entries.na: ثم ادبر يسعي
entries.nt: then turned his back and tried

entries.a: فَحَشَرَ فَنَادَىٰ
entries.t: And gathered and proclaimed.
entries.na: فحشر فنادي
entries.nt: and gathered and proclaimed

entries.a: فَقَالَ أَنَا۠ رَبُّكُمُ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ
entries.t: He said, "I am your Lord, the most high."
entries.na: فقال انا ربكم الاعلي
entries.nt: he said i am your lord the most high

entries.a: فَأَخَذَهُ ٱللَّهُ نَكَالَ ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ وَٱلْأُولَىٰٓ
entries.t: So God seized him with an exemplary punishment, in the last and in the first.
entries.na: فاخذه الله نكال الاخره والاولي
entries.nt: so god seized him with an exemplary punishment in the last and in the first

entries.a: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَعِبْرَةًۭ لِّمَن يَخْشَىٰٓ
entries.t: In this is a lesson for whoever fears.
entries.na: ان في ذلك لعبره لمن يخشي
entries.nt: in this is a lesson for whoever fears

entries.a: ءَأَنتُمْ أَشَدُّ خَلْقًا أَمِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ ۚ بَنَىٰهَا
entries.t: Are you more difficult to create, or the heaven? He constructed it.
entries.na: انتم اشد خلقا ام السما بنيها
entries.nt: are you more difficult to create or the heaven he constructed it

entries.a: رَفَعَ سَمْكَهَا فَسَوَّىٰهَا
entries.t: He raised its masses, and proportioned it.
entries.na: رفع سمكها فسويها
entries.nt: he raised its masses and proportioned it

entries.a: وَأَغْطَشَ لَيْلَهَا وَأَخْرَجَ ضُحَىٰهَا
entries.t: And He dimmed its night, and brought out its daylight.
entries.na: واغطش ليلها واخرج ضحيها
entries.nt: and he dimmed its night and brought out its daylight

entries.a: وَٱلْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ دَحَىٰهَآ
entries.t: And the earth after that He spread.
entries.na: والارض بعد ذلك دحيها
entries.nt: and the earth after that he spread

entries.a: أَخْرَجَ مِنْهَا مَآءَهَا وَمَرْعَىٰهَا
entries.t: And from it, He produced its water and its pasture.
entries.na: اخرج منها ماها ومرعيها
entries.nt: and from it he produced its water and its pasture

entries.a: وَٱلْجِبَالَ أَرْسَىٰهَا
entries.t: And the mountains, He anchored.
entries.na: والجبال ارسيها
entries.nt: and the mountains he anchored

entries.a: مَتَٰعًۭا لَّكُمْ وَلِأَنْعَٰمِكُمْ
entries.t: A source of enjoyment for you and for your animals.
entries.na: متعا لكم ولانعمكم
entries.nt: a source of enjoyment for you and for your animals

entries.a: فَإِذَا جَآءَتِ ٱلطَّآمَّةُ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ
entries.t: But when the Great Cataclysm arrives.
entries.na: فاذا جات الطامه الكبري
entries.nt: but when the great cataclysm arrives

entries.a: يَوْمَ يَتَذَكَّرُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ مَا سَعَىٰ
entries.t: A Day when man will remember what he has endeavored.
entries.na: يوم يتذكر الانسن ما سعي
entries.nt: a day when man will remember what he has endeavored

entries.a: وَبُرِّزَتِ ٱلْجَحِيمُ لِمَن يَرَىٰ
entries.t: And Hell will be displayed to whoever sees.
entries.na: وبرزت الجحيم لمن يري
entries.nt: and hell will be displayed to whoever sees

entries.a: فَأَمَّا مَن طَغَىٰ
entries.t: As for him who was defiant.
entries.na: فاما من طغي
entries.nt: as for him who was defiant

entries.a: وَءَاثَرَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا
entries.t: And preferred the life of this world.
entries.na: واثر الحيوه الدنيا
entries.nt: and preferred the life of this world

entries.a: فَإِنَّ ٱلْجَحِيمَ هِىَ ٱلْمَأْوَىٰ
entries.t: Then Hell is the shelter.
entries.na: فان الجحيم هي الماوي
entries.nt: then hell is the shelter

entries.a: وَأَمَّا مَنْ خَافَ مَقَامَ رَبِّهِۦ وَنَهَى ٱلنَّفْسَ عَنِ ٱلْهَوَىٰ
entries.t: But as for him who feared the Standing of his Lord, and restrained the self from desires.
entries.na: واما من خاف مقام ربه ونهي النفس عن الهوي
entries.nt: but as for him who feared the standing of his lord and restrained the self from desires

entries.a: فَإِنَّ ٱلْجَنَّةَ هِىَ ٱلْمَأْوَىٰ
entries.t: Then Paradise is the shelter.
entries.na: فان الجنه هي الماوي
entries.nt: then paradise is the shelter

entries.a: يَسْـَٔلُونَكَ عَنِ ٱلسَّاعَةِ أَيَّانَ مُرْسَىٰهَا
entries.t: They ask you about the Hour, "When will it take place?"
entries.na: يسلونك عن الساعه ايان مرسيها
entries.nt: they ask you about the hour when will it take place

entries.a: فِيمَ أَنتَ مِن ذِكْرَىٰهَآ
entries.t: You have no knowledge of it.
entries.na: فيم انت من ذكريها
entries.nt: you have no knowledge of it

entries.a: إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ مُنتَهَىٰهَآ
entries.t: To your Lord is its finality.
entries.na: الي ربك منتهيها
entries.nt: to your lord is its finality

entries.a: إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مُنذِرُ مَن يَخْشَىٰهَا
entries.t: You are just a warner for whoever dreads it.
entries.na: انما انت منذر من يخشيها
entries.nt: you are just a warner for whoever dreads it

entries.a: كَأَنَّهُمْ يَوْمَ يَرَوْنَهَا لَمْ يَلْبَثُوٓا۟ إِلَّا عَشِيَّةً أَوْ ضُحَىٰهَا
entries.t: On the Day when they witness it-as though they only stayed an evening, or its morning.
entries.na: كانهم يوم يرونها لم يلبثوا الا عشيه او ضحيها
entries.nt: on the day when they witness it as though they only stayed an evening or its morning

entries.a: عَبَسَ وَتَوَلَّىٰٓ
entries.t: He frowned and turned away.
entries.na: عبس وتولي
entries.nt: he frowned and turned away

entries.a: أَن جَآءَهُ ٱلْأَعْمَىٰ
entries.t: When the blind man approached him.
entries.na: ان جاه الاعمي
entries.nt: when the blind man approached him

entries.a: وَمَا يُدْرِيكَ لَعَلَّهُۥ يَزَّكَّىٰٓ
entries.t: But how do you know? Perhaps he was seeking to purify himself.
entries.na: وما يدريك لعله يزكي
entries.nt: but how do you know perhaps he was seeking to purify himself

entries.a: أَوْ يَذَّكَّرُ فَتَنفَعَهُ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰٓ
entries.t: Or be reminded, and the message would benefit him.
entries.na: او يذكر فتنفعه الذكري
entries.nt: or be reminded and the message would benefit him

entries.a: أَمَّا مَنِ ٱسْتَغْنَىٰ
entries.t: But as for him who was indifferent.
entries.na: اما من استغني
entries.nt: but as for him who was indifferent

entries.a: فَأَنتَ لَهُۥ تَصَدَّىٰ
entries.t: You gave him your attention.
entries.na: فانت له تصدي
entries.nt: you gave him your attention

entries.a: وَمَا عَلَيْكَ أَلَّا يَزَّكَّىٰ
entries.t: Though you are not liable if he does not purify himself.
entries.na: وما عليك الا يزكي
entries.nt: though you are not liable if he does not purify himself

entries.a: وَأَمَّا مَن جَآءَكَ يَسْعَىٰ
entries.t: But as for him who came to you seeking.
entries.na: واما من جاك يسعي
entries.nt: but as for him who came to you seeking

entries.a: وَهُوَ يَخْشَىٰ
entries.t: In awe.
entries.na: وهو يخشي
entries.nt: in awe

entries.a: فَأَنتَ عَنْهُ تَلَهَّىٰ
entries.t: To him you were inattentive.
entries.na: فانت عنه تلهي
entries.nt: to him you were inattentive

entries.a: كَلَّآ إِنَّهَا تَذْكِرَةٌۭ
entries.t: Do not. This is a Lesson.
entries.na: كلا انها تذكره
entries.nt: do not this is a lesson

entries.a: فَمَن شَآءَ ذَكَرَهُۥ
entries.t: Whoever wills, shall remember it.
entries.na: فمن شا ذكره
entries.nt: whoever wills shall remember it

entries.a: فِى صُحُفٍۢ مُّكَرَّمَةٍۢ
entries.t: On honorable pages.
entries.na: في صحف مكرمه
entries.nt: on honorable pages

entries.a: مَّرْفُوعَةٍۢ مُّطَهَّرَةٍۭ
entries.t: Exalted and purified.
entries.na: مرفوعه مطهره
entries.nt: exalted and purified

entries.a: بِأَيْدِى سَفَرَةٍۢ
entries.t: By the hands of scribes.
entries.na: بايدي سفره
entries.nt: by the hands of scribes

entries.a: كِرَامٍۭ بَرَرَةٍۢ
entries.t: Noble and devoted.
entries.na: كرام برره
entries.nt: noble and devoted

entries.a: قُتِلَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ مَآ أَكْفَرَهُۥ
entries.t: Perish man! How thankless he is!
entries.na: قتل الانسن ما اكفره
entries.nt: perish man how thankless he is

entries.a: مِنْ أَىِّ شَىْءٍ خَلَقَهُۥ
entries.t: From what did He create him?
entries.na: من اي شي خلقه
entries.nt: from what did he create him

entries.a: مِن نُّطْفَةٍ خَلَقَهُۥ فَقَدَّرَهُۥ
entries.t: From a sperm drop He created him, and enabled him.
entries.na: من نطفه خلقه فقدره
entries.nt: from a sperm drop he created him and enabled him

entries.a: ثُمَّ ٱلسَّبِيلَ يَسَّرَهُۥ
entries.t: Then He eased the way for him.
entries.na: ثم السبيل يسره
entries.nt: then he eased the way for him

entries.a: ثُمَّ أَمَاتَهُۥ فَأَقْبَرَهُۥ
entries.t: Then He puts him to death, and buries him.
entries.na: ثم اماته فاقبره
entries.nt: then he puts him to death and buries him

entries.a: ثُمَّ إِذَا شَآءَ أَنشَرَهُۥ
entries.t: Then, when He wills, He will resurrect him.
entries.na: ثم اذا شا انشره
entries.nt: then when he wills he will resurrect him

entries.a: كَلَّا لَمَّا يَقْضِ مَآ أَمَرَهُۥ
entries.t: But no, he did not fulfill what He has commanded him.
entries.na: كلا لما يقض ما امره
entries.nt: but no he did not fulfill what he has commanded him

entries.a: فَلْيَنظُرِ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ إِلَىٰ طَعَامِهِۦٓ
entries.t: Let man consider his food.
entries.na: فلينظر الانسن الي طعامه
entries.nt: let man consider his food

entries.a: أَنَّا صَبَبْنَا ٱلْمَآءَ صَبًّۭا
entries.t: We pour down water in abundance.
entries.na: انا صببنا الما صبا
entries.nt: we pour down water in abundance

entries.a: ثُمَّ شَقَقْنَا ٱلْأَرْضَ شَقًّۭا
entries.t: Then crack the soil open.
entries.na: ثم شققنا الارض شقا
entries.nt: then crack the soil open

entries.a: فَأَنۢبَتْنَا فِيهَا حَبًّۭا
entries.t: And grow in it grains.
entries.na: فانبتنا فيها حبا
entries.nt: and grow in it grains

entries.a: وَعِنَبًۭا وَقَضْبًۭا
entries.t: And grapes and herbs.
entries.na: وعنبا وقضبا
entries.nt: and grapes and herbs

entries.a: وَزَيْتُونًۭا وَنَخْلًۭا
entries.t: And olives and dates.
entries.na: وزيتونا ونخلا
entries.nt: and olives and dates

entries.a: وَحَدَآئِقَ غُلْبًۭا
entries.t: And luscious gardens.
entries.na: وحدايق غلبا
entries.nt: and luscious gardens

entries.a: وَفَٰكِهَةًۭ وَأَبًّۭا
entries.t: And fruits and vegetables.
entries.na: وفكهه وابا
entries.nt: and fruits and vegetables

entries.a: مَّتَٰعًۭا لَّكُمْ وَلِأَنْعَٰمِكُمْ
entries.t: Enjoyment for you, and for your livestock.
entries.na: متعا لكم ولانعمكم
entries.nt: enjoyment for you and for your livestock

entries.a: فَإِذَا جَآءَتِ ٱلصَّآخَّةُ
entries.t: But when the Deafening Noise comes to pass.
entries.na: فاذا جات الصاخه
entries.nt: but when the deafening noise comes to pass

entries.a: يَوْمَ يَفِرُّ ٱلْمَرْءُ مِنْ أَخِيهِ
entries.t: The Day when a person will flee from his brother.
entries.na: يوم يفر المر من اخيه
entries.nt: the day when a person will flee from his brother

entries.a: وَأُمِّهِۦ وَأَبِيهِ
entries.t: And his mother and his father.
entries.na: وامه وابيه
entries.nt: and his mother and his father

entries.a: وَصَٰحِبَتِهِۦ وَبَنِيهِ
entries.t: And his consort and his children.
entries.na: وصحبته وبنيه
entries.nt: and his consort and his children

entries.a: لِكُلِّ ٱمْرِئٍۢ مِّنْهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ شَأْنٌۭ يُغْنِيهِ
entries.t: Every one of them, on that Day, will have enough to preoccupy him.
entries.na: لكل امري منهم يوميذ شان يغنيه
entries.nt: every one of them on that day will have enough to preoccupy him

entries.a: وُجُوهٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ مُّسْفِرَةٌۭ
entries.t: Faces on that Day will be radiant.
entries.na: وجوه يوميذ مسفره
entries.nt: faces on that day will be radiant

entries.a: ضَاحِكَةٌۭ مُّسْتَبْشِرَةٌۭ
entries.t: Laughing and rejoicing.
entries.na: ضاحكه مستبشره
entries.nt: laughing and rejoicing

entries.a: وَوُجُوهٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍ عَلَيْهَا غَبَرَةٌۭ
entries.t: And Faces on that Day will be covered with misery.
entries.na: ووجوه يوميذ عليها غبره
entries.nt: and faces on that day will be covered with misery

entries.a: تَرْهَقُهَا قَتَرَةٌ
entries.t: Overwhelmed by remorse.
entries.na: ترهقها قتره
entries.nt: overwhelmed by remorse

entries.a: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْكَفَرَةُ ٱلْفَجَرَةُ
entries.t: These are the faithless, the vicious.
entries.na: اوليك هم الكفره الفجره
entries.nt: these are the faithless the vicious

entries.a: إِذَا ٱلشَّمْسُ كُوِّرَتْ
entries.t: When the sun is rolled up.
entries.na: اذا الشمس كورت
entries.nt: when the sun is rolled up

entries.a: وَإِذَا ٱلنُّجُومُ ٱنكَدَرَتْ
entries.t: When the stars are dimmed.
entries.na: واذا النجوم انكدرت
entries.nt: when the stars are dimmed

entries.a: وَإِذَا ٱلْجِبَالُ سُيِّرَتْ
entries.t: When the mountains are set in motion.
entries.na: واذا الجبال سيرت
entries.nt: when the mountains are set in motion

entries.a: وَإِذَا ٱلْعِشَارُ عُطِّلَتْ
entries.t: When the relationships are suspended.
entries.na: واذا العشار عطلت
entries.nt: when the relationships are suspended

entries.a: وَإِذَا ٱلْوُحُوشُ حُشِرَتْ
entries.t: When the beasts are gathered.
entries.na: واذا الوحوش حشرت
entries.nt: when the beasts are gathered

entries.a: وَإِذَا ٱلْبِحَارُ سُجِّرَتْ
entries.t: When the oceans are set aflame.
entries.na: واذا البحار سجرت
entries.nt: when the oceans are set aflame

entries.a: وَإِذَا ٱلنُّفُوسُ زُوِّجَتْ
entries.t: When the souls are paired.
entries.na: واذا النفوس زوجت
entries.nt: when the souls are paired

entries.a: وَإِذَا ٱلْمَوْءُۥدَةُ سُئِلَتْ
entries.t: When the girl, buried alive, is asked:
entries.na: واذا الموده سيلت
entries.nt: when the girl buried alive is asked

entries.a: بِأَىِّ ذَنۢبٍۢ قُتِلَتْ
entries.t: For what crime was she killed?
entries.na: باي ذنب قتلت
entries.nt: for what crime was she killed

entries.a: وَإِذَا ٱلصُّحُفُ نُشِرَتْ
entries.t: When the records are made public.
entries.na: واذا الصحف نشرت
entries.nt: when the records are made public

entries.a: وَإِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ كُشِطَتْ
entries.t: When the sky is peeled away.
entries.na: واذا السما كشطت
entries.nt: when the sky is peeled away

entries.a: وَإِذَا ٱلْجَحِيمُ سُعِّرَتْ
entries.t: When the Fire is set ablaze.
entries.na: واذا الجحيم سعرت
entries.nt: when the fire is set ablaze

entries.a: وَإِذَا ٱلْجَنَّةُ أُزْلِفَتْ
entries.t: When Paradise is brought near.
entries.na: واذا الجنه ازلفت
entries.nt: when paradise is brought near

entries.a: عَلِمَتْ نَفْسٌۭ مَّآ أَحْضَرَتْ
entries.t: Each soul will know what it has readied.
entries.na: علمت نفس ما احضرت
entries.nt: each soul will know what it has readied

entries.a: فَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِٱلْخُنَّسِ
entries.t: I swear by the galaxies.
entries.na: فلا اقسم بالخنس
entries.nt: i swear by the galaxies

entries.a: ٱلْجَوَارِ ٱلْكُنَّسِ
entries.t: Precisely running their courses.
entries.na: الجوار الكنس
entries.nt: precisely running their courses

entries.a: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا عَسْعَسَ
entries.t: And by the night as it recedes.
entries.na: واليل اذا عسعس
entries.nt: and by the night as it recedes

entries.a: وَٱلصُّبْحِ إِذَا تَنَفَّسَ
entries.t: And by the morn as it breathes.
entries.na: والصبح اذا تنفس
entries.nt: and by the morn as it breathes

entries.a: إِنَّهُۥ لَقَوْلُ رَسُولٍۢ كَرِيمٍۢ
entries.t: This is the speech of a noble messenger.
entries.na: انه لقول رسول كريم
entries.nt: this is the speech of a noble messenger

entries.a: ذِى قُوَّةٍ عِندَ ذِى ٱلْعَرْشِ مَكِينٍۢ
entries.t: Endowed with power, eminent with the Lord of the Throne.
entries.na: ذي قوه عند ذي العرش مكين
entries.nt: endowed with power eminent with the lord of the throne

entries.a: مُّطَاعٍۢ ثَمَّ أَمِينٍۢ
entries.t: Obeyed and honest.
entries.na: مطاع ثم امين
entries.nt: obeyed and honest

entries.a: وَمَا صَاحِبُكُم بِمَجْنُونٍۢ
entries.t: Your friend is not possessed.
entries.na: وما صاحبكم بمجنون
entries.nt: your friend is not possessed

entries.a: وَلَقَدْ رَءَاهُ بِٱلْأُفُقِ ٱلْمُبِينِ
entries.t: He saw him on the luminous horizon.
entries.na: ولقد راه بالافق المبين
entries.nt: he saw him on the luminous horizon

entries.a: وَمَا هُوَ عَلَى ٱلْغَيْبِ بِضَنِينٍۢ
entries.t: And He does not withhold knowledge of the Unseen.
entries.na: وما هو علي الغيب بضنين
entries.nt: and he does not withhold knowledge of the unseen

entries.a: وَمَا هُوَ بِقَوْلِ شَيْطَٰنٍۢ رَّجِيمٍۢ
entries.t: And it is not the word of an accursed devil.
entries.na: وما هو بقول شيطن رجيم
entries.nt: and it is not the word of an accursed devil

entries.a: فَأَيْنَ تَذْهَبُونَ
entries.t: So where are you heading?
entries.na: فاين تذهبون
entries.nt: so where are you heading

entries.a: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌۭ لِّلْعَٰلَمِينَ
entries.t: It is only a Reminder to all mankind.
entries.na: ان هو الا ذكر للعلمين
entries.nt: it is only a reminder to all mankind

entries.a: لِمَن شَآءَ مِنكُمْ أَن يَسْتَقِيمَ
entries.t: To whoever of you wills to go straight.
entries.na: لمن شا منكم ان يستقيم
entries.nt: to whoever of you wills to go straight

entries.a: وَمَا تَشَآءُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
entries.t: But you cannot will, unless God wills-The Lord of the Worlds.
entries.na: وما تشاون الا ان يشا الله رب العلمين
entries.nt: but you cannot will unless god wills the lord of the worlds

entries.a: إِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ ٱنفَطَرَتْ
entries.t: When the sky breaks apart.
entries.na: اذا السما انفطرت
entries.nt: when the sky breaks apart

entries.a: وَإِذَا ٱلْكَوَاكِبُ ٱنتَثَرَتْ
entries.t: When the planets are scattered.
entries.na: واذا الكواكب انتثرت
entries.nt: when the planets are scattered

entries.a: وَإِذَا ٱلْبِحَارُ فُجِّرَتْ
entries.t: When the oceans are exploded.
entries.na: واذا البحار فجرت
entries.nt: when the oceans are exploded

entries.a: وَإِذَا ٱلْقُبُورُ بُعْثِرَتْ
entries.t: When the tombs are strewn around.
entries.na: واذا القبور بعثرت
entries.nt: when the tombs are strewn around

entries.a: عَلِمَتْ نَفْسٌۭ مَّا قَدَّمَتْ وَأَخَّرَتْ
entries.t: Each soul will know what it has advanced, and what it has deferred.
entries.na: علمت نفس ما قدمت واخرت
entries.nt: each soul will know what it has advanced and what it has deferred

entries.a: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ مَا غَرَّكَ بِرَبِّكَ ٱلْكَرِيمِ
entries.t: O man! What deluded you concerning your Lord, the Most Generous?
entries.na: يايها الانسن ما غرك بربك الكريم
entries.nt: o man what deluded you concerning your lord the most generous

entries.a: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَكَ فَسَوَّىٰكَ فَعَدَلَكَ
entries.t: He Who created you, and formed you, and proportioned you?
entries.na: الذي خلقك فسويك فعدلك
entries.nt: he who created you and formed you and proportioned you

entries.a: فِىٓ أَىِّ صُورَةٍۢ مَّا شَآءَ رَكَّبَكَ
entries.t: In whatever shape He willed, He assembled you.
entries.na: في اي صوره ما شا ركبك
entries.nt: in whatever shape he willed he assembled you

entries.a: كَلَّا بَلْ تُكَذِّبُونَ بِٱلدِّينِ
entries.t: But you reject the religion.
entries.na: كلا بل تكذبون بالدين
entries.nt: but you reject the religion

entries.a: وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكُمْ لَحَٰفِظِينَ
entries.t: Though over you are watchers.
entries.na: وان عليكم لحفظين
entries.nt: though over you are watchers

entries.a: كِرَامًۭا كَٰتِبِينَ
entries.t: Honest recorders.
entries.na: كراما كتبين
entries.nt: honest recorders

entries.a: يَعْلَمُونَ مَا تَفْعَلُونَ
entries.t: They know everything you do.
entries.na: يعلمون ما تفعلون
entries.nt: they know everything you do

entries.a: إِنَّ ٱلْأَبْرَارَ لَفِى نَعِيمٍۢ
entries.t: The virtuous will be in bliss.
entries.na: ان الابرار لفي نعيم
entries.nt: the virtuous will be in bliss

entries.a: وَإِنَّ ٱلْفُجَّارَ لَفِى جَحِيمٍۢ
entries.t: While the wicked will be in Hell.
entries.na: وان الفجار لفي جحيم
entries.nt: while the wicked will be in hell

entries.a: يَصْلَوْنَهَا يَوْمَ ٱلدِّينِ
entries.t: They will enter it on the Day of Justice.
entries.na: يصلونها يوم الدين
entries.nt: they will enter it on the day of justice

entries.a: وَمَا هُمْ عَنْهَا بِغَآئِبِينَ
entries.t: And they will not be absent from it.
entries.na: وما هم عنها بغايبين
entries.nt: and they will not be absent from it

entries.a: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ
entries.t: But what will convey to you what the Day of Justice is?
entries.na: وما ادريك ما يوم الدين
entries.nt: but what will convey to you what the day of justice is

entries.a: ثُمَّ مَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ
entries.t: Then again, what will convey to you what the Day of Justice is?
entries.na: ثم ما ادريك ما يوم الدين
entries.nt: then again what will convey to you what the day of justice is

entries.a: يَوْمَ لَا تَمْلِكُ نَفْسٌۭ لِّنَفْسٍۢ شَيْـًۭٔا ۖ وَٱلْأَمْرُ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلَّهِ
entries.t: The Day when no soul will avail another soul anything; and the decision on that Day is God's.
entries.na: يوم لا تملك نفس لنفس شيا والامر يوميذ لله
entries.nt: the day when no soul will avail another soul anything and the decision on that day is god s

entries.a: وَيْلٌۭ لِّلْمُطَفِّفِينَ
entries.t: Woe to the defrauders.
entries.na: ويل للمطففين
entries.nt: woe to the defrauders

entries.a: ٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ٱكْتَالُوا۟ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ يَسْتَوْفُونَ
entries.t: Those who, when they take a measure from people, they take in full.
entries.na: الذين اذا اكتالوا علي الناس يستوفون
entries.nt: those who when they take a measure from people they take in full

entries.a: وَإِذَا كَالُوهُمْ أَو وَّزَنُوهُمْ يُخْسِرُونَ
entries.t: But when they measure or weigh to others, they cheat.
entries.na: واذا كالوهم او وزنوهم يخسرون
entries.nt: but when they measure or weigh to others they cheat

entries.a: أَلَا يَظُنُّ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ أَنَّهُم مَّبْعُوثُونَ
entries.t: Do these not know that they will be resurrected?
entries.na: الا يظن اوليك انهم مبعوثون
entries.nt: do these not know that they will be resurrected

entries.a: لِيَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍۢ
entries.t: For a Great Day?
entries.na: ليوم عظيم
entries.nt: for a great day

entries.a: يَوْمَ يَقُومُ ٱلنَّاسُ لِرَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
entries.t: The Day when mankind will stand before the Lord of the Worlds?
entries.na: يوم يقوم الناس لرب العلمين
entries.nt: the day when mankind will stand before the lord of the worlds

entries.a: كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَٰبَ ٱلْفُجَّارِ لَفِى سِجِّينٍۢ
entries.t: Not at all. The record of the wicked is in Sijjeen.
entries.na: كلا ان كتب الفجار لفي سجين
entries.nt: not at all the record of the wicked is in sijjeen

entries.a: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا سِجِّينٌۭ
entries.t: But how can you know what Sijjeen is?
entries.na: وما ادريك ما سجين
entries.nt: but how can you know what sijjeen is

entries.a: كِتَٰبٌۭ مَّرْقُومٌۭ
entries.t: A numerical book.
entries.na: كتب مرقوم
entries.nt: a numerical book

entries.a: وَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
entries.t: Woe on that Day to the deniers.
entries.na: ويل يوميذ للمكذبين
entries.nt: woe on that day to the deniers

entries.a: ٱلَّذِينَ يُكَذِّبُونَ بِيَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
entries.t: Those who deny the Day of Reckoning.
entries.na: الذين يكذبون بيوم الدين
entries.nt: those who deny the day of reckoning

entries.a: وَمَا يُكَذِّبُ بِهِۦٓ إِلَّا كُلُّ مُعْتَدٍ أَثِيمٍ
entries.t: But none denies it except the sinful aggressor.
entries.na: وما يكذب به الا كل معتد اثيم
entries.nt: but none denies it except the sinful aggressor

entries.a: إِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ ءَايَٰتُنَا قَالَ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
entries.t: When Our revelations are recited to him, he says, "Legends of the ancients."
entries.na: اذا تتلي عليه ايتنا قال اسطير الاولين
entries.nt: when our revelations are recited to him he says legends of the ancients

entries.a: كَلَّا ۖ بَلْ ۜ رَانَ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
entries.t: Not at all. Their hearts have become corroded by what they used to earn.
entries.na: كلا بل ران علي قلوبهم ما كانوا يكسبون
entries.nt: not at all their hearts have become corroded by what they used to earn

entries.a: كَلَّآ إِنَّهُمْ عَن رَّبِّهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لَّمَحْجُوبُونَ
entries.t: Not at all. On that Day, they will be screened from their Lord.
entries.na: كلا انهم عن ربهم يوميذ لمحجوبون
entries.nt: not at all on that day they will be screened from their lord

entries.a: ثُمَّ إِنَّهُمْ لَصَالُوا۟ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
entries.t: Then they will roast in Hell.
entries.na: ثم انهم لصالوا الجحيم
entries.nt: then they will roast in hell

entries.a: ثُمَّ يُقَالُ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
entries.t: Then it will be said, "This is what you used to deny."
entries.na: ثم يقال هذا الذي كنتم به تكذبون
entries.nt: then it will be said this is what you used to deny

entries.a: كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَٰبَ ٱلْأَبْرَارِ لَفِى عِلِّيِّينَ
entries.t: No indeed; the record of the righteous is in Elliyyeen.
entries.na: كلا ان كتب الابرار لفي عليين
entries.nt: no indeed the record of the righteous is in elliyyeen

entries.a: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا عِلِّيُّونَ
entries.t: But how can you know what Elliyyoon is?
entries.na: وما ادريك ما عليون
entries.nt: but how can you know what elliyyoon is

entries.a: كِتَٰبٌۭ مَّرْقُومٌۭ
entries.t: A numerical book.
entries.na: كتب مرقوم
entries.nt: a numerical book

entries.a: يَشْهَدُهُ ٱلْمُقَرَّبُونَ
entries.t: Witnessed by those brought near.
entries.na: يشهده المقربون
entries.nt: witnessed by those brought near

entries.a: إِنَّ ٱلْأَبْرَارَ لَفِى نَعِيمٍ
entries.t: Indeed, the righteous will be amid bliss.
entries.na: ان الابرار لفي نعيم
entries.nt: indeed the righteous will be amid bliss

entries.a: عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ يَنظُرُونَ
entries.t: On thrones, looking on.
entries.na: علي الارايك ينظرون
entries.nt: on thrones looking on

entries.a: تَعْرِفُ فِى وُجُوهِهِمْ نَضْرَةَ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
entries.t: You will recognize on their faces the radiance of bliss.
entries.na: تعرف في وجوههم نضره النعيم
entries.nt: you will recognize on their faces the radiance of bliss

entries.a: يُسْقَوْنَ مِن رَّحِيقٍۢ مَّخْتُومٍ
entries.t: They will be given to drink a sealed wine.
entries.na: يسقون من رحيق مختوم
entries.nt: they will be given to drink a sealed wine

entries.a: خِتَٰمُهُۥ مِسْكٌۭ ۚ وَفِى ذَٰلِكَ فَلْيَتَنَافَسِ ٱلْمُتَنَٰفِسُونَ
entries.t: Whose seal is musk-this is what competitors should compete for.
entries.na: ختمه مسك وفي ذلك فليتنافس المتنفسون
entries.nt: whose seal is musk this is what competitors should compete for

entries.a: وَمِزَاجُهُۥ مِن تَسْنِيمٍ
entries.t: Its mixture is of Tasneem.
entries.na: ومزاجه من تسنيم
entries.nt: its mixture is of tasneem

entries.a: عَيْنًۭا يَشْرَبُ بِهَا ٱلْمُقَرَّبُونَ
entries.t: A spring from which those brought near drink.
entries.na: عينا يشرب بها المقربون
entries.nt: a spring from which those brought near drink

entries.a: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ أَجْرَمُوا۟ كَانُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ يَضْحَكُونَ
entries.t: Those who committed crimes used to laugh at those who believed.
entries.na: ان الذين اجرموا كانوا من الذين امنوا يضحكون
entries.nt: those who committed crimes used to laugh at those who believed

entries.a: وَإِذَا مَرُّوا۟ بِهِمْ يَتَغَامَزُونَ
entries.t: And when they passed by them, they would wink at one another.
entries.na: واذا مروا بهم يتغامزون
entries.nt: and when they passed by them they would wink at one another

entries.a: وَإِذَا ٱنقَلَبُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِمُ ٱنقَلَبُوا۟ فَكِهِينَ
entries.t: And when they went back to their families, they would go back exulting.
