entries.na: واذا انقلبوا الي اهلهم انقلبوا فكهين
entries.nt: and when they went back to their families they would go back exulting

entries.a: وَإِذَا رَأَوْهُمْ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَضَآلُّونَ
entries.t: And if they saw them, they would say, "These people are lost."
entries.na: واذا راوهم قالوا ان هولا لضالون
entries.nt: and if they saw them they would say these people are lost

entries.a: وَمَآ أُرْسِلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِمْ حَٰفِظِينَ
entries.t: Yet they were not sent as guardians over them.
entries.na: وما ارسلوا عليهم حفظين
entries.nt: yet they were not sent as guardians over them

entries.a: فَٱلْيَوْمَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْكُفَّارِ يَضْحَكُونَ
entries.t: But on that Day, those who believed will laugh at the unbelievers.
entries.na: فاليوم الذين امنوا من الكفار يضحكون
entries.nt: but on that day those who believed will laugh at the unbelievers

entries.a: عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ يَنظُرُونَ
entries.t: On luxurious furnishings, looking on.
entries.na: علي الارايك ينظرون
entries.nt: on luxurious furnishings looking on

entries.a: هَلْ ثُوِّبَ ٱلْكُفَّارُ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْعَلُونَ
entries.t: Have the unbelievers been repaid for what they used to do?
entries.na: هل ثوب الكفار ما كانوا يفعلون
entries.nt: have the unbelievers been repaid for what they used to do

entries.a: إِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ ٱنشَقَّتْ
entries.t: When the sky is ruptured.
entries.na: اذا السما انشقت
entries.nt: when the sky is ruptured

entries.a: وَأَذِنَتْ لِرَبِّهَا وَحُقَّتْ
entries.t: And hearkens to its Lord, as it must.
entries.na: واذنت لربها وحقت
entries.nt: and hearkens to its lord as it must

entries.a: وَإِذَا ٱلْأَرْضُ مُدَّتْ
entries.t: And when the earth is leveled out.
entries.na: واذا الارض مدت
entries.nt: and when the earth is leveled out

entries.a: وَأَلْقَتْ مَا فِيهَا وَتَخَلَّتْ
entries.t: And casts out what is in it, and becomes empty.
entries.na: والقت ما فيها وتخلت
entries.nt: and casts out what is in it and becomes empty

entries.a: وَأَذِنَتْ لِرَبِّهَا وَحُقَّتْ
entries.t: And hearkens to its Lord, as it must.
entries.na: واذنت لربها وحقت
entries.nt: and hearkens to its lord as it must

entries.a: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ إِنَّكَ كَادِحٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ كَدْحًۭا فَمُلَٰقِيهِ
entries.t: O man! You are laboring towards your Lord, and you will meet Him.
entries.na: يايها الانسن انك كادح الي ربك كدحا فملقيه
entries.nt: o man you are laboring towards your lord and you will meet him

entries.a: فَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ بِيَمِينِهِۦ
entries.t: As for him who is given his book in his right hand.
entries.na: فاما من اوتي كتبه بيمينه
entries.nt: as for him who is given his book in his right hand

entries.a: فَسَوْفَ يُحَاسَبُ حِسَابًۭا يَسِيرًۭا
entries.t: He will have an easy settlement.
entries.na: فسوف يحاسب حسابا يسيرا
entries.nt: he will have an easy settlement

entries.a: وَيَنقَلِبُ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِۦ مَسْرُورًۭا
entries.t: And will return to his family delighted.
entries.na: وينقلب الي اهله مسرورا
entries.nt: and will return to his family delighted

entries.a: وَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ وَرَآءَ ظَهْرِهِۦ
entries.t: But as for him who is given his book behind his back.
entries.na: واما من اوتي كتبه ورا ظهره
entries.nt: but as for him who is given his book behind his back

entries.a: فَسَوْفَ يَدْعُوا۟ ثُبُورًۭا
entries.t: He will call for death.
entries.na: فسوف يدعوا ثبورا
entries.nt: he will call for death

entries.a: وَيَصْلَىٰ سَعِيرًا
entries.t: And will enter the Blaze.
entries.na: ويصلي سعيرا
entries.nt: and will enter the blaze

entries.a: إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ فِىٓ أَهْلِهِۦ مَسْرُورًا
entries.t: He used to be happy among his family.
entries.na: انه كان في اهله مسرورا
entries.nt: he used to be happy among his family

entries.a: إِنَّهُۥ ظَنَّ أَن لَّن يَحُورَ
entries.t: He thought he would never return.
entries.na: انه ظن ان لن يحور
entries.nt: he thought he would never return

entries.a: بَلَىٰٓ إِنَّ رَبَّهُۥ كَانَ بِهِۦ بَصِيرًۭا
entries.t: In fact, his Lord was watching him.
entries.na: بلي ان ربه كان به بصيرا
entries.nt: in fact his lord was watching him

entries.a: فَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِٱلشَّفَقِ
entries.t: I swear by the twilight.
entries.na: فلا اقسم بالشفق
entries.nt: i swear by the twilight

entries.a: وَٱلَّيْلِ وَمَا وَسَقَ
entries.t: And by the night, and what it covers.
entries.na: واليل وما وسق
entries.nt: and by the night and what it covers

entries.a: وَٱلْقَمَرِ إِذَا ٱتَّسَقَ
entries.t: And by the moon, as it grows full.
entries.na: والقمر اذا اتسق
entries.nt: and by the moon as it grows full

entries.a: لَتَرْكَبُنَّ طَبَقًا عَن طَبَقٍۢ
entries.t: You will mount stage by stage.
entries.na: لتركبن طبقا عن طبق
entries.nt: you will mount stage by stage

entries.a: فَمَا لَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
entries.t: What is the matter with them that they do not believe?
entries.na: فما لهم لا يومنون
entries.nt: what is the matter with them that they do not believe

entries.a: وَإِذَا قُرِئَ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْقُرْءَانُ لَا يَسْجُدُونَ ۩
entries.t: And when the Quran is read to them, they do not bow down?
entries.na: واذا قري عليهم القران لا يسجدون
entries.nt: and when the quran is read to them they do not bow down

entries.a: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ يُكَذِّبُونَ
entries.t: In fact, those who disbelieve are in denial.
entries.na: بل الذين كفروا يكذبون
entries.nt: in fact those who disbelieve are in denial

entries.a: وَٱللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يُوعُونَ
entries.t: But God knows what they hide inside.
entries.na: والله اعلم بما يوعون
entries.nt: but god knows what they hide inside

entries.a: فَبَشِّرْهُم بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ
entries.t: So inform them of a painful punishment.
entries.na: فبشرهم بعذاب اليم
entries.nt: so inform them of a painful punishment

entries.a: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍۭ
entries.t: Except those who believe and do good deeds; they will have an undiminished reward.
entries.na: الا الذين امنوا وعملوا الصلحت لهم اجر غير ممنون
entries.nt: except those who believe and do good deeds they will have an undiminished reward

entries.a: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلْبُرُوجِ
entries.t: By the sky with the constellations.
entries.na: والسما ذات البروج
entries.nt: by the sky with the constellations

entries.a: وَٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلْمَوْعُودِ
entries.t: And by the Promised Day.
entries.na: واليوم الموعود
entries.nt: and by the promised day

entries.a: وَشَاهِدٍۢ وَمَشْهُودٍۢ
entries.t: And by the witness and the witnessed.
entries.na: وشاهد ومشهود
entries.nt: and by the witness and the witnessed

entries.a: قُتِلَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْأُخْدُودِ
entries.t: Destroyed were the People of the Trench.
entries.na: قتل اصحب الاخدود
entries.nt: destroyed were the people of the trench

entries.a: ٱلنَّارِ ذَاتِ ٱلْوَقُودِ
entries.t: The fire supplied with fuel.
entries.na: النار ذات الوقود
entries.nt: the fire supplied with fuel

entries.a: إِذْ هُمْ عَلَيْهَا قُعُودٌۭ
entries.t: While they sat around it.
entries.na: اذ هم عليها قعود
entries.nt: while they sat around it

entries.a: وَهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَفْعَلُونَ بِٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ شُهُودٌۭ
entries.t: And were witnessing what they did to the believers.
entries.na: وهم علي ما يفعلون بالمومنين شهود
entries.nt: and were witnessing what they did to the believers

entries.a: وَمَا نَقَمُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ إِلَّآ أَن يُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَمِيدِ
entries.t: They begrudged them only because they believed in God the Almighty, the Praiseworthy.
entries.na: وما نقموا منهم الا ان يومنوا بالله العزيز الحميد
entries.nt: they begrudged them only because they believed in god the almighty the praiseworthy

entries.a: ٱلَّذِى لَهُۥ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ شَهِيدٌ
entries.t: To Whom belongs the sovereignty of the heavens and the earth. God is witness over everything.
entries.na: الذي له ملك السموت والارض والله علي كل شي شهيد
entries.nt: to whom belongs the sovereignty of the heavens and the earth god is witness over everything

entries.a: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ فَتَنُوا۟ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَٰتِ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَتُوبُوا۟ فَلَهُمْ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابُ ٱلْحَرِيقِ
entries.t: Those who tempt the believers, men and women, then do not repent; for them is the punishment of Hell; for them is the punishment of Burning.
entries.na: ان الذين فتنوا المومنين والمومنت ثم لم يتوبوا فلهم عذاب جهنم ولهم عذاب الحريق
entries.nt: those who tempt the believers men and women then do not repent for them is the punishment of hell for them is the punishment of burning

entries.a: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُمْ جَنَّٰتٌۭ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْكَبِيرُ
entries.t: Those who believe and do righteous deeds will have Gardens beneath which rivers flow. That is the great triumph.
entries.na: ان الذين امنوا وعملوا الصلحت لهم جنت تجري من تحتها الانهر ذلك الفوز الكبير
entries.nt: those who believe and do righteous deeds will have gardens beneath which rivers flow that is the great triumph

entries.a: إِنَّ بَطْشَ رَبِّكَ لَشَدِيدٌ
entries.t: The onslaught of your Lord is severe.
entries.na: ان بطش ربك لشديد
entries.nt: the onslaught of your lord is severe

entries.a: إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ يُبْدِئُ وَيُعِيدُ
entries.t: It is He who begins and repeats.
entries.na: انه هو يبدي ويعيد
entries.nt: it is he who begins and repeats

entries.a: وَهُوَ ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلْوَدُودُ
entries.t: And He is the Forgiving, the Loving.
entries.na: وهو الغفور الودود
entries.nt: and he is the forgiving the loving

entries.a: ذُو ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱلْمَجِيدُ
entries.t: Possessor of the Glorious Throne.
entries.na: ذو العرش المجيد
entries.nt: possessor of the glorious throne

entries.a: فَعَّالٌۭ لِّمَا يُرِيدُ
entries.t: Doer of whatever He wills.
entries.na: فعال لما يريد
entries.nt: doer of whatever he wills

entries.a: هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ٱلْجُنُودِ
entries.t: Has there come to you the story of the legions?
entries.na: هل اتيك حديث الجنود
entries.nt: has there come to you the story of the legions

entries.a: فِرْعَوْنَ وَثَمُودَ
entries.t: Of Pharaoh and Thamood?
entries.na: فرعون وثمود
entries.nt: of pharaoh and thamood

entries.a: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فِى تَكْذِيبٍۢ
entries.t: In fact, those who disbelieve are in denial.
entries.na: بل الذين كفروا في تكذيب
entries.nt: in fact those who disbelieve are in denial

entries.a: وَٱللَّهُ مِن وَرَآئِهِم مُّحِيطٌۢ
entries.t: And God encloses them from beyond.
entries.na: والله من ورايهم محيط
entries.nt: and god encloses them from beyond

entries.a: بَلْ هُوَ قُرْءَانٌۭ مَّجِيدٌۭ
entries.t: In fact, it is a Glorious Quran.
entries.na: بل هو قران مجيد
entries.nt: in fact it is a glorious quran

entries.a: فِى لَوْحٍۢ مَّحْفُوظٍۭ
entries.t: In a Preserved Tablet.
entries.na: في لوح محفوظ
entries.nt: in a preserved tablet

entries.a: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلطَّارِقِ
entries.t: By the sky and at-Tariq.
entries.na: والسما والطارق
entries.nt: by the sky and at tariq

entries.a: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلطَّارِقُ
entries.t: But what will let you know what at-Tariq is?
entries.na: وما ادريك ما الطارق
entries.nt: but what will let you know what at tariq is

entries.a: ٱلنَّجْمُ ٱلثَّاقِبُ
entries.t: The Piercing Star.
entries.na: النجم الثاقب
entries.nt: the piercing star

entries.a: إِن كُلُّ نَفْسٍۢ لَّمَّا عَلَيْهَا حَافِظٌۭ
entries.t: There is no soul without a Protector over it.
entries.na: ان كل نفس لما عليها حافظ
entries.nt: there is no soul without a protector over it

entries.a: فَلْيَنظُرِ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ مِمَّ خُلِقَ
entries.t: Let man consider what he was created from.
entries.na: فلينظر الانسن مم خلق
entries.nt: let man consider what he was created from

entries.a: خُلِقَ مِن مَّآءٍۢ دَافِقٍۢ
entries.t: He was created from gushing liquid.
entries.na: خلق من ما دافق
entries.nt: he was created from gushing liquid

entries.a: يَخْرُجُ مِنۢ بَيْنِ ٱلصُّلْبِ وَٱلتَّرَآئِبِ
entries.t: Issuing from between the backbone and the breastbones.
entries.na: يخرج من بين الصلب والترايب
entries.nt: issuing from between the backbone and the breastbones

entries.a: إِنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ رَجْعِهِۦ لَقَادِرٌۭ
entries.t: He is certainly able to return him.
entries.na: انه علي رجعه لقادر
entries.nt: he is certainly able to return him

entries.a: يَوْمَ تُبْلَى ٱلسَّرَآئِرُ
entries.t: On the Day when the secrets are disclosed.
entries.na: يوم تبلي السراير
entries.nt: on the day when the secrets are disclosed

entries.a: فَمَا لَهُۥ مِن قُوَّةٍۢ وَلَا نَاصِرٍۢ
entries.t: He will have no strength, and no supporter.
entries.na: فما له من قوه ولا ناصر
entries.nt: he will have no strength and no supporter

entries.a: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلرَّجْعِ
entries.t: By the sky that returns.
entries.na: والسما ذات الرجع
entries.nt: by the sky that returns

entries.a: وَٱلْأَرْضِ ذَاتِ ٱلصَّدْعِ
entries.t: And the earth that cracks open.
entries.na: والارض ذات الصدع
entries.nt: and the earth that cracks open

entries.a: إِنَّهُۥ لَقَوْلٌۭ فَصْلٌۭ
entries.t: It is a Decisive Word.
entries.na: انه لقول فصل
entries.nt: it is a decisive word

entries.a: وَمَا هُوَ بِٱلْهَزْلِ
entries.t: It is no joke.
entries.na: وما هو بالهزل
entries.nt: it is no joke

entries.a: إِنَّهُمْ يَكِيدُونَ كَيْدًۭا
entries.t: They plot and scheme.
entries.na: انهم يكيدون كيدا
entries.nt: they plot and scheme

entries.a: وَأَكِيدُ كَيْدًۭا
entries.t: But I plot and scheme.
entries.na: واكيد كيدا
entries.nt: but i plot and scheme

entries.a: فَمَهِّلِ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ أَمْهِلْهُمْ رُوَيْدًۢا
entries.t: Therefore, give the blasphemers respite, a brief respite.
entries.na: فمهل الكفرين امهلهم رويدا
entries.nt: therefore give the blasphemers respite a brief respite

entries.a: سَبِّحِ ٱسْمَ رَبِّكَ ٱلْأَعْلَى
entries.t: Praise the Name of your Lord, the Most High.
entries.na: سبح اسم ربك الاعلي
entries.nt: praise the name of your lord the most high

entries.a: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ فَسَوَّىٰ
entries.t: He who creates and regulates.
entries.na: الذي خلق فسوي
entries.nt: he who creates and regulates

entries.a: وَٱلَّذِى قَدَّرَ فَهَدَىٰ
entries.t: He who measures and guides.
entries.na: والذي قدر فهدي
entries.nt: he who measures and guides

entries.a: وَٱلَّذِىٓ أَخْرَجَ ٱلْمَرْعَىٰ
entries.t: He who produces the pasture.
entries.na: والذي اخرج المرعي
entries.nt: he who produces the pasture

entries.a: فَجَعَلَهُۥ غُثَآءً أَحْوَىٰ
entries.t: And then turns it into light debris.
entries.na: فجعله غثا احوي
entries.nt: and then turns it into light debris

entries.a: سَنُقْرِئُكَ فَلَا تَنسَىٰٓ
entries.t: We will make you read, so do not forget.
entries.na: سنقريك فلا تنسي
entries.nt: we will make you read so do not forget

entries.a: إِلَّا مَا شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ يَعْلَمُ ٱلْجَهْرَ وَمَا يَخْفَىٰ
entries.t: Except what God wills. He knows what is declared, and what is hidden.
entries.na: الا ما شا الله انه يعلم الجهر وما يخفي
entries.nt: except what god wills he knows what is declared and what is hidden

entries.a: وَنُيَسِّرُكَ لِلْيُسْرَىٰ
entries.t: We will ease you into the Easy Way.
entries.na: ونيسرك لليسري
entries.nt: we will ease you into the easy way

entries.a: فَذَكِّرْ إِن نَّفَعَتِ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ
entries.t: So remind, if reminding helps.
entries.na: فذكر ان نفعت الذكري
entries.nt: so remind if reminding helps

entries.a: سَيَذَّكَّرُ مَن يَخْشَىٰ
entries.t: The reverent will remember.
entries.na: سيذكر من يخشي
entries.nt: the reverent will remember

entries.a: وَيَتَجَنَّبُهَا ٱلْأَشْقَى
entries.t: But the wretched will avoid it.
entries.na: ويتجنبها الاشقي
entries.nt: but the wretched will avoid it

entries.a: ٱلَّذِى يَصْلَى ٱلنَّارَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ
entries.t: He who will enter the Gigantic Fire.
entries.na: الذي يصلي النار الكبري
entries.nt: he who will enter the gigantic fire

entries.a: ثُمَّ لَا يَمُوتُ فِيهَا وَلَا يَحْيَىٰ
entries.t: Where he will neither die, nor live.
entries.na: ثم لا يموت فيها ولا يحيي
entries.nt: where he will neither die nor live

entries.a: قَدْ أَفْلَحَ مَن تَزَكَّىٰ
entries.t: Successful is he who purifies himself.
entries.na: قد افلح من تزكي
entries.nt: successful is he who purifies himself

entries.a: وَذَكَرَ ٱسْمَ رَبِّهِۦ فَصَلَّىٰ
entries.t: And mentions the name of his Lord, and prays.
entries.na: وذكر اسم ربه فصلي
entries.nt: and mentions the name of his lord and prays

entries.a: بَلْ تُؤْثِرُونَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا
entries.t: But you prefer the present life.
entries.na: بل توثرون الحيوه الدنيا
entries.nt: but you prefer the present life

entries.a: وَٱلْءَاخِرَةُ خَيْرٌۭ وَأَبْقَىٰٓ
entries.t: Though the Hereafter is better, and more lasting.
entries.na: والاخره خير وابقي
entries.nt: though the hereafter is better and more lasting

entries.a: إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَفِى ٱلصُّحُفِ ٱلْأُولَىٰ
entries.t: This is in the former scriptures.
entries.na: ان هذا لفي الصحف الاولي
entries.nt: this is in the former scriptures

entries.a: صُحُفِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَمُوسَىٰ
entries.t: The Scriptures of Abraham and Moses.
entries.na: صحف ابرهيم وموسي
entries.nt: the scriptures of abraham and moses

entries.a: هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ٱلْغَٰشِيَةِ
entries.t: Has there come to you the news of the overwhelming?
entries.na: هل اتيك حديث الغشيه
entries.nt: has there come to you the news of the overwhelming

entries.a: وُجُوهٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍ خَٰشِعَةٌ
entries.t: Faces on that Day will be shamed.
entries.na: وجوه يوميذ خشعه
entries.nt: faces on that day will be shamed

entries.a: عَامِلَةٌۭ نَّاصِبَةٌۭ
entries.t: Laboring and exhausted.
entries.na: عامله ناصبه
entries.nt: laboring and exhausted

entries.a: تَصْلَىٰ نَارًا حَامِيَةًۭ
entries.t: Roasting in a scorching Fire.
entries.na: تصلي نارا حاميه
entries.nt: roasting in a scorching fire

entries.a: تُسْقَىٰ مِنْ عَيْنٍ ءَانِيَةٍۢ
entries.t: Given to drink from a flaming spring.
entries.na: تسقي من عين انيه
entries.nt: given to drink from a flaming spring

entries.a: لَّيْسَ لَهُمْ طَعَامٌ إِلَّا مِن ضَرِيعٍۢ
entries.t: They will have no food except thorns.
entries.na: ليس لهم طعام الا من ضريع
entries.nt: they will have no food except thorns

entries.a: لَّا يُسْمِنُ وَلَا يُغْنِى مِن جُوعٍۢ
entries.t: That neither nourishes, nor satisfies hunger.
entries.na: لا يسمن ولا يغني من جوع
entries.nt: that neither nourishes nor satisfies hunger

entries.a: وُجُوهٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ نَّاعِمَةٌۭ
entries.t: Faces on that Day will be joyful.
entries.na: وجوه يوميذ ناعمه
entries.nt: faces on that day will be joyful

entries.a: لِّسَعْيِهَا رَاضِيَةٌۭ
entries.t: Satisfied with their endeavor.
entries.na: لسعيها راضيه
entries.nt: satisfied with their endeavor

entries.a: فِى جَنَّةٍ عَالِيَةٍۢ
entries.t: In a lofty Garden.
entries.na: في جنه عاليه
entries.nt: in a lofty garden

entries.a: لَّا تَسْمَعُ فِيهَا لَٰغِيَةًۭ
entries.t: In it you will hear no nonsense.
entries.na: لا تسمع فيها لغيه
entries.nt: in it you will hear no nonsense

entries.a: فِيهَا عَيْنٌۭ جَارِيَةٌۭ
entries.t: In it is a flowing spring.
entries.na: فيها عين جاريه
entries.nt: in it is a flowing spring

entries.a: فِيهَا سُرُرٌۭ مَّرْفُوعَةٌۭ
entries.t: In it are raised beds.
entries.na: فيها سرر مرفوعه
entries.nt: in it are raised beds

entries.a: وَأَكْوَابٌۭ مَّوْضُوعَةٌۭ
entries.t: And cups set in place.
entries.na: واكواب موضوعه
entries.nt: and cups set in place

entries.a: وَنَمَارِقُ مَصْفُوفَةٌۭ
entries.t: And cushions set in rows.
entries.na: ونمارق مصفوفه
entries.nt: and cushions set in rows

entries.a: وَزَرَابِىُّ مَبْثُوثَةٌ
entries.t: And carpets spread around.
entries.na: وزرابي مبثوثه
entries.nt: and carpets spread around

entries.a: أَفَلَا يَنظُرُونَ إِلَى ٱلْإِبِلِ كَيْفَ خُلِقَتْ
entries.t: Do they not look at the camels-how they are created?
entries.na: افلا ينظرون الي الابل كيف خلقت
entries.nt: do they not look at the camels how they are created

entries.a: وَإِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ كَيْفَ رُفِعَتْ
entries.t: And at the sky-how it is raised?
entries.na: والي السما كيف رفعت
entries.nt: and at the sky how it is raised

entries.a: وَإِلَى ٱلْجِبَالِ كَيْفَ نُصِبَتْ
entries.t: And at the mountains-how they are installed?
entries.na: والي الجبال كيف نصبت
entries.nt: and at the mountains how they are installed

entries.a: وَإِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ كَيْفَ سُطِحَتْ
entries.t: And at the earth-how it is spread out?
entries.na: والي الارض كيف سطحت
entries.nt: and at the earth how it is spread out

entries.a: فَذَكِّرْ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مُذَكِّرٌۭ
entries.t: So remind. You are only a reminder.
entries.na: فذكر انما انت مذكر
entries.nt: so remind you are only a reminder

entries.a: لَّسْتَ عَلَيْهِم بِمُصَيْطِرٍ
entries.t: You have no control over them.
entries.na: لست عليهم بمصيطر
entries.nt: you have no control over them

entries.a: إِلَّا مَن تَوَلَّىٰ وَكَفَرَ
entries.t: But whoever turns away and disbelieves.
entries.na: الا من تولي وكفر
entries.nt: but whoever turns away and disbelieves

entries.a: فَيُعَذِّبُهُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلْأَكْبَرَ
entries.t: God will punish him with the greatest punishment.
entries.na: فيعذبه الله العذاب الاكبر
entries.nt: god will punish him with the greatest punishment

entries.a: إِنَّ إِلَيْنَآ إِيَابَهُمْ
entries.t: To Us is their return.
entries.na: ان الينا ايابهم
entries.nt: to us is their return

entries.a: ثُمَّ إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا حِسَابَهُم
entries.t: Then upon Us rests their reckoning.
entries.na: ثم ان علينا حسابهم
entries.nt: then upon us rests their reckoning

entries.a: وَٱلْفَجْرِ
entries.t: By the daybreak.
entries.na: والفجر
entries.nt: by the daybreak

entries.a: وَلَيَالٍ عَشْرٍۢ
entries.t: And ten nights.
entries.na: وليال عشر
entries.nt: and ten nights

entries.a: وَٱلشَّفْعِ وَٱلْوَتْرِ
entries.t: And the even and the odd.
entries.na: والشفع والوتر
entries.nt: and the even and the odd

entries.a: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا يَسْرِ
entries.t: And the night as it recedes.
entries.na: واليل اذا يسر
entries.nt: and the night as it recedes

entries.a: هَلْ فِى ذَٰلِكَ قَسَمٌۭ لِّذِى حِجْرٍ
entries.t: Is there in this an oath for a rational person?
entries.na: هل في ذلك قسم لذي حجر
entries.nt: is there in this an oath for a rational person

entries.a: أَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِعَادٍ
entries.t: Have you not seen how your Lord dealt with Aad?
entries.na: الم تر كيف فعل ربك بعاد
entries.nt: have you not seen how your lord dealt with aad

entries.a: إِرَمَ ذَاتِ ٱلْعِمَادِ
entries.t: Erum of the pillars.
entries.na: ارم ذات العماد
entries.nt: erum of the pillars

entries.a: ٱلَّتِى لَمْ يُخْلَقْ مِثْلُهَا فِى ٱلْبِلَٰدِ
entries.t: The like of which was never created in the land.
entries.na: التي لم يخلق مثلها في البلد
entries.nt: the like of which was never created in the land

entries.a: وَثَمُودَ ٱلَّذِينَ جَابُوا۟ ٱلصَّخْرَ بِٱلْوَادِ
entries.t: And Thamood-those who carved the rocks in the valley.
entries.na: وثمود الذين جابوا الصخر بالواد
entries.nt: and thamood those who carved the rocks in the valley

entries.a: وَفِرْعَوْنَ ذِى ٱلْأَوْتَادِ
entries.t: And Pharaoh of the Stakes.
entries.na: وفرعون ذي الاوتاد
entries.nt: and pharaoh of the stakes

entries.a: ٱلَّذِينَ طَغَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْبِلَٰدِ
entries.t: Those who committed excesses in the lands.
entries.na: الذين طغوا في البلد
entries.nt: those who committed excesses in the lands

entries.a: فَأَكْثَرُوا۟ فِيهَا ٱلْفَسَادَ
entries.t: And spread much corruption therein.
entries.na: فاكثروا فيها الفساد
entries.nt: and spread much corruption therein

entries.a: فَصَبَّ عَلَيْهِمْ رَبُّكَ سَوْطَ عَذَابٍ
entries.t: So your Lord poured down upon them a scourge of punishment.
entries.na: فصب عليهم ربك سوط عذاب
entries.nt: so your lord poured down upon them a scourge of punishment

entries.a: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَبِٱلْمِرْصَادِ
entries.t: Your Lord is on the lookout.
entries.na: ان ربك لبالمرصاد
entries.nt: your lord is on the lookout

entries.a: فَأَمَّا ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ إِذَا مَا ٱبْتَلَىٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ فَأَكْرَمَهُۥ وَنَعَّمَهُۥ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّىٓ أَكْرَمَنِ
entries.t: As for man, whenever his Lord tests him, and honors him, and prospers him, he says, "My Lord has honored me."
entries.na: فاما الانسن اذا ما ابتليه ربه فاكرمه ونعمه فيقول ربي اكرمن
entries.nt: as for man whenever his lord tests him and honors him and prospers him he says my lord has honored me

entries.a: وَأَمَّآ إِذَا مَا ٱبْتَلَىٰهُ فَقَدَرَ عَلَيْهِ رِزْقَهُۥ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّىٓ أَهَٰنَنِ
entries.t: But whenever He tests him, and restricts his livelihood for him, he says, "My Lord has insulted me."
entries.na: واما اذا ما ابتليه فقدر عليه رزقه فيقول ربي اهنن
entries.nt: but whenever he tests him and restricts his livelihood for him he says my lord has insulted me

entries.a: كَلَّا ۖ بَل لَّا تُكْرِمُونَ ٱلْيَتِيمَ
entries.t: Not at all. But you do not honor the orphan.
entries.na: كلا بل لا تكرمون اليتيم
entries.nt: not at all but you do not honor the orphan

entries.a: وَلَا تَحَٰٓضُّونَ عَلَىٰ طَعَامِ ٱلْمِسْكِينِ
entries.t: And you do not urge the feeding of the poor.
entries.na: ولا تحضون علي طعام المسكين
entries.nt: and you do not urge the feeding of the poor

entries.a: وَتَأْكُلُونَ ٱلتُّرَاثَ أَكْلًۭا لَّمًّۭا
entries.t: And you devour inheritance with all greed.
entries.na: وتاكلون التراث اكلا لما
entries.nt: and you devour inheritance with all greed

entries.a: وَتُحِبُّونَ ٱلْمَالَ حُبًّۭا جَمًّۭا
entries.t: And you love wealth with immense love.
entries.na: وتحبون المال حبا جما
entries.nt: and you love wealth with immense love

entries.a: كَلَّآ إِذَا دُكَّتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ دَكًّۭا دَكًّۭا
entries.t: No-when the earth is leveled, pounded, and crushed.
entries.na: كلا اذا دكت الارض دكا دكا
entries.nt: no when the earth is leveled pounded and crushed

entries.a: وَجَآءَ رَبُّكَ وَٱلْمَلَكُ صَفًّۭا صَفًّۭا
entries.t: And your Lord comes, with the angels, row after row.
entries.na: وجا ربك والملك صفا صفا
entries.nt: and your lord comes with the angels row after row

entries.a: وَجِا۟ىٓءَ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بِجَهَنَّمَ ۚ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ يَتَذَكَّرُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ وَأَنَّىٰ لَهُ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ
entries.t: And on that Day, Hell is brought forward. On that Day, man will remember, but how will remembrance avail him?
entries.na: وجاي يوميذ بجهنم يوميذ يتذكر الانسن واني له الذكري
entries.nt: and on that day hell is brought forward on that day man will remember but how will remembrance avail him

entries.a: يَقُولُ يَٰلَيْتَنِى قَدَّمْتُ لِحَيَاتِى
entries.t: He will say, "If only I had forwarded for my life."
entries.na: يقول يليتني قدمت لحياتي
entries.nt: he will say if only i had forwarded for my life

entries.a: فَيَوْمَئِذٍۢ لَّا يُعَذِّبُ عَذَابَهُۥٓ أَحَدٌۭ
entries.t: On that Day, none will punish as He punishes.
entries.na: فيوميذ لا يعذب عذابه احد
entries.nt: on that day none will punish as he punishes

entries.a: وَلَا يُوثِقُ وَثَاقَهُۥٓ أَحَدٌۭ
entries.t: And none will shackle as He shackles.
entries.na: ولا يوثق وثاقه احد
entries.nt: and none will shackle as he shackles

entries.a: يَٰٓأَيَّتُهَا ٱلنَّفْسُ ٱلْمُطْمَئِنَّةُ
entries.t: But as for you, O tranquil soul.
entries.na: يايتها النفس المطمينه
entries.nt: but as for you o tranquil soul

entries.a: ٱرْجِعِىٓ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكِ رَاضِيَةًۭ مَّرْضِيَّةًۭ
entries.t: Return to your Lord, pleased and accepted.
entries.na: ارجعي الي ربك راضيه مرضيه
entries.nt: return to your lord pleased and accepted

entries.a: فَٱدْخُلِى فِى عِبَٰدِى
entries.t: Enter among My servants.
entries.na: فادخلي في عبدي
entries.nt: enter among my servants

entries.a: وَٱدْخُلِى جَنَّتِى
entries.t: Enter My Paradise.
entries.na: وادخلي جنتي
entries.nt: enter my paradise

entries.a: لَآ أُقْسِمُ بِهَٰذَا ٱلْبَلَدِ
entries.t: I swear by this land.
entries.na: لا اقسم بهذا البلد
entries.nt: i swear by this land

entries.a: وَأَنتَ حِلٌّۢ بِهَٰذَا ٱلْبَلَدِ
entries.t: And you are a resident of this land.
entries.na: وانت حل بهذا البلد
entries.nt: and you are a resident of this land

entries.a: وَوَالِدٍۢ وَمَا وَلَدَ
entries.t: And by a father and what he fathered.
entries.na: ووالد وما ولد
entries.nt: and by a father and what he fathered

entries.a: لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ فِى كَبَدٍ
entries.t: We created man in distress.
entries.na: لقد خلقنا الانسن في كبد
entries.nt: we created man in distress

entries.a: أَيَحْسَبُ أَن لَّن يَقْدِرَ عَلَيْهِ أَحَدٌۭ
entries.t: Does he think that no one has power over him?
entries.na: ايحسب ان لن يقدر عليه احد
entries.nt: does he think that no one has power over him

entries.a: يَقُولُ أَهْلَكْتُ مَالًۭا لُّبَدًا
entries.t: He says, "I have used up so much money."
entries.na: يقول اهلكت مالا لبدا
entries.nt: he says i have used up so much money

entries.a: أَيَحْسَبُ أَن لَّمْ يَرَهُۥٓ أَحَدٌ
entries.t: Does he think that no one sees him?
entries.na: ايحسب ان لم يره احد
entries.nt: does he think that no one sees him

entries.a: أَلَمْ نَجْعَل لَّهُۥ عَيْنَيْنِ
entries.t: Did We not give him two eyes?
entries.na: الم نجعل له عينين
entries.nt: did we not give him two eyes

entries.a: وَلِسَانًۭا وَشَفَتَيْنِ
entries.t: And a tongue, and two lips?
entries.na: ولسانا وشفتين
entries.nt: and a tongue and two lips

entries.a: وَهَدَيْنَٰهُ ٱلنَّجْدَيْنِ
entries.t: And We showed him the two ways?
entries.na: وهدينه النجدين
entries.nt: and we showed him the two ways

entries.a: فَلَا ٱقْتَحَمَ ٱلْعَقَبَةَ
entries.t: But he did not brave the ascent.
entries.na: فلا اقتحم العقبه
entries.nt: but he did not brave the ascent

entries.a: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلْعَقَبَةُ
entries.t: And what will explain to you what the ascent is?
entries.na: وما ادريك ما العقبه
entries.nt: and what will explain to you what the ascent is

entries.a: فَكُّ رَقَبَةٍ
entries.t: The freeing of a slave.
entries.na: فك رقبه
entries.nt: the freeing of a slave

entries.a: أَوْ إِطْعَٰمٌۭ فِى يَوْمٍۢ ذِى مَسْغَبَةٍۢ
entries.t: Or the feeding on a day of hunger.
entries.na: او اطعم في يوم ذي مسغبه
entries.nt: or the feeding on a day of hunger

entries.a: يَتِيمًۭا ذَا مَقْرَبَةٍ
entries.t: An orphan near of kin.
entries.na: يتيما ذا مقربه
entries.nt: an orphan near of kin

entries.a: أَوْ مِسْكِينًۭا ذَا مَتْرَبَةٍۢ
entries.t: Or a destitute in the dust.
entries.na: او مسكينا ذا متربه
entries.nt: or a destitute in the dust

entries.a: ثُمَّ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلصَّبْرِ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلْمَرْحَمَةِ
entries.t: Then he becomes of those who believe, and advise one another to patience, and advise one another to kindness.
entries.na: ثم كان من الذين امنوا وتواصوا بالصبر وتواصوا بالمرحمه
entries.nt: then he becomes of those who believe and advise one another to patience and advise one another to kindness

entries.a: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْمَيْمَنَةِ
entries.t: These are the people of happiness.
entries.na: اوليك اصحب الميمنه
entries.nt: these are the people of happiness

entries.a: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا هُمْ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْمَشْـَٔمَةِ
entries.t: But as for those who defy Our revelations-these are the people of misery.
entries.na: والذين كفروا بايتنا هم اصحب المشمه
entries.nt: but as for those who defy our revelations these are the people of misery

entries.a: عَلَيْهِمْ نَارٌۭ مُّؤْصَدَةٌۢ
entries.t: Upon them is a padlocked Fire.
entries.na: عليهم نار موصده
entries.nt: upon them is a padlocked fire

entries.a: وَٱلشَّمْسِ وَضُحَىٰهَا
entries.t: By the sun and its radiance.
entries.na: والشمس وضحيها
entries.nt: by the sun and its radiance

entries.a: وَٱلْقَمَرِ إِذَا تَلَىٰهَا
entries.t: And the moon as it follows it.
entries.na: والقمر اذا تليها
entries.nt: and the moon as it follows it

entries.a: وَٱلنَّهَارِ إِذَا جَلَّىٰهَا
entries.t: And the day as it reveals it.
entries.na: والنهار اذا جليها
entries.nt: and the day as it reveals it

entries.a: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا يَغْشَىٰهَا
entries.t: And the night as it conceals it.
entries.na: واليل اذا يغشيها
entries.nt: and the night as it conceals it

entries.a: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ وَمَا بَنَىٰهَا
entries.t: And the sky and He who built it.
entries.na: والسما وما بنيها
entries.nt: and the sky and he who built it

entries.a: وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا طَحَىٰهَا
entries.t: And the earth and He who spread it.
entries.na: والارض وما طحيها
entries.nt: and the earth and he who spread it

entries.a: وَنَفْسٍۢ وَمَا سَوَّىٰهَا
entries.t: And the soul and He who proportioned it.
entries.na: ونفس وما سويها
entries.nt: and the soul and he who proportioned it

entries.a: فَأَلْهَمَهَا فُجُورَهَا وَتَقْوَىٰهَا
entries.t: And inspired it with its wickedness and its righteousness.
entries.na: فالهمها فجورها وتقويها
entries.nt: and inspired it with its wickedness and its righteousness

entries.a: قَدْ أَفْلَحَ مَن زَكَّىٰهَا
entries.t: Successful is he who purifies it.
entries.na: قد افلح من زكيها
entries.nt: successful is he who purifies it

entries.a: وَقَدْ خَابَ مَن دَسَّىٰهَا
entries.t: Failing is he who corrupts it.
entries.na: وقد خاب من دسيها
entries.nt: failing is he who corrupts it

entries.a: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ بِطَغْوَىٰهَآ
entries.t: Thamood denied in its pride.
entries.na: كذبت ثمود بطغويها
entries.nt: thamood denied in its pride

entries.a: إِذِ ٱنۢبَعَثَ أَشْقَىٰهَا
entries.t: When it followed its most wicked.
entries.na: اذ انبعث اشقيها
entries.nt: when it followed its most wicked

entries.a: فَقَالَ لَهُمْ رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ نَاقَةَ ٱللَّهِ وَسُقْيَٰهَا
entries.t: The messenger of God said to them, "This is the she-camel of God, so let her drink."
entries.na: فقال لهم رسول الله ناقه الله وسقيها
entries.nt: the messenger of god said to them this is the she camel of god so let her drink

entries.a: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَعَقَرُوهَا فَدَمْدَمَ عَلَيْهِمْ رَبُّهُم بِذَنۢبِهِمْ فَسَوَّىٰهَا
entries.t: But they called him a liar, and hamstrung her. So their Lord crushed them for their sin, and leveled it.
entries.na: فكذبوه فعقروها فدمدم عليهم ربهم بذنبهم فسويها
entries.nt: but they called him a liar and hamstrung her so their lord crushed them for their sin and leveled it

entries.a: وَلَا يَخَافُ عُقْبَٰهَا
entries.t: And He does not fear its sequel.
entries.na: ولا يخاف عقبها
entries.nt: and he does not fear its sequel

entries.a: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا يَغْشَىٰ
entries.t: By the night as it covers.
entries.na: واليل اذا يغشي
entries.nt: by the night as it covers

entries.a: وَٱلنَّهَارِ إِذَا تَجَلَّىٰ
entries.t: And the day as it reveals.
entries.na: والنهار اذا تجلي
entries.nt: and the day as it reveals

entries.a: وَمَا خَلَقَ ٱلذَّكَرَ وَٱلْأُنثَىٰٓ
entries.t: And He who created the male and the female.
entries.na: وما خلق الذكر والانثي
entries.nt: and he who created the male and the female

entries.a: إِنَّ سَعْيَكُمْ لَشَتَّىٰ
entries.t: Your endeavors are indeed diverse.
entries.na: ان سعيكم لشتي
entries.nt: your endeavors are indeed diverse

entries.a: فَأَمَّا مَنْ أَعْطَىٰ وَٱتَّقَىٰ
entries.t: As for him who gives and is righteous.
entries.na: فاما من اعطي واتقي
entries.nt: as for him who gives and is righteous

entries.a: وَصَدَّقَ بِٱلْحُسْنَىٰ
entries.t: And confirms goodness.
entries.na: وصدق بالحسني
entries.nt: and confirms goodness

entries.a: فَسَنُيَسِّرُهُۥ لِلْيُسْرَىٰ
entries.t: We will ease his way towards ease.
entries.na: فسنيسره لليسري
entries.nt: we will ease his way towards ease

entries.a: وَأَمَّا مَنۢ بَخِلَ وَٱسْتَغْنَىٰ
entries.t: But as for him who is stingy and complacent.
entries.na: واما من بخل واستغني
entries.nt: but as for him who is stingy and complacent

entries.a: وَكَذَّبَ بِٱلْحُسْنَىٰ
entries.t: And denies goodness.
entries.na: وكذب بالحسني
entries.nt: and denies goodness

entries.a: فَسَنُيَسِّرُهُۥ لِلْعُسْرَىٰ
entries.t: We will ease his way towards difficulty.
entries.na: فسنيسره للعسري
entries.nt: we will ease his way towards difficulty

entries.a: وَمَا يُغْنِى عَنْهُ مَالُهُۥٓ إِذَا تَرَدَّىٰٓ
entries.t: And his money will not avail him when he plummets.
entries.na: وما يغني عنه ماله اذا تردي
entries.nt: and his money will not avail him when he plummets

entries.a: إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا لَلْهُدَىٰ
entries.t: It is upon Us to guide.
entries.na: ان علينا للهدي
entries.nt: it is upon us to guide

entries.a: وَإِنَّ لَنَا لَلْءَاخِرَةَ وَٱلْأُولَىٰ
entries.t: And to Us belong the Last and the First.
entries.na: وان لنا للاخره والاولي
entries.nt: and to us belong the last and the first

entries.a: فَأَنذَرْتُكُمْ نَارًۭا تَلَظَّىٰ
entries.t: I have warned you of a Fierce Blaze.
entries.na: فانذرتكم نارا تلظي
entries.nt: i have warned you of a fierce blaze

entries.a: لَا يَصْلَىٰهَآ إِلَّا ٱلْأَشْقَى
entries.t: None will burn in it except the very wicked.
entries.na: لا يصليها الا الاشقي
entries.nt: none will burn in it except the very wicked

entries.a: ٱلَّذِى كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ
entries.t: He who denies and turns away.
entries.na: الذي كذب وتولي
entries.nt: he who denies and turns away

entries.a: وَسَيُجَنَّبُهَا ٱلْأَتْقَى
entries.t: But the devout will avoid it.
entries.na: وسيجنبها الاتقي
entries.nt: but the devout will avoid it

entries.a: ٱلَّذِى يُؤْتِى مَالَهُۥ يَتَزَكَّىٰ
entries.t: He who gives his money to become pure.
entries.na: الذي يوتي ماله يتزكي
entries.nt: he who gives his money to become pure

entries.a: وَمَا لِأَحَدٍ عِندَهُۥ مِن نِّعْمَةٍۢ تُجْزَىٰٓ
entries.t: Seeking no favor in return.
entries.na: وما لاحد عنده من نعمه تجزي
entries.nt: seeking no favor in return

entries.a: إِلَّا ٱبْتِغَآءَ وَجْهِ رَبِّهِ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ
entries.t: Only seeking the acceptance of his Lord, the Most High.
entries.na: الا ابتغا وجه ربه الاعلي
entries.nt: only seeking the acceptance of his lord the most high

entries.a: وَلَسَوْفَ يَرْضَىٰ
entries.t: And he will be satisfied.
entries.na: ولسوف يرضي
entries.nt: and he will be satisfied

entries.a: وَٱلضُّحَىٰ
entries.t: By the morning light.
entries.na: والضحي
entries.nt: by the morning light

entries.a: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا سَجَىٰ
entries.t: And the night as it settles.
entries.na: واليل اذا سجي
entries.nt: and the night as it settles

entries.a: مَا وَدَّعَكَ رَبُّكَ وَمَا قَلَىٰ
entries.t: Your Lord did not abandon you, nor did He forget.
entries.na: ما ودعك ربك وما قلي
entries.nt: your lord did not abandon you nor did he forget

entries.a: وَلَلْءَاخِرَةُ خَيْرٌۭ لَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْأُولَىٰ
entries.t: The Hereafter is better for you than the First.
entries.na: وللاخره خير لك من الاولي
entries.nt: the hereafter is better for you than the first

entries.a: وَلَسَوْفَ يُعْطِيكَ رَبُّكَ فَتَرْضَىٰٓ
entries.t: And your Lord will give you, and you will be satisfied.
entries.na: ولسوف يعطيك ربك فترضي
entries.nt: and your lord will give you and you will be satisfied

entries.a: أَلَمْ يَجِدْكَ يَتِيمًۭا فَـَٔاوَىٰ
entries.t: Did He not find you orphaned, and sheltered you?
entries.na: الم يجدك يتيما فاوي
entries.nt: did he not find you orphaned and sheltered you

entries.a: وَوَجَدَكَ ضَآلًّۭا فَهَدَىٰ
entries.t: And found you wandering, and guided you.
entries.na: ووجدك ضالا فهدي
entries.nt: and found you wandering and guided you

entries.a: وَوَجَدَكَ عَآئِلًۭا فَأَغْنَىٰ
entries.t: And found you in need, and enriched you?
entries.na: ووجدك عايلا فاغني
entries.nt: and found you in need and enriched you

entries.a: فَأَمَّا ٱلْيَتِيمَ فَلَا تَقْهَرْ
entries.t: Therefore, do not mistreat the orphan.
entries.na: فاما اليتيم فلا تقهر
entries.nt: therefore do not mistreat the orphan

entries.a: وَأَمَّا ٱلسَّآئِلَ فَلَا تَنْهَرْ
entries.t: Nor rebuff the seeker.
entries.na: واما السايل فلا تنهر
entries.nt: nor rebuff the seeker

entries.a: وَأَمَّا بِنِعْمَةِ رَبِّكَ فَحَدِّثْ
entries.t: But proclaim the blessings of your Lord.
entries.na: واما بنعمه ربك فحدث
entries.nt: but proclaim the blessings of your lord

entries.a: أَلَمْ نَشْرَحْ لَكَ صَدْرَكَ
entries.t: Did We not soothe your heart?
entries.na: الم نشرح لك صدرك
entries.nt: did we not soothe your heart

entries.a: وَوَضَعْنَا عَنكَ وِزْرَكَ
entries.t: And lift from you your burden.
entries.na: ووضعنا عنك وزرك
entries.nt: and lift from you your burden

entries.a: ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنقَضَ ظَهْرَكَ
entries.t: Which weighed down your back?
entries.na: الذي انقض ظهرك
entries.nt: which weighed down your back

entries.a: وَرَفَعْنَا لَكَ ذِكْرَكَ
entries.t: And raised for you your reputation?
entries.na: ورفعنا لك ذكرك
entries.nt: and raised for you your reputation

entries.a: فَإِنَّ مَعَ ٱلْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا
entries.t: With hardship comes ease.
entries.na: فان مع العسر يسرا
entries.nt: with hardship comes ease

entries.a: إِنَّ مَعَ ٱلْعُسْرِ يُسْرًۭا
entries.t: With hardship comes ease.
entries.na: ان مع العسر يسرا
entries.nt: with hardship comes ease

entries.a: فَإِذَا فَرَغْتَ فَٱنصَبْ
entries.t: When your work is done, turn to devotion.
entries.na: فاذا فرغت فانصب
entries.nt: when your work is done turn to devotion

entries.a: وَإِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ فَٱرْغَب
entries.t: And to your Lord turn for everything.
entries.na: والي ربك فارغب
entries.nt: and to your lord turn for everything

entries.a: وَٱلتِّينِ وَٱلزَّيْتُونِ
entries.t: By the fig and the olive.
entries.na: والتين والزيتون
entries.nt: by the fig and the olive

entries.a: وَطُورِ سِينِينَ
entries.t: And Mount Sinai.
entries.na: وطور سينين
entries.nt: and mount sinai

entries.a: وَهَٰذَا ٱلْبَلَدِ ٱلْأَمِينِ
entries.t: And this safe land.
entries.na: وهذا البلد الامين
entries.nt: and this safe land

entries.a: لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ فِىٓ أَحْسَنِ تَقْوِيمٍۢ
entries.t: We created man in the best design.
entries.na: لقد خلقنا الانسن في احسن تقويم
entries.nt: we created man in the best design

entries.a: ثُمَّ رَدَدْنَٰهُ أَسْفَلَ سَٰفِلِينَ
entries.t: Then reduced him to the lowest of the low.
entries.na: ثم رددنه اسفل سفلين
entries.nt: then reduced him to the lowest of the low

entries.a: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ فَلَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍۢ
entries.t: Except those who believe and do righteous deeds; for them is a reward without end.
entries.na: الا الذين امنوا وعملوا الصلحت فلهم اجر غير ممنون
entries.nt: except those who believe and do righteous deeds for them is a reward without end

entries.a: فَمَا يُكَذِّبُكَ بَعْدُ بِٱلدِّينِ
entries.t: So why do you still reject the religion?
entries.na: فما يكذبك بعد بالدين
entries.nt: so why do you still reject the religion

entries.a: أَلَيْسَ ٱللَّهُ بِأَحْكَمِ ٱلْحَٰكِمِينَ
entries.t: Is God not the Wisest of the wise?
entries.na: اليس الله باحكم الحكمين
entries.nt: is god not the wisest of the wise

entries.a: ٱقْرَأْ بِٱسْمِ رَبِّكَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ
entries.t: Read: In the Name of your Lord who created.
entries.na: اقرا باسم ربك الذي خلق
entries.nt: read in the name of your lord who created

entries.a: خَلَقَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ مِنْ عَلَقٍ
entries.t: Created man from a clot.
entries.na: خلق الانسن من علق
entries.nt: created man from a clot

entries.a: ٱقْرَأْ وَرَبُّكَ ٱلْأَكْرَمُ
entries.t: Read: And your Lord is the Most Generous.
entries.na: اقرا وربك الاكرم
entries.nt: read and your lord is the most generous

entries.a: ٱلَّذِى عَلَّمَ بِٱلْقَلَمِ
entries.t: He who taught by the pen.
entries.na: الذي علم بالقلم
entries.nt: he who taught by the pen

entries.a: عَلَّمَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ مَا لَمْ يَعْلَمْ
entries.t: Taught man what he never knew.
entries.na: علم الانسن ما لم يعلم
entries.nt: taught man what he never knew

entries.a: كَلَّآ إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ لَيَطْغَىٰٓ
entries.t: In fact, man oversteps all bounds.
entries.na: كلا ان الانسن ليطغي
entries.nt: in fact man oversteps all bounds

entries.a: أَن رَّءَاهُ ٱسْتَغْنَىٰٓ
entries.t: When he considers himself exempt.
entries.na: ان راه استغني
entries.nt: when he considers himself exempt

entries.a: إِنَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ ٱلرُّجْعَىٰٓ
entries.t: But to your Lord is the return.
entries.na: ان الي ربك الرجعي
entries.nt: but to your lord is the return

entries.a: أَرَءَيْتَ ٱلَّذِى يَنْهَىٰ
entries.t: Have you seen him who prevents?
entries.na: اريت الذي ينهي
entries.nt: have you seen him who prevents

entries.a: عَبْدًا إِذَا صَلَّىٰٓ
entries.t: A servant when he prays?
entries.na: عبدا اذا صلي
entries.nt: a servant when he prays

entries.a: أَرَءَيْتَ إِن كَانَ عَلَى ٱلْهُدَىٰٓ
entries.t: Do you think he is upon guidance?
entries.na: اريت ان كان علي الهدي
entries.nt: do you think he is upon guidance

entries.a: أَوْ أَمَرَ بِٱلتَّقْوَىٰٓ
entries.t: Or advocates righteousness?
entries.na: او امر بالتقوي
entries.nt: or advocates righteousness

entries.a: أَرَءَيْتَ إِن كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰٓ
entries.t: Do you see how he disbelieved and turned away?
entries.na: اريت ان كذب وتولي
entries.nt: do you see how he disbelieved and turned away

entries.a: أَلَمْ يَعْلَم بِأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَرَىٰ
entries.t: Does he not know that God sees?
entries.na: الم يعلم بان الله يري
entries.nt: does he not know that god sees

entries.a: كَلَّا لَئِن لَّمْ يَنتَهِ لَنَسْفَعًۢا بِٱلنَّاصِيَةِ
entries.t: No. If he does not desist, We will drag him by the forelock.
entries.na: كلا لين لم ينته لنسفعا بالناصيه
entries.nt: no if he does not desist we will drag him by the forelock

entries.a: نَاصِيَةٍۢ كَٰذِبَةٍ خَاطِئَةٍۢ
entries.t: A deceitful, sinful forelock.
entries.na: ناصيه كذبه خاطيه
entries.nt: a deceitful sinful forelock

entries.a: فَلْيَدْعُ نَادِيَهُۥ
entries.t: Let him call on his gang.
entries.na: فليدع ناديه
entries.nt: let him call on his gang

entries.a: سَنَدْعُ ٱلزَّبَانِيَةَ
entries.t: We will call the Guards.
entries.na: سندع الزبانيه
entries.nt: we will call the guards

entries.a: كَلَّا لَا تُطِعْهُ وَٱسْجُدْ وَٱقْتَرِب ۩
entries.t: No, do not obey him; but kneel down, and come near.
entries.na: كلا لا تطعه واسجد واقترب
entries.nt: no do not obey him but kneel down and come near

entries.a: إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَٰهُ فِى لَيْلَةِ ٱلْقَدْرِ
entries.t: We sent it down on the Night of Decree.
entries.na: انا انزلنه في ليله القدر
entries.nt: we sent it down on the night of decree

entries.a: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا لَيْلَةُ ٱلْقَدْرِ
entries.t: But what will convey to you what the Night of Decree is?
entries.na: وما ادريك ما ليله القدر
entries.nt: but what will convey to you what the night of decree is

entries.a: لَيْلَةُ ٱلْقَدْرِ خَيْرٌۭ مِّنْ أَلْفِ شَهْرٍۢ
entries.t: The Night of Decree is better than a thousand months.
entries.na: ليله القدر خير من الف شهر
entries.nt: the night of decree is better than a thousand months

entries.a: تَنَزَّلُ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ فِيهَا بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِم مِّن كُلِّ أَمْرٍۢ
entries.t: In it descend the angels and the Spirit, by the leave of their Lord, with every command.
entries.na: تنزل المليكه والروح فيها باذن ربهم من كل امر
entries.nt: in it descend the angels and the spirit by the leave of their lord with every command

entries.a: سَلَٰمٌ هِىَ حَتَّىٰ مَطْلَعِ ٱلْفَجْرِ
entries.t: Peace it is; until the rise of dawn.
entries.na: سلم هي حتي مطلع الفجر
entries.nt: peace it is until the rise of dawn

entries.a: لَمْ يَكُنِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ وَٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ مُنفَكِّينَ حَتَّىٰ تَأْتِيَهُمُ ٱلْبَيِّنَةُ
entries.t: Those who disbelieved among the People of the Scripture, and the Polytheists, were not apart, until the Clear Evidence came to them.
entries.na: لم يكن الذين كفروا من اهل الكتب والمشركين منفكين حتي تاتيهم البينه
entries.nt: those who disbelieved among the people of the scripture and the polytheists were not apart until the clear evidence came to them

entries.a: رَسُولٌۭ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ يَتْلُوا۟ صُحُفًۭا مُّطَهَّرَةًۭ
entries.t: A messenger from God reciting purified scripts.
entries.na: رسول من الله يتلوا صحفا مطهره
entries.nt: a messenger from god reciting purified scripts

entries.a: فِيهَا كُتُبٌۭ قَيِّمَةٌۭ
entries.t: In them are valuable writings.
entries.na: فيها كتب قيمه
entries.nt: in them are valuable writings

entries.a: وَمَا تَفَرَّقَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَآءَتْهُمُ ٱلْبَيِّنَةُ
entries.t: Those who were given the Scripture did not splinter, except after the Clear Evidence came to them.
entries.na: وما تفرق الذين اوتوا الكتب الا من بعد ما جاتهم البينه
entries.nt: those who were given the scripture did not splinter except after the clear evidence came to them

entries.a: وَمَآ أُمِرُوٓا۟ إِلَّا لِيَعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ ٱلدِّينَ حُنَفَآءَ وَيُقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَيُؤْتُوا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ ۚ وَذَٰلِكَ دِينُ ٱلْقَيِّمَةِ
entries.t: They were commanded only to worship God, devoting their faith to Him alone, and to practice regular prayer, and to give alms. That is the upright religion.
entries.na: وما امروا الا ليعبدوا الله مخلصين له الدين حنفا ويقيموا الصلوه ويوتوا الزكوه وذلك دين القيمه
entries.nt: they were commanded only to worship god devoting their faith to him alone and to practice regular prayer and to give alms that is the upright religion

entries.a: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ وَٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ فِى نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ ۚ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمْ شَرُّ ٱلْبَرِيَّةِ
entries.t: Those who disbelieve among the People of the Scripture, and the Polytheists, will be in the Fire of Hell, where they will abide forever. These are the worst of creatures.
entries.na: ان الذين كفروا من اهل الكتب والمشركين في نار جهنم خلدين فيها اوليك هم شر البريه
entries.nt: those who disbelieve among the people of the scripture and the polytheists will be in the fire of hell where they will abide forever these are the worst of creatures

entries.a: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمْ خَيْرُ ٱلْبَرِيَّةِ
entries.t: As for those who believe and lead a righteous life-these are the best of creatures.
entries.na: ان الذين امنوا وعملوا الصلحت اوليك هم خير البريه
entries.nt: as for those who believe and lead a righteous life these are the best of creatures

entries.a: جَزَآؤُهُمْ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ جَنَّٰتُ عَدْنٍۢ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدًۭا ۖ رَّضِىَ ٱللَّهُ عَنْهُمْ وَرَضُوا۟ عَنْهُ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ لِمَنْ خَشِىَ رَبَّهُۥ
entries.t: Their reward is with their Lord: Gardens of Eternity beneath which rivers flow, where they will abide forever. God is pleased with them, and they are pleased with Him. That is for whoever fears His Lord.
entries.na: جزاوهم عند ربهم جنت عدن تجري من تحتها الانهر خلدين فيها ابدا رضي الله عنهم ورضوا عنه ذلك لمن خشي ربه
entries.nt: their reward is with their lord gardens of eternity beneath which rivers flow where they will abide forever god is pleased with them and they are pleased with him that is for whoever fears his lord

entries.a: إِذَا زُلْزِلَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ زِلْزَالَهَا
entries.t: When the earth is shaken with its quake.
entries.na: اذا زلزلت الارض زلزالها
entries.nt: when the earth is shaken with its quake

entries.a: وَأَخْرَجَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ أَثْقَالَهَا
entries.t: And the earth brings out its loads.
entries.na: واخرجت الارض اثقالها
entries.nt: and the earth brings out its loads

entries.a: وَقَالَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ مَا لَهَا
entries.t: And man says, "What is the matter with it?"
entries.na: وقال الانسن ما لها
entries.nt: and man says what is the matter with it

entries.a: يَوْمَئِذٍۢ تُحَدِّثُ أَخْبَارَهَا
entries.t: On that Day, it will tell its tales.
entries.na: يوميذ تحدث اخبارها
entries.nt: on that day it will tell its tales

entries.a: بِأَنَّ رَبَّكَ أَوْحَىٰ لَهَا
entries.t: For your Lord will have inspired it.
entries.na: بان ربك اوحي لها
entries.nt: for your lord will have inspired it

entries.a: يَوْمَئِذٍۢ يَصْدُرُ ٱلنَّاسُ أَشْتَاتًۭا لِّيُرَوْا۟ أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ
entries.t: On that Day, the people will emerge in droves, to be shown their works.
entries.na: يوميذ يصدر الناس اشتاتا ليروا اعملهم
entries.nt: on that day the people will emerge in droves to be shown their works

entries.a: فَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيْرًۭا يَرَهُۥ
entries.t: Whoever has done an atom's weight of good will see it.
entries.na: فمن يعمل مثقال ذره خيرا يره
entries.nt: whoever has done an atom s weight of good will see it

entries.a: وَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍۢ شَرًّۭا يَرَهُۥ
entries.t: And whoever has done an atom's weight of evil will see it.
entries.na: ومن يعمل مثقال ذره شرا يره
entries.nt: and whoever has done an atom s weight of evil will see it

entries.a: وَٱلْعَٰدِيَٰتِ ضَبْحًۭا
entries.t: By the racers panting.
entries.na: والعديت ضبحا
entries.nt: by the racers panting

entries.a: فَٱلْمُورِيَٰتِ قَدْحًۭا
entries.t: Igniting sparks.
entries.na: فالموريت قدحا
entries.nt: igniting sparks

entries.a: فَٱلْمُغِيرَٰتِ صُبْحًۭا
entries.t: Raiding at dawn.
entries.na: فالمغيرت صبحا
entries.nt: raiding at dawn

entries.a: فَأَثَرْنَ بِهِۦ نَقْعًۭا
entries.t: Raising clouds of dust.
entries.na: فاثرن به نقعا
entries.nt: raising clouds of dust

entries.a: فَوَسَطْنَ بِهِۦ جَمْعًا
entries.t: Storming into the midst.
entries.na: فوسطن به جمعا
entries.nt: storming into the midst

entries.a: إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ لِرَبِّهِۦ لَكَنُودٌۭ
entries.t: Indeed, the human being is ungrateful to his Lord.
entries.na: ان الانسن لربه لكنود
entries.nt: indeed the human being is ungrateful to his lord

entries.a: وَإِنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ ذَٰلِكَ لَشَهِيدٌۭ
entries.t: And he bears witness to that.
entries.na: وانه علي ذلك لشهيد
entries.nt: and he bears witness to that

entries.a: وَإِنَّهُۥ لِحُبِّ ٱلْخَيْرِ لَشَدِيدٌ
entries.t: And he is fierce in his love of wealth.
entries.na: وانه لحب الخير لشديد
entries.nt: and he is fierce in his love of wealth

entries.a: ۞ أَفَلَا يَعْلَمُ إِذَا بُعْثِرَ مَا فِى ٱلْقُبُورِ
entries.t: Does he not know? When the contents of the graves are scattered around.
entries.na: افلا يعلم اذا بعثر ما في القبور
entries.nt: does he not know when the contents of the graves are scattered around

entries.a: وَحُصِّلَ مَا فِى ٱلصُّدُورِ
entries.t: And the contents of the hearts are obtained.
entries.na: وحصل ما في الصدور
entries.nt: and the contents of the hearts are obtained

entries.a: إِنَّ رَبَّهُم بِهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لَّخَبِيرٌۢ
entries.t: Their Lord, on that Day, is fully informed of them.
entries.na: ان ربهم بهم يوميذ لخبير
entries.nt: their lord on that day is fully informed of them

entries.a: ٱلْقَارِعَةُ
entries.t: The Shocker.
entries.na: القارعه
entries.nt: the shocker

entries.a: مَا ٱلْقَارِعَةُ
entries.t: What is the Shocker?
entries.na: ما القارعه
entries.nt: what is the shocker

entries.a: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلْقَارِعَةُ
entries.t: What will explain to you what the Shocker is?
entries.na: وما ادريك ما القارعه
entries.nt: what will explain to you what the shocker is

entries.a: يَوْمَ يَكُونُ ٱلنَّاسُ كَٱلْفَرَاشِ ٱلْمَبْثُوثِ
entries.t: The Day when the people will be like scattered moths.
entries.na: يوم يكون الناس كالفراش المبثوث
entries.nt: the day when the people will be like scattered moths

entries.a: وَتَكُونُ ٱلْجِبَالُ كَٱلْعِهْنِ ٱلْمَنفُوشِ
entries.t: And the mountains will be like tufted wool.
entries.na: وتكون الجبال كالعهن المنفوش
entries.nt: and the mountains will be like tufted wool

entries.a: فَأَمَّا مَن ثَقُلَتْ مَوَٰزِينُهُۥ
entries.t: As for he whose scales are heavy.
entries.na: فاما من ثقلت موزينه
entries.nt: as for he whose scales are heavy

entries.a: فَهُوَ فِى عِيشَةٍۢ رَّاضِيَةٍۢ
entries.t: He will be in a pleasant life.
entries.na: فهو في عيشه راضيه
entries.nt: he will be in a pleasant life

entries.a: وَأَمَّا مَنْ خَفَّتْ مَوَٰزِينُهُۥ
entries.t: But as for he whose scales are light.
entries.na: واما من خفت موزينه
entries.nt: but as for he whose scales are light

entries.a: فَأُمُّهُۥ هَاوِيَةٌۭ
entries.t: His home is the Abyss.
entries.na: فامه هاويه
entries.nt: his home is the abyss

entries.a: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا هِيَهْ
entries.t: Do you know what it is?
entries.na: وما ادريك ما هيه
entries.nt: do you know what it is

entries.a: نَارٌ حَامِيَةٌۢ
entries.t: A Raging Fire.
entries.na: نار حاميه
entries.nt: a raging fire

entries.a: أَلْهَىٰكُمُ ٱلتَّكَاثُرُ
entries.t: Abundance distracts you.
entries.na: الهيكم التكاثر
entries.nt: abundance distracts you

entries.a: حَتَّىٰ زُرْتُمُ ٱلْمَقَابِرَ
entries.t: Until you visit the graveyards.
entries.na: حتي زرتم المقابر
entries.nt: until you visit the graveyards

entries.a: كَلَّا سَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ
entries.t: Indeed, you will know.
entries.na: كلا سوف تعلمون
entries.nt: indeed you will know

entries.a: ثُمَّ كَلَّا سَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ
entries.t: Certainly, you will know.
entries.na: ثم كلا سوف تعلمون
entries.nt: certainly you will know

entries.a: كَلَّا لَوْ تَعْلَمُونَ عِلْمَ ٱلْيَقِينِ
entries.t: If you knew with knowledge of certainty.
entries.na: كلا لو تعلمون علم اليقين
entries.nt: if you knew with knowledge of certainty

entries.a: لَتَرَوُنَّ ٱلْجَحِيمَ
entries.t: You would see the Inferno.
entries.na: لترون الجحيم
entries.nt: you would see the inferno

entries.a: ثُمَّ لَتَرَوُنَّهَا عَيْنَ ٱلْيَقِينِ
entries.t: Then you will see it with the eye of certainty.
entries.na: ثم لترونها عين اليقين
entries.nt: then you will see it with the eye of certainty

entries.a: ثُمَّ لَتُسْـَٔلُنَّ يَوْمَئِذٍ عَنِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
entries.t: Then, on that Day, you will be questioned about the Bliss.
entries.na: ثم لتسلن يوميذ عن النعيم
entries.nt: then on that day you will be questioned about the bliss

entries.a: وَٱلْعَصْرِ
entries.t: By time.
entries.na: والعصر
entries.nt: by time

entries.a: إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ لَفِى خُسْرٍ
entries.t: The human being is in loss.
entries.na: ان الانسن لفي خسر
entries.nt: the human being is in loss

entries.a: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلصَّبْرِ
entries.t: Except those who believe, and do good works, and encourage truth, and recommend patience.
entries.na: الا الذين امنوا وعملوا الصلحت وتواصوا بالحق وتواصوا بالصبر
entries.nt: except those who believe and do good works and encourage truth and recommend patience

entries.a: وَيْلٌۭ لِّكُلِّ هُمَزَةٍۢ لُّمَزَةٍ
entries.t: Woe to every slanderer backbiter.
entries.na: ويل لكل همزه لمزه
entries.nt: woe to every slanderer backbiter

entries.a: ٱلَّذِى جَمَعَ مَالًۭا وَعَدَّدَهُۥ
entries.t: Who gathers wealth and counts it over.
entries.na: الذي جمع مالا وعدده
entries.nt: who gathers wealth and counts it over

entries.a: يَحْسَبُ أَنَّ مَالَهُۥٓ أَخْلَدَهُۥ
entries.t: Thinking that his wealth has made him immortal.
entries.na: يحسب ان ماله اخلده
entries.nt: thinking that his wealth has made him immortal

entries.a: كَلَّا ۖ لَيُنۢبَذَنَّ فِى ٱلْحُطَمَةِ
entries.t: By no means. He will be thrown into the Crusher.
entries.na: كلا لينبذن في الحطمه
entries.nt: by no means he will be thrown into the crusher

entries.a: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلْحُطَمَةُ
entries.t: And what will make you realize what the Crusher is?
entries.na: وما ادريك ما الحطمه
entries.nt: and what will make you realize what the crusher is

entries.a: نَارُ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُوقَدَةُ
entries.t: God's kindled Fire.
entries.na: نار الله الموقده
entries.nt: god s kindled fire

entries.a: ٱلَّتِى تَطَّلِعُ عَلَى ٱلْأَفْـِٔدَةِ
entries.t: That laps to the hearts.
entries.na: التي تطلع علي الافده
entries.nt: that laps to the hearts

entries.a: إِنَّهَا عَلَيْهِم مُّؤْصَدَةٌۭ
entries.t: It closes in on them.
entries.na: انها عليهم موصده
entries.nt: it closes in on them

entries.a: فِى عَمَدٍۢ مُّمَدَّدَةٍۭ
entries.t: In extended columns.
entries.na: في عمد ممدده
entries.nt: in extended columns

entries.a: أَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِأَصْحَٰبِ ٱلْفِيلِ
entries.t: Have you not considered how your Lord dealt with the People of the Elephant?
entries.na: الم تر كيف فعل ربك باصحب الفيل
entries.nt: have you not considered how your lord dealt with the people of the elephant

entries.a: أَلَمْ يَجْعَلْ كَيْدَهُمْ فِى تَضْلِيلٍۢ
entries.t: Did He not make their plan go wrong?
entries.na: الم يجعل كيدهم في تضليل
entries.nt: did he not make their plan go wrong

entries.a: وَأَرْسَلَ عَلَيْهِمْ طَيْرًا أَبَابِيلَ
entries.t: He sent against them swarms of birds.
entries.na: وارسل عليهم طيرا ابابيل
entries.nt: he sent against them swarms of birds

entries.a: تَرْمِيهِم بِحِجَارَةٍۢ مِّن سِجِّيلٍۢ
entries.t: Throwing at them rocks of baked clay.
entries.na: ترميهم بحجاره من سجيل
entries.nt: throwing at them rocks of baked clay

entries.a: فَجَعَلَهُمْ كَعَصْفٍۢ مَّأْكُولٍۭ
entries.t: Leaving them like chewed-up leaves.
entries.na: فجعلهم كعصف ماكول
entries.nt: leaving them like chewed up leaves

entries.a: لِإِيلَٰفِ قُرَيْشٍ
entries.t: For the security of Quraish.
entries.na: لايلف قريش
entries.nt: for the security of quraish

entries.a: إِۦلَٰفِهِمْ رِحْلَةَ ٱلشِّتَآءِ وَٱلصَّيْفِ
entries.t: Their security during winter and summer journeys.
entries.na: الفهم رحله الشتا والصيف
entries.nt: their security during winter and summer journeys

entries.a: فَلْيَعْبُدُوا۟ رَبَّ هَٰذَا ٱلْبَيْتِ
entries.t: Let them worship the Lord of this House.
entries.na: فليعبدوا رب هذا البيت
entries.nt: let them worship the lord of this house

entries.a: ٱلَّذِىٓ أَطْعَمَهُم مِّن جُوعٍۢ وَءَامَنَهُم مِّنْ خَوْفٍۭ
entries.t: Who has fed them against hunger, and has secured them against fear.
entries.na: الذي اطعمهم من جوع وامنهم من خوف
entries.nt: who has fed them against hunger and has secured them against fear

entries.a: أَرَءَيْتَ ٱلَّذِى يُكَذِّبُ بِٱلدِّينِ
entries.t: Have you considered him who denies the religion?
entries.na: اريت الذي يكذب بالدين
entries.nt: have you considered him who denies the religion

entries.a: فَذَٰلِكَ ٱلَّذِى يَدُعُّ ٱلْيَتِيمَ
entries.t: It is he who mistreats the orphan.
entries.na: فذلك الذي يدع اليتيم
entries.nt: it is he who mistreats the orphan

entries.a: وَلَا يَحُضُّ عَلَىٰ طَعَامِ ٱلْمِسْكِينِ
entries.t: And does not encourage the feeding of the poor.
entries.na: ولا يحض علي طعام المسكين
entries.nt: and does not encourage the feeding of the poor

entries.a: فَوَيْلٌۭ لِّلْمُصَلِّينَ
entries.t: So woe to those who pray.
entries.na: فويل للمصلين
entries.nt: so woe to those who pray

entries.a: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَن صَلَاتِهِمْ سَاهُونَ
entries.t: Those who are heedless of their prayers.
entries.na: الذين هم عن صلاتهم ساهون
entries.nt: those who are heedless of their prayers

entries.a: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ يُرَآءُونَ
entries.t: Those who put on the appearance.
entries.na: الذين هم يراون
entries.nt: those who put on the appearance

entries.a: وَيَمْنَعُونَ ٱلْمَاعُونَ
entries.t: And withhold the assistance.
entries.na: ويمنعون الماعون
entries.nt: and withhold the assistance

entries.a: إِنَّآ أَعْطَيْنَٰكَ ٱلْكَوْثَرَ
entries.t: We have given you plenty.
entries.na: انا اعطينك الكوثر
entries.nt: we have given you plenty

entries.a: فَصَلِّ لِرَبِّكَ وَٱنْحَرْ
entries.t: So pray to your Lord and sacrifice.
entries.na: فصل لربك وانحر
entries.nt: so pray to your lord and sacrifice

entries.a: إِنَّ شَانِئَكَ هُوَ ٱلْأَبْتَرُ
entries.t: He who hates you is the loser.
entries.na: ان شانيك هو الابتر
entries.nt: he who hates you is the loser

entries.a: قُلْ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ
entries.t: Say, "O disbelievers.
entries.na: قل يايها الكفرون
entries.nt: say o disbelievers

entries.a: لَآ أَعْبُدُ مَا تَعْبُدُونَ
entries.t: I do not worship what you worship.
entries.na: لا اعبد ما تعبدون
entries.nt: i do not worship what you worship

entries.a: وَلَآ أَنتُمْ عَٰبِدُونَ مَآ أَعْبُدُ
entries.t: Nor do you worship what I worship.
entries.na: ولا انتم عبدون ما اعبد
entries.nt: nor do you worship what i worship

entries.a: وَلَآ أَنَا۠ عَابِدٌۭ مَّا عَبَدتُّمْ
entries.t: Nor do I serve what you serve.
entries.na: ولا انا عابد ما عبدتم
entries.nt: nor do i serve what you serve

entries.a: وَلَآ أَنتُمْ عَٰبِدُونَ مَآ أَعْبُدُ
entries.t: Nor do you serve what I serve.
entries.na: ولا انتم عبدون ما اعبد
entries.nt: nor do you serve what i serve

entries.a: لَكُمْ دِينُكُمْ وَلِىَ دِينِ
entries.t: You have your way, and I have my way."
entries.na: لكم دينكم ولي دين
entries.nt: you have your way and i have my way

entries.a: إِذَا جَآءَ نَصْرُ ٱللَّهِ وَٱلْفَتْحُ
entries.t: When there comes God's victory, and conquest.
entries.na: اذا جا نصر الله والفتح
entries.nt: when there comes god s victory and conquest

entries.a: وَرَأَيْتَ ٱلنَّاسَ يَدْخُلُونَ فِى دِينِ ٱللَّهِ أَفْوَاجًۭا
entries.t: And you see the people entering God's religion in multitudes.
entries.na: ورايت الناس يدخلون في دين الله افواجا
entries.nt: and you see the people entering god s religion in multitudes

entries.a: فَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ وَٱسْتَغْفِرْهُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ تَوَّابًۢا
entries.t: Then celebrate the praise of your Lord, and seek His forgiveness. He is the Accepter of Repentance.
entries.na: فسبح بحمد ربك واستغفره انه كان توابا
entries.nt: then celebrate the praise of your lord and seek his forgiveness he is the accepter of repentance

entries.a: تَبَّتْ يَدَآ أَبِى لَهَبٍۢ وَتَبَّ
entries.t: Condemned are the hands of Abee Lahab, and he is condemned.
entries.na: تبت يدا ابي لهب وتب
entries.nt: condemned are the hands of abee lahab and he is condemned

entries.a: مَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُ مَالُهُۥ وَمَا كَسَبَ
entries.t: His wealth did not avail him, nor did what he acquired.
entries.na: ما اغني عنه ماله وما كسب
entries.nt: his wealth did not avail him nor did what he acquired

entries.a: سَيَصْلَىٰ نَارًۭا ذَاتَ لَهَبٍۢ
entries.t: He will burn in a Flaming Fire.
entries.na: سيصلي نارا ذات لهب
entries.nt: he will burn in a flaming fire

entries.a: وَٱمْرَأَتُهُۥ حَمَّالَةَ ٱلْحَطَبِ
entries.t: And his wife-the firewood carrier.
entries.na: وامراته حماله الحطب
entries.nt: and his wife the firewood carrier

entries.a: فِى جِيدِهَا حَبْلٌۭ مِّن مَّسَدٍۭ
entries.t: Around her neck is a rope of thorns.
entries.na: في جيدها حبل من مسد
entries.nt: around her neck is a rope of thorns

entries.a: قُلْ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدٌ
entries.t: Say, "He is God, the One.
entries.na: قل هو الله احد
entries.nt: say he is god the one

entries.a: ٱللَّهُ ٱلصَّمَدُ
entries.t: God, the Absolute.
entries.na: الله الصمد
entries.nt: god the absolute

entries.a: لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ
entries.t: He begets not, nor was He begotten.
entries.na: لم يلد ولم يولد
entries.nt: he begets not nor was he begotten

entries.a: وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُۥ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌۢ
entries.t: And there is nothing comparable to Him."
entries.na: ولم يكن له كفوا احد
entries.nt: and there is nothing comparable to him

entries.a: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلْفَلَقِ
entries.t: Say, "I take refuge with the Lord of Daybreak.
entries.na: قل اعوذ برب الفلق
entries.nt: say i take refuge with the lord of daybreak

entries.a: مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
entries.t: From the evil of what He created.
entries.na: من شر ما خلق
entries.nt: from the evil of what he created

entries.a: وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ
entries.t: And from the evil of the darkness as it gathers.
entries.na: ومن شر غاسق اذا وقب
entries.nt: and from the evil of the darkness as it gathers

entries.a: وَمِن شَرِّ ٱلنَّفَّٰثَٰتِ فِى ٱلْعُقَدِ
entries.t: And from the evil of those who practice sorcery.
entries.na: ومن شر النفثت في العقد
entries.nt: and from the evil of those who practice sorcery

entries.a: وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ
entries.t: And from the evil of an envious when he envies."
entries.na: ومن شر حاسد اذا حسد
entries.nt: and from the evil of an envious when he envies

entries.a: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلنَّاسِ
entries.t: Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind.
entries.na: قل اعوذ برب الناس
entries.nt: say i seek refuge in the lord of mankind

entries.a: مَلِكِ ٱلنَّاسِ
entries.t: The King of mankind.
entries.na: ملك الناس
entries.nt: the king of mankind

entries.a: إِلَٰهِ ٱلنَّاسِ
entries.t: The God of mankind.
entries.na: اله الناس
entries.nt: the god of mankind

entries.a: مِن شَرِّ ٱلْوَسْوَاسِ ٱلْخَنَّاسِ
entries.t: From the evil of the sneaky whisperer.
entries.na: من شر الوسواس الخناس
entries.nt: from the evil of the sneaky whisperer

entries.a: ٱلَّذِى يُوَسْوِسُ فِى صُدُورِ ٱلنَّاسِ
entries.t: Who whispers into the hearts of people.
entries.na: الذي يوسوس في صدور الناس
entries.nt: who whispers into the hearts of people

entries.a: مِنَ ٱلْجِنَّةِ وَٱلنَّاسِ
entries.t: From among jinn and among people."
entries.na: من الجنه والناس
entries.nt: from among jinn and among people
